product_posting.title: Product accounting
product_posting.hint: Default account and dimensions for document lines with this product. A line can override them, an empty field inherits from the category, otherwise the document posting template applies.
product_posting.double_entry_only: Default product accounts are used in double-entry bookkeeping only.
product_posting.revenue_hint: Class 6. Empty = by category, otherwise by the invoice posting template.
product_posting.expense_hint: Class 5. Applies when a purchase invoice line has neither its own account nor an expense kind.
product_posting.category_hint: Applies to products with this category as primary that have no account or dimension of their own. Inherited by subcategories.

accrual_period.hint: Period the revenue belongs to (annual subscription, rent, service). The invoice is posted in full; year-end closing defers the part beyond the year end to account 384.

other_items.title: Other receivables and payables
other_items.subtitle: Manual items, taxes and payroll liabilities in one place.
other_items.sources_hint: Payroll and taxes are managed in their source module.
other_items.form_hint: You can attach documents after saving the item, from its detail page.
other_items.search: Search title, counterparty, number or reference
other_items.partner_directory: Choose a counterparty from the address book
other_items.accounting_hint: Accounts can be filled in later, but are required before posting. Choose them according to the actual transaction.
other_items.posting_lines_hint: The receivable or payable stays on one account for the full amount. Split the other side across counter accounts.
other_items.posting_lines_invalid: Enter every counter account and amount so the sum matches the item amount.
other_items.tax_classification_hint: In tax evidence, check the tax classification of each actual payment. This item's kind does not classify income or expense automatically.
other_items.foreign_payment_hint: Matching a foreign currency payment requires exchange rate settlement.
other_items.result_impact_title: Other items in the profit forecast
other_items.result_impact_hint: Current year total by revenue or expense counter account. Includes posted items and labeled drafts; balance sheet items are excluded.
other_items.repost_hint: The original entry will be reversed and a new one posted on the selected date. The date must be in an open period.
other_items.repost_required: Choose both accounts, a valid date and a reason of at least three characters.
other_items.repost_unchanged: The selected accounts are the same as before.
other_items.repost_paid: This item has allocated payments. Unlink them before reposting.
other_items.confirm_confirm: Confirm this item in tax evidence?
other_items.confirm_reverse: Reverse this item and its journal entry?
other_items.confirm_delete: Remove this draft? A recurring occurrence remains in its schedule as cancelled.
other_items.reason_required: Enter a reason of at least three characters.
other_items.reverse_paid: This item has payments. Unlink them before reversing it.
other_items.validation_required: Enter a title, kind, dates and a positive amount.

plans.schedule_hint: A daily task creates items up to 90 days ahead; you can also create them manually. Documents linked to the source item are linked to each item.
plans.auto_post: Automatically post items when they arise
plans.auto_post_hint: A confirmed template is posted no earlier than the item's issue date, into an open period. Future items remain drafts. Without this option, all items require manual confirmation.
plans.auto_post_source: Confirm or post the source item before enabling automatic posting.
plans.source_inactive: The source item was reversed. Recurrence has stopped; existing drafts remain listed.
plans.no_generated: No later items have been created yet.
plans.installments_hint: Installments spread payment of one document across the cash flow forecast. They do not create journal entries.
plans.paid_locked: The schedule cannot be changed after a payment is allocated.

invoice_default_note.title: Default note below items
invoice_default_note.hint: Text pre-filled into the note below items on every newly created document. You can rewrite or delete it in the document at any time; already issued documents are left untouched.
invoice_default_note.enabled_hint: While this is off, nothing is pre-filled.
invoice_default_note.language_hint: The variant follows the document language, not the currency. When the text for the document language is missing, the note stays empty.
invoice_default_note.placeholder: E.g. retention of title and the late payment interest rate.

time_billing.hint: Enter hours and minutes (1:20) or decimal hours (1.5).
time_billing.invalid: Enter H:MM or decimal hours. Minutes must be between 00 and 59.
time_billing.rate_hint: The hourly rate supports up to 6 decimal places.

payroll_bank.title: Send payroll payment order to bank
payroll_bank.hint: The saved KPC batch will be handed to the bank for authorization. Review and authorize it in online banking. Sending does not mark payroll liabilities as paid.
payroll_bank.unavailable: This batch cannot currently be submitted directly to the bank.
payroll_bank.confirm: Send payroll batch {reference} with {count} payments totaling {amount} through {provider}? Review and authorize payments in online banking.

creditas_bank.error_token_rejected: The bank denied access (HTTP 401/403). Check key validity, allowed operations and any access restrictions in CREDITAS. A certificate is not mandatory for token-only access.
creditas_bank.error_inactive: This account is inactive in MyÚčto. Activate it in Currencies and accounts first.
creditas_bank.error_response: The CREDITAS response does not match the expected format. Give your administrator the time of the attempt so the server-side cause can be checked.
creditas_bank.title: Connect Banka CREDITAS
creditas_bank.mtls_hint: Enter your security token and Account ID to connect. The client certificate is optional; attach it only if your specific bank access requires mutual TLS authentication (mTLS).
creditas_bank.token_hint: Create a security key for the selected account in CREDITAS online banking and grant the required permissions. The key contains exactly 64 letters and digits.
creditas_bank.account_hint: Account ID is the system identifier shown in the account details for an active API key, not the account number or IBAN. Select the correct account type; the server verifies its account number and currency.
creditas_bank.server_hint: The administrator must provide a server encryption key and, when a client certificate is used, mTLS support. Credentials and the certificate private key are not displayed or saved in browser storage.
creditas_bank.payment_hint: Submitting payment files requires the key's extended payment-entry permission. File submission does not replace bank authorization or confirm settlement; statements confirm payment.
creditas_bank.account_id: Account ID from API key details
creditas_bank.credentials_hint: If your bank access requires a certificate, choose a .p12/.pfx file including the private key, up to 24 KiB. When replacing credentials, re-enter the token and Account ID; attach the certificate if you want to continue using it. Fields are cleared after a successful save.
creditas_bank.unchanged: Stored credentials remain hidden and unchanged. You do not need to enter them again to pause or re-enable the connection.
creditas_bank.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect CREDITAS and remove stored credentials? Previously imported statements and payment submission history will be retained.
creditas_bank.invalid_token: The security key must contain exactly 64 letters and digits.
creditas_bank.error_account_id: Account ID must contain 1 to 40 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Use the identifier from API key details.
creditas_bank.error_certificate: The selected certificate could not be read or is invalid. Use a .p12/.pfx file up to 24 KiB and check its password.
creditas_bank.error_certificate_runtime: The server lacks required client certificate support. The administrator must check PHP, cURL and OpenSSL.
creditas_bank.error_credentials: Credentials are incomplete or invalid. Check the 64-character token, Account ID and account type. If you use a certificate, also check its validity and password.
creditas_bank.error_encryption: The administrator must configure a valid server encryption key to securely store credentials.
creditas_bank.error_account: The account or currency returned by the bank does not match this MyÚčto account. Check Account ID, account type and token permissions.
creditas_bank.error_remote: The connection to CREDITAS could not be completed. Check bank availability and token permissions; if your access uses mTLS, also check the client certificate.
creditas_bank.error_cooldown: The request limit has been reached. Wait before trying again.
creditas_bank.error_busy: Another operation is running for this account. Try again shortly.
creditas_bank.error_generic: The CREDITAS connection could not be completed. Check credentials and server readiness.

kb_plus.title: KB Business
kb_plus.intro: KB+ is the banking application; this connection uses the Extra service API Business. It is not the legacy KB Business API for MojeBanka. With the Plus variant the connector reads transactions via ADAA and sends payment batches via BATCHDA; with the Basic variant it downloads KM statements via STATDA.
kb_plus.prerequisite_bank: Business accounts require KB+ with a paid Standard Business, Komfort Business or Exclusive Business tariff and a separately activated Extra service API Business. KB+ alone or the free Start Business tariff is not sufficient. KB's FAQ also permits private individuals with an active Premium service; confirm eligibility for your account with KB.
kb_plus.prerequisite_plan: The Business banking tariff and API Business service variant are separate products. Basic is free and only provides statements for previous business days (STATDA service), at most 50 downloads per month. Plus reads transactions (ADAA service) at most once per 61 minutes and includes payment batches, Pro once per 10 minutes. Set your contracted variant below. Confirm current pricing, scope and limits with the bank.
kb_plus.prerequisite_activation: First select an Extra service API Business variant in KB+ and conclude the agreement. Then connect in MyÚčto. Manage existing consents in KB+: Settings → Service settings → Account access → Third-party access. Contact kbplus{'@'}kb.cz if options or permissions are missing.
kb_plus.prerequisite_subscriptions: Technical application registration is a separate administrator step: subscribe to the Client Registration, OAuth and ADAA APIs at developers.kb.cz; each has its own key. For the Basic variant also subscribe to the Statements Direct API (STATDA); its key is not entered in the form, statements are authorised by the consent with the statda permission. Payment batches (BATCHDA) do not need a separate key. Select I also want payment batches during registration and the application is registered at KB with the bpisp permission as well. Fill in the BatchDA key only if KB issued one to you. These keys do not replace the bank service agreement or the account owner's consent.
kb_plus.official_service: KB API Business terms and variants
kb_plus.official_faq: Activation and consent management in KB+
kb_plus.prerequisite_certificate: A qualified client certificate supported by KB, in .p12/.pfx format including its private key. A regular communication certificate from another bank is not a replacement.
kb_plus.prerequisite_server: A public HTTPS application address, a server encryption key and an application contact email. The server checks readiness.
kb_plus.logging_warning: Notice: KB callback URLs may contain sensitive registration data or authorization codes. Web server, proxy or application logs may retain them. We recommend disabling or redacting these parameters in logs. This notice does not block connection.
kb_plus.authorization_hint: Access consent or submitting a payment file does not mean payment was made. Authorize payments in online banking when required; statements confirm actual settlement.
kb_plus.field_batchda_api_key: BatchDA API key (optional, only if KB issued one to you)
kb_plus.payment_batches_hint: The KB registration also requests the bpisp permission for sending payment batches. Select it only if your Extra service API Business variant includes batches; otherwise KB rejects the registration.
kb_plus.credentials_hint: Credentials are sent only to the application server and are not stored in browser storage. Fields are cleared after a registration attempt. The certificate must not exceed 24 KiB.
kb_plus.existing_client_hint: The application is already registered for this company. Continue to KB to grant or renew access to this account; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable: Sending payment orders to KB is currently not active and the application cannot verify why. Transactions import normally. Refresh the connection status; if the notice remains, verify the connection again.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_registration: Sending payment orders to KB is not active because the application is registered at KB for reading transactions only, without the bpisp permission. Transactions import normally. For payment batches, choose Enter keys again, select I also want payment batches and complete the registration and consent at KB.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_authorization: The application is registered at KB for payment batches, but the granted account consent does not include the bpisp permission yet. Transactions import normally. Choose Start new verification in KB+ and grant a new consent; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.batch_unavailable_plan_basic: Sending payment orders to KB is unavailable because the Basic variant is selected, which only provides statements. After switching to Plus in KB+, change the variant above and start a new verification for payment batches.
kb_plus.statements_unavailable_registration: Transactions cannot be imported now: the selected variant reads data via {service}, but the application is registered at KB without this permission. Choose Enter keys again and complete the registration and consent at KB.
kb_plus.statements_unavailable_authorization: Transactions cannot be imported now: the selected variant reads data via {service}, but the granted account consent does not include this permission. Choose Start new verification in KB+ and grant a new consent; you do not need to enter the keys again.
kb_plus.plan_intro: Select the variant contracted with KB. It determines how often transactions are downloaded and whether payment orders can be sent.
kb_plus.plan_basic_hint: KM statements (STATDA) for previous business days only, downloaded automatically once a day (KB allows at most 50 downloads per month). Read-only, payment orders cannot be sent. Switching from Plus requires a registration and consent with the statda permission.
kb_plus.plan_plus_hint: Transactions including today, downloaded automatically at most once per 61 minutes. Also supports payment batches (BATCHDA) if the consent includes the bpisp permission. Select it for the Pro variant too.
kb_plus.plan_saved: The API Business variant has been saved.
kb_plus.error_plan: The API Business variant could not be saved. Refresh the connection status and try again.
kb_plus.restart_confirm: Start new verification with KB? This invalidates the previous unfinished verification link.
kb_plus.redirecting: Registration has started. Redirecting to the secure KB page.
kb_plus.connected: The bank confirmed access to the correct account and currency. You can now import statements using synchronization.
kb_plus.pending_hint: Verification is not complete. Finish the open KB step and refresh the status. Starting again invalidates the previous unfinished link.
kb_plus.server_not_ready: Server configuration currently prevents connection. Contact the application administrator.
kb_plus.status_not_registered: The application is not registered for KB+ yet.
kb_plus.status_registered: The application is registered. Continue to grant account access.
kb_plus.status_registration_pending: Waiting for application registration confirmation at KB.
kb_plus.status_authorization_pending: Waiting for account access consent at KB.
kb_plus.status_expired: Previous verification has expired. Start a new verification.
kb_plus.error_registration_invalid: KB did not complete registration or returned invalid registration details. Check API keys, the certificate and bank application settings.
kb_plus.error_expired: The verification link expired. Start a new verification.
kb_plus.error_used: This verification link has already been used or replaced. Refresh the status and start again if needed.
kb_plus.error_account_not_found: The bank did not grant access to this account and currency. Check the account and consent scope granted at KB.
kb_plus.error_account_ambiguous: The bank returned multiple possible accounts. The connection was not saved for safety; ask your administrator to check account identification.
kb_plus.error_encryption: The administrator must configure a valid server encryption key to securely store bank credentials.
kb_plus.error_app_url: The administrator must configure the public HTTPS application address and matching KB callbacks.
kb_plus.error_callback_redaction: The administrator must ensure that web server, proxy and application logs do not retain sensitive bank callback parameters.
kb_plus.error_contact: The administrator must configure a valid application contact email (at most 43 characters).
kb_plus.error_remote: The connection to KB could not be completed. Refresh the status; if the issue persists, check bank availability and server settings.
kb_plus.error_certificate: The certificate could not be read or is invalid. Select a qualified .p12/.pfx file up to 24 KiB and check its password.
kb_plus.error_certificate_runtime: The server lacks required client certificate support. The administrator must check PHP, cURL and OpenSSL configuration.
kb_plus.error_cooldown: The request limit has been reached. Wait before refreshing the connection status.
kb_plus.error_busy: Another operation is running for this account. Wait and refresh the status.
kb_plus.error_redirect: The server returned a disallowed redirect destination. The link was not opened for safety. Reload the page and contact the administrator.
kb_plus.error_registration_plan: The application registration at KB does not include the service the selected variant needs (Basic downloads statements via STATDA, Plus reads transactions via ADAA). Choose Enter keys again and register again.
kb_plus.error_credentials_rejected: KB rejected the API key or certificate. Check that the keys come from production services (not Sandbox) and belong to the right service, and that the certificate is qualified and contains the organization name and company ID.
kb_plus.error_generic: The KB+ connection could not be completed. Refresh the status and check server readiness and bank registration.

bank_connection.csas_sandbox_hint: Use the sandbox WEB-API-key, Client ID and Client Secret from Erste Developer Portal. Add Accounts API v3, mark the siblings.accounts scope as required and register the callback URL below. Test in a separate test company with a sandbox account, not in real accounting records. The sandbox returns static data; reconnect the account after changing environments.
bank_connection.csas_hint: Register an application for Česká spořitelna on Erste Developer Portal, add Premium Accounts API and OAuth2 Authorization Code. Register the exact callback URL below, obtain production access approval and activate Premium API with the bank. Enter the production API key, Client ID and Client Secret. You will be redirected to the bank to consent to selected accounts. MyÚčto connects only the account matching this number and currency; connect additional accounts separately.
bank_connection.csas_read_only: This connector imports booked transactions into the regular statement records and shared automatic synchronization. Informational and pending transactions are not posted. Payment submission, instant notifications and original statement file downloads are not implemented yet. KPC/PDF payment exports remain available.
bank_connection.csas_logging: Administrator warning: the bank callback contains a short-lived authorization code. Disable logging of sensitive callback parameters in web server, proxy and application logs. This warning does not block connection.
bank_connection.csas_server: The administrator must configure the bank credential encryption key.
bank_connection.csas_error: Česká spořitelna consent could not be completed. Check credentials, callback URL and account permissions, then restart the connection.
bank_connection.fio_help_title: API token for a specific account
bank_connection.csob_help_title: ČSOB CEB contract number and communication certificate
bank_connection.csob_no_files: ČSOB provided no GPC statement or BBF advice for this account and period. Check file generation and certificate permissions in CEB. Today's payment can be imported once the bank makes it available in an advice or statement.
bank_connection.rb_help_title: Application Client ID and Premium API certificate
bank_connection.account_verification_hint: Verify and save checks that access matches the configured account and currency. Credentials must belong to this specific account.
bank_connection.credentials_storage_hint: The administrator must configure a server encryption key. Credentials are stored encrypted and are not returned to the browser. For certificate connections, select a .p12/.pfx file including its private key and enter its password if protected.
bank_connection.payment_help_hint: Enable the required permission in the bank to submit payment orders. Submission does not replace authorization in online banking or confirm settlement. Direct submission supports domestic CZK orders only.
bank_connection.error_dns: The server could not resolve the bank address (DNS). The administrator must check server network settings.
bank_connection.error_connect: The server cannot connect to the bank. Check bank availability, firewall and proxy settings.
bank_connection.error_timeout: The bank request timed out. Check bank availability and try again later.
bank_connection.error_tls_handshake: The secure connection to the bank failed (TLS). This may be caused by a rejected client certificate or incompatible TLS; check the communication certificate issued and enabled in ČSOB CEB.
bank_connection.error_client_certificate: The server could not use the client certificate or private key for TLS. The administrator must check the PKCS#12 export and cURL/OpenSSL configuration.
bank_connection.error_server_certificate: The server does not trust the bank server certificate. The administrator must fix the trusted CA certificates; do not disable TLS verification.
bank_connection.error_ca_configuration: The server cannot load the trusted CA certificate store. The administrator must check PHP/cURL CA configuration and file permissions.
bank_connection.error_account_inactive: The bank account is inactive in MyÚčto. Edit it under Currencies and accounts, enable Active account and save. Then verify the connection again. The bank has not been contacted yet.
bank_connection.error_csob_rejected: ČSOB rejected the Business Connector request. Check service activation, the contract number and communication certificate permissions in CEB.
bank_connection.error_transport: The connection to the bank could not be established or completed. The administrator must check availability, TLS and the client certificate. This does not necessarily mean an incorrect password.
bank_connection.error_bank_http: The bank server returned an unsuccessful HTTP response. Check credentials, service activation and bank availability.
bank_connection.error_bank_response: The bank returned a response that the connector could not safely process. Response format compatibility must be checked; this step did not verify the account.
bank_connection.error_csob_pending: ČSOB has not prepared all files or their download is incomplete. Synchronization was not advanced. Try again later or check statements in CEB.
bank_connection.error_csob_evidence: No verifiable GPC statement with a transaction for this account and currency was found in the contract within the last 45 days. Check statement formats and certificate permissions in ČSOB CEB.
bank_connection.csob_hint: Activate Business Connector in ČSOB CEB and create a communication certificate. We import GPC statements and intraday BBF advices; enable their generation and download for the account in CEB. Enter the contract number, .p12/.pfx certificate and its password if protected. Verification checks contract access and does not require statements or transactions. Account number and currency are checked when each statement or advice is imported; connecting alone does not confirm access to the specific account.
bank_connection.csob_sync_hint: GPC statements and intraday BBF advices are imported for this account. Enable advice downloads and generation in BBF format in ČSOB CEB. Daily statements are usually available the following morning; today's transactions can be imported once the bank prepares an advice. Dates refer to file creation in ČSOB. Leave From empty for automatic continuation, or set both dates for up to 31 days. Pending files do not advance synchronization.
bank_connection.payment_status_import_started: The bank received the file and is processing the import. Check validation results and authorize the orders in internet banking. In CREDITAS, find the batch under Transakce → Zadané → Hromadné (Transactions → Submitted → Bulk). No payment has been executed by this step.
bank_connection.no_supported_accounts: None of your accounts currently supports a direct connection.
bank_connection.archive_cancelled_confirm: Order #{id} was submitted to the bank and cannot be permanently deleted. I confirm that I cancelled the entire batch in internet banking and none of its payments will be executed. Archive the order and hide it from the list? Submission history and duplicate submission protection will be retained. The application has not verified cancellation with the bank; invoice status and payment-order markers remain unchanged.
bank_connection.archived_cancelled: The order was archived based on your confirmation of cancellation in the bank.
bank_connection.certificate_unchanged: Leave all fields empty to retain stored credentials. To replace them, provide the Client ID, certificate and password together.
bank_connection.rb_hint: First contact your RB banker to confirm Premium API activation and batch payment import/statement download permissions for this account. The service may incur tariff charges. Developers.rb.cz only provides the application Client ID, not account access. After activation, create a Premium API certificate in internet banking, assign accounts and allowed operations, and download the .p12 file. If the option is missing, check availability and permissions with your banker. Payments are authorized in the bank; the certificate requires periodic unblocking.
bank_connection.error_certificate: Check the Client ID, valid PKCS#12 certificate and its password. The maximum file size is 24 kB.
bank_connection.error_certificate_runtime: The server requires PHP cURL with in-memory client certificate and key support, and the OpenSSL extension.
bank_connection.error_cooldown: The connection or bank has limited request frequency. Wait at least 30 seconds and try again.
bank_connection.error_busy: Another bank operation is running for this account. Wait for it to finish.
bank_connection.error_token: Check the Fio API token, its activation, permissions and expiry date.
bank_connection.error_token_kb_plus: KB denied access to the account (HTTP 401/403). The consent granted in KB+ may have expired or been revoked, or the request exceeded the contracted API Business variant. Check the selected variant (Basic or Plus), the consent in KB+ under Third-party access and, if needed, start a new verification in KB+.
bank_connection.error_token_moneta: MONETA rejected the token (HTTP 401/403). The token may have expired or been revoked. In Internet Banking open Settings / Other / API token management, create a new token and paste it here.
bank_connection.error_history_moneta: History is unavailable or the import has a gap. MONETA returns transactions at most 2 years back and older periods may require two-factor verification in Internet Banking. Fill in the missing period manually in ranges of at most 31 days.
bank_connection.error_history_kb_plus: History is unavailable or the import has a gap. Fill in the missing period manually in ranges of at most 31 days.
bank_connection.last_failed_kb_plus: The last import failed. Check the selected API Business variant and the consent in KB+, then try importing again.
bank_connection.kb_plus_sync_hint: An empty From date continues automatically from the last import; the To date is ignored. For a manual import fill in both dates, at most 31 days inclusive. With the Basic variant KB only provides statements up to the previous business day and at most 50 downloads per month; with Plus you can download once per 61 minutes.
bank_connection.error_kb_plus_statements: The Basic variant downloads statements via STATDA, but the consent granted at KB does not include this permission. In the KB+ connection choose Enter keys again, or Start new verification in KB+.
bank_connection.error_kb_plus_statement_pending: KB is still preparing the statement and the server cannot wait any longer. Synchronization was not advanced. The automatic import will fetch it (within 24 hours for the Basic variant), or you can try again manually later. With the Basic variant every attempt counts towards the limit of 50 downloads per month.
bank_connection.error_server: The server did not finish the import and returned no usable response. Synchronization was not advanced; try again in a few minutes. If the error persists, give the administrator the exact time of the attempt.
bank_connection.error_server_kb_plus: The server did not finish the import from KB. With the Basic variant KB prepares the statement first, which can take longer than the server can wait. Synchronization was not advanced; the automatic import will fetch it, or you can try again manually later. If the error persists, give the administrator the exact time of the attempt.
bank_connection.error_network: No response arrived from the server (the request timed out or the connection dropped). Reload the page and check whether the transactions were imported before trying again.
bank_connection.kb_plus_sync_progress: Importing from KB for {seconds} s. With the Basic variant the bank prepares the statement first, which can take up to a minute. Keep this page open.
bank_connection.error_history: History is unavailable or synchronization has a gap. Check the bank's history limit and import missing periods manually. Fio may require unlocking older history.
bank_connection.error_encryption: The administrator must check MYINVOICE_SECRET_KEY and the availability of the key used to store the token.
bank_connection.error_account: The account does not match the connection or its settings have changed. Check the account number, bank and currency, then verify the connection again.
bank_connection.error_reconciliation: The import stopped because more than one previously imported record matches the same transaction and the application cannot safely decide which one to keep. Review overlapping bank statements and duplicate transactions, reconcile them manually, then run synchronization again.
bank_connection.reconciliation_intro: Compare each new transaction with the previously imported record. Confirming marks them as the same payment, so another duplicate record will not be created.
bank_connection.reconciliation_wait: Confirmation will be available in {seconds} seconds due to the bank connection safety limit.
bank_connection.error_period: Choose a shorter period with both dates, at most 31 days. The period cannot end in the future.
bank_connection.error_payable: Documents have changed or been settled since the order was prepared. Check their outstanding amounts and prepare an up-to-date order.
bank_connection.error_date: The payment date is in the past. Prepare a new order with a current payment date.
bank_connection.error_payment_unavailable: This bank connection cannot send payment orders. The KB+ connection uses the Basic variant or its consent does not include payment batches; upload the order to the bank manually.
bank_connection.title: Direct bank connection
bank_connection.intro: Import transactions and submit payment orders directly to your bank. Available features depend on the bank.
bank_connection.no_accounts: Create a bank account in the list above first.
bank_connection.bank_unavailable: Direct connection is not available for this account yet.
bank_connection.token_hint: Create a Fio token in internet banking for this specific account. Read access is sufficient for importing transactions; payment orders also require permission to import payments. Tokens expire according to their bank settings; replace the token here when it expires.
bank_connection.moneta_hint: Create the token in MONETA Internet Banking under Settings / Other / API token management / Create token and confirm it in Smart Banka. The token covers all your MONETA accounts; the application uses it only for this account. Its validity is limited, so enable automatic renewal when creating it, otherwise replace the token here after it expires. Bulk payment orders sent from the application appear in Internet Banking under Messages and notifications, where they still have to be signed.
bank_connection.key_hint: The token is stored encrypted. The installation administrator must configure a dedicated server encryption key first.
bank_connection.token_required: Enter an account token to establish the first connection.
bank_connection.token_unchanged: Leave blank to retain the stored token
bank_connection.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this account and delete its stored token? Previously imported transactions and payment submission history will be retained.
bank_connection.last_failed: The last import failed. Check the token validity and try importing transactions again.
bank_connection.sync_hint: An empty From date automatically continues the previous import; To is ignored in this mode. For a manual import, enter both dates covering no more than 31 days inclusive. Overlapping periods can be imported again. Older history may need to be unlocked for the token in internet banking.
bank_connection.invalid_period: Enter both valid dates covering no more than 31 days inclusive, with From no later than To and To no later than today.
bank_connection.synced: Import complete. New transactions: {imported}, matched: {matched}, skipped duplicates: {skipped}.
bank_connection.payment_title: Submit a payment order to the bank
bank_connection.payment_hint: Submission only sends the order to the bank for authorization. Review and authorize it in internet banking. This step does not mark invoices as paid.
bank_connection.payment_czk_only: Direct submission is available only for domestic CZK payment orders.

rulesets.title: Payroll legislation rules
rulesets.subtitle: Rates, thresholds, deadlines and code lists used by the payroll calculation. The verified set ships effective and we stand behind it — there is nothing to approve or tick off, and every domain shows where its values come from. Overriding is possible and takes effect without a new release, but whoever enters the edited values stands behind them. Values are national and apply to every company.

category_note.risky_savings: The expense side (527) is tracked. If you post other payroll items to 527 as well, separate the contribution with an analytical account (e.g. 527.100).
category_note.non_monetary_neutral: An informational row, not a difference. Non-monetary benefits (typically 1 % of the vehicle purchase price) are not posted separately — the expense is already in the books from the source document, so they are excluded from the gross wages being compared.
category_note.partner_settlement: An offset pays out nothing — it only reclassifies the liability (331/366 debit / 365 credit). The Net pay category is lower by this amount and the payments column stays empty.
category_note.tax_bonus_receivable: An informational row, not a difference. Tax bonuses paid out exceeded the advance tax due; the excess reduces future remittances or is refunded on request (Sec. 35d(5)). The Income tax category already accounts for it.
category_note.unposted_liabilities: An informational row, not a difference. Employer liability insurance and benefits are paid from payroll but posted from their own document — the payroll bridge does not post them, so there is nothing to compare.

command_hint.lock_and_calculate: Locks the period inputs and calculates payroll right away. The lock freezes the input snapshot — anything entered afterwards stays out of the calculation and out of filings until the run is reopened. You see the pre-flight findings before anything is frozen.
command_hint.calculate: Recalculates payroll from the frozen input snapshot. The snapshot does not change, so you can recalculate as often as you need.
command_hint.approve: Approves the calculated payroll: stores the result as binding, creates payslips and records both the review and the approval in the run history. After approval the figures change only through a correction revision.
command_hint.post: Posts the approved payroll to the general ledger. A company on tax evidence gets no journal entry and the run simply moves on.
command_hint.prepare_payments: Prepares the payment liabilities (net pay, contributions, tax) and opens payments. This is where a missing verified institution account shows up.
command_hint.mark_paid: Marks contributions and net pay as settled. Only possible once every liability is covered by a matched payment.
command_hint.close: Closes the run for the period. A closed run can only be reopened by requesting a correction.
command_hint.reopen: Opens a new revision over corrected inputs. The original revision stays in the history together with the documents already issued.
command_hint.refresh_inputs: Takes a new snapshot of the current approved inputs, absences and statutory records and returns the run to recalculation. The work-in-progress revision stays in the history as abandoned; approved revisions are never affected.

annual_settlement.bonus_threshold_not_met: No annual bonus arose: income of {income} did not reach the annual threshold of {threshold}.

bonus_eligibility.income_below_threshold: No annual bonus arose: income of {income} did not reach the annual threshold of {threshold}.

annual_settlement.bonus_threshold_hint: The annual calculation reassesses every eligible month. It can therefore catch up the bonus for months in which the monthly income threshold was not met.

prior_employers_options.none: They had no other employer this year

blocker.not_requested: The employee did not ask for an annual settlement, or we have no record of it. Without a request no settlement is performed and the tax is settled by the advances withheld.
blocker.requested_after_deadline: The request arrived after 15 February. After that day the employer can no longer perform the annual settlement.
blocker.declaration_not_signed: The employee did not sign a taxpayer declaration with you for this year. Without it no credits are applied, monthly or annually.
blocker.declaration_unverified: The taxpayer declaration has no supporting evidence. Add it on the employee card.
blocker.prior_employer_documents_missing: Certificates from previous employers for this year are missing. The law does not allow a settlement without them.
blocker.prior_employer_documents_late: Certificates from previous employers arrived after 15 February.
blocker.must_file_tax_return: The employee files their own tax return. The employer must not perform an annual settlement for them.
blocker.filing_obligation_unknown: We do not know whether the employee files a tax return. Answer this — it decides whether a settlement is possible at all.
blocker.annual_only_claims_unsupported: The employee claims deductions or credits the application cannot compute yet. The settlement has to be done outside the application, or the employee files their own return.
blocker.annual_only_claims_unknown: We do not know whether the employee claims deductions or credits that apply only annually.
blocker.external_certificate_unverified: The certificate from a previous employer has no supporting evidence. Only an evidenced document may enter the whole-year total.
blocker.external_certificate_incomplete: The certificate from a previous employer is missing one of the figures the law requires. Fill them in under Certificate from another payer — until then the application will not guess them, because an incomplete total would produce an overpayment the employee is not entitled to.
blocker.accumulator_missing: The annual tax accumulation for this year is missing. Check the employee's opening balances and approved payroll.
blocker.no_approved_months: The employee has no approved month in this year, so there is nothing to settle.
blocker.settlement_deadline_passed: 31 March has passed — the day by which the employer performs the annual settlement.
blocker.non_resident: The employee is not a documented Czech tax resident. Employers do not perform an annual settlement for them.
blocker.credit_evidence_unverified: A tax credit claim has no supporting evidence, or the documented claims contradict each other.
blocker.child_evidence_unverified: A child tax benefit claim has no supporting evidence.
blocker.child_claim_conflict: The child claims contradict each other — check the child order, the shared-household confirmation and the exclusion of the other taxpayer.
blocker.child_jmhz_evidence_incomplete: Complete the child's name and date of birth on the child card, then state in the annual settlement documents whether another person in the shared household claimed the child.
blocker.takeover_child_claim_missing: In the months taken over from the previous payroll program the employee claimed the child tax benefit (credit or bonus), but the child records have no entitlement for them. Enter the child entitlement on the employee card retroactively from the first month it was claimed (typically January) — otherwise the settlement would reclaim a benefit the employee already received as unjustified.
blocker.already_settled: The annual settlement for this year has already been performed. It is done once a year.
blocker.ruleset_year_not_covered: We have no effective tax rules covering the whole of this year, so annual amounts cannot be derived.
blocker.tax_year_not_finished: The tax year has not ended yet. The annual settlement can only be performed from 1 January of the following year.
blocker.taxpayer_credit_evidence_missing: The employee has signed the taxpayer declaration, but the basic taxpayer credit is missing from their claim records. Add it on the employee card — without it the settlement would compute the tax without the annual credit.
blocker.request_date_missing: The request is recorded as submitted but has no submission date. Without it there is no proof the request arrived by 15 February. The record is saved — fill in the request date.
blocker.prior_documents_date_missing: The prior employers' documents are recorded as provided but have no receipt date. Without it the 15 February deadline cannot be evidenced. The record is saved — fill in the receipt date.

editor.title: New schedule or actual time
editor.difficulty_factors_hint: 1 to 255, for this record only. Leave empty when nothing differs from the usual state of the workplace — the count agreed on the employment is used instead.

plan_shifts.hint: Creates published shifts on all working days of the month from the employment's work calendar (without a calendar Monday to Friday at 8 h). Days that already have a shift are skipped. Sick-pay and vacation compensation need these shifts.

grid.title: Monthly attendance grid
grid.subtitle: One row per employee, one column per day. Type the hours worked into a cell — “8”, “8:30” or “7.5” all work. Exceptions (shifts across midnight, breaks, surcharge categories) stay in the row editor above.
grid.hours_hint: The record starts at the given time and lasts the entered hours plus the break. Cells hold net worked time.
grid.flag_notice: Night work, weekend, public holiday and difficult environment are flags over THE SAME hours, not extra hours. They are never added to time worked — that is always regular work plus overtime.
grid.month_approved: The month is approved, nothing can be written to it.
grid.saved_partially: Days saved: {saved}. Not saved: {failed} — they stay in the grid with the reason on the cell.
grid.save_failed: The grid could not be saved.
grid.filled: Days filled: {count}. Only empty cells were touched.
grid.skipped_absence: Days of approved absence skipped (sick leave, care, vacation…): {count}.
grid.absences_failed: The month's absences could not be loaded, so nothing was filled — days of sickness or vacation would otherwise get worked hours. Try again.
grid.filled_without_calendar: Days filled: {count}. {people} employments have no work calendar, so Monday to Friday at eight hours was assumed — such an estimate does not know about public holidays.
grid.copied: Days copied: {count} for {people} employees from {period}. Employees not found: {missing}. Days that do not fit this month: {skipped}.
grid.copy_failed: The previous month could not be loaded.
grid.keyboard_hint: Tab and arrows move around the grid, Enter jumps one row down, {primary}+Enter saves.
grid.mobile_note: The monthly grid needs a tablet or wider — on a phone a cell would be narrower than a finger. Use the row entry below, or the import.
grid.blocked_no_permission: You are not allowed to write attendance.
grid.blocked_nothing_changed: Nothing has changed yet. Type hours into a cell, or use a bulk action above the grid.
grid.blocked_flag_category: Bulk filling only makes sense for regular work and overtime. Flags (night, weekend, holiday, difficult environment) are entered on specific days.

problems.unparsable: The hours cannot be read. Write them as “8”, “8:30” or “7.5”.
problems.delete_unsupported: The grid does not delete records — deletion is a revision with a reason. Use the row editor.
problems.locked: The day holds several records of the same category, so one number cannot replace them. Edit it in the row editor.
problems.crosses_midnight: The day would run past midnight. Enter a shift across midnight in the row editor.
problems.invalid_wall_time: That time does not exist on this day (daylight saving change). Enter the day in the row editor.

overtime.title: Overtime — Section 93 Labour Code limits
overtime.consent_missing: No consent to overtime beyond the ordered limit is on record.
overtime.consent_open: Overtime consent on record from {from}, open-ended.
overtime.consent_until: Overtime consent on record from {from} to {to}.
overtime.consent_hint: Beyond the ordered limit (8 hours per week and 150 hours per year) overtime may only be required by agreement with the employee — Section 93(3) of the Labour Code. Record the date the agreement takes effect; without it all recorded overtime is measured against the ordered-overtime limits.
overtime.consent_failed: Overtime consent could not be saved.
overtime.consent_blocked_no_date: Fill in the date the agreement takes effect.
overtime.prefilled_date: Prefilled with the first day of the month on screen. Days before this date count as ordered overtime (8 h/week, 150 h/year).
overtime.prefilled_date_other_month: Prefilled with the first day of the browsed month {period}, not the date on the paperwork. Days before this date count as ordered overtime (8 h/week, 150 h/year) — correct the date when recording retroactively.
overtime.prohibition_banner: The recorded overtime breaches a statutory overtime ban. The payroll run cannot be approved until the finding is overridden with a reason.

compensatory_check.absence_without_compensation: Compensatory time off is recorded for this month, but no overtime record it offsets — the Section 93(5) exclusion will not apply.
compensatory_check.compensation_without_absence: Granted compensatory time off is recorded for this month, but attendance has no matching absence — payroll does not know about the time off.
compensatory_check.grant_date_unknown: Some compensatory time off has no grant date, so it cannot be assigned to a month.

overtime.averaging_hint: Total overtime must not exceed an average of 8 hours per week over an averaging period of at most 26 consecutive weeks. Only a collective agreement may extend it, to at most 52 weeks, so an extension requires a reference to that agreement. Without a setting, the statutory 26 weeks apply.
overtime.averaging_saved: The averaging period has been saved.
overtime.averaging_failed: The averaging period could not be saved.
overtime.averaging_load_failed: Existing averaging periods could not be loaded.
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_date: Enter the date the setting takes effect.
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_weeks: Enter the length in whole weeks.
overtime.averaging_blocked_statutory_max: Without a collective agreement the period may be at most 26 weeks (Section 93(4)).
overtime.averaging_blocked_collective_max: Not even a collective agreement may set a period longer than 52 weeks (Section 93(4)).
overtime.averaging_blocked_no_reference: Name the collective agreement that sets the longer period.
overtime.protection_hint: A pregnant employee must not work overtime at all; an employee caring for a child under one year of age may not be ordered to work overtime, although it may be agreed. Being a minor is not recorded here — it follows from the date of birth (Sections 245(1) and 350(2)).
overtime.protection_child_under_one: Caring for a child under one — overtime cannot be ordered
overtime.protection_saved: The overtime ban has been saved.
overtime.protection_failed: The overtime ban could not be saved.
overtime.protection_blocked_no_date: Enter the date the protection takes effect.
overtime.compensation_hint: Overtime compensated by time off is excluded from the averaging period under Section 93(4). What matters is the date the overtime fell on, not the day the employee took the time off. The entry does not affect the ordered-overtime limits under Section 93(2).

ztp_p_grant.hint: The day from which the card was granted (per the labour office decision). The double credit applies from the first month at whose start the card was valid.
ztp_p_grant.required: Enter the day the ZTP/P card was granted. It determines the month from which the double credit applies.
ztp_p_grant.double_from: The double credit applies from {date} based on the grant date on the child card.
ztp_p_grant.split: The double credit applies only from {date}. The claim will be saved in two parts: the basic amount until then, double from {date}.
ztp_p_grant.too_early: The double credit applies only from {date}. Change the start of the claim, or end it at the end of the previous month and enter the double credit as a new claim from {date}.

form.jmhz_name_hint: For a child, enter the names exactly as documented. MyÚčto does not split the full name automatically.
form.birth_number_hint: Stored encrypted and shown only masked in the list. An empty field keeps the stored value unchanged.
form.ztp_p: The person holds a ZTP/P card
form.student: The adult child studies continuously (up to age 26)
form.child_order_hint: The child's order in the shared household. It drives the credit amount and also counts children claimed by the other parent.
form.credit_status: The child credit is claimed by
form.credit_status_hint: If the other parent claims the child, enter the child with its order in the household. It is reported to ČSSZ with code N so the other children get the correct rate.
form.other_caregiver_required_hint: Name the person who claims the credit for this child. ČSSZ requires it in the monthly report.
form.evidence_reference_hint: Optional lookup into payroll documentation. The user is responsible for verifying the claim; an empty field does not block saving or calculation.
form.effective_from: Claim from (first day of the month)
form.effective_to: Claim until (last day of the month)
form.effective_to_hint: Leave empty for an ongoing claim. Filling it in ends the claim.
form.claim_ztp_p: Claim the double amount for a ZTP/P child
form.shared_household: The child lives in the shared household
form.other_claimant_excluded: The other taxpayer does not claim the credit for this period
form.other_household_caregiver: Another person in the same household supports the same children
form.other_household_caregiver_hint: The monthly report asks for this (JMHZ 10453). Without an answer the report cannot be built; answering yes requires naming the other person.
form.other_caregiver_birth_date: Other supporting person - date of birth
form.supersede_hint: If the claim reaches into a period covered by an approved payroll revision, the change is stored as a new effective version and the original record stays in history.

event_month.existence_from_hint: Date of birth, adoption, placement into care or start of study. If support starts during a month, that month counts only for these events.
event_month.existence_to_hint: Date of death, end of study or the 26th birthday. The month in which support ends counts in full.
event_month.effective_from_hint: {date} at the earliest. The month of birth, adoption, placement into care or start of study counts in full (Section 35c(10) of the Income Tax Act).
event_month.effective_from_too_early: The claim can start on {date} at the earliest. Support starts during a month, which counts only for birth, adoption, placement into care or start of study; choose it as the reason for the claim.
event_month.effective_to_hint: {date} at the latest, i.e. the end of the month in which support ends.
event_month.effective_to_too_late: The claim can last until {date} at the latest, the end of the month in which support ends.
event_month.ztp_p_hint: The double amount applies from the month at whose start the entitlement to the ZTP/P card was granted. Enter the grant date on the child card and the application will split the claim accordingly.

card_save.title: Saving the person card
card_save.unsaved: Everything saved | Unsaved changes in 1 section: | Unsaved changes in {count} sections: | Unsaved changes in {count} sections:
card_save.discard_confirm: The card has unsaved changes ({sections}). Discard them?
card_save.collapse_confirm: The full personal record has unsaved changes. Collapsing it discards them. Continue?
card_save.stopped: Saving stopped at section {section}. Fix what the section points out and save again; the other edited sections remain unsaved.

quick_edit.title: Common employee details
quick_edit.subtitle: Name, contact, address and pay in one place.
quick_edit.structured_name_hint: Enter the first and last name separately — the system does not split the display name.
quick_edit.alternative_identifiers_hint: ECP, VCP, foreign tax identifier and health insurance number. Fill in only the one the employee actually has.
quick_edit.health_insurance_number_hint: Only when it differs from the birth number or the employee has none: copy it from the insurance card or from the health insurer's notice. It is not the ECP.
quick_edit.name: Name
quick_edit.reveal_failed: The details could not be shown.
quick_edit.sensitive_replace_hint: Optional. Fill it in only when changing it.
quick_edit.contact_replace_hint: Fill these in only when changing them. The address is stored whole — enter street, city, postal code and country.
quick_edit.employment_history_hint: The new working hours and pay apply from this day. The previous ones stay in the history.
quick_edit.advanced_hint: All addresses, contacts, identifiers (birth number, ECP, VCP, foreign), payout accounts and historical versions.
quick_edit.change_reason_default: Quick edit of common employee details
quick_edit.name_required: Enter both the employee's first and last name.
quick_edit.address_complete_required: To change the residence, complete the street, city, postal code and country.
quick_edit.gross_invalid: Regular gross salary must be a non-negative amount with at most two decimal places.
quick_edit.personal_number_required: The personal number cannot be removed, only changed. Enter a new one or keep the original.
quick_edit.employment_unavailable: The employee has no active primary employment relationship whose employment details can be changed.
quick_edit.load_failed: The common employee details could not be loaded.
quick_edit.save_failed: The common employee details could not be saved.

quick_edit.birth_number_optional_hint: Not required to save the card; needed only for the social security registration (a foreign personal number works too) and for health insurer notifications.
quick_edit.contact_optional_hint: The whole section is optional — the card saves without an address or contacts. Fill in the address completely, or not at all.

profile.title: Personal and payment details
profile.subtitle: Adds contacts, identifiers and payout targets to the same employee record.
profile.load_failed: The personal profile could not be loaded.
profile.saved: The personal profile has been saved.
profile.save_failed: The personal profile could not be saved.
profile.save_scope: Saves every section of this card at once.
profile.mask_hint: Sensitive data is only shown in masked form. Enter a new value only when changing it.
profile.reveal_failed: The values could not be shown.
profile.registration_identity_hint: Birth details, citizenship and sex for PREZEC/REGZEC. Expand this only on hire or when the record changes.
profile.birth_surname_prefilled_hint: Prefilled from the surname. If the person changed their surname (e.g. by marriage), correct it.
profile.registration_identity_effective_hint: These details are stored in the same historical version and apply from the date above.
profile.address_replace_hint: To change an existing address, complete all four parts; blank fields keep the stored address.
profile.partner_settlement_hint: The net wage is not paid out — it is reclassified monthly as a set-off against the shareholder account (331/366 Dr / 365 Cr). No payment and no cash document is created.
profile.partner_settlement_account_hint: Analytic code of Other liabilities to shareholders from the company chart of accounts.
profile.partner_settlement_unavailable: Set-off against the shareholder account is available only for partner income or statutory-office remuneration.
profile.cash_allocation_settlement: Nothing is paid out - the whole net wage is settled against the account, so there is nothing to split.
profile.account_hint: Active bank allocations and cash must add up to 100 %.
profile.verify_on_save: I have verified this account — record the verification when saving the profile
profile.save_before_verify: Save this account's changes before verifying it.
profile.account_verified: The bank account has been verified.
profile.verification_failed: The bank account could not be verified.
profile.not_verified: The account has not been verified yet.

payout_rules.title: Payout rules
payout_rules.hint: A rule says where the net pay goes and in what order. The payout method above is only a declaration — payments follow these rules.
payout_rules.missing_title: Without a payout rule the employee cannot be paid.
payout_rules.missing_hint: The rule decides where the net pay goes — to a specific payout account, to the cash desk, or as a set-off against the partner's account. Until an active rule exists here, the payout cannot be processed.
payout_rules.empty: There is no payout rule yet.
payout_rules.account_required: The employee has no payout account yet. Add one above with Add account — saving the profile links the rule to the new account automatically.
payout_rules.pending_deactivation: Once the profile is saved the rule is deactivated and disappears from the active list. It stays with the historical payouts made under it.
payout_rules.unverified_account: The account is not verified yet — the wage cannot be prepared for payment until verification is done.
payout_rules.save_hint: Payout rule changes are saved together with the card using Save all in the bar at the bottom of the page.
payout_rules.defaults_title: Default rule from the payout method
payout_rules.defaults_save_first: The card has unsaved changes. The default rule is based on the saved payout method and accounts — save the card with Save all first.
payout_rules.defaults_applied: The default payout rule has been created.
payout_rules.defaults_failed: The default payout rule could not be created.
payout_rules.load_failed: The payout rules could not be loaded.
payout_rules.saved: The payout rules have been saved.
payout_rules.save_failed: The payout rules could not be saved.

people.employment_created: The employment relationship has been created.
people.terms_saved: A new version of the contractual terms has been saved.
people.terms_corrected: The effective terms have been corrected.
people.essentials_hint: Changes are saved with the single button below.
people.health_insurer_hint: It is kept in the person's statutory evidence, not on the relationship — the value is only mirrored here. It decides where health insurance is paid.
people.gross_invalid: The regular gross pay must be an amount, for example 45000 or 45000.50.
people.new_terms_date_required: Fill in the date from which the new terms apply.

terms_group.exceptions_hint: Increased employer rate, insurance discount and special flags for the social security administration. An ordinary employment needs none of it.

save_mode.title: How to save the change
save_mode.correct_hint: Overwrites the version effective from {date}. For typos and filling in a missing detail.
save_mode.version: New terms apply from a date
save_mode.version_hint: Creates a new version. The current one stays in the history.

people.mutation_failed: The employment relationship could not be updated.
people.transition_saved: The employment status has been changed.
people.new_terms_effective_hint: The latest version is effective from {date}. The new one can start no earlier than {min}.
people.leave_entitlement_weeks_override_hint: Leave blank to inherit the company allowance. The minimum is 4 weeks.
people.probable_earning_open: Record probable earnings (§ 355 of the Labour Code)
people.probable_earning_hourly_hint: Fill in only where an actual average cannot arise — the employee did not work at least 21 days in the decisive period (an agreement in its first month, a task fee). Leave blank for an ordinary employment; the average is computed from closed payroll runs.
people.probable_earning_rationale_hint: How the amount was set — the usual level of pay components or the pay of employees doing the same work (§ 355(2) of the Labour Code).
people.probable_earning_invalid: The probable hourly earning must be an amount, for example 280 or 280.50.
people.probable_earning_rationale_required: Add a justification explaining how the probable earning was set.
people.workload_bps: Workload in hundredths of a percent

jmhz_evidence.title: JMHZ – work position
jmhz_evidence.functional_benefits: Functional benefits under Section 6(10) of the Income Tax Act
jmhz_evidence.form_hint_outside_insurance: Activity types 11 to 14 are employment income that does not establish insurance participation: neither social nor health insurance is calculated and the monthly report uses the other-income form (11, 13, 14) or the international hiring-out form (12).
jmhz_evidence.form_hint_prisoner: The prison sentence detail reports the employment on the prisoner form: without health insurance, position and wage breakdown, with the ELDP and worked hours.
jmhz_evidence.options_failed: The pinned JMHZ codebooks could not be loaded. Saving validated evidence is blocked.
jmhz_evidence.search_municipality: Start typing a municipality name or code
jmhz_evidence.external_codebook_verified: Municipality and country are checked against pinned codebooks verified through {date}.
jmhz_evidence.temporary_assignment_blocker: For a temporary assignment, enter the user undertaking the employee is assigned to (company ID, or a foreign entity) on the employment card after saving. Without it the monthly report cannot be filed.
jmhz_evidence.default_no_hint: Unanswered questions count as “no” in the monthly CSSZ report and never block the submission. They stay unanswered in the records so it remains visible that nobody confirmed them explicitly; the submission notes that the value came from reading the default state.

jmhz_assignment_user.kind: User undertaking the employee is assigned to
jmhz_assignment_user.hint: For a temporary assignment the monthly CSSZ report requires the user's identification (check 103).
jmhz_assignment_user.ico_hint: Eight digits; the check digit is validated.
jmhz_assignment_user.foreign_id: Registration number of the foreign user
jmhz_assignment_user.foreign_id_hint: The report accepts exactly eight digits.
jmhz_assignment_user.name: Name of the foreign user

jmhz_risk_categorization.label: JMHZ risk categorisation
jmhz_risk_categorization.hint: For this rate the monthly report states the risk work hours and the risk categorisation code; the hours are the hours worked in the relationship.
jmhz_risk_categorization.auto_category_4: For risk employment the monthly report states risk categorisation 1 (category 4 work) and the risk work hours from the hours worked in the relationship.

deferred_income.title: Deferred income after the relationship ended
deferred_income.hint: Income settled in a month after the relationship ended (for example a bonus paid later) is reported in the monthly report on the Deferred income form. Confirm it here for the settlement month, otherwise the payroll run rejects the income.
deferred_income.period_hint: The month in which you settle the income in the payroll run. Insurance is paid for this month.
deferred_income.period_invalid: Deferred income belongs to a month after the relationship ended, {first} at the earliest.
deferred_income.type_hint: The application handles income after the employment ended. Other kinds (for example back pay for earlier months of an ongoing relationship) are filed as a corrective report on the CSSZ ePortal.
deferred_income.removed: The deferred income confirmation is cancelled.
deferred_income.load_failed: The deferred income confirmations could not be loaded.
deferred_income.save_failed: The deferred income confirmation could not be saved.

jmhz_questions.title: Questions for the monthly CSSZ report
jmhz_questions.hint: For the vast majority of employees the answer is no three times. You do not need to open this section.
jmhz_questions.apz: Do you receive a labour office contribution for this job (active employment policy)?
jmhz_questions.apz_instrument: Which active employment policy instrument is it?
jmhz_questions.functional_benefits: Are these functional benefits under Section 6(10) of the Income Tax Act?
jmhz_questions.temporary_assignment: Is the employee temporarily assigned to another employer?
jmhz_questions.default_no_hint: You can change the answers any time on the employment card. Leaving them unanswered is fine: the monthly CSSZ report reads it as “no”.

jmhz_ordinary_profile.title: JMHZ – exceptional situations
jmhz_ordinary_profile.hint: Most employees need no selection. Mark only a situation that can genuinely apply to this employment; a change is retained as a new effective terms version.
jmhz_ordinary_profile.orchard_discount_eligible: The orchard or vegetable-growing employee insurance discount may be claimed
jmhz_ordinary_profile.specific_legal_fact_applies: A specific legal event reportable in JMHZ may occur
jmhz_ordinary_profile.ozp_employment_support_applies: The employer may claim supported employment funding for a person with a disability
jmhz_ordinary_profile.deep_mining_work_applies: The work is performed in deep mining
jmhz_ordinary_profile.monthly_hint: Automatic JMHZ preparation cannot yet handle these flagged exceptions. If one actually applies, contact support; do not disable correct information to submit a report. Enforcement, insolvency and deduction agreements are taken from their respective records.

cz_isco.placeholder: Code or occupation name, e.g. 43111 or accountant
cz_isco.hint: Type part of the code or occupation name; accents do not matter.
cz_isco.min_chars: Enter at least two characters — part of the code or occupation name
cz_isco.no_results: Nothing matches — try part of the occupation name
cz_isco.search_failed: The classification could not be loaded.
cz_isco.search_failed_hint: This is not an empty result. Try again, or type the code manually.
cz_isco.unknown_code: Code is not in the current ČSÚ classification

people.health_association_member: Member of a cooperative or owners' association working for it for remuneration
people.health_association_member_hint: An employee for health insurance only in a month in which the counting income is reached (Section 5(a) of Act No. 48/1997 Coll.). In other months the person is left out of the payment statement and the minimum.
people.tax_declaration_hint: It is kept in the person's statutory evidence, not on the relationship — it can be signed or withdrawn at any time, so the value is only mirrored here. It decides the monthly taxpayer credit (Income Tax Act, § 35ba and § 38k (4)).

social_employer_rate_category.rescue_and_company_fire_service: Medical rescuer or company fire brigade — point b)

people.social_employer_rate_category_evidence_h: Optional lookup, for example the work categorisation decision number. The user is responsible for the selected rate; an empty field does not block calculation.

social_part_time_discount_reason.dependent_close_person_care: Caring for a dependent close person — (c)
social_part_time_discount_reason.study_under_26: Preparing for a future occupation, under 26 — (d)

people.social_part_time_discount_evidence_hint: Optional lookup, for example a disability decision number or a certificate of study. The user is responsible for verifying the claim; an empty field does not block the discount or calculation.
people.social_part_time_discount_notified_on_hi: Under Section 7a(5) the discount is only due if the intent to apply it was notified to the Czech Social Security Administration no later than when it is applied. This field no longer establishes the entitlement - since the intent register was introduced (Filings → Discount intent) the accepted OZUSPOJ notification decides. It remains only for periods calculated earlier.
people.checklist_predecessor_handled: Handled by the previous payroll software (before payroll started in MyÚčto)

start_estimated.title: Start date {start} is only estimated from the earliest taken-over report
start_estimated.hint: A JMHZ report without a start date yields the insurance start in the earliest reported month. The employment may have started earlier, and the taken-over wages for the earlier months of the year would then be missing for the annual tax settlement and the tax statement. It does not block the payroll run or the monthly report. Check the start date against the contract: if the employment started earlier, import the reports for the missing months (the start moves automatically) or correct the start in the employment terms; if it is correct, confirm it.

people.confirmation_request_hint: The certificate is issued within 10 days of the request (Section 38j(3) of the Income Tax Act). Once the request date is recorded, the statutory deadline overview tracks it.

jmhz_identity.title: CSSA identifiers assigned for JMHZ
jmhz_identity.summary: The person's OIC / MPSV ID and the employment ID PPV
jmhz_identity.description: CSSA assigns these identifiers after registration. Test and production values are separate; the application stores them encrypted and only shows a mask after saving.
jmhz_identity.person_hint: Exactly 10 digits including the check digit.
jmhz_identity.employment_hint: A numeric identifier of no more than 22 digits.
jmhz_identity.source_hint: For example the title or date of the CSSA protocol. An empty field does not block saving.
jmhz_identity.confirm: I confirm that I verified the entered values against CSSA evidence and selected the correct environment.
jmhz_identity.saved: The JMHZ identifiers were stored securely.
jmhz_identity.load_failed: The JMHZ identifiers could not be loaded.
jmhz_identity.save_failed: The JMHZ identifiers could not be saved.
jmhz_identity.start_date_missing: Enter the employment start date first — it is higher up on this card, in the relation terms.
jmhz_identity.identifier_required: Enter the person's OIČ or the relation's ID PPV. Whichever you already have from ČSSZ is enough.
jmhz_identity.valid_from_required: Fill in the date the identifier is valid from.
jmhz_identity.confirm_required: Tick the confirmation that the values match the ČSSZ record.
jmhz_identity.permission_required: Saving requires permission to edit both the person and the employment.
jmhz_identity.reveal_failed: The full identifier value could not be shown.
jmhz_identity.correction_hint: You are correcting a manually typed number. The previous value is discarded and replaced by what you save. Submissions already sent stay unchanged.

openings.title: This employee started before you began running payroll here
openings.title_new_hire: Confirm the new employee's opening state
openings.confirm_start_zero: Confirm the start on {date}? There was no pay at this company before the start, so a zero opening state for {year} is recorded as well. If this year's pay is being taken over from another program, cancel and enter the totals under Opening states.
openings.hint: Started {start}, payroll runs from {period}. To make the calculation and the annual settlement add up, the totals from the previous processing need to be filled in.
openings.hint_new_hire: If there was no earlier payroll for this employee at this company, save an explicit zero opening state below. This does not create fictitious processed months.
openings.done: The opening state is confirmed — the calculation and annual settlement use it. You can review or correct it below.
openings.panel_hint: Totals for the months processed elsewhere. Copy them from the previous system's report; enter amounts in whole currency units.
openings.zero_hint: Fill in every month in which the employment lasted. An empty month is not zero: if the employee really had no income in it (e.g. unpaid leave), tick “Really zero” for it. A source reference is optional.
openings.new_hire_zero_hint: This is a new hire with no previous payroll at this company. Save a zero opening state; a source reference is optional.
openings.nothing_to_fill: There are no previously processed months. Save the zero opening state below.
openings.source_placeholder: e.g. Payroll summary 1–7/2026 from system XY
openings.source_hint: An optional note for your own reference; opening balances can be saved without it.
openings.locked: A report has already been filed or an annual document issued for this year, so the opening balances can no longer change.
openings.approved_warning: Payroll for {periods} has already been processed in this year. You can still save a correction of the opening balances, but the calculated months will not recalculate themselves — review them and file a corrective revision if needed.
openings.amount_invalid: Amounts for month {month} must be non-negative numbers.
openings.load_failed: Opening balances could not be loaded.
openings.save_failed: Opening balances could not be saved.

import.title: Import from a spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX)
import.hint: One file for the whole company. Each row is one month of one employee, amounts in whole minor units. List every taken-over month in which the employment lasted; write a month without income as zeros (an empty row is not zero). Download the template so the header matches.
import.format_invalid: Only CSV or XLSX files are supported.
import.preview_failed: The import preview could not be built.
import.apply_failed: The import could not be completed.
import.template_failed: The template file could not be downloaded.

explicit.confirm_hint: Tick only for a month in which the employee really had no income. An empty month is not saved as zero.
explicit.empty_month: Month {month} has no amount filled in. Enter the totals from the previous program, or tick “Really zero”.

statutory_evidence.reason_custom: Other — I will type my own document reference
statutory_evidence.issues_block_save: Before saving, fill in the details listed at the individual records.

reason.declaration_38k_not_signed: Employee did not sign the declaration
reason.residence_cz_birth_number_address: Birth number and address of residence in CZ
reason.residence_cz_domicile_certificate: Certificate of tax domicile in CZ
reason.residence_foreign_domicile_certificate: Certificate of tax domicile of another state
reason.residence_foreign_tax_authority_confirma: Confirmation by a foreign tax authority
reason.social_a1_certificate: A1 form issued by another state
reason.social_foreign_insurance_confirmation: Confirmation of insurance in another state

reason.minimum_sickness_certificate: Certificate of sickness, quarantine or caring for a family member
reason.pension_age_statutory_table: Calculated from the annex to Act No. 155/1995 Coll.
