issue.period_required: Fill in when the record starts.
issue.period_month_start: Records are kept in whole months — set the start to {day}.
issue.effective_to_before_from: The end precedes the start — fix one of the dates.
issue.effective_to_month_end: Records are kept in whole months — set the end to {day}.
issue.country_required: Pick “{label}” from the list of countries — the server rejects the record without it.
issue.country_must_be_foreign: A non-resident must have a country other than CZ. For a Czech resident switch the option to “Czech tax resident”.
issue.insurer_required: Pick a health insurer from the list, or switch the status to “Unverified”.
issue.insurer_unknown: Insurer code {code} is not in the codebook — pick an insurer from the list.
issue.insurer_not_applicable_in_czech_regime: Anyone covered by the Czech public health insurance always has an insurer. Pick one, or — until you find out which — switch the status to “Unverified”.
issue.reference_invalid: The document reference for “{label}” may contain only letters, digits and . : / _ - and must start with a letter or a digit.
issue.employer_unknown: The selected employer has no assessment base documented for this month — add it first.
issue.a1_valid_until_required: A verified A1 must be valid at least until {day}. Fill in the validity date, or switch A1 to “Not applicable”.
issue.a1_valid_until_too_early: A1 must be valid at least until {day} — the calculation does not accept an earlier date.
issue.multiple_open_rows: Only one record may stay open. Fill in “Valid to” (last day of the month) on the older one.
issue.employment_from_required: Fill in since when the employment with the other employer lasts.
issue.employment_to_before_from: The end of the employment with the other employer precedes its start.
issue.reference_required: Fill in “{label}”. The employer is picked as the top-up payer by this label.
issue.amount_invalid: “{label}” must be a non-negative amount in CZK with at most two decimals (e.g. 15000 or 15000.50).

statutory_evidence.title: Statutory evidence of the person
statutory_evidence.subtitle: Tax declaration, tax residence, tax credits, social and health insurance jurisdiction, the working pensioner discount, retirement age and pension received, and exceptions from the health insurance minimum.
statutory_evidence.pension_age_suggestion: Based on the date of birth, the retirement age is reached on {day} (section 32 and annex 1 of Act No. 155/1995 Coll.). The suggested day is prefilled in a new record; check it, the calculation does not know a reduced retirement age.
statutory_evidence.pension_age_no_suggestion: The retirement age does not follow unambiguously from the date of birth (for women it depends on the number of children raised, special groups have a reduced age). Enter it according to the CSSA (ČSSZ) notice.
statutory_evidence.blocked_badge: all filled in | 1 missing item | {count} missing items | {count} missing items
statutory_evidence.blockers_consequence: Until these are filled in, the payroll run cannot compute the statutory part for this person and ends in manual review.
statutory_evidence.complete: The evidence is complete for this month — the statutory calculation has what it needs.
statutory_evidence.effective_on_hint: The evidence is evaluated per whole month; the date selects which month is checked.
statutory_evidence.frozen_hint: History up to {day} is closed by approved payroll. Older rows cannot be rewritten or deleted — a change is stored as a new version from the next month.
statutory_evidence.evidence_note_placeholder: e.g. original in the employee folder, copy in the file

section.health_month_evidence: Monthly evidence of the health minimum
section.health_minimum_reductions: Exceptions from the health insurance minimum

section_hint.tax_declarations: Decides whether monthly credits and allowances apply, or tax is withheld without them.
section_hint.tax_residences: A non-resident is taxed differently than a resident; a supporting reference can be stored optionally.
section_hint.tax_credit_claims: Monthly tax credits for the taxpayer, disability and ZTP/P card holders. They apply only with a signed declaration; without a record the credit is not deducted and the tax advance is higher by its amount. Each kind of credit is its own series, so they may apply concurrently.
section_hint.social_jurisdictions: Whether the person is subject to Czech social insurance. A foreign regime needs a country; a supporting reference is optional.
section_hint.social_discount_claims: Insurance discount for an employee drawing an old-age pension. If it is not claimed, pick “not claimed”.
section_hint.health_coverages: Whether the person is subject to Czech health insurance and which insurer they are registered with.
section_hint.health_month_evidence: Left empty means the employee pays the top-up to the minimum assessment base — that is what the law says. Add a record only for the exception: an obstacle on the employer's side, or the choice of employer when there are several.
section_hint.health_minimum_reductions: Who the minimum assessment base does not apply to (Section 3(8) of Act No. 592/1992 Coll.): a state-insured person (pensioner, student, parent on parental leave…), a ZTP or ZTP/P card holder, someone who reached pension age without pension entitlement, a self-employed person paying advances at least from the minimum, and someone receiving only a foster carer reward. If the exception starts during a month, the minimum is reduced proportionally by days, so it is entered with an exact date. A documented working pensioner discount, the ZTP/P tax credit, sickness, quarantine, caring, maternity and parental leave are applied by the calculation itself; you do not need to enter them here.
section_hint.health_other_employer_bases: With concurrent employments the minimum is assessed from the sum of the assessment bases with all employers. Enter the base the employee had with another employer for the month; which of them pays the top-up is set in the monthly evidence of the health minimum.
section_hint.social_pension_age: The day the employee reached or will reach retirement age. From that day the activity has code D both in the pension insurance record and in the monthly report, and if no old-age pension is received, deducted periods are reported. Leave empty if you do not know the day; code D then does not arise.
section_hint.social_pensions: The pension the employee receives, with its kind from the CSSA (ČSSZ) code list (the same as in the REGZEC registration). An early old-age pension gives code D; an old-age pension ends deducted periods from the first whole month of payment and, from 2025, also the annual pension insurance record. Importing REGZEC registrations fills it into empty records.

registration.title: ČSSZ relation registration
registration.description: Initial registration and subsequent changes to the insured relation. New A2–A8 events are first approved as an immutable source and only then prepared for dispatch.

changes.title: Changes to report
changes.description: Details that no longer match what was last filed. They must be reported within 8 days of the day you learned about the change.

filing_state.deadline_overdue: The filing deadline passed on {due}. File as soon as possible; a late filing may be fined by ČSSZ.
filing_state.existing_ready: A registration for this employment is already prepared in the queue (filing no. {id}, {status}). Do not prepare another one; open it in the queue and send it.
filing_state.existing_sent: A registration for this employment has already been sent to ČSSZ (filing no. {id}, {status}). Report changes with a change notice and errors with a correction.

registration.window: Can be filed from {from}, no later than {to}.
registration.employer_window: Note: this is the first employee. File the employer's own registration no later than {to} — after that date the employer status is presumed by law.

registration_window.not_derived: The start date {start} precedes 1 July 2026, when the current registration duty took effect. File the registration without undue delay — the app does not derive a deadline under the former rules and treats the filing as late.
registration_window.not_statutory: This filing has no statutory deadline. Until {milestone} the monthly report can be cancelled together with it without manual processing; later, file a corrective report.
registration_window.foreign_permit: Foreigner with an employment permit, employee card or blue card: the filing also serves as the notice to the labour office (section 88 of the Employment Act) and the earlier of both deadlines applies. For a card it runs 45 days from the day the conditions for issuing it were met; check that day against the decision.

completion.scope_minimal: Data supplement – only items the ONZ form did not carry
completion.hint: The supplement is for employees registered earlier via the ONZ form. The filing is built from the saved registration profile (A1) — status in employment, work mode, place of work, occupation, position, education, country of residence; the full profile adds addresses, health insurer and pension. The date is the day of sending (ČSSZ takes it as "valid from"). It works for a relationship that has already ended too — the filing then carries the end date. If the profile is missing or incomplete, open it above and complete it.

warnings.title: Before you file
warnings.open_own: Change the activity type of this relationship

registration.not_sent_yet: Not sent yet. The employee is registered only once the social security administration confirms it.

environment_notice.production: Filing goes to ČSSZ PRODUCTION - the registration lands in the live register of insured persons. For a trial run, switch the environment in the top right to Test.
environment_notice.test: Filing goes to the ČSSZ TEST environment - it will not register the employee. A real filing requires switching the environment to Production.

missing.title: Nothing is missing. | The registration cannot be built yet, 1 item is missing. | The registration cannot be built yet, {count} items are missing. | The registration cannot be built yet, {count} items are missing.
missing.where_employer: Payroll settings → Employer and payroll units
missing.variable_symbol_placeholder: The employer variable symbol looks like a placeholder (a sequence of digits used in examples) rather than the symbol ČSSZ assigned to the company. Check it in the payroll settings of the payroll unit before you send the filing.

before_start.label: Registration before start
before_start.hint: The employee must be registered before starting work, at the earliest 8 days in advance (Section 19(1) of Act No. 323/2025 Coll.). A partial registration needs only the basic data; the rest is added within 8 days after the start. You can file the full A1 registration right away once the A1 profile is complete; if the employee starts on a different day, file a correction A4, and if they never start, a cancellation A8.

unknown_start.label: Start was not known in advance
unknown_start.hint: The employee started work without prior notice. The registration deadline is then 8 days from the day the duty to provide performance arose, or from the first performance (Section 19(1)(b) of Act No. 323/2025 Coll.), instead of the start day.

registration.send_failed: The registration could not be sent.
registration.poll_failed: The registration result could not be fetched.
registration.close_failed: The registration dispatch could not be closed.
registration.awaiting_protocol: ČSSZ has confirmed receipt, not acceptance. Fetch the result manually; do not close the dispatch until then.
registration.write_required: Sending, fetching the result and closing require write access to payroll submissions.
registration.failed: The registration could not be prepared.

a1.title: Authoritative REGZEC A1 profile
a1.description: The source for the initial full registration. Stored encrypted; a draft is overwritten on each save - once the registration is filed, the stored state is kept as the record of what you submitted.
a1.warning: Prefilled values come from the person's and the employment's master data; each one states its source. Saving creates a new version of the snapshot and never changes the person or employment record.
a1.saved_draft: The draft profile was stored. | The draft profile was stored. 1 item still blocks filing — it is marked red at the field and listed above. | The draft profile was stored. {count} items still block filing — they are marked red at the fields and listed above.
a1.check_complete: The check passed — the profile is complete and ready to file from.
a1.check_incomplete: The check found no items. | The check found 1 item. It is marked red at the field, with a summary above. | The check found {count} items. They are marked red at the fields, with a summary above.
a1.check_failed: The check could not be run.
a1.problems_hint: You can still save — the draft stays on the server. Filing becomes possible once this list is empty.

problem.missing: {field} is missing — the ČSSZ registration (REGZEC A1) cannot be filed without it.
problem.too_long: {field} is longer than ČSSZ accepts: at most {max} characters, it now has {length}.
problem.digits: {field} must be a numeric code of exactly {length} digits.
problem.country: {field} must be a two-letter country code, for example CZ or SK.
problem.date: {field} must be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-08-05.
problem.status_for_activity: {field}: for activity type “{activity}” only {allowed} is allowed, it is now “{value}”.
problem.status_format: {field} must be a four-digit code from the NKPZ classification, it is now “{value}”.
problem.status_unknown: {field} is not in the NKPZ classification, it is now “{value}”. Pick a code from the list.
problem.profession_five_digits: {field} must be a five-digit CZ-ISCO code (category), it is now “{value}”. ČSSZ does not accept a four-digit sub-group in the registration; pick a five-digit category on the employment card.
problem.postal_code_cz: {field} must have five digits for an address in the Czech Republic and must not start with 0, 8 or 9 (for example 60200), it is now “{value}”.
problem.house_number_cz: {field} must be a number of at most four digits for a Czech address (no letters or slashes), it is now “{value}”. Put the orientation number in its own field.
problem.orientation_number_cz_residence: {field} may have at most {max} characters for an address of stay in the Czech Republic, it is now “{value}”.
problem.orientation_number_cz: {field} may have at most {max} characters for a Czech address, it is now “{value}”.
problem.residence_country_mismatch: {field} must match the tax residency country (“{tax}”), it is now “{value}”.
problem.small_scale_dpp: {field} must not be switched on for activity “{activity}” (agreement to complete a job), small-scale employment is not used for agreements.
problem.education_not_relevant: {field} is not tracked for a Czech citizen working under an agreement (activity “{activity}”), it must be “Z” (not relevant), it is now “{value}”.
problem.underage: The employee is younger than {min_age} on the start date and ČSSZ rejects such a filing on entry. Check the date of birth and the start date.
problem.attachment_extension: Attachment {name} has an unsupported extension. ČSSZ accepts only .doc, .docx, .rtf, .xls, .xlsx, .pdf, .jpg and .txt.
problem.attachment_duplicate_name: Attachment {name} has the same name as another attachment. Attachment names must be unique.
problem.attachment_file_size: Attachment {name} is larger than 2 MB, the most ČSSZ accepts.
problem.attachment_total_size: The attachments together are larger than 4 MB, the most ČSSZ accepts.
problem.health_restrictions_max: {field} may contain a single restriction, it has {count} now. Keep the one valid on the start date.
problem.foreign_insurance_current: {field} must be P (last carrier) or S (current carrier), it is now “{value}”.
problem.foreign_insurance_sector: {field} must be a code from the Sector codebook (01 to 08), it is now “{value}”.

a1.gap_unreachable: Could not locate {field} on screen. Please report it - this is a navigation bug.
a1.saved: Version {version} was stored and is ready for a new A1 preview.
a1.load_failed: The REGZEC A1 profile could not be loaded.
a1.save_failed: The REGZEC A1 profile could not be saved.
a1.error_title: Nothing was saved — the server state is unchanged
a1.error_kept: Your values stay in the form and are backed up in this browser, so you keep them even after closing the card or reloading the page.
a1.error_above: Nothing was saved. The red box at the top says what is missing and where to add it.
a1.draft_title: You have an unsaved profile here
a1.draft_hint: An unsent version of this form from {saved} is stored in this browser. Continue with it?
a1.draft_restored: The unsaved profile is back in the form. It reaches the server only once you save.
a1.variant: Variant A1-{variant} per the ČSSZ business matrix.
a1.missing_title: Fill in manually from the HR file ({count})
a1.missing_hint: The application does not keep these, so it cannot prefill them. They do not block submission - what does is shown in red below. Fill them in as you go so the snapshot is complete.
a1.master_data_title: These values differ from master data
a1.master_data_hint: The form does not follow master data on its own. Use the button next to an item to write your correction into the person and employment records.
a1.master_data_submitted_note: The registration has already been filed, so the authority holds the old value. If it needs to know, file a change notice (REGZEC A3) — writing to master data does not change what was filed.
a1.master_data_none: Nothing was written to master data — reasons below.
a1.write_master_data_hint: Saves into the person and employment card at the same time - only values that actually differ. Turn off when the value applies to this registration only.
a1.permanent_address_hint: Mandatory address. It comes from the person card (Address history); the application does not track the house number, so copy it from your records.
a1.czech_residence_hint: Optional — fill it in only when the residence in Czechia differs from the permanent address. It is mandatory for a person whose permanent address is outside Czechia, unless they are a cross-border worker (AT, DE, PL, SK). The country is prefilled to Czechia.
a1.contact_address_hint: Optional — fill it in only when it differs from the permanent address.

tax_residency.residence_address: Provide the residence address in the country of residency
tax_residency.residence_address_hint: Optional for a Czech tax resident. For a tax resident of another country it is mandatory — enter the residence address in that country, not the stay in Czechia.

employment.employment_status_code_hint: Four-digit code from the ČSÚ classification of status in employment (NKPZ), e.g. 1111 open-ended employment, 1112 fixed-term, 1211/1212 DPČ agreement, 1221/1222 DPP agreement. ČSSZ rejects shorter codes.

foreign_insurance.hint: Mandatory for activity type “N” (contract employee): choose the specification and the country. Otherwise fill it in only if the employee was insured abroad and you are the first employer after that insurance ended. If you fill in any part of the address, the house number, postal code and municipality are required.
foreign_insurance.name: Carrier name

sector_option.01: Accidents at work and occupational diseases

foreign_worker.free_access: Free access to the labour market

event.automatic: Automatically from the current relation state (A1/P1/P2)
event.load_failed: The REGZEC events could not be loaded.
event.save_failed: The REGZEC event could not be approved.

effective_on.correction: Date of the original filing being corrected

event.a2_hint: Fill only the branch applicable to the activity type. Variant 10 sends no unemployment evidence; SPEC may contain only the early-termination reason. The server safely rejects an invalid combination.
event.not_applicable: Do not send for this variant

unemployment.omit: No evidence (A2-10, death, or SPEC without details)

event.average_net_earnings: Average monthly net earnings in CZK
event.learned_on: Day the employer learned of the change (optional; the 8-day deadline runs from it, otherwise from the validity date)
event.tax_residency_two_step_hint: A foreign employee claiming a tax relief needs two steps: action 1 (hire) cannot state the tax residence country effective date, so this change must follow with the same date as the hire date — otherwise the report fails with error 40243.
event.tax_residency_latency_hint: The change takes effect at the ČSSZ within hours to days. A monthly report filed sooner will fail with error 40243 — wait a while before sending it.
event.not_started_confirmation: I confirm that the relation is recorded as a non-appearance and that the selected date is the original planned start date.
event.a8_hint: Report a non-appearance within 8 days of the expected start date (Section 19(4) of Act No. 323/2025 Coll.). The relationship must be recorded as not started.
event.a8_reason_other: Other reason (wrong variable symbol, activity type, invalidated relationship)
event.a8_other_hint: A cancellation for another reason has no statutory deadline, but the ČSSZ processes it only with a written explanation attached. Until the 20th day of the following month the monthly report can be cancelled together with it; later, file a corrective report.
event.a4_start_hint: The registration was filed with an expected start date and the employee started on a different day. ČSSZ processes a correction of the actual start date only with a cover letter attached, by a clerk.
event.identifiers_verified: I verified the OIČ and ID PPV in the employee list on the ČSSZ ePortal
event.identifiers_verified_hint: Only for an employee taken over from an earlier notification (ONZ) whose numbers do not come from a ČSSZ protocol, an accepted A3 completion or an imported ČSSZ employee export. The A2 deregistration can then be filed without the A3 completion, which stays as a separate duty.

dimensions.title: Payroll dimensions of this relation
dimensions.hint: Assignment of cost centers, projects and activities to this employment relation over time.
dimensions.empty: This relation has no dimension assigned yet.
dimensions.save_failed: Failed to save the dimension assignment.
dimensions.overlap_error: This employment relation already has another dimension of the same type assigned in this period.
dimensions.ineffective_error: The selected dimension is not effective for the whole assignment period.
dimensions.conflict_title: Someone else changed this assignment in the meantime
dimensions.dimension_required: Pick the dimension you want to assign to this relation.
dimensions.valid_from_required: Fill in the date the assignment starts on.
dimensions.valid_to_invalid: The end of validity cannot precede its start.
dimensions.none_available: This company has no effective payroll dimension yet.
dimensions.split_hint: The employment's costs are split between the selected dimensions of one type by share; the shares must add up to 100 %. Existing assignments of the same type end the day before the split starts.
dimensions.split_invalid: Select different dimensions, fill in positive shares and make sure they add up to exactly 100 %.

surcharge_policy.title: Statutory surcharge policy (Sections 114–118)
surcharge_policy.hint: What is agreed for this employment relation beyond the statutory minimum. Without an agreement the statutory default applies — and a month with work on a public holiday or in a difficult environment cannot be approved.
surcharge_policy.edit_blocked_no_open: Only the version that is currently effective and has no end date can be corrected. Older versions are never rewritten — payrolls calculated from them still point at them.
surcharge_policy.edit_title: Correction of the effective policy version
surcharge_policy.edit_hint: The correction changes what was agreed, not when it took effect. For a change from a different date, create a new version.
surcharge_policy.history_locked_error: This policy version can no longer be changed — it is closed or a newer one supersedes it. Create a new version instead.
surcharge_policy.conflict_error: Someone else changed the policy in the meantime. The current state has been reloaded — check it and save again.
surcharge_policy.no_permission: Only a user allowed to write employment relations can change the surcharge policy. Ask your company administrator for the permission.
surcharge_policy.empty: This relation has no agreed surcharge policy yet — the statutory default applies.
surcharge_policy.load_failed: Failed to load the surcharge policy.
surcharge_policy.statutory_title: What applies without an agreed policy
surcharge_policy.statutory_holiday_hint: For a public holiday the law grants compensatory time off (Section 115(1)) unless agreed otherwise, not a surcharge. Until something else is agreed, a month with holiday work does not pass attendance approval.
surcharge_policy.new_hint: A policy is never rewritten — a new version is created next to the old one and the history stays readable.
surcharge_policy.valid_from_required: Fill in the date from which the new policy version applies.
surcharge_policy.valid_from_locked: A correction never moves the effective date — it is the boundary against the previous version, whose end is derived from it.
surcharge_policy.valid_to_hint: Optional. Filling it in closes the policy; from the next day the statutory default applies, so compensatory time off for holidays and a missing basis for a difficult environment.
surcharge_policy.valid_to_invalid: The end of validity cannot precede the start of the policy.
surcharge_policy.holiday_mode_hint: A wage agreed with regard to holiday work does not exist — Section 114(3) covers overtime only.
surcharge_policy.factors_hint: 1 to 255. Without a documented count the difficult environment surcharge is not calculated and the month does not pass approval.
surcharge_policy.factors_invalid: Enter the number of aggravating factors between 1 and 255, or leave the field empty.
surcharge_policy.rates_hint: For each surcharge choose whether it is agreed as a percentage of average earnings or as a fixed amount per hour. An empty field means the statutory minimum is used.
surcharge_policy.lower_allowed: a lower rate may be agreed
surcharge_policy.lower_forbidden: a lower rate cannot be agreed
surcharge_policy.below_statutory_warning: The rate is below the statutory minimum for a kind where the law does not allow it — the server will reject such a record:
surcharge_policy.fixed_hint: The amount for every worked hour of that kind. The statutory minimum still applies: if the agreed amount is lower, overtime, public holidays and difficult environments are paid at the statutory minimum and the difference is visible on the payslip.
surcharge_policy.fixed_invalid: The fixed amount must be positive and at most CZK 1,000 per hour.
surcharge_policy.fixed_statutory_note: For a fixed amount the statutory minimum is derived from each person's own average earnings, so it cannot be shown here in advance.

standby.label: Standby pay (% of average earnings)
standby.hint: Calculated from the standby minutes entered on shifts in Time & attendance and added to payroll when the month is approved. Empty = statutory minimum of {rate} %.
standby.invalid: Under Section 140 of the Labour Code, standby pay must be at least {rate} % of average earnings (and at most 500 %).

surcharge_policy.save_failed: Failed to save the surcharge policy.
surcharge_policy.exists_error: A surcharge policy already exists for this date. Choose a different validity date.

people.load_failed_hint: The employee list did not load, so we do not know who the company has. Please try again.
people.office_empty: The employer has no active payroll office yet — create one in payroll settings.
people.office_missing_warning: This employment has no payroll office. Social insurance cannot be reported and the payroll run will stop on it. Select it in the Payroll office field of the employment and save.
people.terms_basics_hint: Fill in what actually changes. Only fields the save cannot go through without are marked with an asterisk; everything else is optional.
people.terms_advanced_hint: JMHZ evidence, insurance and tax regimes, rate categories and discounts. An ordinary employment needs none of it.
people.change_reason_hint: Optional. Shows up in the employment timeline.

transport_delivery.possibly_what: The request to ČSSZ went out but no response came back. ČSSZ may have received it, so the submission is not resent automatically: a second dispatch could create a duplicate.
transport_delivery.possibly_where: First look for the protocol: in the company data box (message from ČSSZ) or on the ČSSZ ePortal among submissions. Load it here; if the original is at ČSSZ, this proves the submission. Confirm a retry only if there is no protocol anywhere.
transport_delivery.original_title: The original submission is at ČSSZ
transport_delivery.original_what: ČSSZ answered the repeated dispatch that it already has an identical submission (control 22, error 20022). This is not a rejection and nothing is resent.
transport_delivery.original_where: Provide or load the protocol of the original from the company data box or the ČSSZ ePortal.
transport_delivery.who: Concerns submission no. {id} at ČSSZ (monthly report sent via VREP).
transport_delivery.correlation: CorrelationID {id}: the app keeps asking for the result by itself.
transport_delivery.confirm_hint: The same frozen document with the same submission GUID is sent. Should the original be at ČSSZ after all, ČSSZ answers with error 20022 and the app recognises it.
transport_delivery.reason_label: How you verified there is no protocol of the original
transport_delivery.reason_placeholder: E.g. there is no protocol for the submission in the data box nor on the ČSSZ ePortal.
transport_delivery.searched_label: I searched for the protocol in the data box and on the ČSSZ ePortal and did not find it.
transport_delivery.reason_required: Describe how you searched for the protocol and tick the confirmation.
transport_delivery.confirm_failed: The retry could not be confirmed.
transport_delivery.confirmed: Retry confirmed. The submission is among those ready to dispatch; it goes out with the same GUID.
transport_delivery.protocol_original_at_cssz: The original is at ČSSZ: this error is not a rejection. Provide the protocol of the original and do not resend.
transport_delivery.refrozen: The submission was refrozen with a new GUID {guid} (previously {previous}); it goes out as a new regular submission.
transport_delivery.late_discount_where: The last accepted discount is in the ČSSZ protocol in Dispatch status. If the discount is higher, correct it in the payroll run and prepare the report again.
transport_delivery.late_discount_confirm: The discount does not exceed the last accepted one, freeze

submissions.title: Payroll submissions
submissions.subtitle: Prepare, verify and download statutory reports with clearly separated test and production environments.
submissions.subtitle_production_only: Prepare, verify, send and track statutory reports.
submissions.details_health: Details: HOZ notifications, manual preparation and history
submissions.details_eldp: Pension record sheets and manual completion
submissions.details_jmhz: Details: previews, legal facts, submissions by the previous program and history
submissions.other_fail_closed: Obligations whose agenda the system does not recognise — typically recorded manually or coming from an older version. They stay visible here so they cannot get lost; the system offers neither preparation nor submission for them.
submissions.jmhz_fail_closed: Prepare JMHZ from an approved immutable revision and, after a validation dry run, submit it through ISDS or VREP. Production filing becomes available when the statutory window opens.
submissions.health_fail_closed: Prepare the payment overview or the bulk notification from a frozen calculation and, for an insurer with a documented attachment format, send it by data box — through the gateway, or after confirming a Mobile Key session. Without a documented format or a known data box, it stays download-and-send-yourself. Nothing is marked as sent or accepted without a verified channel and receipt.

monthly_checklist.title: Monthly overview for the accountant
monthly_checklist.description: One list for the selected period: what to generate and send, where, by which channel, and by when — and for anything MyÚčto does not send itself, exactly why and what to do about it.
monthly_checklist.load_failed: The monthly overview failed to load. Please try again.
monthly_checklist.prepare_failed: The submission could not be prepared. Please try again.
monthly_checklist.empty: No open item for the selected period.
monthly_checklist.done_by_delivery_hint: Fulfilled by delivery to the insurer's data box — the insurer does not send a processing result. A defect would come as a separate notice.

send.gateway_hint: The sending gateway approves every draft in the data box separately ({count}). Only the Mobile Key sends all messages with one confirmation — set it up under Data box.
send.manual_hint: Messages ({count}) are waiting in the data box outbox to be sent manually.

send.receipts_pending: Waiting for delivery receipts — {delivered} of {total} sent messages have one.

statutory.title: Sickness and other statutory obligations
statutory.description: A truthful capability matrix for the selected period. NEMPRI and HZUPN currently require a manual official-channel workflow; MyÚčto only preserves an immutable link to a real DMS receipt. Nothing is transmitted here.
statutory.error: The statutory-obligation overview could not be loaded or saved.
statutory.saved: The manual-completion evidence was stored immutably.

agenda.NEMPRI: Employer notice of an employee benefit claim
agenda.HZUPN: Employer report at the end of incapacity
agenda.OZUSPOJ: Notice of intent to claim the insurance discount

reason.nempri_legacy_variant_not_supported: The pre-2025 NEMPRI variant is not supported by this workflow. Use the period-specific procedure and do not mark anything as fulfilled here.
reason.nempri_only_partially_in_jmhz: JMHZ only absorbed part of the data, so NEMPRI remains a separate action and must not be switched off automatically. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.
reason.nempri_standalone_prepared: NEMPRI is a standalone obligation for this period. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.
reason.nempri_standalone_manual: NEMPRI is a standalone obligation for this period. An accountant must complete both its content and submission in an official channel.
reason.hzupn_remains_standalone: HZUPN remains a standalone report alongside JMHZ. MyÚčto builds the data message, validates it against the pinned XSD and can send it through the data box; the VREP/APEP channel is not open for this agenda.
reason.eldp_historic_preparation_available: A historic ELDP can be prepared on its dedicated tab. This overview does not duplicate its data or status.
reason.eldp_jmhz_default_on_demand_exception: From 2026, ordinary ELDP data comes from JMHZ, but historic and on-demand scenarios remain. Preparation is available on the dedicated tab.
reason.accident_insurance_calculation_output_li: Assessment-base and rate calculation, assessment, output and payment liability for statutory accident insurance are not implemented. JMHZ does not replace the obligation. MyÚčto can only preserve evidence of an externally verified amount and an actually completed payment.
reason.accident_insurance_calculated_and_materi: MyÚčto calculates the quarterly assessment base from social insurance and assesses the premium using the rate set in Payroll Settings (at least CZK 100). JMHZ does not replace the obligation. MyÚčto does not yet know the statutory rate table by prevailing activity — enter the rate manually from the insurer's assessment.

workflow.record_sickness_case: Record the sickness case on the Sickness benefits tab — the report is built from it.
workflow.prepare_nempri_submission: Prepare the NEMPRI data message and have it validated against the pinned XSD.
workflow.prepare_hzupn_submission: Prepare the HZUPN data message and have it validated against the pinned XSD.
workflow.send_via_data_box: Send it through the data box with the button on the case in the Sickness benefits tab. You get a delivery note back, not a numbered confirmation.
workflow.verify_case_and_source_data: Verify the specific case, relevant period and source data, including earnings and shifts, outside this P0 overview.
workflow.submit_in_official_channel: Complete and submit the report through a verified official ČSSZ channel.
workflow.store_official_receipt_in_company_dms: Store the real receipt or protocol as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.record_receipt_evidence: Only then record the reference and DMS document below as evidence of manual completion.
workflow.use_eldp_workspace: Use the dedicated Pension record sheet tab; preparation never implies that the form was submitted.
workflow.calculate_accident_insurance_externally: Determine the period, assessment base, rate and amount from professionally verified external sources; MyÚčto neither calculates nor validates them.
workflow.pay_accident_insurance_externally: Make the actual payment outside MyÚčto and verify both its amount and the payee identification.
workflow.store_payment_evidence_in_company_dms: Store the payment confirmation or a specific official document as a company-scoped DMS document.
workflow.record_payment_evidence: Only then record the amount, references and DMS document as immutable manual-completion evidence.
workflow.review_accident_insurance_rate_setting: Check that the company has an up-to-date rate from the insurer's assessment and the insurer's account set up in Institutions.
workflow.review_accident_insurance_liability: Review the calculated assessment base and assessed premium on the payments list for the last month of the quarter.
workflow.pay_accident_insurance_liability: Pay the assessed liability the same way as other payroll levies and match the payment against the bank statement.

form.title: Manual-completion evidence — {agenda}
form.description: The record is append-only. Corrections are added as new evidence; the original is neither edited nor deleted.
form.document_placeholder: Search for the receipt, protocol or payment document…
form.missing: Still missing before it can be saved: {list}.
form.missing_document: pick a document from the DMS
form.document_hint: The server accepts only an active company-scoped document owned by this tenant and freezes its SHA-256 itself.
form.confirmation: I confirm that the submission was actually completed in an official external channel and the specified company DMS document is its real receipt or protocol.
form.payment_confirmation: I confirm that the amount was determined using a professionally verified external procedure, actually paid, and the specified company DMS document is its payment confirmation or a specific official document. MyÚčto did not verify the calculation or payment.

evidence.title: Stored evidence
evidence.description: Immutable records separated by tenant, environment and period.
evidence.empty: No evidence is stored for this period and environment.

transport.title: Sent submissions and their status
transport.description: Every dispatch attempt to ČSSZ, newest first. Sending happens when a submission is frozen — this screen tracks the status and fetches the result.
transport.load_failed: The dispatch history could not be loaded.
transport.state_unknown: Until the request succeeds the system does not know what was sent — please do not read this empty screen as proof that nothing went out.

environment.label: Environment
environment.production_note: Live submissions to ČSSZ. What is in this list counts towards the authority.
environment.test_note: ČSSZ test environment. A submission made here does not discharge the obligation.

vs.label: Employer variable symbol
vs.hint: The VREP gateway identifies the submission by the employer's variable symbol — without it the status cannot be fetched and the transaction cannot be closed. You will find it on the ČSSZ registration decision.
vs.missing: No active workplace in the employer settings has a social-security variable symbol filled in. Add it in the settings, or type it here manually.
vs.required: Enter the variable symbol (at most ten digits) so the status can be fetched or the transaction closed.
vs.test_mismatch_warning: In the test environment, the ČSSZ accepts only its assigned test variable symbol. A submission under a different symbol (e.g. the live one) will be rejected.

empty.title: Nothing has been sent yet
empty.description: No dispatch attempt has been made in this environment yet. Submissions are sent after freezing on the JMHZ tab.
empty.import_hint: If you filed in this environment using other software, import the processing protocol from your data box — the overview will then show it next to submissions sent from here.

dispatched.note: Sent through the data box. There is no VREP polling attempt here, so the outcome comes from the protocol ČSSZ delivers to the box.

imported.action: Import protocol from the data box
imported.hint: This overview does not know about submissions filed by other software. The processing protocol delivered by ČSSZ to your data box can be imported here as XML, so filings made outside the app show up as well. The JMHZ partial protocol (attachment JMH-DILCI-PROTOKOL-…) can be imported too; upload it under its original name, which carries the variable symbol and period. A protocol issued to another variable symbol, with an invalid ČSSZ seal or with an employment the company does not have on record is refused.
imported.added: The protocol was imported. Sent tab: {status}.
imported.replaced: This protocol had already been imported — the record was updated, no duplicate was created.
imported.failed: The protocol could not be imported.
imported.note: This document arrived through the data box; the app did not send it. It therefore holds no submission payload — the status cannot be polled and no transaction can be closed. The protocol itself is the result.
imported.guid_missing: The protocol states no submission ID
imported.detail_unavailable: The stored original could not be re-read, so error detail is unavailable here. The protocol reports {total} error(s).
imported.errors_failed: The protocol errors could not be loaded.

ready.title: Prepared submissions are waiting to be sent
ready.description: These exact submissions have already been frozen but have not been sent yet (for a report in partial packages, not all packages have been sent). Send them directly from here by their submission number — the application will not look up another submission for the same period.
ready.user_action_note: Nothing is sent automatically. You start every dispatch with this button; for ISDS you then explicitly confirm sign-in and sending.
ready.vrep_started: Submission no. {id} was handed to the VREP gateway. Follow the result in the history below.
ready.isds_queued: The submission was prepared in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id}.
ready.isds_already_queued: The submission is already in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id}; no duplicate message was created.
ready.outbox: ISDS outgoing message no. {id} is prepared. Your sign-in and confirmation are still required before sending.
ready.existing_outbox: This submission is already in the ISDS outbox as message no. {id} — status: {state}. Another dispatch is blocked to prevent a duplicate.
ready.gateway_start_failed: The message is safely stored in the outbox, but ISDS sign-in could not be started. Open outgoing submissions and try signing in again.
ready.dispatch_failed: The prepared submission could not be handed over for dispatch.

packages.progress: The report has more than 1500 forms and is sent in {count} partial packages. Sent {sent} of {count}.
packages.interrupted: Sending was interrupted. The button sends only the packages that have not left yet; packages already sent are not sent again. Follow the protocols of the individual packages in the history below.
packages.vrep_only: A report split into partial packages is sent only via VREP; it cannot be sent through a data box.

transport.awaiting_note: ČSSZ confirmed receipt of the message, not acceptance of the submission — only the processing protocol decides the result. Fetch the status; until then do not close the transaction or the result would be lost.
transport.delete_hint: Permanently removes the attempt from history. Only possible for an attempt the authority never answered.
transport.delete_confirm: Permanently delete attempt #{no} from history? Nothing will remain but the audit log entry. An attempt with a protocol or delivery receipt cannot be deleted.
transport.delete_failed: The attempt could not be deleted.
transport.poll_failed: The submission status could not be fetched.
transport.poll_inconclusive: ČSSZ has returned neither a receipt confirmation nor a protocol yet. Please try again in a moment.
transport.close_failed: The transaction could not be closed.
transport.closed: The transaction of attempt no. {id} has been closed.
transport.close_note: The protocol has been retrieved, so the transaction can be closed. The ČSSZ submission protocol requires closing it.

reverify.hint: Verifies the stored ČSSZ protocol exactly like a freshly retrieved one. The submission status changes only if the protocol passes the signature check.
reverify.note: The ČSSZ protocol for this attempt is stored, but its signature could not be verified when it was retrieved, so the submission status was left unchanged. You can verify the protocol again.
reverify.verified: The protocol is verified and the submission is now “{status}”.
reverify.already: The protocol is already verified; nothing changed. The submission is “{status}”.
reverify.failed: The protocol could not be verified and the submission is unchanged. Reason: {message}
reverify.request_failed: The protocol re-verification could not be started.

transport.copy_failed: The browser did not allow clipboard access. Select the CorrelationID and copy it manually.
transport.acknowledged: ČSSZ confirmed receipt, processing is running. Recommended delay before the next query: {seconds} s.

report.control_unknown: Our catalog does not know this control — the message is therefore shown exactly as it arrived from ČSSZ.

automation.title: Protocol retrieval in the background
automation.description: The application asks ČSSZ for the result on its own and closes the transaction once the protocol arrives. The buttons below are here for when you need to step in sooner.
automation.next_poll: The next check is scheduled for {at}.
automation.next_poll_unknown: The next check will run on the next background pass.
automation.last_error: The last check failed: {message} The application will try again.
automation.closed: The transaction at ČSSZ is closed ({at}).
automation.close_pending: The transaction at ČSSZ is not closed yet; the application will try on its own.
automation.close_error: Closing the transaction failed: {message} Try closing it with the button.
automation.expired_note: The application stopped asking. Check the submission on the ČSSZ ePortal or in your data box and load the protocol using “Load protocol”.

transport.closed_already: This message's transaction was already closed.

storno.confirm_title: Really cancel the whole report for {period}?
storno.confirm_text: A cancellation voids ALL reports filed at ČSSZ for this period, not just the last one sent. It can only be filed until the 20th of the following month; after that only an amendment will do.
storno.frozen: The cancellation is prepared as submission no. {id}. Send it the same way as a regular report.
storno.already: A cancellation for this report already exists — it is submission no. {id}.
storno.failed: The cancellation could not be prepared.
storno.unavailable: Only a report already sent to ČSSZ can be cancelled.

correction.title: Content correction for {period}
correction.description: Select the current complete preparation after correcting payroll data. An accepted form is filed again in full with the same identity; a rejected or missing form is added as a new form. Summary and PVPOJ are always checked for everyone in the company.
correction.deadline_hint: A wrongly claimed relief for this period can only be corrected until the 20th day of the following month. After that deadline, no correction can be filed.
correction.preparation_placeholder: Search by revision, date or period
correction.preparation_loading: Finding eligible current preparations for this submission…
correction.preparation_empty: No complete current preparation is available for the same company, environment, period and payroll run.
correction.preparation_auto: The only eligible preparation was selected automatically: {preparation}
correction.preparation_load_failed: Eligible current preparations could not be loaded safely.
correction.loading: Verifying signed protocols and resolving the effective form state…
correction.empty: Enter the current preparation and load form results.
correction.protocol_errors: The last displayed protocol identified {count} employments with a specific error.
correction.select_errors: Select those flagged by the protocol
correction.impact_confirmation: I confirm that the current preparation contains complete corrected data. The application will freeze each selected form in full and, when affected, the summary and PVPOJ for everyone; sending remains a separate explicit action.
correction.frozen: The content correction is prepared as submission no. {id}. Review it and send it with a separate action.
correction.already: The same content correction was already frozen — it is submission no. {id}.
correction.load_failed: The effective form state could not be resolved authoritatively.
correction.failed: The content correction could not be prepared.

signing.title: ČSSZ signing certificate
signing.description: Choose which stored certificate signs this company's payroll submissions. Certificates are not uploaded here. The application has a single vault: upload the certificate under System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures and enable it for the company under Taxes → EPO filing & archive → EPO certificates.
signing.load_failed: The signing certificate settings could not be loaded.
signing.state_unknown: Until the request succeeds the system does not know whether a certificate is selected — please do not read this empty screen as proof that none is configured.
signing.storage_unavailable: The storage for the certificate choice is not available yet — the database migration has not run. The choice cannot be saved right now.

environment.label: Environment
environment.production_note: Live environment. This certificate signs real submissions to ČSSZ.
environment.test_note: ČSSZ test environment. The test certificate is usually a different one — mixing them up only shows up in the ČSSZ protocol, typically after the deadline.

current.title: What signs right now
current.none: No certificate is selected for this environment. Payroll submissions will not be signed.
current.foreign: Another user saved this choice with their own certificate — it is not in your vault, so you cannot sign with it.

picker.title: Certificate choice
picker.description: The list contains the vault certificates available to you. A new certificate is uploaded under System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures and enabled for this company under Taxes → EPO filing & archive → EPO certificates.
picker.label: Certificate from the vault

vault.empty: Your vault contains no certificate. Certificates are uploaded in one place for the whole application, under System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures.

certificate.subject: Issued to
certificate.serial_hex: Serial number (hexadecimal, as in the certificate)
certificate.serial_decimal: Serial number (decimal, as on the ČSSZ form)

serial.label: Serial number registered with ČSSZ
serial.hint: The number is on the “Oznámení o zmocnění k úkonům a službám ČSSZ a Úřadu práce ČR (pro zmocněnou osobu)” form you used to register the certificate with OSSZ. ČSSZ prints it in decimal while the certificate carries it in hexadecimal — compare it against both forms shown above. Separators (colons, spaces) do not matter.
serial.hint_optional: If the numbers do not match, the save is rejected: ČSSZ would reject a submission signed with such a certificate. The field may be left empty, but then nobody verifies the match against the registration.

step_up.title: Identity confirmation
step_up.hint: This choice decides what signs official filings on behalf of the company, so it is verified the same way as managing the key itself.
step_up.password_missing: Enter your current password, or verify with a passkey.
step_up.passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys — use your password.

signing.saved: The certificate choice has been saved.
signing.save_failed: The certificate choice could not be saved.
signing.removed: The certificate choice has been cleared.
signing.remove_failed: The certificate choice could not be cleared.
signing.read_only: You are not allowed to change the signing certificate.

inbox.title: Payroll submission inbox
inbox.subtitle: A derived overview of approaching and missed deadlines, rejected submissions and pending identity checks. Acknowledging or snoozing never changes the obligation or submission state — it only manages the reminder.
inbox.load_failed: The inbox could not be loaded.
inbox.empty: No open items. Everything is either fine or resolved.
inbox.snooze_until_required: Enter the date and time to snooze until.
inbox.snooze_until_past: The snooze date must be in the future — please pick a later date and time.
inbox.snooze_reason_placeholder: E.g. waiting for a document from the client.
inbox.snooze_reason_required: Please provide a reason for snoozing.

overview.transport_available: Submit by data box from the app
overview.load_failed: The obligation and submission overview could not be loaded.
overview.jmhz_load_failed: The PVPOJ control preview is unavailable for one or more approved revisions.
overview.jmhz_download_failed: The PVPOJ control preview could not be downloaded.

overview.jmhz_preview_empty: No approved revision with a complete social-insurance calculation and CSSZ liability is available for the selected period.
overview.jmhz_office_variable_symbol_missing: has no employer variable symbol at CSSZ — the overview cannot be filed without it. Add it in the payroll office settings.
overview.jmhz_social_office_unknown: The payroll office no longer exists in the company register, so the overview cannot be assigned to it.
overview.jmhz_social_office_allocation_failed: Splitting the social-insurance contribution across payroll offices failed, so no per-registration overview was produced.
overview.jmhz_social_multiple_offices: The payroll run covers relationships from several payroll offices. PVPOJ is filed per registration — choose which one to build.
overview.jmhz_evidence_description: Ordinary employments are evidenced automatically from saved payroll and effective terms. The payroll accountant handles only recorded exceptions or incomplete sources.
overview.jmhz_evidence_empty: There is no approved revision to confirm for the selected period.
overview.jmhz_evidence_confirm_each: I explicitly confirm that none of the following occurred in the period:
overview.jmhz_evidence_load_failed: The legal-fact confirmation could not be loaded.
overview.jmhz_evidence_save_failed: The legal-fact confirmation could not be saved.

overview.jmhz_evidence_attention_default: This employment requires monthly exception details.

jmhz_evidence_facts.specific_legal_fact_occurred: No specific legal fact governed by interaction IN13 occurred.
jmhz_evidence_facts.ozp_employment_support_claimed: No employment support for persons with disabilities governed by interaction IN28 is claimed.
jmhz_evidence_facts.deep_mining_work_occurred: No deep-mining work governed by interaction IN30 was performed.

overview.jmhz_dry_run_description: Builds the ordinary monthly report XML from the frozen sources and validates it against the pinned ČSSZ schema. Nothing is sent and no submission is created.
overview.jmhz_dry_run_empty: There is no approved revision to dry-run for the selected period.
overview.jmhz_dry_run_valid: The XML passed the pinned schema {version}.
overview.jmhz_dry_run_blocked: The report cannot be built yet. There are {count} completion steps below ({records} individual findings).

jmhz_attribute_glossary.10051: personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV), assigned by the social security administration
jmhz_attribute_glossary.10228: employment identifier (ID PPV), assigned by the social security administration

overview.jmhz_dry_run_copy_failed: The browser did not allow clipboard access. Open the XML with the button next to it and copy it manually.
overview.jmhz_dry_run_read_only: You do not have write access to payroll submissions, so the dry run cannot be started.
overview.jmhz_dry_run_incomplete: The XML passed the schema, but the control catalogue is not fully executed yet — the submission is not ready to send.
overview.jmhz_controls_summary: CSSZ controls: {passed} passed · {failed} failed · {remote} decided by CSSZ · {gaps} not implemented
overview.jmhz_controls_blocking: Blocking defects ({count}) — the submission would be ineffective
overview.jmhz_controls_warnings: Passable defects ({count}) — the submission goes through with wrong data
overview.jmhz_deadline: Submission window: {from} to {to} (shifted to a working day).
overview.jmhz_controls_deviations: Deviations from the literal catalogue wording ({count}) — verified against the CSSZ protocol, does not block the filing
overview.jmhz_dry_run_failed: The JMHZ monthly report test could not be started.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_description: Choose the transport channel. Both paths first freeze the exact XML data that will be sent. ISDS prepares a data message for CSSA and asks you to sign in and approve it directly in the data box.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_empty: Complete an approved payroll revision, the validation preview and the mandatory legal evidence first.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_confirm_vrep: You are sending the monthly report for {period} under VS {symbol} straight to the Social Security Administration over VREP, signed with a certificate. Environment: {environment}.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_confirm_isds: You are sending the monthly report for {period} under VS {symbol} to the Social Security Administration through the data box. Environment: {environment}.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_confirm_irreversible: Sending cannot be undone. A mistake can only be fixed by filing a correction.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_obligation_missing: No JMHZ obligation is recorded for this registration. Refresh the overview or check obligation creation for the payroll run.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_not_open: Production filing opens on {date}. The test environment remains available for rehearsal.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_already_started: The filing is already in status {status}. Another copy cannot be created; follow it in the submissions overview.
overview.jmhz_abandon_hint: If the Social Security Administration refused the filing, discard the pending send and file again.
overview.jmhz_abandon_prompt: Why is the send being discarded? Paste what the Social Security Administration replied — it stays with the attempt in the history.
overview.jmhz_abandon_failed: The pending send could not be discarded.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_failed: JMHZ could not be frozen or handed to the selected channel.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_vrep_started: VREP accepted attempt #{id} in status {status}. Follow its result and protocol on the Sent tab.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_isds_queued: The message is ready for {name}, box ID {box}. It has NOT been sent yet — send it from the outbox.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_manual: Neither the sending gateway nor the Mobile Key is available for this company. Send the message from the outbox using your own data box, then fill in the message ID and the delivery receipt.
overview.jmhz_dispatch_mobile_key: The sending gateway is not active, but the filing can be sent directly from the app once you confirm the session in Mobile Key.
overview.jmhz_gateway_credentials: You enter credentials only on the ISDS page. MyÚčto neither sees nor stores them, and the message is sent only after you approve the draft.
overview.jmhz_gateway_methods: ISDS determines the methods available for your account — for example username and password, an application password with the eGovernment security key, or the Mobile eGovernment Key.
overview.jmhz_gateway_continue: Sign in and approve in ISDS
overview.jmhz_gateway_start_failed: The data message is queued, but ISDS sign-in could not be started. Continue from the ISDS outbox.

jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_identity_id_ppv_missing: The employment identifier (ID PPV) is missing. It is assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered — copy it from the registration receipt or the portal. It is filled in on the employment card, section "Identifiers assigned by the social security administration".
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_identity_unresolved: The employment has an unresolved identity task towards the social security administration. Finish it on the employment card; the report cannot be built until then.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.unknown: The report check could not be completed and the application cannot yet identify a specific remedy. Contact support with the period, employment and technical check details. Do not guess replacement values.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.effective_term_missing: The effective employment terms for this month are missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.component_jmhz_mapping_missing: A payroll component used in this period has no monthly report mapping. Add it in Payroll → Components. Components not used in the period do not block the report.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.component_jmhz_manual_review: A payroll component's JMHZ classification requires manual review.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.component_jmhz_treatment_invalid: A payroll component has an invalid JMHZ setting.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_average_hourly_earning_missing: The verified average hourly earnings are missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_whole_czk_required: The amount reported in the monthly report as whole crowns came out with hallers in the payroll run result. The official ČSSZ and MPSV documentation does not define how hallers are rounded, so the app does not round them on its own. Under Sections 142(2) and 144 of the Labour Code, wages, salaries, agreement remuneration and wage compensation are rounded up to whole crowns: open Payroll → Payroll runs, round the haller amount of the payroll component up to whole crowns for the affected people (the field number is in the technical detail) and recalculate the run.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_identity_incomplete: The employment has no stored personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV) or employment identifier (ID PPV). Both numbers are assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered. If the employee is not registered yet, file the registration first (PREZEC/REGZEC A1); the numbers arrive in the receipt. Otherwise copy them from the receipt or the social security portal. They are filled in on the employment card, section "Identifiers assigned by the social security administration".
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_identity_oic_missing: The personal identifier (OIC / IK MPSV) is missing. It is assigned by the social security administration when the employee is registered — copy it from the registration receipt or the portal. It is filled in on the employment card, section "Identifiers assigned by the social security administration".
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario_activity_code_missing: The JMHZ activity type code is missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_verified_boolean_missing: A mandatory yes/no choice has not been confirmed.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_work_month_not_approved: The month's working time has not been approved.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_workplace_codebooks_unverified: Verified workplace code-list data is missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_ordinary_evidence_missing: The ordinary-profile legal facts are not confirmed.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_attribute_10116_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether statutory or contractual wage deductions are reported.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_attribute_10546_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether the employee claims the seasonal social-insurance discount.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_interaction_in13_unresolved: The occurrence of the specific employment legal fact has not been confirmed.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_interaction_in28_unresolved: Employment support for persons with disabilities has not been confirmed.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_interaction_in30_unresolved: It has not been confirmed whether the employee performed deep-mining work.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_primary_employment_unresolved: The primary employment relationship is not determined. An employee with concurrent relationships must have exactly one relationship marked as the main one; the others are secondary.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_taxpayer_declaration_unresolved: The taxpayer declaration is not evidenced.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_advance_tax_missing: The advance tax result is missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_advance_tax_incomplete: The advance tax result is incomplete.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_tax_credit_breakdown_unav: The breakdown of claimed tax credits cannot be reported yet.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_deductions_unsupported: Wage deductions are not supported by this profile yet.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_withholding_tax_unsupport: Withholding tax is not supported by this profile yet.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_withholding_above_thresho: Withholding tax must not apply because income from agreements to complete a job and from other relationships reaches the statutory thresholds (ČSSZ check 325).
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_concurrent_participation_: In this month the employee has more than one concurrent relationship participating in social insurance and the payroll run result was calculated before contributions were calculated per relationship. Open Payroll → Payroll runs, choose “Open correction” on this month's run, calculate the payroll again, approve the new revision and prepare the report again.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_temporary_assignment_user_missing: The employee is temporarily assigned to a user undertaking (employment agency), but the user is not identified. On the employment card, in the ČSSZ evidence section, enter the user's company ID (IČO), or for a foreign entity its country, registration number and name. Then recalculate the payroll run.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_risk_categorization_missing: The relationship is classified as a paramedic or a member of a company fire unit, but it does not say which of the two. On the employment card, in the Exceptional situations section, choose the “JMHZ risk categorisation”. Then recalculate the payroll run.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_employee_social_discount_relationsh: The working pensioner's social insurance discount cannot be assigned to an employment: the relationship that carries the person's contributions does not participate in insurance or has a different assessment base than the one the discount was calculated from. Check participation of the relationships in Payroll → Payroll runs.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_employee_social_discount_exclusive: One employment combines the working pensioner discount with the seasonal social insurance discount. Both cannot be applied at the same time; correct one of them.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_annual_fields_unsupported: Annual attributes are not supported by this profile yet.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_pvpoj_unavailable: The insurance part of the submission is missing.
jmhz_dry_run_blockers.jmhz_scenario1_pvpoj_source_mismatch: The insurance part does not match the selected CSSZ registration. Refresh the overview and check the payroll-office assignment.

eldp.title: Pension insurance record sheet
eldp.intro: The record sheet is no longer an annual duty. From 2026 the employer neither draws it up nor files it — pension insurance data is reported in the single monthly employer report and the Czech Social Security Administration assembles the sheet from it; employees can see it on the ČSSZ ePortal. Here you prepare one only in three exceptions:

exceptions.beforeTwentySix: For periods before 1 January 2026, governed by the earlier wording of the Act.
exceptions.endedBeforeApril: For employment ended before 1 April 2026, covered by the transitional provision.
exceptions.authorityRequest: On request from ČSSZ/ÚSSZ under Section 38a(2) and (3) — when the deadline for the monthly or corrective report has passed, or the record sheet cannot be assembled from the reported data.

notApplicable.title: No record sheet is drawn up for this year and employment.
notApplicable.authorityHint: If ČSSZ/ÚSSZ asked you to file one, tick the request option below and enter the date you received it; the eight-day deadline runs from that day.

exceptionOnly.title: This is an exception, not an annual duty.

eldp.legalBasis: Act No. 582/1991 Coll., Section 38(1) and (2) and Section 39(1) as amended by Act No. 360/2025 Coll.; exceptions under Section 38a(2) and (3) and the transitional provisions. The form itself was not abolished, it merely stopped being routine.
eldp.confirmExcluded: I confirm the excluded periods derived from the recorded absences.
eldp.deductedDerivedHint: Periods deducted after reaching retirement age (code D) are derived from absences: unpaid leave, unexcused absence, sickness, care and months without insurance participation.
eldp.deathOnHint: Fill in only for a pension record issued in connection with death (type 03). It is submitted within 3 months of death.

copy.hint: The copies are printed from the frozen sheet. Have the employee sign the copy for the employer's records and keep it for three years after the year it covers; record the hand-over at the request on the person card.
copy.failed: The copy could not be prepared.

fromRequest.title: Record sheet for a recorded request
fromRequest.hint: The request data are taken from the recorded request; the prepared sheet is linked to it and the submission then carries the deadline.

eldp.requestedByAuthority: The record sheet is being prepared at the request of the authority.
eldp.authorityRequestReceivedOnHint: The eight-day deadline starts on this date. For a request made during the year, the sheet ends with the last month whose payroll has already been approved; future months are not required.
eldp.authorityRequestDueOnHint: From 2027 the deadline for a pension record on request is no longer set by law but by the request itself. Copy it from the request.

pension.title: Employee pension details
pension.description: The ELDP code and whether the record is kept at all depend on pension details. Their source is the statutory records on the person card (sections Retirement age and Pension received), the same as for the monthly report. The fields here are only a check: an empty field means "as recorded", a filled one must match the records.
pension.ageReachedOnHint: Only if it happened by the end of the reported year. From this date the activity has code D (e.g. 1D+).
pension.earlyPensionFrom: Recipient of early old-age pension from
pension.earlyPensionFromHint: From this date the activity also has code D. The record is still kept.
pension.fullPensionPaidFrom: First month of full old-age pension payment
pension.fullPensionPaidFromHint: From 2025 no pension record is kept for a recipient of a full old-age pension; months from this month are left out of the record.
pension.foreignInsurance: The employee participates or participated in pension insurance abroad (the record is then kept even for a full pension recipient).
pension.confirm: I confirm the employee's pension details for the reported year (empty fields are taken from the person's statutory records).

accident_insurance.rate_source_hint: The employer determines the rate and calculates and pays the premium itself (section 12(2) of the decree) — the insurer issues no assessment. The schedule below is a reference for picking the rate; what gets saved is what you confirm. Enter the insurer's bank account and variable symbol in the Institution payment accounts section above (type Statutory insurance) — use the same institution code here.

schedule.title: Annex 2 rate schedule
schedule.subtitle: Eight rate groups and 98 activities exactly as listed by the decree. Expand and pick the row matching the company's actual prevailing activity.
schedule.okec_warning: Annex 2 classifies activities by OKEČ, which the Czech Statistical Office retired on 31 December 2007 and replaced with CZ-NACE. The decree has not changed since, so OKEČ remains the binding classification — and the same number means something else in each: OKEČ 62 is air transport, CZ-NACE 62 is information technology. Do not match code numbers. No legal act contains a binding OKEČ to CZ-NACE conversion table either; the insurers' tables are guidance only, and some CZ-NACE codes end up with two different rates in them.
schedule.nace_is: The company's CZ-NACE activity is {nace}. The suggestions below are matched by its NAME, not by the code number.
schedule.nace_missing: The company has no CZ-NACE code in its settings, so MyÚčto has nothing to suggest from. Pick a row from the schedule yourself.
schedule.no_suggestion: Nothing in the annex matches the name of this activity. Go through the schedule — if the activity is not listed and does not involve explosives, radioactive substances, radon, infectious material, poisons or work at great heights or depths, it belongs to „Other economic activities“ (5.6 ‰).
schedule.suggestion_disclaimer: The suggestion is not binding. The rate follows from the prevailing core activity of the employer's business — verify it, MyÚčto does not vouch for it.
schedule.filter_placeholder: Part of an activity name or OKEČ code

accounting_row_hint.withholding_tax: Tax at a special rate under § 6(4) of the Income Tax Act (small agreements without a taxpayer declaration). It is remitted by a separate payment (account prefix 7720 instead of 7704), on a different due date and reported separately, so a shared account merges both liabilities and the balance can no longer be matched against the payments. Tax bonuses and annual settlement refunds belong to the ADVANCE tax account, not here.
accounting_row_hint.risky_savings: Statutory employer contribution to retirement savings for risk work (4% of the assessment base from 1 January 2026). It is not paid to the employee but remitted to the pension company, so it is a statutory social expense (527) against other payables (379), not insurance on 336.
accounting_row_hint.employee_receivable: Where a negative net wage is reclassified — typically health insurance topped up to the minimum assessment base in a month with no cash income. The employee owes the employer, so this is a receivable (335), not a payable.
accounting_row_hint.non_deductible_benefit: The tax-exempt part of a non-cash benefit (recreation, sport, culture, health care, printed books). Under Section 25(1)(h) of the Income Tax Act it is precisely the EXEMPT part that is non-deductible; the part above the cap is taxed at the employee and stays deductible. Account 528 flows automatically into non-deductible expenses in the corporate income tax return.
accounting_row_hint.travel_expense: A travel allowance reimburses an expense under Part Seven of the Labour Code; it is not remuneration for work and does not belong in wage expenses. The contra account stays the payable account of the employment relationship, because the allowance is paid together with the wage.
accounting_row_hint.enforcement_deductions: Deductions ordered by a court, a bailiff or an insolvency administrator. Kept apart from other deductions because they carry a claim ranking and go to a different recipient than voluntary deductions — on a shared account the two balances merge and cannot be traced.
accounting_row_hint.enforcement_fee_revenue: The CZK 50 monthly flat fee the wage payer keeps from the deducted amount to cover its costs (Section 270(2) of the Civil Procedure Code). It is deducted from the employee but not sent to the creditor — without moving it to revenue, a balance would build up on the garnishment liability every month. Usually 648 Other operating revenue. Leave empty to keep the fee on the liability.
accounting_row_hint.accident_insurance: Quarterly premium under Decree No. 125/1993 Coll. The insurer issues no document, so under double-entry bookkeeping the charge (debit expense / credit liability) is created when payments are prepared for the last month of the quarter, and the payment is then posted against that liability.
