codes.jmhz_submission_obligation_scope_mismatc: The recorded obligation does not match the payroll run, period or JMHZ agenda, so the submission cannot be linked to it.
codes.jmhz_submission_period_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry a valid reporting period. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_preparation_blocked: The JMHZ preparation is incomplete, the submission is not created. Complete the missing data according to the check details.
codes.jmhz_submission_replay_mismatch: The frozen artifact of the corrective JMHZ submission is missing or does not match the original submission. Prepare the corrective submission again.
codes.jmhz_submission_replay_state_invalid: The existing JMHZ submission is no longer in the ready-to-send state, so it cannot be recreated with the same content. Refresh the submission state.
codes.jmhz_submission_run_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry the payroll run it belongs to. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_snapshot_hash_missing: The JMHZ document does not carry the fingerprint of the preparation it was built from. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_submission_split_payload: The report is split into partial packages and each package is handled separately. Open the packages in the submission detail.
codes.jmhz_submission_split_refreeze_unsupport: A report split into partial packages cannot be frozen again one package at a time. Discard the rejected submission and freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_state_unknown: The previous JMHZ submission's state is not defined in the application; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_submission_type_invalid: The frozen JMHZ submission does not have a supported type R, O or S. Freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_submission_type_unknown: The JMHZ submission type is not defined in the application's rules; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_taxpayer_declaration_unresolved: The taxpayer declaration is not evidenced.
codes.jmhz_temporary_assignment_user_missing: The employee is temporarily assigned to a user, but the employment lacks the user's identification (ČSSZ check 103). Fill in the user's company ID, or for a foreign entity the country, registration number and name.
codes.jmhz_verified_boolean_missing: The recorded value for the APZ contribution, functional benefits or temporary assignment is invalid.
codes.jmhz_vrep_correlation_invalid: The JMHZ submission's CorrelationID has an invalid format; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_endpoint_missing: The operation address for VREP is not configured for this environment; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_http_error: The ČSSZ VREP server returned an HTTP error while sending the JMHZ submission. Try sending it again after a while.
codes.jmhz_vrep_invalid_response: The ČSSZ VREP server returned an empty or oversized response while sending the JMHZ submission. Try sending it again after a while.
codes.jmhz_vrep_poll_request_mismatch: The JMHZ submission status query does not reference the correct CorrelationID; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_request_empty: An empty JMHZ submission envelope cannot be sent to VREP; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_vrep_unavailable: The ČSSZ VREP system is temporarily unavailable or the response did not arrive. Try sending the JMHZ submission again after a while.
codes.jmhz_work_month_not_approved: The month's working time has not been approved.
codes.jmhz_work_summary_v2_missing: The approved monthly work summary is missing.
codes.jmhz_workplace_codebooks_unverified: Verified workplace code-list data is missing.
codes.jmhz_xml_attribute_unresolved: The frozen JMHZ document does not have evidence for a required attribute, and it must not be auto-filled with zero or false. Prepare and freeze the report again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_bonus_without_declaration: The monthly tax bonus cannot be reported without a signed taxpayer declaration. Add the taxpayer declaration for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_child_credit_without_children: The monthly child tax credit cannot be reported if the employee has no recorded dependent children. Add the dependent children for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_credit_without_declaration: A claimed tax credit cannot be reported without a signed taxpayer declaration. Add the taxpayer declaration for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_document_version_unsupported: The JMHZ serializer can only process the current version of the scenario 1 normalized document. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_code_required: An ELDP pension insurance record section with a nonzero number of days must have an ELDP code. Prepare the evidence sheet again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_excluded_days_sum_mismatch: The total excluded periods in the pension record do not match their breakdown by type (Section 16(4) of Act No. 155/1995). Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_excluded_days_without_code: Excluded periods cannot be reported in the pension record without an excluded-period type code. Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_missing: A submission component must contain at least one ELDP pension record section. Prepare the report again; contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_eldp_section18_days_sum_mismatc: The total excluded days in the pension record do not match their breakdown under Section 18(7) of Act No. 187/2006. Check the absences in the period.
codes.jmhz_xml_employee_social_discount_mispla: The employee's social insurance discount can only be carried on the form that reports that person's contributions. Check the discount assignment and insurance participation of the employments.
codes.jmhz_xml_employee_social_discount_zero: The employee's social insurance discount is marked as claimed but its amount is zero. Check the discount calculation or its confirmation for the employee.
codes.jmhz_xml_employer_rate_category_unknown: Without the employer's rate category, the assessment base cannot be split under Section 5a(1) of the Social Security Contributions Act. Set the employer's rate category in the payroll office settings.
codes.jmhz_xml_exempt_income_exceeds_total: Exempt income must not exceed the total processed income. Check the payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_form_limit_exceeded: One data package of a submission carries at most 1500 forms. The application splits a regular report above that limit into partial packages itself; an amending or cancelling submission of that size does not fit into one package. Amend fewer employments at once and send the rest in another amending submission.
codes.jmhz_xml_identity_name_incomplete: The employee is reported by name because the social security administration has not yet assigned an OIC or ID PPV, and in addition the surname, first name, date of birth, start date or activity type is missing.
codes.jmhz_xml_international_hire_attribute_un: The international hiring-out form (activity type 12) carries only the basic taxpayer credit and no monthly tax bonus. File an employment with another credit, a child benefit or a bonus manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_no_valid_form: The JMHZ submission must contain at least one valid component, but none remained after processing. ČSSZ rejects a regular report without any person form (check 232). Check the employments included in this report; an employment that continues without income is reported with a zero form.
codes.jmhz_xml_not_byte_stable: Re-serializing the same JMHZ submission did not return identical bytes; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_xml_overtime_exceeds_worked_hours: Overtime hours in the work summary must not exceed the number of worked hours. Check and correct the working time for the month.
codes.jmhz_xml_paid_unworked_hours_below_sickn: The paid non-worked hours in the work summary do not cover the hours of sickness with wage compensation. Check the sickness records and working time for the month.
codes.jmhz_xml_period_invalid: The JMHZ submission's reporting period is out of the valid range; it must be a valid calendar month matching the pinned schema. Check the reporting period of the report or the cancellation.
codes.jmhz_xml_primary_employment_invalid: The employee must have exactly one employment marked as primary, on which the summary data is reported. Check and correct the primary-employment marking on the employee's card.
codes.jmhz_xml_prisoner_excluded_days_unsuppor: The prisoner form carries only sick leave and maternity among excluded periods. Family member care, paternity or another excluded period cannot be entered there; file this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_pvpoj_missing: A regular JMHZ submission must contain the insurance part (PVPOJ). Check the social insurance calculation in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_resolution_blocked: The JMHZ document has unresolved blocking findings, so it cannot be serialized into a submission or a content correction. Fix the earlier findings listed in the report check.
codes.jmhz_xml_scenario_3_profile_unsupported: An employment with activity type K through S only supports the statutory profile S with detail 1; any other combination requires individual handling and filing through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_scenario_unsupported: The submission component does not belong to a JMHZ scenario the application can build automatically. File this employment's report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_serialization_failed: The JMHZ submission XML could not be created due to a technical error. Try again, and contact support if the problem persists.
codes.jmhz_xml_split_submission_unsupported: The data package order does not match the number of packages of the report. A report with more than 1500 forms is split into partial packages when it is frozen; run the report test and freeze the report again from the preparation.
codes.jmhz_xml_submission_type_unsupported: The source document for building the XML must be a complete regular preparation; another document type cannot be serialized. Prepare the regular report again.
codes.jmhz_xml_surcharge_total_missing: The surcharge breakdown cannot be reported without the total surcharge amount (field 10332). Check the surcharge payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_temporary_assignment_user_inval: The temporary assignment user is not filled in correctly (the company ID must have eight digits). Correct it on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_xml_risk_categorization_invalid: The risk categorization must come from the ČSSZ code list (1, 6 or 7). Correct it on the employment card.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_type_invalid: The deferred income type must come from the ČSSZ code list (1 to 6). Contact support.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_periods_unsuppo: Type 1 deferred income carries exactly one ELDP period; the application cannot build another layout. File the report manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_xml_deferred_income_period_invalid: The deferred income month must be 1 to 12. Contact support.
codes.jmhz_deferred_income_type_unsupported: The application processes only type 1 deferred income on its own. File other types manually through the ČSSZ ePortal.
codes.jmhz_eldp_deferred_section_invalid: The deferred income ELDP does not match the frozen run result. Prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_xml_variable_symbol_invalid: The employer's variable symbol must have exactly ten digits. Check the variable symbol setting for the payroll office or the OSSZ registration.
codes.jmhz_xml_wage_breakdown_without_wage: The wage breakdown cannot be reported when the processed wage is zero. Check the payroll components in the payroll run.
codes.jmhz_xml_work_summary_missing: The submission component has no frozen monthly work summary. Approve the working time for the month and prepare the report again.
codes.jmhz_xsd_validation_failed: The monthly JMHZ report XML failed validation against the pinned XSD schema; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_zero_report_attribute_unknown: The requested zero-report JMHZ attribute is not defined in the application; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.
codes.jmhz_zero_report_situation_unknown: The zero-report situation for JMHZ is not described in the application's rules; this is a technical issue for support to investigate.

server_codes.nempri_transfer_not_required: The second NEMPRI notice as of the transfer date is not filed for this case: the employee was not transferred because of pregnancy, maternity or breastfeeding in an earlier month than the social event. Check the transfer and its reason in the case.
server_codes.nempri_decision_number_missing: The decision number is missing (for an e-sick-note or eOČR, the number from the doctor's decision). ČSSZ uses it to match the notice to the decision. Fill it in on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_relationship_code_invalid: The relationship to the cared-for person is not a ČSSZ code-list value for this benefit type. Select it from the list on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_relationship_code_not_in_kind: The relationship to the cared-for person is only filled in for care benefit and long-term care benefit.
server_codes.nempri_paternity_reason_invalid: The paternity benefit reason must be OTC, ZEM or PEC. Select it from the list on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_paternity_reason_not_in_kind: The paternity benefit reason is only filled in for paternity benefit.
server_codes.nempri_maternity_care_reason_invalid: The reason for taking the child into care must be a value from the CIS_DUVPREVZETI code list. Select it from the list.
server_codes.nempri_maternity_care_reason_not_in_kind: The reason for taking the child into care is only filled in for maternity benefit.
server_codes.nempri_maternity_care_reason_with_decisi: With a reason for taking the child into care the submission must not carry a decision number. Remove it on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_maternity_child_without_care_reas: A regular start of maternity benefit carries no child. Fill in the reason for taking the child into care, or remove the child from the case.
server_codes.nempri_maternity_care_child_missing: When the child was taken into care, the application must name that child.
server_codes.sickness_event_after_employment: The insured event began after the employment ended and this benefit type has no protection period. Check the event start date or the employment end date.
server_codes.sickness_event_outside_protection_period: The insured event began after the protection period following the end of employment (section 15 of Act No. 187/2006 Coll.). No entitlement arose from this employment.
server_codes.sickness_protection_period_excluded: No protection period follows from this employment (agreement to complete a job, small-scope employment, a student during holidays, or a recipient of an old-age or third-degree invalidity pension). No entitlement arose after the employment ended.
server_codes.hzupn_not_for_benefit_kind: The notice of ending incapacity for work is only filed for sickness benefit.
server_codes.nempri_within_wage_compensation_window: The incapacity for work or quarantine did not exceed 14 calendar days. It is fully covered by wage compensation (section 192 of the Labour Code) and sickness benefit is only paid from day 15 (section 26(1) of Act No. 187/2006 Coll.), so nothing is sent to the Czech Social Security Administration. If the incapacity lasted longer, correct its end date in the case.
server_codes.hzupn_return_before_incapacity: The day of return to work cannot precede the start of the incapacity for work.
server_codes.dlo_employer_consent_invalid: The employer's decision on long-term care must be consent or refusal.
server_codes.dlo_employer_consent_missing: Select whether the employer consented to the long-term care or refused it.
server_codes.dlo_employer_consent_not_in_kind: The employer's consent is only recorded for long-term care benefit.
server_codes.dlo_employer_consent_date_missing: Fill in the date the employer told the employee its decision on long-term care.
server_codes.dlo_employer_refusal_reason_missing: A refusal of long-term care must state the reason: serious operational reasons under section 191a of the Labour Code.
server_codes.dlo_employer_refusal_reason_without_refu: The refusal reason is only filled in for a refusal.
server_codes.dlo_employer_refusal_reason_too_long: The refusal reason may have at most 500 characters.
server_codes.dlo_employer_refused: The employer refused the long-term care, so long-term care benefit does not arise from this employment and the application is not forwarded.
server_codes.sickness_case_actor_missing: The benefit case was not created automatically. Create it manually under Submissions → Sickness insurance benefits.
server_codes.sickness_case_has_submission: The benefit case already has a prepared or sent submission, so it was not cancelled together with the absence. Check it under Submissions → Sickness insurance benefits.
server_codes.nempri_care_reason_invalid: The care reason must be illness, quarantine, inability to care for the child, or closure of a school or facility.
server_codes.nempri_cared_person_not_found: The selected person is not a dependant of this employee. Select them again on the case.
server_codes.nempri_codebook_value_invalid: A ČSSZ code list value has 1 to 3 characters 0-9 and A-Z.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_month_missing: The submission must carry every month of the decisive period and some have no source. Calculate and approve the months MyÚčto calculates; add taken-over wages in the payroll takeover check. You can also enter the months manually on the case.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_months_invalid: Each month of the decisive period needs a month (YYYY-MM), non-negative countable income and 0 to 31 excluded days.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_excluded_days_unknown: Excluded days under section 18(7) of the Sickness Insurance Act cannot be determined for some months of the decisive period. Zero would lower the daily assessment base. Enter these months manually on the case.
server_codes.nempri_capped_base_unsupported: The taken-over assessment base is capped by the annual maximum and the report does not carry the part above it. The decisive period needs the full amount. Enter these months manually on the case.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_payroll_source_invalid: A frozen payroll revision does not match its fingerprint, so the decisive period cannot be built from it. Contact support.
server_codes.nempri_payment_connection_partner_settle: The wage is paid through a partner, so MyÚčto does not know the account or address for paying the benefit, which NEMPRI requires. Correct the payout method in the person's payout profile, or submit the notification outside the application.
server_codes.nempri_payment_address_invalid: The address for paying the benefit needs a municipality, a house number and a postal code. Correct it on the person card.
server_codes.nempri_bank_code_unknown: The bank code of the payout account is not in the current Czech National Bank code list, so ČSSZ would reject the NEMPRI notice. Correct the account on the person card.
server_codes.nempri_payment_connection_invalid: The employee's payout account is neither a valid Czech account nor an IBAN, so it cannot be written to NEMPRI. Correct it on the person card.
server_codes.nempri_payment_connection_missing: The employee's payout profile has no account the wage is paid to. Without it ČSSZ will request the payment method and the benefit will be delayed. Add the account on the person card.
server_codes.nempri_periods_invalid: Care days must be a list of from–to periods.
server_codes.nempri_legacy_form_required: The event arose before 1 January 2025. Nursing benefit, long-term nursing benefit, paternity benefit and maternity benefit with a decision issued in 2024 are handled with the NEMPRI20 form, which MyÚčto does not build. Submit the notification as NEMPRI20 outside the application, for example through the ČSSZ ePortal.
server_codes.nempri_care_actions_all_three: ČSSZ does not use Start, Continuation and End together. If the need for care has already ended, select only Start and End in the case (Continuation is redundant).
server_codes.nempri_care_continuation_with_end: According to ČSSZ, Continuation together with End is redundant. If the need for care has ended, select only End in the case.
server_codes.nempri_decision_number_forbidden: The decision number is not filled in for this benefit type. Remove it on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_decision_number_format_invalid: The decision number does not have the format ČSSZ checks for this benefit type (NEM: a letter and 6 to 7 digits, or 10 digits optionally prefixed with the IČPE; PPM ends with M, OSE with N or Z, OPP with T, DLO with L, always a seven-digit number with an optional ICPE prefix).
server_codes.nempri_worked_hours_missing: The employee worked on the day of the event, so the confirmation must state the hours worked and the working time. If the application did not find them in shifts or the schedule, fill them in on the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_worked_hours_exceed_working_time: The hours worked must not exceed the working time.
server_codes.nempri_hours_without_worked: Hours worked and working time are stated only when the employee worked on the day of the event. Tick "worked" or remove the hours.
server_codes.nempri_school_holidays_missing: The employee is a student, so the confirmation must say whether the event falls within school holidays.
server_codes.nempri_school_holidays_without_student: School holidays are stated only for a student.
server_codes.nempri_pension_kind_missing: The employee receives a pension, so the confirmation must state the pension type.
server_codes.nempri_pension_kind_without_pension: The pension type is stated only for an employee who receives a pension.
server_codes.nempri_pension_kind_invalid: The pension type must be a code from the ČSSZ code list CIS_DRUHDUCH_NEM. Choose it from the list in the benefit case.
server_codes.nempri_child_birth_missing: The employee starts maternity benefit, so the confirmation must state the child's date of birth.
server_codes.nempri_child_birth_without_maternity: The child's date of birth is stated only when starting maternity benefit.
server_codes.nempri_unpaid_leave_end_missing: Unpaid leave must also have the day it lasted until.
server_codes.nempri_other_claim_details_missing: If another person is stated to have a claim to the benefit, the application must also state the parental allowance claim and the other natural person under section 57.
server_codes.nempri_cared_personally_missing: For continued or ended care the application must say whether the employee cared personally.
server_codes.nempri_planned_shifts_missing: For continued or ended care the supporting data must say whether the employee had planned shifts.
server_codes.nempri_planned_shifts_worked_missing: With planned shifts the supporting data must say whether the employee worked them.
server_codes.nempri_shift_schedule_missing: With planned shifts the supporting data must contain the shift schedule.
server_codes.nempri_leave_flag_missing: For long-term care benefit the supporting data must say whether the employee had time off work.
server_codes.nempri_leave_periods_missing: If the employee had time off work, the supporting data must state its periods.
server_codes.nempri_worked_last_day_missing: When care ends, the supporting data must say whether the employee worked on the last day of care.
server_codes.nempri_last_day_hours_missing: The supporting data must state both the working time and the hours worked on the last day.
server_codes.nempri_last_day_hours_exceed: The hours worked on the last day must not exceed the working time.
server_codes.nempri_return_date_missing: If last-day hours are filled in, the supporting data must also state the return-to-work date.
server_codes.nempri_school_business_id_missing: For a closed school or facility the application must state its company ID.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_period_missing: The submission must contain the decisive period. Add the months of the decisive period or the probable income.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_period_probable_with_mon: The decisive period carries either months or the probable income, never both.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_period_empty: The decisive period carries neither months nor the probable income.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_period_incomplete: The list of months of the decisive period must cover the whole period (each calendar month exactly once), otherwise ÚSSZ cannot compute the daily assessment base.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_income_zero: The countable income for the decisive period is zero. State the probable income instead of the months.
server_codes.nempri_decisive_amount_not_whole_czk: A month of the decisive period carries income with cents. NEMPRI accepts whole crowns only; round the income to whole CZK.
server_codes.nempri_payment_connection_forbidden: The payment connection belongs to the start action only. For continued or ended care the submission must not carry it.
server_codes.nempri_payment_connection_required: The submission must carry the payment connection (how wages are paid). The employee has no account or address in the payout profile to pay the benefit to; wages paid via a partner do not replace it. Fill in the account or address on the person card.
server_codes.hzupn_hours_missing: A return to work must state the hours worked and the working time on the last day of incapacity (0 for an employee who did not work).
server_codes.hzupn_worked_hours_zero_with_shift: If the working time of the last day is above 0, the hours worked must be neither 0 nor empty; ČSSZ rejects such a notification.
server_codes.hzupn_return_reason_with_return: The reason for not returning is stated only when the employee did not return to work.
server_codes.hzupn_return_date_with_no_return: The return-to-work date is stated only when the employee returned to work.
server_codes.hzupn_hours_without_return: Last-day hours are stated only when the employee returned to work.
server_codes.hzupn_ossz_name_too_long: The ČSSZ office name may have at most 30 characters.
server_codes.nempri_probable_income_missing: The decisive period has no assessment base or fewer than 30 non-excluded days, so ÚSSZ uses the probable income. Enter it on the case; the suggestion is the monthly gross wage from the contract, for agreements and small-scale employment the income in the month of the event.
server_codes.registration_a2_termination_record_misma: The deregistration does not match the termination recorded on the employment card (reason for the labour office or termination by death). Use Prefill from termination, or correct the termination on the employment card.
server_codes.registration_a3_completion_mode_invalid: The scope of completing data must be the whole profile, or only the data the ONZ registration did not carry. Choose one of the options in the form.
server_codes.registration_a3_completion_profile_incom: The registration profile (A1) is incomplete, so the completion cannot be built from it. Complete it in the employment registration.
server_codes.registration_a3_completion_profile_missi: Completing data is built from the registration profile (A1), which this employment lacks. Fill in and save the A1 profile, then repeat the completion.
server_codes.registration_a3_completion_variant_unsup: The application prepares the completion of data only for ordinary employments (OST variant). For this activity type file it via the ČSSZ portal.
server_codes.registration_event_relationship_detail_i: The relationship detail does not match the activity type. Correct it in the employment terms.
server_codes.zp_first_registration_identity_missing: The first registration of a foreigner without an assigned insurance number is reported with sex and date of birth. Add them on the person card.
server_codes.zp_mv_registration_required: ZP MV ČR (211) does not use codes E and C. The employee must first be registered with ZP MV ČR and the assigned insured number copied onto the person card; only then can the start be reported with code P or A.
server_codes.hzupn_incapacity_end_missing: The notice of ending incapacity for work can only be filed after it has ended (section 97(3)). Fill in the end date of the incapacity.
server_codes.hzupn_incapacity_period_invalid: The end date of the incapacity for work cannot be earlier than its start date.
server_codes.hzupn_issue_date_missing: The notification must have an issue date. Fill it in on the case.
server_codes.hzupn_work_intervals_invalid: Days worked during incapacity must be given as a list of intervals, each with a start and end date.
server_codes.hzupn_xml_serialization_failed: The HZUPN notification XML could not be built. Try preparing the submission again, or contact support.
server_codes.nempri_activity_code_missing: The employment has no activity type filled in for the date the insured event began, which NEMPRI requires. Fill it in on the employment conditions.
server_codes.nempri_birth_number_missing: NEMPRI requires either the birth number or the insured person's registration number. Fill it in on the person's record.
server_codes.nempri_vpm_payment_date_missing: The deadline for the compensatory allowance runs from the payroll payment date (section 97(5)). It cannot be calculated without it - fill in the pay date under Payroll settings.
server_codes.nempri_xml_serialization_failed: The NEMPRI notification XML could not be built. Try preparing the submission again, or contact support.
server_codes.registration_a2_end_by_death_forbidden: Termination of employment by death is not reported for this activity type. Leave the switch in the form empty.
server_codes.registration_a2_end_source_mismatch: This filing can only be approved once the employment is actually marked as ended in the records and its end date matches the date in the form. Set the end date on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_a2_jmhz_corrections_incompl: This event cannot be approved until the corrective monthly employer reports (JMHZ) for the affected periods are closed. Finish the reports for those periods and repeat the approval.
server_codes.registration_a2_jmhz_evidence_changed: This filing relies on monthly employer reports (JMHZ) that have changed since it was approved. Reload the months to be corrected and approve a new event.
server_codes.registration_a2_jmhz_evidence_missing: There is no saved record confirming that the corrective monthly employer reports (JMHZ) are closed. Approve the event again - only a newly approved event saves this record.
server_codes.registration_a2_relationship_detail_inva: The relationship detail code does not match the employment's activity type - it is either filled in when it should not be, missing, or has the wrong value. Fix it on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_a2_settlement_amount_requir: The payment amount is missing, or more than one has been filled in. When entitled to severance pay, fill in exactly one of the offered amounts.
server_codes.registration_a2_settlement_forbidden: Severance-pay details are only sent for termination reason 4 or 5, but a different reason is selected. Leave the relevant fields in the form empty, or change the termination reason.
server_codes.registration_a2_settlement_payment_forbi: Severance-payment details are only sent when there is an entitlement to severance pay. Leave the relevant fields in the form empty, or check the severance entitlement.
server_codes.registration_a2_settlement_record_mismat: The severance details in the deregistration do not match the Employment end record. Use Prefill from the end record, or correct the end record on the employment card.
server_codes.registration_a2_unemployment_forbidden: Unemployment-benefit supporting data is not sent for this type of termination - it is either the direct variant 10 or termination by death. Choose the option without supporting data in the form.
server_codes.registration_a3_activity_explanation_att: The relationship detail cannot be reported through this filing: ČSSZ requires an explanatory attachment that the application cannot yet include. Handle this change with ČSSZ outside the application.
server_codes.registration_a3_effective_date_mismatch: The date of the tax residency change must match the date the change is reported for. A single filing carries only one effective date - align both dates, or report the residency change separately.
server_codes.registration_a3_foreign_legislation_requ: The end of subjection to foreign legislation is not reported through a data change (REGZEC A3). It is the start of Czech legislation (REGZEC A6); if the employment was registered as subject to foreign legislation from the start, file the end of employment (REGZEC A2) and a new registration (REGZEC A1).
server_codes.registration_a4_activity_correction_unsu: A change of activity type cannot be sent as a correction (REGZEC A4) - ČSSZ does not allow such a transition via electronic correction. Cancel the original registration (REGZEC A8) and file a new registration (REGZEC A1) with the correct activity type.
server_codes.registration_a4_activity_explanation_att: The relationship detail cannot be corrected through this filing: ČSSZ requires an explanatory attachment that the application cannot yet include. Handle this correction with ČSSZ outside the application.
server_codes.registration_a4_explanation_attachment_r: The agreed start date cannot be corrected through this filing: ČSSZ requires a written explanation that the application cannot yet include. Handle this correction with ČSSZ outside the application.
server_codes.registration_a4_original_filing_date_mis: The date of the original filing being corrected must exactly match the date in the archived original submission. Correct the date in the form.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_action_invalid: The archived original submission has no recognizable filing type, so the correction cannot be verified against it. Select a different original submission.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_activity_missing: The ČSSZ activity type is missing from the original accepted submission, so the correction cannot be verified against it. Select a different original submission, or handle the correction with ČSSZ outside the application.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_artifact_invalid: The archived file of the original submission is not a readable REGZEC filing, so the correction cannot be verified against it. Select a different original submission that concerns only this employee.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_artifact_missing: The original accepted submission has no archived sent file to verify the correction against. Select a different original submission, or handle the correction with ČSSZ outside the application.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_identity_mismatch: The ČSSZ employment identifier in the original accepted submission belongs to a different employment. Select a submission that relates to the employment being corrected.
server_codes.registration_a4_source_submission_invali: The original accepted submission number does not match any submission ČSSZ accepted for this employment. Select a submission from the list of sent submissions.
server_codes.registration_a8_explanation_attachment_i: The file with the explanation of the cancellation could not be read, or it is larger than 15 MB. Attach it in the form again.
server_codes.registration_a8_explanation_attachment_r: The cancellation needs a reason: either the employee never started (confirm it in the form), or it is another reason and then attach a file with a written explanation. Without it ČSSZ will not process the cancellation.
server_codes.registration_a5_variable_symbol_unchange: The new variable symbol equals the original one. ČSSZ rejects such a transfer, enter the new variable symbol assigned by ČSSZ.
server_codes.registration_a4_start_attachment_require: ČSSZ processes a correction of the actual start date only with a cover letter attached. Attach a file explaining the correction in the form.
server_codes.registration_a4_explanation_attachment_i: The cover letter file for the correction could not be read or does not meet the ČSSZ conditions (extension, size). Attach it in the form again.
server_codes.registration_a5_variable_symbol_invalid: The new variable symbol is not valid: its check digit does not match or it does not start with a social security district office code. ČSSZ would reject the transfer, copy the new symbol exactly from the ČSSZ notice.
server_codes.registration_a6_foreign_from_start: The start of Czech legislation (REGZEC A6) cannot be filed: the employment was registered as subject to foreign legislation from the start. ČSSZ does not accept this change through A3 or A6. File the end of employment (REGZEC A2) and a new registration (REGZEC A1) as of the day Czech legislation started to apply, even though the employment continues.
server_codes.registration_event_before_start: The notice is reported as of a day before the employee started. ČSSZ accepts a change only as of the start day or later. Correct the date in the form, or check the start day on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_event_czech_residence_forbi: The address of stay in the Czech Republic is not sent for an employee with permanent residence in the Czech Republic, ČSSZ would reject the notice. Remove it from the notice; if the permanent residence moves abroad, report the new permanent address in the same change.
server_codes.registration_event_czech_residence_unver: The address of stay in the Czech Republic is sent only for an employee with permanent residence abroad, but the person has no country of permanent residence. Add the permanent address with its country on the person record, or report it in the same change.
server_codes.registration_event_birth_number_missing: A change or correction of the registration of an employee with Czech citizenship must carry the birth number or the insured person's registration number, otherwise ČSSZ rejects it. Add the birth number on the person record and approve the notice again.
server_codes.registration_event_foreign_insurance_mis: A change or correction of the registration of an employee with activity type “N” (contract employee) must carry the foreign insurance carrier. Fill it in the registration profile (A1), save it and approve the notice again.
server_codes.registration_employer_variable_symbol_in: The employer variable symbol is not valid: its check digit does not match or it does not start with a social security district office code. ČSSZ would reject the filing. Copy the symbol exactly from the ČSSZ notice into the employer payroll settings (accounting unit).
server_codes.registration_cssz_workplace_code_invalid: The social security office code is not in the ČSSZ district codebook, so ČSSZ rejects it. Correct the code in the employer payroll settings.
server_codes.registration_event_delta_variant_forbidd: The notification contains a part that the data message must not carry for this activity type (forbidden element), so ČSSZ would reject it. Remove the listed data from the notification.
server_codes.registration_a3_underage: The employee is younger than 14 on the new start date and ČSSZ rejects such a filing on entry. Check the date of birth and the start date.
server_codes.registration_a2_early_termination_forbid: The early termination reason is not sent in the deregistration: it is given only for a foreigner with a work permit, employee card or blue card whose employment ends before the permit expires.
server_codes.registration_a2_early_termination_requir: The foreigner's employment ends before the work permit, employee card or blue card expires, so ČSSZ requires the early termination reason (1 to 3).
server_codes.registration_a1_after_p1_start_too_late: The employee started later than 8 days after the expected day from the accepted partial registration. A full registration with the actual date can no longer be added, file the non-start notification (PREZEC P2) and a new registration.
server_codes.registration_prezec_p1_archive_unreadabl: The variable symbol and the expected start day, which the follow-up filing must refer to, could not be read from the archive of the accepted partial registration (PREZEC P1).
server_codes.registration_unknown_start_not_applicabl: The fallback deadline for an employee whose start was not known in advance applies only to a direct full registration (REGZEC A1) without a previous partial registration.
server_codes.registration_unknown_start_in_future: The start has not happened yet, so it was known in advance. The fallback deadline is chosen only for an employee who already started working without notice.
server_codes.registration_a8_no_show_source_mismatch: This cancellation can only be approved once the employment is marked in the records as not started and the date in the form matches the originally planned start date. Set both the status and the date on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_a8_source_submission_invali: The original accepted submission number does not match any submission ČSSZ accepted for this employment. Select a submission from the list of sent submissions.
server_codes.registration_data_incomplete: The registration cannot be built yet, some details of the person or the employer are missing. Fill them in according to the list and prepare it again.
server_codes.registration_artifact_mismatch: The stored submission does not match the one the application just prepared, so the registration was not saved. Try preparing it again - if this message recurs, it is an application error and the submission must not be sent.
server_codes.registration_calendar_basis_unsupported: The registration deadline is calculated using a calendar basis the application cannot yet record, so the registration cannot be prepared. This is an error in the payroll legislation rules - contact support.
server_codes.registration_change_duty_not_fileable: This duty is not filed by the application through the registration action (REGZEC A3). Close it manually.
server_codes.registration_change_payload_empty: The proposed change did not produce any data to file.
server_codes.registration_change_payload_unsupported: Some of the changed data is not carried by the REGZEC A3 data record in this version. Close the draft manually.
server_codes.registration_cssz_workplace_code_missing: The social security administration code is missing, and the filing cannot be submitted without it. Fill it in under settings - the field is named Social security administration code.
server_codes.registration_deadline_before_supported_w: The application calculates the ČSSZ employee-registration deadline only from 1 July 2026, when the duty took effect. This start date is earlier, so determine the deadline under the rules in force at that time.
server_codes.registration_deadline_start_date_invalid: The registration event date is missing or invalid. Enter it in the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-08-05.
server_codes.registration_dispatch_attempt_unknown: No dispatch of a registration filing with this number exists for this company. Open the dispatch history again and select the specific dispatch from it.
server_codes.registration_dispatch_poll_unavailable: The ČSSZ response can only be checked for a dispatch that is still awaiting one. This dispatch is already closed - its outcome is in the dispatch history.
server_codes.registration_employer_variable_symbol_mi: The variable symbol is missing for the payroll accounting unit this employment belongs to, and without it ČSSZ has no way to know which employer to register the employee under. Fill it in and prepare the registration again.
server_codes.registration_event_id_ppv_snapshot_misma: The ČSSZ employment identifier stored with the approved event differs from the one the employee has as of the event date. Check the value and approve the event again.
server_codes.registration_event_in_future: The event has not happened yet. Approve it only on the day it actually occurs, or correct the date in the form.
server_codes.registration_event_snapshot_invalid: The saved notice is missing a required value. Open the notice, check the data, and prepare the filing again.
server_codes.registration_event_snapshot_missing: There is no saved event record for the filing to be built from. Open the notice on the employment record, save it, and prepare the filing again.
server_codes.registration_identity_effective_date_mis: The decisive date must exactly match the single-day period of the registration event.
server_codes.registration_identity_employment_scope_m: The start date is missing. Without it the application cannot determine which form of the data should be sent to ČSSZ.
server_codes.registration_identity_environment_invali: The environment of the registration identity snapshot is not valid.
server_codes.registration_identity_id_ppv_scope_misma: The ČSSZ employment identifier for this company points to a different person, so the submission would go out for the wrong employee. Fix the assignment on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_identity_idempotent_replay_: The repeated request does not match the scope of the original snapshot. Try preparing the submission again.
server_codes.registration_identity_invalid: A value on the person's record is either missing or invalid (the sex field must be male or female; another field must not be left blank once it has a value). Check the person's record.
server_codes.registration_identity_revision_not_curre: The snapshot requires the current approved source revision.
server_codes.registration_identity_scope_already_froz: A frozen snapshot already exists for this scope under a different request identifier. Try preparing the submission again.
server_codes.registration_identity_submission_not_dra: A new snapshot can only be frozen while the submission is a draft.
server_codes.registration_identity_submission_scope_m: The submission does not match the company, environment, agenda or employment it was prepared for.
server_codes.registration_identity_unresolved: There is an open unresolved task on this employment that is blocking the registration. Resolve it and try again.
server_codes.registration_interaction_unsupported: This combination cannot be filed - the application only supports filings from the menu on the employment record. Select the filing type again from the menu.
server_codes.registration_jurisdiction_direction_mism: The selected filing type does not match the current direction of cross-border insurance jurisdiction. Choose the opposite of the offered events.
server_codes.registration_prezec_p1_guid_missing: The termination of a pre-registration (PREZEC P2) must reference the GUID of the original accepted partial registration (P1). Load the ČSSZ protocol for the accepted P1 first; without the correct GUID ČSSZ cannot process the termination and the pre-registration stays open.
server_codes.registration_prezec_identifier_required: Neither the birth number nor the insured person's registration number is filled in. The pre-start partial registration (PREZEC) cannot be filed without one of them - fill it in on the person's record, or if the employee has neither, file a full REGZEC registration instead.
server_codes.registration_regzec_a1_foreign_insurance: The registration of an employee with activity type “N” (contract employee) must carry the foreign insurance carrier, otherwise ČSSZ will not accept it. Fill in the Foreign insurance carrier section of the registration profile (specification and country) and save it.
server_codes.registration_regzec_a1_profile_conflict: Someone else saved the registration profile in the meantime. Your draft changes will be lost, but they will not overwrite someone else's work.
server_codes.registration_regzec_a1_source_scope_mism: The start date changed on the employment record in the meantime, so the open form was pointing at a different day than the one the registration is being frozen to. Draft changes will be saved to the correct day.
server_codes.registration_regzec_a1_variant_data_inco: The employee registration (REGZEC A1) does not yet have all the data ČSSZ requires for this activity type. A draft profile can be saved, but it can only be filed once completed - the Check button shows what is missing.
server_codes.registration_regzec_action_variant_unsup: The selected filing type cannot be submitted for this activity type - ČSSZ does not allow it. Check the activity type on the employment record, or choose a different notification type.
server_codes.registration_regzec_activity_invalid: The entered activity type is not in the ČSSZ code list. Select it from the list - a manually typed abbreviation is not accepted.
server_codes.registration_regzec_relationship_detail_: The relationship detail code does not match the selected activity type - it is either filled in when it should not be, missing, or has the wrong value. Fix it on the employment record.
server_codes.registration_replay_artifact_missing: A registration filing for this employment already exists, but it has no saved XML to send. A new filing is not created to avoid a duplicate at ČSSZ - open the original filing under Payroll, Filings and reports, and finish it there.
server_codes.registration_regzec_a1_profile_missing: The REGZEC A1 profile for this employment is not saved, and the full registration is built from it. Click Complete profile, check the prefilled data and save the profile.
server_codes.registration_already_prepared: A registration for this employment is already prepared in the queue. No second one is created: open it under Payroll, Filings and reports, Queue and send it; if the data changed, cancel the prepared filing there first.
server_codes.registration_already_registered: This employment already has an employment ID (ID PPV) assigned by ČSSZ, so it is already registered there (the registration was sent from another program or came with the migrated data). ČSSZ would reject a second registration as a duplicate: report missing or changed data with a change notice (A3) and errors in the filed registration with a correction (A4).
server_codes.registration_already_filed: A registration for this employment has already been sent to ČSSZ. No second one is filed: report changed data with a change notice and errors in the sent registration with a correction.
server_codes.registration_tax_residence_address_missi: When tax residency changes to a country other than Czechia, the filing must also carry the residence address in that country, otherwise ČSSZ rejects it. Fill it in the A1 registration profile and report the change from the proposal in the Changes to report block.
server_codes.registration_schema_integrity_failed: The ČSSZ form templates in this installation are missing or differ from the verified versions. The submission cannot be checked as a result - this is not an error in your data, contact support.
server_codes.registration_schema_unavailable: This ČSSZ form cannot be prepared by this version of the application. Only REGZEC25 registrations and notices and partial PREZEC26 registrations are supported - file others through the ČSSZ portal.
server_codes.registration_serializer_unavailable: This ČSSZ registration form cannot be filled in by this version of the application. Only REGZEC25 and PREZEC26 are supported - file others through the ČSSZ portal.
server_codes.registration_start_date_missing: The employment's start date is missing, so the registration deadline cannot be calculated or the registration filed. Fill it in and prepare the registration again.
server_codes.registration_supplier_missing: The company the registration is being filed for was not found. Switch to the correct company and prepare the registration again.
server_codes.sickness_artifact_mismatch: The stored file's fingerprint does not match the frozen XML submission. Try preparing the submission again.
server_codes.sickness_benefit_kind_invalid: The benefit type must be one of NEM, VPM, OPP, PPM, OSE or DLO from the ČSSZ code list.
server_codes.sickness_case_cancelled: A submission cannot be prepared from a cancelled case.
server_codes.sickness_case_conflict: Someone else changed this case in the meantime. Reload it and repeat the change.
server_codes.sickness_case_not_editable: A cancelled case can no longer be edited. If the event occurred again, create a new case.
server_codes.sickness_case_document_settled: The submission is already settled (accepted, or filed by the previous program), so its data no longer change. File a correction instead: tick Corrective submission and fill in the decision number if the benefit type carries one.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_already_recorded: The acceptance of this submission is already recorded. Another acceptance belongs only to a corrective submission.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_already_settled: The submission is already settled; a rejection or filing by the previous program cannot be recorded for it.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_predecessor: This submission was filed by the previous payroll program; acceptance is recorded only for submissions sent from MyÚčto.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_predecessor_not_takeove: Filing by the previous program can only be recorded on a case taken over from the previous payroll program.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_reopen_not_predecessor: Only a submission recorded as filed by the previous program can be returned for filing. An outcome of a submission from MyÚčto is corrected by a corrective submission.
server_codes.sickness_case_predecessor_period: The submission deadline began while payroll was run by the previous payroll program. If that program filed it, record it on the case with Filed by the previous program; otherwise prepare and file it from MyÚčto.
server_codes.sickness_document_handled_by_predecessor: The previous payroll program filed this submission for the event, so MyÚčto does not file it again.
server_codes.sickness_transfer_reason_invalid: The reason for transfer to other work must be pregnancy, maternity or breastfeeding.
server_codes.sickness_transfer_reason_without_transfe: The transfer reason is filled in only for a transfer to other work. Tick the transfer and fill in its date.
server_codes.sickness_protection_period_pension_kind_: The employee receives a pension but its type is missing on the case. Without it, it cannot be assessed whether a protection period follows the end of employment. Fill in the pension type.
server_codes.dlo_basis_not_in_kind: Leave and the shift schedule are filled in as payout data only for long-term care benefit.
server_codes.dlo_leave_periods_without_leave: Leave periods belong to "Had leave". Tick it, or remove the periods.
server_codes.dlo_shift_schedule_without_planned_shift: The shift schedule belongs to "Had shifts scheduled on the benefit days". Tick it, or remove the schedule.
server_codes.sickness_case_overlaps: This employment already has a recorded case of the same benefit type overlapping this period. ČSSZ would not be able to match two submissions for the same event.
server_codes.sickness_case_period_invalid: The end date of the insured event cannot be earlier than its start date.
server_codes.sickness_date_invalid: The entered date has an invalid format. Enter it as YYYY-MM-DD.
server_codes.sickness_employment_missing: No employment relationship exists on the date the insured event began.
server_codes.sickness_hours_invalid: The entered value must be a number of hours in one day from 0 to 24 with at most two decimal places.
server_codes.sickness_ossz_code_invalid: The OSSZ code is not in the ČSSZ office code list C_COKR, or ČSSZ does not use it for e-filing (101 headquarters). Correct it in Payroll settings, Employer section, or directly in the case.
server_codes.nempri_care_declaration_missing: An application with the start action must carry all employee declarations. A declaration left blank is stated as NO.
server_codes.nempri_care_days_missing: When care continues or ends, the application must carry the days the employee provided care. Fill them in on the case.
server_codes.nempri_last_day_hours_without_worked: For care benefit, the working time and hours worked on the last day are stated only if the employee worked on the last day of care.
server_codes.nempri_date_in_future: The date of birth of the child or cared person and the date of transfer to other work must not be later than today. Correct it on the case.
server_codes.hzupn_within_wage_compensation_window: The incapacity did not exceed 14 calendar days; wage compensation covers all of it and no sickness benefit arises. The HZUPN report is therefore not filed.
server_codes.hzupn_incapacity_in_protection_period: The incapacity arose only after the employment ended (in the protection period). ČSSZ does not require the HZUPN report in this case; if the OSSZ asks for it, file it as requested.
server_codes.hzupn_employment_ended_during_incapacity: The employment ended during the incapacity. ČSSZ does not require the HZUPN report in this case; if the OSSZ asks for it, file it as requested.
server_codes.nempri_small_scope_income_missing: The employee works under an agreement to perform work (DPP), so the notification carries the countable income for the month the event arose. Fill it in on the case.
server_codes.hzupn_return_decision_missing: The employer report must state whether the employee returned to work after the incapacity (Yes with the date and last-day hours, or No with the reason). Choose the answer in the case.
server_codes.hzupn_last_day_hours_out_of_range: Both the working time and the hours worked on the last day of incapacity must be between 0 and 24 hours.
server_codes.hzupn_issue_date_too_early: The report issue date must be after 31 December 2019. Correct it in the case.
server_codes.hzupn_confirmation_number_format_invalid: The decision number in the HZUPN report must use the format valid since 2020: a letter E to Z (except K) and 6 to 7 digits, or an electronic serial number (10 digits from 2001010000, optionally prefixed with the IČPE).
server_codes.hzupn_confirmation_number_icpe_invalid: The doctor's IČPE at the start of the decision number failed the 8th digit check. Copy the decision number from the eNeschopenka again.
server_codes.nempri_decision_number_icpe_invalid: The doctor's IČPE at the start of the decision number failed the 8th digit check. Copy the decision number again.
server_codes.sickness_identity_incomplete: The person is missing their name, surname or date of birth as of the decisive date. Without them ČSSZ would not accept the submission.
server_codes.sickness_incapacity_from_missing: The case must have the date the insured event began.
server_codes.sickness_notification_window_invalid: The filing window came out empty. Check the dates of the insured event.
server_codes.sickness_ossz_code_missing: The company is missing the three-digit OSSZ workplace code from the ČSSZ code list. Fill it in under Payroll settings, Employer section, or enter it directly on the case.
server_codes.sickness_receipt_outcome_invalid: The submission outcome must be accepted, rejected, filed by the previous program or cancelled.
server_codes.sickness_submission_not_prepared: The submission has not been prepared yet, so there is nothing to send. First choose Prepare on the case.
server_codes.sickness_submission_sent_via_vrep: The submission has already been sent (or possibly sent) via VREP. It is not sent again through the data box, as ČSSZ would receive it twice.
server_codes.sickness_supplier_missing: The company for this benefit case was not found.
server_codes.sickness_variable_symbol_missing: The payroll office of the employment is missing its ČSSZ variable symbol. Fill it in under Payroll settings, Employer, at the employment's office and prepare the submission again.
server_codes.zp_artifact_mismatch: The stored file's fingerprint does not match the frozen data record. Try preparing the submission again.
server_codes.zp_bulk_notification_empty: The bulk notification must contain at least one record. No record could be documented by the application for the selected period and insurer.
server_codes.zp_bulk_notification_correction_required: The insurer has already received a bulk notification for this period with a different date or insurance number. A new notification would send a second registration or deregistration. File the correction manually with an X, Y or Z correction record as the insurer instructs.
server_codes.zp_bulk_notification_correction_x_availa: The insurer has already received a bulk notification for this period with a different insurance number. The application can build a correction notification: an X record with the wrong number and a P record with the correct one. Confirm to build the correction.
server_codes.zp_bulk_notification_previous_unreadable: The bulk notification already sent for the same period and insurer cannot be read, so the new one cannot be compared with it and is not built.
server_codes.zp_change_address_incomplete: The address in the bulk notification record is incomplete.
server_codes.zp_change_address_too_long: The address in the bulk notification record exceeds the sixty characters allowed by the data record.
server_codes.zp_change_code_mapping_undocumented: The change code for this duty cannot be determined - the schema does not document a code for this duty type.
server_codes.zp_change_code_not_reported_by_employer: This change code is reported by the insured person themselves, not the employer. The unified XSD schema would allow it, but the law does not.
server_codes.zp_change_code_unknown: The change code is not in the unified bulk-notification data record.
server_codes.zp_change_date_invalid: The change date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
server_codes.zp_change_identity_missing: The employee is missing the historical identity (first and last name) as of the decisive date - the bulk notification cannot be built without it. Complete the person's record.
server_codes.zp_change_insurance_number_missing: The employee has neither a birth number nor a health insurance number on record - the bulk notification cannot be built without one. The ECP is not used as the insurance number; copy the number from the insurance card or the insurer's notice to the person's card.
server_codes.zp_change_person_name_missing: The bulk notification record must include both first name and surname.
server_codes.zp_change_person_name_too_long: Neither first name nor surname may exceed the sixty characters allowed by the data record.
server_codes.zp_contribution_not_whole_crowns: The total contribution includes fractions of a crown, but the data record requires whole crowns. Only the contribution calculation may round, not the submission.
server_codes.zp_correction_source_conflict: The source of the corrective statement already belongs to a different type of submission.
server_codes.zp_date_invalid: The date of the reported fact must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
server_codes.zp_document_type_unknown: The unified health insurer data record does not have this document type.
server_codes.zp_duty_rule_unavailable: There is no rule in effect for the notification duty on the selected date.
server_codes.zp_employer_city_missing: The company's registered address has no municipality. Fill it in under Settings, Company - the health insurer data record requires it.
server_codes.zp_employer_city_too_long: The municipality of the company's registered address exceeds the sixty characters the data record allows.
server_codes.zp_employer_house_number_missing: The company's registered address has no house number. Fill it in under Settings, Company - an address without a street is identified by the house number and municipality.
server_codes.zp_employer_house_number_too_long: The house number of the company's registered address exceeds the sixty characters the data record allows.
server_codes.zp_employer_name_missing: The company has no name. Fill it in under Settings, Company.
server_codes.zp_employer_name_too_long: The company name exceeds the eighty characters the data record allows.
server_codes.zp_employer_phone_invalid: The payer's phone number has more digits than the data record allows (max thirty) after removing separators.
server_codes.zp_employer_street_too_long: The street of the company's registered address exceeds the sixty characters the data record allows.
server_codes.zp_employment_not_notifiable: A cancelled start of employment or an archived employment does not create a notification duty toward the health insurer.
server_codes.zp_insurance_number_invalid: The insured person's number must have nine or ten digits, or for a foreigner without an assigned number the format MDDMMYYYY or ZDDMMYYYY.
server_codes.zp_insurer_code_missing: The employee has no health insurer on record, so the notification has nowhere to go. Fill it in on the employee's record.
server_codes.zp_insurer_code_unknown: The health insurer code is not in the unified data record.
server_codes.zp_internal_reference_invalid: The internal submission reference may only contain safe characters.
server_codes.zp_isds_attachment_undocumented: For this health insurer there is currently no documented data-message attachment format.
server_codes.zp_official_form_changed: The official form does not match the pinned fingerprint. Use the verified version of the file, or update the fingerprint together with it.
server_codes.zp_official_form_unavailable: The official form is missing from this installation. Contact support.
server_codes.zp_official_form_unknown: The application does not recognize the specified official form.
server_codes.zp_overview_assessment_base_invalid: The total assessment base cannot be negative and cannot exceed the fourteen digits allowed by the data record.
server_codes.zp_overview_contribution_invalid: The total contribution cannot be negative.
server_codes.zp_overview_employee_count_invalid: The data record cannot carry a statement with no employees - the count must be a positive number, zero is not accepted. A statement for a month with no counted person cannot be filed this way.
server_codes.zp_overview_kind_invalid: The statement type must be either regular or corrective.
server_codes.zp_overview_month_invalid: The reporting month must be between 1 and 12.
server_codes.zp_overview_only_former_employees: The month's contributions come only from income of former employees, who are not counted in the statement's headcount. The data record cannot carry a count of zero, so file the statement on the insurer's form or as the insurer instructs.
server_codes.zp_overview_year_invalid: The reporting year must be between 2000 and 2099.
server_codes.zp_payer_account_missing: The company has no payment account on record for that date. Create one under Payroll, Employer settings, Institution payment accounts (type Health insurer), and enter the ten-digit payer number the insurer assigned you at registration in the employer VS field.
server_codes.zp_payer_accounting_unit_invalid: The payer's accounting unit number must have exactly two digits.
server_codes.zp_payer_business_id_invalid: The payer's company ID (IČO) must have exactly eight digits.
server_codes.zp_payer_business_id_missing: The company has no company ID (IČO) and no payer number is recorded for the insurer. Fill in the IČO in company settings or, if the company has no IČO or more than 99 payroll units, enter the special payer number NNNNNNNN99 assigned by VZP in the employer VS field of the insurer payment account.
server_codes.zp_payer_number_invalid: The payer's identification number must have exactly ten digits - an eight-digit company ID plus a two-digit accounting unit number.
server_codes.zp_payer_number_missing: The payment account effective on that date is missing the ten-digit payer number. Fill it in under Payroll, Employer settings, Institution payment accounts, in the employer VS field - the insurer assigned it at registration and it has exactly ten digits.
server_codes.zp_pdf_artifact_mismatch: The stored PDF's fingerprint does not match the frozen statement. Try preparing the submission again.
server_codes.zp_period_contains_unresolved_employment: Duties cannot be processed: several employments are missing the data needed to determine their health insurer.
server_codes.zp_period_in_future: The health insurer rejects a payment statement for a future month. Prepare it no earlier than in the month it covers.
server_codes.zp_period_invalid: The payroll period must be in the format YYYY-MM.
server_codes.zp_portal_gateway_description_on_request: The description of this health insurer's portal gateway is not currently published, only available on request. Automated dispatch is therefore not offered - send the file manually via data box or the insurer's portal.
server_codes.zp_postal_code_invalid: The postal code must have exactly five digits with no space.
server_codes.zp_registered_duty_changed: The previously recorded duty no longer matches the current data. Check whether the insurer or the deadline changed, or whether the duty was cancelled.
server_codes.zp_schema_bundle_missing: The pinned XSD schema is missing from this installation or has a different fingerprint. Download the correct file and run the submission again - schemas are deliberately not downloaded at runtime.
server_codes.zp_shared_data_message_acceptance_unconf: It is not confirmed that this channel accepts the unified data record in this format. Send the file manually through a documented channel (data box or the insurer's portal).
server_codes.zp_submission_artifact_missing: The previously prepared submission is missing one of its two frozen source files. Prepare the submission again.
server_codes.zp_supplier_missing: The company for the submission was not found.
server_codes.zp_supplier_not_found: The company for tracking duties was not found.
server_codes.zp_transport_envelope_undocumented: No documented transport envelope format exists for automated dispatch to this health insurer. The application prepares the file, but you must send it manually through a documented channel (data box or the insurer's portal).
server_codes.zp_xml_serialization_failed: The health insurer data record could not be built.
server_codes.zp_xml_snapshot_mismatch: The data record does not match the exact source snapshot.
server_codes.zp_xsd_validation_failed: The data record did not pass validation against the pinned XSD schema.
