problems.no_revisions: No approved payroll is available for the reporting year.
problems.missing_month: An approved payroll month needed to document insurance duration and earnings is missing.
problems.revision: The evidence includes a payroll revision that is not current and approved.
problems.missing_employment: The employment is missing from saved payroll evidence for a reporting month.
problems.dates: Employment start or end dates are missing or differ between saved payroll months.
problems.ambiguous: More than one approved source exists for a month; the correct source cannot be safely selected.
problems.integrity: Saved evidence does not match or has an invalid format. A pension insurance record cannot safely be prepared.
problems.unsupported: Automatic pension insurance record preparation does not yet support this case.
problems.activity: The activity type or detailed classification is outside the cases this pension insurance preparation supports.
problems.social: Saved payroll lacks a complete social insurance calculation, insurance participation or assessment base.
problems.absence_dates: An absence has an invalid start or end date.
problems.absence_overlap: Excluded periods overlap or exceed the employment duration.
problems.income_month: No countable income was paid in the month and the recorded absences cannot decide whether the month is an insurance period (sickness combined with unpaid leave, the month of childbirth, or a month with neither income nor absence).
problems.unknown: A preparation error must be investigated by support.
problems.takeover: A payroll month taken over from the previous program lacks a value the pension evidence sheet needs, or it contradicts the payroll kept in MyÚčto.
problems.takeover_revision: MyÚčto calculates payroll for the indicated month but has no approved revision; data taken over from the previous program must not replace it.
problems.prepared_on: The date of preparation precedes the "To" date of a row; ČSSZ rejects such a record sheet with error 251.
problems.correction: A record sheet for this year and employment is already frozen, or the corrective sheet has nothing to correct.
problems.previous_employment: The employment follows an earlier employment of the same person within three months in the same year, so it has no record sheet of its own.
problems.confirmation: A confirmation in the pension record form is missing or invalid (excluded periods, days without insurance, date of the authority request or the note).
problems.confirmation_document: The supporting document for settling the pension record is missing, or the selected document cannot be read.
problems.no_insurance: No pension insurance period arose for the employment in the selected year, so no pension record is prepared.
problems.not_applicable: No standalone pension record is filed for this year; pension insurance data travel in the monthly report.
problems.manual_state: The pension record for this year is already settled or submitted; no further entry is needed.
problems.pension: The employee's pension details are missing or contradictory (retirement age, early or full old-age pension, insurance abroad).
problems.pension_not_kept: No pension record is kept for this year for a recipient of a full old-age pension.

steps.no_revisions: In Payroll, select the reporting year and check the months during which the employment existed. Complete genuinely missing calculations and approvals. If payroll was processed elsewhere, do not create fictitious calculations; contact support about historical evidence.
steps.missing_month: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.revision: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.missing_employment: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.dates: Compare the actual start and end dates on the employment card with the affected payroll months. An error confined to old approved payroll requires a correction revision for that month. Do not alter accurate employment dates to make them agree; ask support to investigate an unclear mismatch.
steps.ambiguous: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.integrity: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.unsupported: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.activity: On the employment card, verify Activity type and Detailed employment classification against the actual contract and their effective dates. Correct erroneous data and recalculate the affected payroll. If the data is correct, do not change the employment type; contact support for this case.
steps.social: Open payroll for the indicated month. Verify that it includes the correct employment and complete contributions, make any necessary correction and approve the current revision. Prepare the record again. Do not correct already accurate payroll or accepted submissions solely because of this warning.
steps.absence_dates: Open this employment’s absences and check dates and overlaps for the reporting period. Correct only erroneous records, then recalculate and approve affected payroll. If overlapping absences are accurate, do not remove them just to pass validation; contact support.
steps.absence_overlap: Open this employment’s absences and check dates and overlaps for the reporting period. Correct only erroneous records, then recalculate and approve affected payroll. If overlapping absences are accurate, do not remove them just to pass validation; contact support.
steps.income_month: Open this employment’s absences and verify the absences in the indicated month. If an absence or forgotten pay is missing, add it and recalculate payroll. If the records are accurate, the law decides only about the whole month and the application cannot resolve it; process that month manually and do not change anything just to pass validation.
steps.unknown: Contact support with the reporting year, employment and technical details below. Do not change employee data or approved payroll blindly because of this error.
steps.takeover: Open the payroll takeover review, fill in the missing value for the indicated month (activity kind, insured days, assessment base, employment dates) and repeat the takeover. Do not estimate the value: the evidence sheet feeds a pension calculation. If the previous program never issued it, file the evidence sheet for that month outside the application.
steps.takeover_revision: Open payroll for the indicated month, finish the calculation and approve the current revision, or discard the draft run. Only then prepare the evidence sheet again. Taken-over data will not substitute the month so that a draft calculation with different figures cannot stay hidden.
steps.prepared_on: In Date of preparation enter a day no earlier than the last "To" date (on termination, the end date or later), or clear the field to use the end of the last accounted month.
steps.correction: If the source data changed after freezing, tick Corrective record sheet and prepare it again. If nothing changed, no corrective sheet is needed; if no sheet exists yet, prepare the regular one first.
steps.previous_employment: Open the record sheet of the earlier employment (link below) and prepare it; the following employment is added as further rows. If the earlier sheet is already frozen, the following employment gets a sheet of its own.
steps.confirmation: In the form above, tick the confirmations of excluded periods and days without insurance, fill in the date the authority request was delivered when preparing on request, and shorten the note to 500 characters. Then prepare the record again.
steps.confirmation_document: In the Settle pension record section, select or upload the supporting document (for example the ePortál filing confirmation) and save again.
steps.no_insurance: Check that the correct year and employment are selected. If there really was no insurance period in the year, no pension record is filed and nothing else is needed.
steps.not_applicable: Do not file anything separately; make sure the monthly reports for the year are submitted and accepted.
steps.manual_state: You can see the settlement state in the pension record overview; no new entry is needed.
steps.pension: In the form above, fill in the employee's pension details according to the pension decision (date retirement age was reached, early pension, first month of full pension payment, insurance abroad), confirm them and prepare the record again.
steps.pension_not_kept: Do not file anything. If the employee participates in pension insurance abroad, tick it in the form and prepare the record again.

problems.terms: Weekly working time is not uniquely defined throughout the month or changes during it.
problems.absence: This month contains an absence request or correction that is not yet approved or closed.
problems.calendar: A day in the month has no work calendar or is covered by multiple calendar versions.
problems.month_boundary: A recorded work interval starts and ends in different calendar months.
problems.overlap: Regular or overtime work intervals overlap.
problems.break: A break is longer than the entire recorded work interval.
problems.integrity: The month’s saved attendance has incomplete or invalid data; a summary cannot safely be built from it.
problems.work_source: The month takes attendance from an import summary but also has time entries. Two sources of the same time are never merged.
problems.import_missing: The month takes attendance from an import summary, but its current revision has none (typically after the month was reopened).
problems.import_values: The attendance import summary has no worked hours, or its overtime exceeds the worked hours.
problems.unknown: The working time summary could not be verified. Support must investigate.

steps.terms: Open Weekly working time in this employment’s terms. Compare the effective versions for the month with the contract. Correct missing or wrongly effective terms and refresh attendance. Do not erase a real change of working hours; contact support if the summary cannot handle it.
steps.absence: The link opens this employment’s absences for the same month. Complete approval or rejection of pending requests and corrections according to the facts. Return to attendance, refresh and reopen month approval.
steps.calendar: Check the calendar for this employment. Create calendar / New calendar version currently sets Monday to Friday at 8 hours per day from the month’s start. Use it only if this matches the actual schedule. Ask an administrator to resolve other schedules or overlapping versions; do not change the calendar merely to pass validation.
steps.month_boundary: Check the work interval’s start and end. Split work crossing a month boundary into the actual portions worked in each month without changing the total duration. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.overlap: Compare this employment’s records by date and work category. Remove only an incorrect duplicate or correct the actual time; do not record regular work and overtime twice for the same interval. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.break: Check the start, end and break duration in this employment’s records. Correct the wrongly entered time using actual attendance. Contact support if the editor cannot correct it. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.integrity: Contact support with the month, employment and technical details below. Do not change attendance blindly because of this error.
steps.work_source: Decide which attendance source applies to the month. If the imported data is right, remove the wrongly recorded time entries; if the entries are right, do not use the import summary for this month. Refresh the summary afterwards.
steps.import_missing: Open Attendance imports and apply this month’s batch again with the summary written to working months. Then refresh the summary and approve the month.
steps.import_values: Correct the data in the attendance system (worked hours and overtime) and import it again. Overtime is part of the worked time and must not exceed it.
steps.unknown: Contact support with the month, employment and technical details below. Do not confirm substitute values just to complete the report.

average.step: Open Average earnings for this employment. Year {year} and quarter {quarter} are selected as the period in which the average applies; the calculation reference period is the previous quarter. Check the source data, create and approve the average, then refresh the exit documents.

external_jmhz.title: Submissions by the previous program
external_jmhz.description: Monthly JMHZ reports and registrations filed for the company by the previous payroll program (PAMICA migration or uploaded XML reports). For a month whose regular report has been sent, MyÚčto does not prepare another regular report: ČSSZ rejects a second regular report. Send corrections for such a month as a corrective submission from the program that filed the report.

external_jmhz.open_history: Open submissions by the previous program

unsent_registration.title: Registration from the previous program not sent: {actions} (prepared {date})
unsent_registration.hint: ČSSZ did not receive this registration and the deadline for the registration or deregistration keeps running. Send it from the previous program, or file it from MyÚčto on the person card in the ČSSZ registration panel. If it was already sent, repeat the migration with a new export and the status will be filled in.
unsent_registration.unmatched: {count} forms did not match any employment in MyÚčto. Typically this is a start entered in the previous program after the export: the person is missing in MyÚčto or has an employment with a different start date. The detail shows the employment from the previous program; check the person in Employees and create them if needed.

external_jmhz.unsent_title: The previous program did not send the report for {period}
external_jmhz.unsent_hint: PAMICA prepared the report, but ČSSZ never received it. Send it from the previous program (MyÚčto does not calculate months before payroll started in MyÚčto). If it has been sent since, repeat the PAMICA migration with a new export and the status will be updated.
external_jmhz.unmatched_form: Not matched to a relationship in MyÚčto (relationship {ref} in the previous program)
external_jmhz.unreadable: The form content could not be read; it is kept in the history, no data was taken from it.
external_jmhz.detail_failed: The submission detail could not be loaded.

section.monthly_hint: For a month with a sent regular report, MyÚčto does not prepare another regular report.
section.registration_hint: Registrations (A1), deregistrations (A2) and changes or completions of data (A3) filed by the previous program. A relationship registered here counts as done in Data completion (A3).

result.not_sent: Not sent: ČSSZ never received it

external_jmhz.remove_failed: The record could not be removed.

remove_dialog.title: Remove the submission from the history?
remove_dialog.when: Remove only a record the migration took over by mistake: the submission was not actually sent, belongs to another company or was uploaded by mistake. Keep submissions ČSSZ actually received.
remove_dialog.monthly_sent: MyÚčto will then treat {period} as a month without a sent regular report and offer to prepare it. If ČSSZ does have the report, it rejects a second regular report.
remove_dialog.monthly_unsent: An unsent report blocks nothing; removing it only hides the unsent month warning.
remove_dialog.registration: The relationships in this submission will no longer count as completed by the previous program in Data completion (A3).
remove_dialog.restore: The record comes back when you repeat the migration from the previous program.

external_jmhz.missing_group_title: JMHZ reports for {count} taken-over months are not in the filing history: {periods}
external_jmhz.missing_group_hint: These months were processed by the previous payroll program and MyÚčto will not prepare reports for them. If the previous program or the ČSSZ portal filed them, confirm the filing outside MyÚčto, or repeat the migration with a new export or upload the sent XML in Payroll → Imports. Otherwise file them from the previous program.

attest.title: Confirm filing outside MyÚčto
attest.intro: Record that the regular monthly report for the selected months was filed by the previous program or the ČSSZ portal. MyÚčto will hold no filing document, only this confirmation.
attest.note_placeholder: e.g. filed via the ČSSZ portal
attest.consequence: A confirmed month is no longer reported as unfiled and MyÚčto will not prepare a second regular report for it. The confirmation can be revoked in the history.
attest.failed: The filing could not be confirmed.
attest.revoke_consequence: The month {period} will reappear among taken-over months without a report.

foreign_income.title: Non-resident income — notices and reports
foreign_income.description: Notice of income flowing abroad (DPSHL1, § 38da of the Income Tax Act) and report on withheld tax security (DPSZD1, § 38e). Both are filed per payment, not per tax period.
foreign_income.manual_entry_hint: Payment details are entered by hand. The application does not track payments to non-residents with withholding tax or tax security, and neither duty arises from payroll, so there is nothing to prefill. The company, target tax office and form checks are added by the system.
foreign_income.tax_id: Tax identification in the state of residence
foreign_income.payment_year_hint: Used instead of the date only for exempt income. Fill in either the date or the year.
foreign_income.remittance_hint: Not filled in for exempt income — no tax was withheld, so none was remitted.
foreign_income.income_description_hint: e.g. income from services under § 22 (1) (c) of the Income Tax Act
foreign_income.secured_tax_hint: Rounded up to whole crowns (§ 38e (5) of the Income Tax Act).
foreign_income.decisive_on: Date of payment, remittance or crediting
foreign_income.establishment: Address of the permanent establishment in Czechia
foreign_income.download_done: The submission XML has been downloaded and archived.
foreign_income.download_failed: The submission XML could not be generated.
foreign_income.load_failed: The form codebooks could not be loaded.
foreign_income.deadlines: The § 38da notice is filed within the deadline for remitting the withheld tax; for exempt income by 31 January of the following year. The § 38e report is filed for each withholding of tax security; no annual statement of security is filed at all (§ 38e (12)).

delete.title: Delete document permanently
delete.warning: The document and its postings (including any reversing entry) will be deleted irreversibly. Unlike a reversal, no trace remains in the books.
delete.hint: For documents already covered by a filed return, prefer a reversal. Deletion is only possible in an open and unlocked period.
delete.draft_warning: A draft has no series number and no postings — deleting it leaves nothing behind and creates no gap in the number series.

help.reverse_after_filing: A reversal after a filed return must be handled via an amended return / follow-up control statement — the system files nothing automatically.

warning.over_cash_limit: The payment exceeds the CZK 270,000 cash limit (Act No. 254/2004 Coll.) — it must be settled by bank transfer.
warning.series_gap: The document was deleted permanently — a gap remains in the number series and the number is not reused.
warning.reversal_date_shifted: The original period is locked, so the reversing entry is dated to the nearest open date — not to the original document date.
warning.negative_balance_after_reverse: The cash register is negative after the reversal — check the subsequent documents.
warning.dic_missing_over_10k: Sale above CZK 10,000 without a VAT No. — add the customer's VAT No. for Control Statement A.4.
warning.dic_not_czech: The partner VAT number is not in Czech format — only Czech VAT numbers belong in the control statement (A.4). Either fix it or leave the field empty (the document then falls into the A.5 summary).
warning.fx_rate_deviation: The entered rate differs from the CNB daily rate — check the rate on the document.

byFunction.title: Income statement — by function
byFunction.subtitle: Decree 500/2002 Coll., Annex 2 Part II (§ 39b)
byFunction.explainer_title: Why this statement needs your input
byFunction.explainer_body: Classification by nature can be derived from the account number; by function it cannot — costs are classified by the function they serve, and the account number does not carry that. The same Services account may be cost of sales at one company and administrative overhead at another. Until the mapping is complete the statement will NOT be produced — an unassigned cost would silently drop out and overstate both gross profit and the result.
byFunction.incomplete_title: The statement cannot be produced yet
byFunction.map_hint: Mapping can also be done per analytic account (511.100 distribution, 511.900 administration) — longest-prefix wins.

mapping.title: Statement account mapping
mapping.subtitle: Company exceptions to the global balance sheet and income statement map
mapping.explainer_body: The global map places an account by its synthetic number. The regulation, however, leaves the company choices the account number cannot express: a shareholder loan due in more than a year belongs to long-term liabilities, income and expenses towards a controlled or controlling entity go to their own sub-rows, and a specific analytic account may belong elsewhere than its synthetic account. An exception applies only to this company and is used by the balance sheet, the income statement, their exports and the corporate income tax return appendix.
mapping.inherited_hint: The exception for group {prefix} applies; edit it in the account group exceptions below the table. Choosing another row here adds an exception for this account only.
mapping.note_placeholder: Reason for the exception, e.g. maturity
mapping.empty: The company has no accounts for this statement.
mapping.orphans_hint: The exception applies to every account whose number starts with the prefix. A specific account can have its own exception, which takes precedence.
mapping.prior_hint: The filed return also carries the previous period column. These exceptions apply up to {year}; an existing exception of the same account is limited to later years. The previous period column uses them when taking it from last year's closed statements is enabled in the closing settings.
mapping.follows_hint: The allowance goes to the row where the statement places the given receivable account, even after you reclassify it. The selected row applies only if the receivable account is not in the map.
mapping.other_years_hint: These exceptions are limited to other years. For one account and balance side the validity years of exceptions must not overlap.

mapping.suggest_disabled: No filed corporate income tax return is on record for this year. Use a suggestion from an uploaded return XML.

The 331/366 balance then nets to zero. Cash and bank accounts are excluded: record a cash payout with a cash document and match a bank payout on the statement.

employees.form_declaration_hint: Without a signed declaration the monthly credit is not applied and the full advance is withheld (§ 38h(4) of the Income Tax Act) — even if the employee is otherwise entitled to it. The employer is liable for any under-withheld advance (§ 38s).

repost.title: Re-post document
repost.strategy_replace: The existing entry will be rewritten — its current lines are deleted and these are written instead.
repost.strategy_reverse: The existing entry is not deleted: it is reversed by a mirror entry and the correction is written as a new entry. Both stay in the journal (§35 of the Accounting Act).
repost.reason_period_not_open: The original entry sits in a “{status}” period — closed periods must not be touched.
repost.reason_date_locked: The books are locked up to {date} — nothing may be written into a locked date.
repost.reason_entry_reversed: The original entry has already been reversed, so the correction goes in as a new entry.
repost.blocked_date_locked: The books are locked up to {date}, today included, so there is nowhere to write the correction. An admin can move the lock in accounting settings.
repost.blocked_period_not_open: The original entry sits in a “{status}” period and there is no open accounting period for today — there is nowhere to write the correction. Open a period in Accounting → Closing.
repost.confirm_date_shift: I understand that the reversal and the correction will be posted on {to} instead of the original {from}.
repost.tax_neutral_available: The entry date is locked up to {lock} by a filed VAT return, but the year is not closed. If the correction only moves amounts between accounts (e.g. 511 → 518.100, merging a discount into the goods) and does not change VAT, the payable, the receivable or cash, the entry is rewritten in place on {date}, without a reversal. Once the income tax return for the year is filed, only within the same account class and without changing tax deductibility. Otherwise a reversal and a new entry are posted. The lines you edit decide.
repost.strategy_replace_in_place: The entry is rewritten in place on {date}, without a reversal. It only moves amounts between accounts with no tax impact.
repost.reverse_because: It cannot be rewritten in place because {reason}.
repost.violation_unknown_account: the correction uses an account that is not in the chart of accounts
repost.violation_special_account: the correction changes a closing or off-balance account
repost.violation_tax_account_changed: VAT or another tax account (34x) changes
repost.violation_amounts_changed: the amount of a payable, receivable or cash changes (settlement account)
repost.violation_account_class_changed: the income tax return is filed and the result changes (move to another account class)
repost.violation_tax_deductibility_changed: the income tax return is filed and tax deductibility changes
repost.proposal_from_rule: The counter account is prefilled from the new rule. Review it and repost.
repost.dimensions_hint: Dimensions are analytics only. “Save dimensions only” applies them to the entry lines without a reversal and without changing accounts or amounts, even in a closed period. With a re-post they are saved together with it.
repost.dimensions_preview: Entry lines after saving the dimensions
repost.dimensions_refused: The dimensions cannot be saved like this: the document items have different dimensions, there is only one posted line and the entry sits in a closed or locked period. Splitting the line would change amounts, which only a re-post may do.
repost.hint: The entry must balance (Σ debit = Σ credit). Double entry, period status and the date lock are enforced by the server — re-posting does not change VAT, that is corrected by editing the document.

reports.after_closing_hint: The default view shows balances at the balance-sheet date BEFORE the closing entry — that is what you need for stocktaking and review. Switch this on to see the state after closing, where balance-sheet accounts are transferred to 702 and closing balances are zero.

trial_balance.title: Trial balance
trial_balance.subtitle: Opening balances, turnovers and closing balances with control checks.
trial_balance.empty: No accounts with movement or opening balance in the selected range.
trial_balance.draft_warning: There are {n} unposted drafts in the range — they are not included.
trial_balance.check_turnover: Σ turnover Dr = Σ turnover Cr
trial_balance.check_continuity: Opening balance continuity (Σ opening Dr = Σ opening Cr)

balance_inventory.title: Balance sheet account inventory
balance_inventory.subtitle: Inventory list of balance-sheet accounts (classes 0–4) with the closing balance at the balance sheet date, documentation and signature space (Czech Accounting Act §29–30).
balance_inventory.empty: There are no balance-sheet accounts with a balance or movement at the balance sheet date.
balance_inventory.as_of_hint: Balance sheet date: {date}. The "Actual state" and "Difference" columns are filled in by hand after the physical inventory count — they are included in the export (PDF/XLSX).
balance_inventory.draft_warning: There are {n} unposted drafts in the period — they are not included in the balances.
balance_inventory.sign_hint: Book value and actual state are stated on the account's normal side — for liability, contra-asset and equity accounts that means a positive number. Accounts with no fixed side (±, e.g. 343 or 431) are stated signed: positive on debit, negative on credit.
balance_inventory.protocol_ref_ph: ref. no. / link to signed protocol
balance_inventory.readonly_hint: The actual state can only be saved for an open or closing period.
balance_inventory.back_filled_hint: The period is closed — the counted balances were derived from the ledger (the closing already verified assets and liabilities). The inventory is therefore complete without manual entry.
balance_inventory.completed_blocked: Cannot complete — {count} unresolved differences. Resolve them (confirm or fix) before completing.

offsets.title: Offsets
offsets.subtitle: Mutual offset of a partner's receivables and payables — offset agreement, PDF and automatic settlement of both documents with a 321/311 posting.
offsets.no_open: The partner has no open receivable and payable at the same time.
offsets.unbalanced: Both sides of the offset must match
offsets.cancel_confirm: Really cancel this offset? The posting will be reversed and documents restored.

fx_rates.title: Exchange-rate mode
fx_rates.subtitle: §24(7) of the Accounting Act — instead of the daily CNB rate, an entity may use a fixed rate for the whole accounting period (month / year).
fx_rates.mode_hint: Switching applies to the future only — already posted documents keep the rate fixed on the header.
fx_rates.prefill: Fetch from CNB (first day of period)
fx_rates.prefilled: CNB rate as of {date} filled in.

repo_rates.title: CNB repo rate
repo_rates.subtitle: CNB two-week repo rate table — decisive for statutory late-payment interest (Gov. Regulation No. 351/2013 Coll.).
repo_rates.hint: Late-payment interest uses the repo rate valid on the first day of the calendar half-year in which the delay lasts, plus 8 percentage points. Add/verify values against the official CNB history.

saldo.title: Open-item ledger
saldo.subtitle: Open items per partner reconciled against the general-ledger account balance — the basis for the statutory receivables/payables inventory.
saldo.empty: No balances or open items on the open-item accounts for the selected balance-sheet date.
saldo.difference_hint: The account balance does not match the sum of open items — the difference may stem from manual entries, reversals, unposted foreign-currency payments or invoices without a source document.
saldo.no_open_items: No open items on this account.
saldo.side_receivable_hint: owed to us: issued invoices, other receivables and advances paid
saldo.side_payable_hint: owed by us: received invoices, other payables and advances received
saldo.flat_empty: No open items match the selected filters.
saldo.advance_vat_hint: VAT from the tax document for the payment
saldo.advance_vat_tooltip: For an advance awaiting its final invoice, Amount is the payment, Paid is the VAT from the tax document for the payment and Remaining is the advance base still waiting for the final invoice.
saldo.period_mismatch_hint: The selected balance-sheet date falls into accounting period {fiscal_year}, not the period selected in the dropdown — the report is still computed correctly.
saldo.period_missing_hint: No accounting period is defined for the selected balance-sheet date — balances are computed cumulatively from the beginning of history.

account_statement.title: Account statement
account_statement.subtitle: Chronological listing of entries on the account with a running balance.
account_statement.empty: No movements in the selected range.

open.subtitle: What the account balance consists of. Group lines that settle each other into a pairing.
open.check_ok: Open items match the account balance.
open.check_diff: Open items differ from the account balance by {amount}.
open.suggestions_empty: No suggestions. No matching amount on the opposite side within the window.
open.line_missing: line no longer in the journal
open.empty: No open items at this date.

section18.title: Cash flows and changes in equity
section18.subtitle: § 18(2) of the Czech Accounting Act, § 40 to § 44 of Decree 500/2002
section18.required_hint: {category} — both statements are a mandatory part of the financial statements.
section18.optional_hint: {category} — the statements are not mandatory; you may still compile them for your own use.
section18.cash_flow_mismatch: The sum of flows does not match the actual change in cash. The statement uses direct classification of movements, so a mismatch means a defect in the data — do not submit it in this state.
section18.equity_mismatch: Closing balances do not match opening balances adjusted for movements. Check the entries on equity accounts.
section18.equity_hint: Increases and decreases are reported separately — a net change would lose the information (a contribution and a payout of the same amount would show as zero).
section18.equity_empty: No equity accounts are flagged in the chart of accounts.

balance_sheet.title: Balance sheet
balance_sheet.subtitle: Balance sheet in the structure of annex 1 of decree no. 500/2002 Coll.
balance_sheet.empty: The statement has no data for the selected parameters.
balance_sheet.negative_net_title: Asset rows with a negative net amount
balance_sheet.negative_net_hint: The row's correction exceeds its gross amount. The allowance is most likely assigned to a different row than the receivable or asset it belongs to. Adjust the statement mapping overrides (correction following the receivable account).

statement_accounts.note_before_closing: Account balances before closing the books, without the closing entry. Click an account to open its statement.
statement_accounts.closed_note: The year is closed; balances match the content of accounts 702 and 710.
statement_accounts.section_unassigned: Accounts not assigned in the statement
statement_accounts.profit_mismatch: Profit from balance sheet accounts ({balance}) does not match profit from income statement accounts ({pl}). Check opening balances and last year's closing.
statement_accounts.profit_mismatch_dimension: With a dimension filter, balance sheet accounts contain only lines carrying this value, so their result ({balance}) may differ from the result of income statement accounts ({pl}). Use the income statement as the result of the dimension.
statement_accounts.unassigned_hint: Number of income statement accounts that are not on any row of the income statement: {count}. The profit includes them, the statement does not. Add statement mapping overrides.

estimate.title: Year-end estimate (not posted)
estimate.note: Nothing in this block is in the books. The figures come from the corporate income tax return preview (including manual base adjustments, loss, donations and credits), from the closing, from asset cards and from the tax advance records. Once the income tax (591) is posted, the block disappears.
estimate.loading: Calculating the estimate from the corporate tax preview…
estimate.error: The estimate could not be loaded.
estimate.unavailable: The tax estimate cannot be calculated now: {message}
estimate.closing_none: The closing has no unposted operations that would change the profit.
estimate.depreciation: Depreciation of the year per depreciation plan (not posted)
estimate.tax: Estimated income tax (after deductions and credits)

income_statement.title: Income statement
income_statement.subtitle: Profit and loss statement by nature per annex 2 of decree no. 500/2002 Coll.
income_statement.empty: The statement has no data for the selected parameters.
income_statement.check_profit: Profit or loss for the period

small_assets.title: Small assets
small_assets.subtitle: Register of assets below the CZK 80,000 threshold expensed directly to account 501 (§28/5 Accounting Act, ČÚS 013, §26/2 Income Tax Act).
small_assets.empty: No small asset card matches the filter.
small_assets.reports_hint: The inventory list is the basis for stocktaking. The 501 breakdown is computed from purchase invoice lines, not from cards — that is why it ties to the general ledger.
small_assets.unit_price_hint: The CZK 80,000 threshold (§26/2 Income Tax Act) is assessed against the unit price.
small_assets.dispose_hint: Disposing of card “{name}”. The card is not deleted — disposed assets must remain provable retrospectively (§28/5 Accounting Act).
small_assets.already_settled: Card is no longer in use — it was disposed or sold.
small_assets.sell_hint: Selling card “{name}”. A sale is an ordinary issued invoice (revenue 642 + VAT); nothing is posted from the card — it is only linked to the sale document.
small_assets.sell_accounting_note: Residual value is 0 (the cost hit 501 at acquisition), so nothing is posted from the card — the revenue is carried by the issued invoice.
small_assets.report_inventory: Small asset inventory as of date
small_assets.report_inventory_hint: Stocktaking list — name, document, price, location and responsible person.
small_assets.report_movements_hint: What was acquired and what was disposed of during the period.
small_assets.report_breakdown_hint: Material (501.100) × small assets (501.200) — comparable with the general ledger.

expense_rules.title: Expense rules
expense_rules.subtitle: Pre-fills the expense kind on received-invoice lines by vendor or text. When a rule matches it suggests the kind (and optionally the account); posting stays up to you.
expense_rules.form_help: A rule applies when ALL filled criteria match (AND). The first one by priority wins.
expense_rules.criteria_hint: Fill at least one of: vendor, vendor name or item description. An amount band alone does not make a rule.
expense_rules.amount_hint: Narrows the match by unit price per piece without VAT. Not a criterion on its own.
expense_rules.kind_hint: Drives the expense account: Service → 518, Material → 501, Small asset → 501 + register card, Fixed asset → 042 and depreciation.
expense_rules.target_account_hint: Set only when the account differs from the kind — e.g. insurance is a Service but books to 548. Empty = derived from the kind.
expense_rules.application_mode_hint: Rules created by the assistant start safely as suggestions. Enable automatic mode only after verification.
expense_rules.err_criteria_missing: Fill at least one criterion: vendor, vendor name or item description.
expense_rules.err_amount_band: Invalid amount band — minimum is greater than maximum.
expense_rules.err_target_account: Invalid target account — it must not be an open-item, VAT or bank account, and the account must be active.
expense_rules.err_vendor_not_found: The selected vendor was not found.
expense_rules.err_generic: The operation could not be completed.
expense_rules.kind_hint_tax_evidence: Long-term assets are not an expense when paid (depreciation applies instead); small assets are added to the small-asset register.
expense_rules.tax_deductible_hint: Set when the document is received, only if automatic rules match all of its items and agree. The cash journal uses it to sort the payment into deductible or non-deductible expenses.
expense_rules.err_target_account_tax_evidence: In tax evidence a rule sets no account, only the kind and tax deductibility of the expense.
expense_rules.err_recurring_prepaid_tax_evidence: Prepaid annual subscriptions are not accrued in tax evidence.

assets.title: Fixed assets
assets.subtitle: Fixed asset cards, tax and accounting depreciation (Czech ITA §26–33, CAS 013).
assets.empty: No asset cards match the filter.

de_kind.032: Works of art and collections (not depreciated)

candidates.title: Create card from received invoice
candidates.hint: Received invoices flagged as fixed assets. Selecting one pre-fills a new card.
candidates.empty: No received invoices flagged as fixed assets.

book.title: Post depreciation for a year
book.hint: Posts the accounting depreciation (551 / accumulated) and confirms the tax depreciation for every asset in use for an ended year. Re-running rewrites entries in place while the period is open.
book.hint_de: Confirms tax depreciation for the year for all assets in use. Tax evidence posts nothing; confirmed depreciation enters expenses in the income tax return.

plan.title: Depreciation plan
plan.empty: The depreciation plan is empty — the asset is not in use or is not depreciated.
plan.delete_confirm: Delete the depreciation posting for {year}? The journal entry and confirmed tax depreciation for this latest year will be deleted; no reversal will be created.
plan.deleted: The depreciation posting for {year} was deleted.
plan.law_version_note: Tax depreciation per Czech ITA 586/1992 Coll. as amended to 1 Jan 2026; accounting depreciation per CAS 013. Claimed depreciation of M1 vehicles above CZK 2,000,000 is reduced per §30e.

lifecycle.put_into_use_no_book_hint: Without posting — asset balances must already be in the books (opening balances, historical assets).
lifecycle.put_into_use_done: The asset has been put into use.
lifecycle.dispose_book: Post the disposal (net book value and removal from the register)
lifecycle.dispose_no_book_hint: Without posting: the disposal is already in the journal (conversion from another program, manual 54x entry against accumulated depreciation). The card is linked to the disposal entry on the disposal date and the tax return takes the net book value from it.
lifecycle.dispose_de_hint: Tax depreciation for the year of disposal is computed (half of the annual amount for straight-line and accelerated depreciation). The tax residual value of a sold or liquidated asset is included in expenses in the income tax return; for a donation it is not an expense and for damage only up to the compensation received.
lifecycle.revert_confirm: Really revert the disposal? Reversal entries will be created and the disposal-year depreciation deleted.
lifecycle.pause_hint: Pausing tax depreciation per §26/8 — later years continue as if there had been no pause. Straight-line and accelerated methods only.
lifecycle.paused: Tax depreciation for {year} has been paused.
lifecycle.unpaused: The pause for {year} has been cancelled.
lifecycle.delete_confirm: Really delete the asset card? This action cannot be undone.
lifecycle.delete_in_use_confirm: Really delete the asset card in use? Its put-into-use journal entry will also be deleted. This cannot be undone and is allowed only without confirmed depreciation or technical improvements.
lifecycle.download_card_error: Could not download the asset card.

improvement.added: The technical improvement has been added.
improvement.err_fields: Completion date and a positive amount are required.

override.title: Tax depreciation for {year}
override.hint: Sets the year's tax depreciation manually, typically when taking over figures from an accountant who calculated them outside the program. The amount flows into the tax return (difference between book and tax depreciation, depreciation table in the appendix) and shifts the tax net book value. Bulk confirmation of depreciation does not overwrite it. The change is recorded in the activity log.
override.saved: The tax depreciation for {year} has been overridden.
override.cleared: The override for {year} has been removed.
override.clear_confirm: Remove the manual override of the {year} tax depreciation and restore the computed amount?
override.err_fields: A non-negative amount and a reason are required.

account_summary.title: Summary card for an account without asset cards
account_summary.hint: For assets kept only in the journal (typically land on 031 without asset cards) creates one summary card: the input price is the account's opening balance and journal movements are increases and decreases of the price. The card matches the account balance, posts nothing and is not depreciated. After further movements on the account, sync it with the journal.
account_summary.empty: No non-depreciable asset account with a balance.
account_summary.has_cards: The account has its own asset cards ({count}) and gets no summary card.
account_summary.created: The summary card for account {account} has been created ({count} movements).
account_summary.synced: The summary card for account {account} has been synced with the journal ({count} movements).

hints.sale_invoice_641: Issue an invoice — the sale revenue (641, incl. VAT) is booked via an issued invoice, not the asset card.
hints.sale_invoice_de: Sale income is not recorded from the asset card. Issue an invoice; it enters the cash journal when it is paid.
hints.donation_vat_output: For donated assets where input VAT was deducted, verify output VAT based on the open market value (§13(4)(a) and §36(6)(a) of the Czech VAT Act). Disposal does not create an internal tax document.
hints.asset_vat_adjustment_evidence: For liquidation, shortage or damage, retain evidence of the disposal and verify any required input VAT settlement or adjustment (§77 and §78e of the Czech VAT Act).
hints.improvement_manual_entry: Post the improvement to 02x / 042 with a manual journal entry — the card reflects it in depreciation and acquisition cost automatically.
hints.below_80k: Movable tangible assets up to CZK 80,000 need not be tax-depreciated assets (§26/2) — consider a one-off expense.
hints.tz_below_80k: Improvements totalling up to CZK 80,000 per year are not a technical improvement per §33 — consider a one-off expense.

editor.subtitle: Fixed asset card — tax and accounting depreciation parameters.
editor.historical_hint: The card is created directly in use with depreciation already claimed; the put-into-use entry is not posted (balances came in via opening balances).
editor.dimensions_hint: Put into use, accounting depreciation and disposal take the card dimensions. A split between several values (e.g. 60/40) is set on the card detail. Left empty, the dimensions of the acquisition purchase invoice are used.
editor.accumulated_hint: Derived from the asset account; empty = non-depreciated asset (§27).
editor.kind_de_hint: Nothing is posted in tax evidence. The type only decides whether the asset is depreciated.
editor.intangible_months_de_hint: Intangible assets are depreciated evenly by months over the period you enter (Section 24(2)(v) of the Income Tax Act). Choose it by the expected period of use and keep it documented.
editor.acc_prospective_hint: Changes to accounting parameters apply prospectively from the following month (CAS 013).
editor.acc_by_tax_hint: Accounting depreciation equals the tax one — annual, on the last day of the year. Useful life is not entered. Use only where the accounting and tax views genuinely do not differ (§28/6 of the Accounting Act).
editor.extraordinary_hint: Extraordinary depreciation §30a: zero-emission vehicle acquired 2024–2028, first depreciator; 24 months (60 % / 40 %), no pausing, improvements do not increase the input price.
editor.m1_limit_hint: M1 vehicle above {limit}: only a proportional part of depreciation is deductible (§30e).
editor.tax_locked: Tax parameters are locked after the first confirmed depreciation (§30/2 ITA).
editor.locked_hint: The field is locked — the depreciation method and input price cannot be changed once depreciation has started (§30/2 ITA).
editor.err_tax_group: Depreciation group is required for straight-line and accelerated methods.
editor.err_extraordinary: Extraordinary depreciation §30a requires a zero-emission vehicle and first depreciator.
editor.err_acc_months: Accounting useful life in months is required for depreciated assets.
editor.err_historical_date: A historical asset requires a put-into-use date.

closing_package.title: Closing package
closing_package.subtitle: Downloads a single ZIP with all closing reports for the selected accounting period — balance sheet, income statement, general ledger, journal, trial balance, VAT book and income tax return.
closing_package.parts_label: What to include in the package
closing_package.include_xlsx: Also include XLSX (except VAT book, tax return and §38a advances notice, which are PDF/XML only)
