job.done_with_warnings: Package ready, but {count} optional part(s) failed — check README/manifest.
job.warnings_notice: Done with warnings — {count} optional part(s) could not be built. The mandatory core is complete; see README and manifest.json in the package for details.
job.in_progress: Package is already being prepared — please wait.
job.delete_confirm: Really delete this finished package from the list? The ZIP file will be removed and cannot be downloaded again.

parts.income_tax_report: Income tax return report (PDF, working copy, not a filing)
parts.income_tax_advances: Income tax advance payments notice under §38a (PDF, PO only)

closing_package.notes_incomplete_hint: The notes to the financial statements can be completed in the editor — filled-in sections are included the next time the package is generated.

setup_assistant.title: Accounting setup assistant
setup_assistant.subtitle: Analyzes any company's history and proposes analytic accounts, expense rules, document postings, bank rules and asset candidates.
setup_assistant.safety: Analysis changes nothing. Catalog and AI rules are stored in suggestion mode; rules overwhelmingly confirmed by past postings may post automatically. History can be rewritten only after a matching dry run and never in a closed or locked period or for documents taken over from another program.
setup_assistant.analysis_help: First checks how received invoices were actually posted and proposes priority rules for vendors consistently posted to one account. Remaining items are recognized by the catalog (Czech, Slovak, German, English) or optionally by AI. Recurring bank movements are analyzed too.
setup_assistant.ai_disclosure: After local analysis, only repeated, shortened texts of typical items are sent. Client and supplier names, document numbers, identifiers, dates and amounts are not sent. AI only proposes the expense nature and analytic account labels; MyÚčto validates accounts and the yearly asset threshold locally.
setup_assistant.ai_sample_hint: Each request contains at most 50 samples. A larger scope increases cost, not model strength.
setup_assistant.ai_unavailable: AI enrichment is not configured or confirmed for this company. Local analysis will run without it.
setup_assistant.ai_result: AI: {status}, {samples} samples sent in {requests} requests, {classified} items enriched, {proposals} proposals created.
setup_assistant.coverage_hint: This is an estimate based on items recognized by the dictionary and, when enabled, AI. The approved dry run shows the exact number of documents that will change.
setup_assistant.history_result: Posting history: {learned} of {documents} documents back a rule, {rules} rules proposed, {covered} items covered, {already} already handled by existing rules, {ambiguous} vendors posted inconsistently.
setup_assistant.review_help: Creating saves rules for future documents and selected analytic accounts without changing history. Confirm each fixed-asset candidate above the annual threshold separately; services are excluded.
setup_assistant.active_rules_available: This company already has {count} active expense rules. The analysis does not propose them again, but you can freeze them into a bundle for a history dry run.
setup_assistant.approved: The selected proposals were applied. History remains unchanged.
setup_assistant.bundle_ready: The rule bundle is locked and ready for history review.
setup_assistant.no_new_proposals: The analysis found no new rule. Existing active rules can still be prepared for a history dry run.
setup_assistant.no_source_proposals: There are no proposals from this source.

fields.name: Name
fields.bank_message_hint: Other safe criteria derived from history, such as counterparty or variable symbol, remain unchanged.
fields.create_analytic_hint: Clear this option when related rules should use an existing analytic account instead.
fields.account_code_locked: Account code {code} and parent account {parent} remain fixed to preserve dependencies. You can edit its name. {count} other proposals reference this account and will also be cleared if you clear the analytic account.
fields.account_replacement_help: The proposed account {code} will not be created. It will be atomically replaced with {replacement} in all {count} pending dependent proposals.

setup_assistant.history_help: This step is optional. The dry run applies the rules frozen in the approved bundle to documents in the selected period. Apply then cleanly replaces the existing entry lines without creating reversals or copies.
setup_assistant.history_range_hint: The range uses the taxable supply date, falling back to the issue date. Empty bounds include all available history. Changing the range requires a new dry run.
setup_assistant.history_scope_matched_hint: The safe default. Documents without a specific match and their manually entered postings remain unchanged.
setup_assistant.history_scope_all: Reclassify every document in the period
setup_assistant.history_scope_all_hint: Also applies default posting rules. Use it for a complete move from synthetic to analytic accounts, but it may replace manually entered postings.
setup_assistant.bank_history_unchanged: This option only applies to received invoices. Already posted bank transactions are not changed.
setup_assistant.apply_confirm: Rewrite document postings according to the approved dry run? Closed periods will remain unchanged.
setup_assistant.rollback_confirm: Restore the original entry lines from the snapshot? Closed periods will remain unchanged.
setup_assistant.delete_snapshot_confirm: Permanently delete the original posting snapshot? The journal will not change, but this reclassification can no longer be restored.
setup_assistant.snapshot_deleted: The original posting snapshot was permanently deleted. The journal was not changed.
setup_assistant.closed_period_note: Closed, closing and soft-locked periods are always skipped. The state is checked again atomically for every replacement.
setup_assistant.dry_run_coverage: {percent}% of dry-run documents will be reclassified ({changed} of {total}).
setup_assistant.background_hint: The job runs in the background. You can close this page and progress will resume when you return.

posting_backfill.title: Post pending documents
posting_backfill.subtitle: Goes through documents sitting in the system unposted and posts them to the journal.
posting_backfill.explainer_title: Why turning on automation is not enough
posting_backfill.explainer_body: Automatic posting is a hook on document CREATION — it fires when an invoice is issued, a purchase invoice is received or a recurring invoice is generated. A document that is already in the system (typically imported from another system) never passes through it, no matter how automation is set. This job is the only way to post such documents in bulk; it posts them with the same code as the accounting activation wizard.
posting_backfill.scope_hint: The job posts issued and purchase invoices. Cash, bank and settlements are posted through their own paths.
posting_backfill.action_start_hint: Posts every unposted invoice. Runs in the background and can be stopped.
posting_backfill.action_dry_hint: Walks the documents and reports what would happen without writing anything.
posting_backfill.background_hint: The job runs in the background — you can close this page, it will finish anyway.
posting_backfill.cancelled: Posting stopped. Documents posted up to that point stay in the journal.

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.subtitle: § 31/§ 32 of the Accounting Act, § 35a VAT Act — retention periods for accounting and tax records and disposal holds
retention.explainer_body: An expired period means the OBLIGATION to retain has ended, not an instruction to shred. A hold under § 32 keeps records even after the period expires — use it during a tax audit, appeal or litigation; it cannot be placed without a documented file number or proceeding description.
retention.action_hold_hint: Places a hold under § 32 — records are kept even after the retention period expires.
retention.form_hint: Records of the selected period (or all) are held until you release the hold — typically after a tax audit or dispute ends.
retention.description_required: Fill in the file number or proceeding description.
retention.description_placeholder: File no. / proceeding description (e.g. tax audit, ref. no. …)
retention.release_confirm: Release this hold? After the periods expire, nothing will prevent disposal of the records.

transition.title: Transition bridge (§ 7b ↔ § 24 ITA)
transition.subtitle: Annexes 2 and 3 of the Income Tax Act — basis for the tax base adjustment when changing the accounting regime
transition.explainer_body: The report shows unpaid receivables and payables as of the transition date (payment status is reconstructed to that day, not today), advances received and paid, and an indicative stock value. The accountant enters the tax base adjustment into the return manually — the system does not apply anything on its own. Add valuables manually.
transition.not_applicable: The transition makes no sense for the selected direction — the company never used that regime.
transition.spread_annual: spread over {years} years: {amount} CZK per year
transition.receivables_title: Unpaid receivables as of the transition date
transition.payables_title: Unpaid payables as of the transition date

statement_notes.carry_over_offer: You filled in the notes last year — {count} sections can be carried over from {year}. Only sections that are empty this year get filled.
statement_notes.carried_over_done: Carried over {count} sections. Review them and change whatever no longer holds.
statement_notes.carried_over_hint: This text was carried over from {year} and you have not confirmed it yet. Check that it still holds — saving marks it as yours.
statement_notes.title: Notes to the financial statements
statement_notes.subtitle: § 18(1)(c) of the Accounting Act, § 39/39a/39b of Decree 500/2002 Coll. The set of sections depends on the entity category and statutory audit. Sections are stored per fiscal year — they can be completed even for a closed period.
statement_notes.complete: The notes are complete — all mandatory sections are filled in.
statement_notes.incomplete: The notes are incomplete — {filled} of {total} mandatory sections filled in.
statement_notes.auto_hint: The system prefills this section from its own data; your own text takes precedence and is never overwritten.
statement_notes.auto_placeholder: The system prefills this section automatically; you can refine it with your own text.
statement_notes.placeholder: Free-form text of the section — the system cannot derive it from the books.
statement_notes.readonly_hint: You do not have write permission — sections are read-only.

closing.title: Period closing
closing.abort_confirm: Really abort the closing and return the period to the Open state?
closing.precheck_empty: Checks have not run yet — start them with the button above.
closing.precheck_stale_hint: The check results are stale — data changed since they were saved (typically the previous period being closed). Run the precheck again; the errors shown below may no longer apply.

precheck.title: Pre-closing checks
precheck.description: Completeness checks before closing — drafts, unposted documents, technical account balances.

depreciation.title: Asset depreciation
depreciation.description: Booking of the year's accounting depreciation (Fixed assets module, CAS 013).

fx_revaluation.title: FX revaluation
fx_revaluation.description: Revaluation of foreign-currency receivables, payables and currency accounts at the CNB rate as of the balance sheet date (§24/6+7 Accounting Act, CAS 006) — accounts 563/663.

estimates.title: Estimated items
estimates.description: Estimated receivables and payables (388/389) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.

deferrals.title: Accruals & deferrals
deferrals.description: Prepaid and accrued items (381–385) — assisted manual entries as of the balance sheet date.

provisions.title: Receivable allowances
provisions.description: Allowances for overdue receivables (§8a/§8c Reserves Act) — proposed from the aging ledger, statutory allowance (558) and accounting allowance beyond it (559) against 391. Optional step.

income_tax.title: Income tax
income_tax.description: Booking of the income tax payable (591/341) as of the balance sheet date — amount from the finalized corporate income tax return / tax-base adjustments report. Optional step.

stock.title: Inventory
stock.description: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015) — posting the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (112/501, 132/504), reclassifying inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648.

close_books.title: Close the books
close_books.description: Closing P&L accounts via 710 and balance sheet accounts via 702, determining the profit or loss (CAS 002).

open_next.title: Open the new year
open_next.description: Opening balance sheet accounts via 701 and transferring the profit or loss to 431 in the following period.

checks.prior_period_open: The previous period is not closed
checks.pl_balance_before_period: Non-zero expense/revenue balances before the period start
checks.drafts_in_period: Unposted journal drafts in the period
checks.journal_unbalanced: The period journal is not balanced (Σ Dr ≠ Σ Cr)
checks.unposted_invoices: Issued invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.unposted_purchases: Received invoices of the period without a journal entry
checks.transit_261_open: Non-zero balance of 261 — Money in transit
checks.transit_261_documented: Balance of 261 is documented by {count} open transfers ({amount})
checks.acquisition_04x_open: Non-zero balances of 041/042 — assets under construction
checks.depreciation_missing: Assets in use without booked accounting depreciation for the year
checks.vat_period_entitlement: Entitlement to quarterly VAT period (§ 99a — prior-year turnover and registration year)
checks.income_tax_hint: Book the current income tax (591/341) via the Income tax closing step — CIT base report
checks.procurement_111_131_open: Non-zero balances of 111/131 — unsettled procurement of materials/goods
checks.accounts_unusual_side: Accounts with a balance on the unusual side (per account type)
checks.assets_without_accumulated_depreciation: Assets on an account without booked accumulated depreciation
checks.vat_343_vs_return: Account 343 balance vs. VAT return for the period
checks.vat_clearing_stale: VAT clearing does not match the period turnover
checks.deposits_314_324_open: Unsettled advance accounts 314/324 at the balance-sheet date
checks.paid_invoices_open_saldo: Paid issued invoices with an open balance on 311 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.paid_purchases_open_saldo: Paid purchase invoices with an open balance on 321 (payment missing in the journal)
checks.clearing_accounts_open: Clearing (suspense) accounts with an open balance at the balance-sheet date
checks.card_clearing_open: Card payment clearing account (378.x) with a balance — unsettled card payments at the balance-sheet date
checks.card_payments_unmatched: Card payments without a document older than the limit in the card posting settings
checks.fx_footprint_missing: Foreign-currency lines on an FX account without a complete currency footprint (currency_code/amount_foreign)
checks.paid_proformas_no_advance: Paid proformas without a booked received advance on 324
checks.paid_advances_no_payment: Paid supplier advance invoices without a booked payment on 314
checks.settled_but_unpaid: Documents in the Sent state but with a payment already in the journal (update the status to Paid)
checks.cancelled_with_entry: Cancelled documents whose journal entry is still active (books and records contradict each other)
checks.entries_without_description: Posted journal entries with no description of the accounting case (§ 11(1)(b) of the Accounting Act) — add a description
checks.section18_statements_required: The entity category also requires a cash flow statement and a statement of changes in equity (§ 18(2) of the Accounting Act) — without them the financial statements are incomplete
checks.vat_registration_due: Turnover exceeded the VAT registration threshold (§ 6 VAT Act) — liability arises by law; check the date and file the registration
checks.vat_status_s79_missing: VAT payer status changed during the period without a line-45 deduction adjustment (§ 79 deduction claim on registration / § 79a deduction reduction on deregistration) — assess the business assets as of the transition date and record any items in the VAT corrections agenda
checks.estimates_unreleased: Estimated liabilities/assets carried from the previous period were not released (CAS 019) — the cost may be booked twice
checks.related_party_price_deviation: Prices charged to related parties differ from prices for unrelated ones (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act) — the difference must be documented
checks.related_party_transactions: Related-party transactions in the period — prices must match arm's-length prices (§ 36a VAT Act, § 23(7) Income Tax Act)
checks.realized_fx_unbooked: Realized FX difference not booked to 563/663 (settled foreign-currency document)
checks.small_asset_cards_incomplete: Small-asset cards do not match the 501.200 turnover (missing cards)
checks.dimension_account_unmapped: P&L entries left on a synthetic account with an account-driving dimension, without an analytic account (missing dimension value or mapping)
checks.dimension_account_map_invalid: The account-driving dimension map points to an analytic account that no longer matches its synthetic account (parent, type or tax deductibility)
checks.cnb_rate_deviation: Document exchange rate deviates from the daily CNB rate
checks.payment_match_audit: Matched payments that don't add up (currency, amount, FX difference, counterparty)
checks.inventory_unresolved: Balance-sheet account stocktaking (§29–30 of the Accounting Act) is not completed or has unresolved differences
checks.attachment_vat_period: Document tax point does not match its attachment and falls into another month — the document may be in the wrong VAT period and control statement
checks.attachment_mismatch: Documents that differ from their extracted attachment (amount, company ID, variable symbol or tax point day) — informative

payment_match_audit.currency_mismatch: Payment currency does not match the document currency
payment_match_audit.fx_on_czk_czk: FX difference (563/663) booked on a CZK transaction against a CZK document
payment_match_audit.counterparty_mismatch: Payment counterparty does not match the document counterparty

closing.depreciation_hint: Verify that the year's accounting depreciation is booked (551 / accumulated depreciation).
closing.depreciation_not_applicable: There was no depreciable asset in this period — the step resolves itself and does not block closing the books.
closing.depreciation_link: Go to Fixed assets — Book depreciation
closing.depreciation_book_hint: Books accounting depreciation for every in-use asset card (551 / accumulated depreciation). Re-running overwrites the entries instead of duplicating them. Once the closing has started this is the only route — the Fixed assets module posts into an open period only.

fx.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
fx.no_open_items: No open foreign-currency documents to revalue.
fx.bank_section: Foreign-currency bank accounts and cash desks
fx.no_bank_rows: No foreign-currency balances — add a row if you keep a currency account or cash desk.

assist.needs_closing: This step becomes available after the closing is started (Closing state).
assist.reverse_confirm: Really reverse entry #{id}? A mirror entry will be created.
assist.fields_required: Select a posting rule and fill in a positive amount and description.

small_asset.title: Small asset accrual
small_asset.hint: Small assets are not depreciated — the whole cost hits 501 in the year of acquisition. Deferring part of it to 381 is an optional accounting policy (Sec. 7 of the Accounting Act), not a legal rule. Pick a mode and the system proposes the deferral; it is released automatically in the next year.
small_asset.no_cards: There are no small asset cards to accrue in this period.
small_asset.posted: Small asset accrual has been posted.
small_asset.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.
small_asset.materiality_hint: The flat rate is a policy only for an immaterial homogeneous set of small assets. Provide a documented materiality limit (base of 501 turnover); without it the flat rate cannot be used.
small_asset.materiality_required: For the flat rate, enter a positive materiality limit (base 501).
small_asset.materiality_missing: The flat rate requires a documented materiality limit — add one, or use pro-rata accrual.
small_asset.materiality_over: Base 501 ({base}) exceeds the materiality limit ({limit}) — the set is material, use pro-rata accrual.

prepaid_expense.title: Prepaid expenses (381)
prepaid_expense.hint: From received-invoice lines marked with a from–to period whose cost extends beyond year-end (insurance, parking, subscriptions). The system pro-rates by days the part belonging to future periods and defers it to 381 (Dr 381 / Cr expense account). Released automatically in N+1.
prepaid_expense.no_items: No invoice lines marked for time accrual in this period.
prepaid_expense.load_failed: Failed to load the accrual preview.

deferred_revenue.title: Deferred revenue (384)
deferred_revenue.hint: From issued invoice lines marked with a from–to period whose revenue extends beyond the year end (annual subscriptions, rent, service contracts). The part belonging to future periods is computed pro rata by days and deferred to 384 (debit revenue account / credit 384). It is released automatically in the next year.
deferred_revenue.no_items: No issued invoice lines in this period are marked for accrual.
deferred_revenue.load_failed: Failed to load the deferred revenue preview.

estimates.suggest_hint: The system finds recurring monthly costs (energy, rent, telco, cloud) whose invoice for the last month of the year is missing at the balance-sheet date, and proposes a passive estimate (389) equal to the average of the recent invoices. Review and confirm each proposal per vendor — the system never posts automatically.
estimates.none: No recurring cost with a missing invoice for the last month.

close.hint: Closes P&L accounts via 710 - Profit and loss account and balance sheet accounts via 702 - Final balance sheet account. Requires all preceding wizard steps completed or skipped and checks without errors.
close.blocked_precheck: The books cannot be closed yet — the pre-checks report an error: {checks}. Fix it and run the checks again in step 1.
close.blocked_steps: The books cannot be closed yet — one of the previous steps is neither confirmed nor skipped.
close.blocked_not_closing: The books can only be closed after the closing has started (Closing state).
close.confirm_text: Closing entries will be booked as of {date} (UZ document series) and period {year} will become Closed. The step can be undone until the financial statements are approved.
close.journal_link: Show closing entries in the journal
close.override_text: The period has unposted active documents. You may close the books over them only with a documented reason — the exception is recorded in the audit log and the closing package.
close.override_reason_ph: E.g. document delivered after closing, will be posted in the next period

open.hint: Books opening balances of balance sheet accounts via 701 — Opening balance sheet account into the following period (created automatically if missing) and transfers the profit or loss to 431.
open.confirm_text: The opening entry will be booked as of the first day of period {year} (OT document series).
open.done: The new year has been opened.
open.fx_reversal_note: If the reversal of receivable/payable revaluation is enabled in settings, a mirror FX entry is booked on the first day of the new period (KR document series).
open.fx_reversal_created: The revaluation reversal was booked on the first day of the period.

opening_takeover.status_label: Opening balances of the next year
opening_takeover.to_create_hint: The next year has no opening entry yet; this step will book it.
opening_takeover.match_hint: The next year already has an opening entry from another source (data transfer or manual entry) and it matches the closing balances account by account. The step takes it over and books nothing new.
opening_takeover.mismatch_hint: The next year already has an opening entry from another source, but it does not match the closing balances. The year cannot be opened until the differences are resolved or the taken-over balances are explicitly replaced with the calculated ones.
opening_takeover.unavailable_hint: Closing balances cannot be calculated — run the checks in step 1.
opening_takeover.preliminary: Preliminary comparison — it becomes final after the books are closed.
opening_takeover.compare_note: Compared account by account; 70x clearing accounts are skipped and account 431 is compared at the synthetic level.
opening_takeover.replace_button: Replace taken-over balances with calculated ones
opening_takeover.replace_text: The taken-over opening entries of the next year will be deleted (with an audit trail) and the calculated opening entry will be booked. State why the taken-over balances are not valid.
opening_takeover.replace_reason_ph: E.g. the taken-over balances contained an error in receivables
opening_takeover.done_taken_over: Opening balances taken over — they match on {count} accounts, nothing was booked.
opening_takeover.done_replaced: The taken-over opening balances were replaced with the calculated ones. Reason: {reason}
opening_takeover.revert_keeps: Undoing this step does not delete the taken-over entry.

revert.confirm: Really undo this step? Its closing entries will be deleted (with an audit trail).

provisions.save_before_page: Post your changes or reload the receivables before changing pages.
provisions.rule_hint: Statutory allowance proposal: §8c small receivables up to CZK 30,000 over 12 months → 100 %; §8a over 18 months → 50 %, over 30 months → 100 %. Adjust per receivable — the system never posts automatically.
provisions.time_barred_warning: The receivable may be time-barred — verify debt acknowledgement or suspension of the limitation period.
provisions.none: No overdue receivables to create allowances for.

income_tax.computed_from_ledger: Computed from the ledger (no finalized return) — verify before booking
income_tax.stock_pending: The inventory close (step 8) has not run yet. Under method B the closing stock is removed from expenses, so the tax base will still change — do not rely on this figure yet. Book the inventory first, then come back.
income_tax.no_return: No finalized CIT return for the year — enter the amount manually per the tax-base adjustments report.
income_tax.booked: Income tax payable has been booked.
income_tax.amount_required: Enter a positive income tax amount.
income_tax.not_applicable_fo: Personal income tax is not an expense of the accounting entity and is not posted to 591/341. Explicitly skip this step.

stock.needs_closing: This step becomes available once closing has started (status Closing).
stock.not_applicable: The company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping — the inventory step is skipped automatically and does not block closing the books.
stock.hint: Method B inventory closing (CAS 015): posts the closing stock per stock records as of the balance sheet date (materials 112/501, goods 132/504, products 123/583), reclassifies inventory shortages to 549 and surpluses to 648. The opening stock is charged to consumption when the new year is opened.
stock.closing_title: Closing stock as of the balance sheet date
stock.no_data: No data yet — post the step with the button below; the system computes the closing stock from stock records.
stock.skipped: The inventory step was skipped (the company does not keep inventory under double-entry bookkeeping).

profit_distribution.title: Profit distribution
profit_distribution.description: Distribution of profit / settlement of loss after approval (431 → 428/429, fund allocations, shareholder shares 364 + withholding tax 342). Booked into the open period.
profit_distribution.already_booked: Profit distribution is already booked for this period.
profit_distribution.date_required: Enter the general meeting decision date.
profit_distribution.shareholder_row_hint: Each Shareholder shares row must represent one shareholder; withholding tax is rounded down separately for each shareholder.

approve.confirm_text_17_7: Once the financial statements are approved, the books can no longer be reopened (§17(7) of the Accounting Act). Corrections are made in the following period (§35).
approve.locked_hint: The statements are approved and the approval cannot be revoked (§17/7). Corrections are made in the period in which the error is found (§35).

reopen.title: Reopening period {year}
reopen.text: Reopening a closed period touches closed accounting records and is recorded in the audit trail. If closing entries exist, first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.

series.title: Document series
series.hint: Journal document series per year — the prefix, number format and next number are editable, numbers are issued sequentially and gaps after deleted entries are not reused.
series.empty: No document series yet — they are created when the first number is issued.
series.format_hint: The number format is optional — an empty field means the built-in PREFIX-YYYY-CCCC. Placeholders (always in curly braces): PREFIX series prefix · YYYY 4-digit year · YY 2-digit year · C+ counter, the number of Cs sets the width. For example PREFIX and CCCCC in curly braces with prefix 26HP yields 26HP00011.
series.prefix_invalid: The prefix must be 1–10 uppercase letters or digits.
series.format_invalid: The number format must contain a counter — add e.g. CCCC in curly braces, otherwise numbers would repeat.
series.next_number_invalid: The next number must be an integer between 1 and 999999999.

settings.title: Closing & statement settings
settings.avg_employees_hint: Goes into the corporate income tax return appendix (poc_zam) — the app does not compute headcount from payroll, fill it in manually.
settings.statutory_audit: Subject to statutory audit (§20 of the Accounting Act)
settings.statutory_audit_hint: An audited entity always prepares full-scope statements (§3a of Decree 500/2002 Coll.).
settings.manual_doc_series: Automatic document numbers for manual entries (ID series)
settings.manual_doc_series_hint: A manual entry without a document number gets one from the ID series.
settings.fx_reversal_at_open: Reverse receivable/payable revaluation on the first day of the new period
settings.fx_reversal_at_open_hint: Unrealised FX differences on receivables and payables are reversed on the first day of the new year (the subledger keeps the document rate).
settings.tax_authority_offset: Present taxes due to/from the tax office as a single net amount
settings.tax_authority_offset_hint: An overpayment of one tax (income tax, VAT, other taxes) is offset against an underpayment of another in the balance sheet, as allowed by Section 58(2) of Decree No. 500/2002 Coll. Disclose the net presentation in the notes; a suggested sentence is shown with the accounting principles. Without this option tax receivables and payables are presented separately.
settings.comparative_from_prior_year: Take the prior period of the statements from last year's closed statements
settings.comparative_from_prior_year_hint: The prior period column is built with the mapping exceptions valid in the previous year, i.e. the same way as the statements you filed for that year. Without this option the prior period is recalculated using the current year's classification; explain the change in the notes.
settings.small_asset_accrual_hint: Accounting policy (§7 ZoÚ, optional): how small assets up to CZK 80,000 are spread onto 381. None = full cost in the year of acquisition; pro-rata = by acquisition date; flat = fixed % of the price. Pre-filled in the closing 'Accruals' step.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts (261)
transfer.hint: Two legs of a transfer via 261 — Money in transit: dispatch (Dr 261 / Cr from-account) and receipt (Dr to-account / Cr 261). Both legs share a PP-series document number.
transfer.same_accounts: The source and target accounts must differ.
transfer.fields_required: Fill in both accounts, a positive amount and both dates.
transfer.bank_candidates_warning: A bank transaction for this transfer exists — post it from the statement; a manual entry would duplicate it.

archive.title: Accounting archive
archive.subtitle: Per-company archival of accounting data — ZIP export with a manifest and checksums (§31/§32 of the Accounting Act).
archive.info: The archive contains the company's accounting data in JSON Lines format: periods, chart of accounts, journal, posting rules, assets, depreciation, invoices, bank and codebooks, including a manifest with SHA-256 checksums. PDF documents are not included (covered by the PDF backup).
archive.restore_note: Restoring an archive is a server-admin CLI helper only (api/bin/archive-restore.php, dry-run validation only) — it cannot be done from the application.

errors.version_conflict: The period was modified by another user — data has been reloaded.
errors.opening_takeover_mismatch: The taken-over opening balances of the next year do not match the closing balances — review the differences table in the Open the new year step.
errors.closing_entries_exist: Closing entries exist — first undo the Open the new year and Close the books steps.
errors.use_closing_workflow: Use the closing wizard — the status cannot be changed directly.
errors.bank_transfer_candidates: Bank transactions for this transfer exist — see the warning.
errors.cross_currency_manual_only: Confirm cross-currency transfers with a manual entry.
errors.period_overlap: The period overlaps an existing period.
errors.period_gap: The following period does not immediately follow the closed period.
errors.previous_period_open: The previous period must be closed first.
errors.closing_unbalanced_702: The closing entry is not balanced (final balance sheet account 702) — check the journal.
errors.missing_account: A required closing account is missing from the chart of accounts.
errors.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
errors.precheck_errors_exist: Pre-closing checks contain errors — the books cannot be closed.

monthly_check.title: Monthly check
monthly_check.subtitle: Completeness and balance-inventory checks over any date range — any time during the year, without starting the year-end closing.
monthly_check.empty: No result yet — run the check with the button above.
monthly_check.lock_current: Locked until {date} — documents dated on or before this day cannot be posted.
monthly_check.lock_confirm: Really set the lock to {date}? Documents dated on or before this day will no longer be postable.

tax_base_adjustments.title: Tax-base adjustments report
tax_base_adjustments.subtitle: CIT reference data — the difference between tax and book depreciation, disposed assets, and informational balances of accrual accounts and FX differences. The system posts nothing.
tax_base_adjustments.no_disposals: No assets were disposed of in this period.

error.unbalanced_entry: The entry is not balanced (Dr ≠ Cr).
error.period_not_open: The fiscal period is not open.
error.duplicate_account: An account with this code already exists.
error.duplicate_period: A fiscal period for this year already exists.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.

profile_signing.title: Certificates and electronic signatures
profile_signing.subtitle: Manage your own signing profiles and certificates.
profile_signing.disabled_text: An admin must first allow users to manage their own signing profiles in electronic signature settings.
profile_signing.form_hint: The profile will be tied to your user account.
profile_signing.credential_hint: The certificate is shared by all enabled profile usages. Prefer picking one from the Certificates section — that is where it is uploaded once for the whole app.
profile_signing.credential_save_first: The certificate can be uploaded after the profile is saved for the first time.
profile_signing.default_profiles_hint: When signed-in user selection is active, the app uses the selected profile for the output type.
profile_signing.default_profile_active: Your own profile will be used for this output.
profile_signing.output_mapping_disabled: Signing for this PDF output is disabled in administration; your own profile will not be used.
profile_signing.output_mapping_not_user: This PDF output is not configured to use the signed-in user source in administration; your own profile will not be used.
profile_signing.output_usage_mismatch: The selected profile does not support {outputUsage}. Profile supports: {profileUsages}.

electronic_signatures.title: Certificates and electronic signatures
electronic_signatures.subtitle: Certificates, signing profiles and PDF output mapping.

credit_note_offset.credit_note_offset: The credit note is set off ({amount}, {date}) against invoice
credit_note_offset.invoice_offset: Amount due reduced by {amount} ({date}) by credit note
credit_note_offset.can_apply_hint: The credit note is not set off against the corrected invoice yet. After the set-off the invoice amount due drops and the other party pays only the difference.
credit_note_offset.revert_confirm: Cancel the credit note set-off? The invoice returns to its original amount due and the credit note stays open for a refund.
credit_note_offset.applied: The credit note is set off against the invoice.
credit_note_offset.reverted: The credit note set-off is cancelled.

purchase_invoice.title: Received invoices
purchase_invoice.duplicate_number_confirm:
{message}

If this is another payment of the same document (for example a payment calendar), you can save it with the same number. Save anyway?
purchase_invoice.subtitle: Vendor documents — company expenses.
purchase_invoice.advance_posting_hint: An advance document is not posted as a liability. Its bank or cash payment is posted to account 314 instead.
purchase_invoice.empty_client: No received invoices yet. Upload your first one.

fields.vendor_invoice_number_hint: As written on the original (e.g. FA-2026-001)
fields.varsymbol_hint: Optional — auto-generated as PF2605001 (prefix by tax type) on receipt
fields.tax_date_rc_hint: Under reverse charge the document is assigned to the VAT period by the tax point date (the obligation to declare tax arises regardless of receiving the document). For EU goods acquisitions the tax point is, per § 25 of the Czech VAT Act, the 15th day of the month following delivery, unless the invoice was issued earlier.
fields.delivery_date_hint: The delivery or hand-over date stated on the document (Leistungsdatum, date of supply) — a record-keeping field; the tax point stays in its own field. For intra-EU acquisitions of goods the statutory tax point under § 25 of the Czech VAT Act is derived from it; if you leave it empty the system does not guess it and only warns.
fields.vat_claim_hint: Input VAT from this document falls into the {period} period — {basis}. Under § 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act the deduction can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document, so the tax point alone cannot pull the document into its own month if it was issued or received later.

vat_claim_basis.issue_date: driven by the issue date (you cannot hold the document earlier)

fields.vat_claim_received_note: Check that the date received matches the day you actually got the document — on an imported document it is pre-filled from the document itself (the issue date, or the tax point when there is none). Until you edit the field, it does not affect the deduction period.
fields.currency_add_hint: Add a currency for received invoices (created as inactive for issued)
fields.currency_add_iso_hint: ISO 4217 code (3 letters), e.g. USD, GBP, CHF
fields.currency_add_inactive_note: Created as inactive (purchases only). If you want to issue invoices in it, activate it later in Settings and add a bank account.
fields.currency_add_advanced_hint: To activate (bank account, rate, decimals), go to
fields.currency_inactive_hint: This currency is inactive for issued invoices (no bank account). Only usable for received invoice tracking.
fields.prices_include_vat_hint: Item prices are gross (incl. VAT) — typical for receipts; VAT is calculated top-down so the total matches to the cent.
fields.vendor_is_vat_payer_hint: Verified online from ARES (CZ) / VIES (EU). If the vendor is not a VAT payer, the VAT deduction is disabled automatically and rates set to 0%. Can be overridden.
fields.is_fixed_asset_hint: Invoice covers long-term assets per § 4(4)(c) of CZ VAT Act (vehicle, machinery). Value is reported additionally on DPHDP3 row 47 as supplementary data.
fields.is_fixed_asset_derived_hint: Derived from items — ticked as soon as at least one item has the expense kind “Fixed asset”. An asset invoice per § 4(4)(c) is additionally reported on DPHDP3 row 47.

small_asset.badge_tooltip: Document contains a small asset — at least one item has the expense kind “Small asset”.

items.title: Items
items.gross_edit_hint: You can overwrite with the gross (incl. VAT) amount — the net unit price is back-calculated.
items.expense_kind_hint: Drives the expense account: Service → 518, Material (incl. fuel) → 501, Small asset → 501 + asset record, Fixed asset → 042 and depreciation. Unspecified behaves as before (518).
items.accrual_hint: Cost belongs to a from–to period (insurance, parking, subscription). The part beyond year-end is deferred to 381 (prepaid expenses) at closing.
items.empty: No items — add at least one to calculate totals.

totals.rounding_hint: Difference between items sum and rounded amount on the invoice (typically +/− 0.5 CZK).

warning.credit_note_positive_total: Credit note has a positive total — it should have negative amounts. A negative sign on one side is enough (e.g. −1 pc × 1000, or 1 pc × −1000); if both quantity and price are negative, VAT/control-statement reports will add the amount instead of subtracting it. Please check the signs.
warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the relevant day by {diff} %. Please check the rate. This is the accounting conversion — the CZK VAT amount on the document (§73/6) is unaffected.
warning.vendor_non_payer_deduction: The vendor is not a VAT payer, yet a VAT deduction is claimed. VAT cannot be deducted from a non-payer — please check the deduction setting.
warning.vendor_unreliable_payer: According to the VAT payer registry (CRPDPH), the vendor is listed as an unreliable VAT payer — paying them carries liability risk for unpaid VAT (§109 VAT Act). Consider special-mode payment (§109a) or verifying with the vendor.
warning.advance_has_tax_document: The linked advance already has a tax document for payment (DDKP) — its VAT was claimed separately. On this final invoice claim the deduction only from the VAT TOP-UP (the difference against the DDKP), otherwise the deduction would be taken twice.
warning.linked_advance_unpaid: Advance {advance} has no posted payment yet, so this invoice did not settle the advance (321/314). Match the advance payment with advance {advance}, not with this invoice; the settlement is then added to this invoice's entry automatically.
warning.receipt_looks_like_prepayment: This document is classified as a receipt, but its content looks like a tax document for a received payment (advance). A receipt books the cost (518) immediately — when the final invoice later arrives, the cost is double-counted. Consider the type "Tax document for payment" (DDKP → VAT deduction only, 343/314) or "Advance".
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded: The relevant date (tax point) or the currency changed, but the exchange rate stayed as it was ({rate} as of {date}) — {reason} Please check the rate on the document.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_source_locked: the rate on the document does not come from an automatic conversion (a person entered it, it came from an import, or its origin is unknown), so automation does not overwrite it.
warning.exchange_rate_not_reloaded_cnb_unavailab: the CNB rate for the new date could not be fetched.
warning.public_authority_fee_out_of_scope: This document looks like a public-authority fee (court fee, administrative fee, duty stamp). A public authority acting in that capacity is not a taxable person (Section 5(4) of the Czech VAT Act), so the supply is outside the scope of VAT — including fees charged by a foreign court or office: no self-assessment under Section 9(1), and the document enters neither the VAT return nor the control statement. That is why no VAT classification was assigned. If this really is an ordinary purchased service, pick the classification manually.
warning.missing_vat_classification: This document carries VAT (or is under reverse charge) but has no VAT classification, so it reaches neither the VAT return nor the control statement. Typically a rate the Czech codebook does not know (e.g. German 19%) or a vendor with an undetermined country. Check the line rates and pick a classification manually.
warning.eu_acquisition_delivery_date_missing: This intra-EU acquisition of goods has no delivery date, so the tax point under § 25 of the Czech VAT Act can be neither computed nor verified. Fill in the delivery date from the document — the VAT period and the CNB rate both depend on the tax point. The system deliberately does not guess it: the month of acquisition cannot be derived from the issue date.
warning.eu_acquisition_tax_date_mismatch: The tax point does not match the § 25 calculation from the delivery date you entered (the 15th day of the month following delivery, or the earlier invoice issue date). Check both dates — the difference moves the supply into a different VAT period and changes the CNB rate.

classification.title: Classification
classification.project_hint: Assigns the cost to an event — revenue, costs and margin are shown on the project detail.
classification.vat_classification_hint: If unset, the code is derived from the VAT rate and the vendor country: domestic 21% → 40, 12% → 41, domestic reverse charge → 5, EU service → 24e (line 5), non-EU service → 24 (line 12). Zero-rated domestic supplies (exempt, non-payer) and public-authority fees (court, administrative) get no code — they belong to neither the VAT return nor the control statement.
classification.vat_deduction_hint: “None” = invoice is excluded from the VAT ledger and DPHDP3/KH (accounting cost only). “Proportional” = partial deduction §75 — enter the % the deduction is reduced to.
classification.tax_deductible_hint: Affects income tax (DPFO/DPPO) only, not VAT. Turn off for non-deductible costs (entertainment…).

purchase_invoice.vat_deduction_reduced_hint: An input used for both taxable and exempt-without-entitlement supplies (§51) — e.g. rent, utilities, accounting fees at a company with exempt income. recurring.day_of_month_hint: 1–28 (safe for February). For the last day of month, check „End of month" below.

recurring.payment_due_unit_hint: "Follow customer" takes the unit from the customer record (which may in turn inherit the company default). Calendar month: Jan 31 → Feb 28, not a fixed 30 days.
recurring.tax_date_mode_hint: For VAT payers. If you bill for services delivered in the previous month, choose „Last day of previous month" — both DUZP and the month in item descriptions follow that period.
recurring.revenue_category_hint: Fixed category for all invoices generated from this template. If not selected, the project default (or customer default) effective at issue time is used.
recurring.increment_month: Sync month in item descriptions to DUZP (e.g. „Hosting 03/2026" → „Hosting 05/2026" if DUZP falls in 5/2026)
recurring.auto_issue: Issue immediately after generating (assign invoice number)
recurring.auto_send_email: Send to client by email after issuing
recurring.draft_open_mode_period_start: At start of period (for ongoing work report)
recurring.draft_open_mode_hint: „At start of period" opens the draft on the 1st day of the billed month, so you can add extra work to the work report throughout the month. The draft is automatically closed, issued and sent the day after the period ends (so work logged on the last day is captured too) — the issue date and tax date still stay at the end of period.
recurring.draft_open_mode_monthly_only: „At start of period" is only available for monthly frequency.
recurring.period_start_requires_monthly: „At start of period" mode can only be used with monthly frequency.
recurring.period_start_requires_auto_issue: „At start of period" mode requires auto-issue (the draft closes itself at the end of the period).
recurring.oss_country_required: Fill in the Member State of consumption for the OSS line — without it the line is saved as domestic.
recurring.oss_rate_type_missing_hint: Without a rate type the generator will try to fill it from the codebook, but only if it derives the same Member State of consumption. Otherwise the line will not reach the OSS return — set the type according to the rate applicable in the Member State of consumption.
recurring.oss_registration_hint: OSS set on a template line is a stored decision: it takes precedence over automatic derivation when invoices are generated. It is only used when the company holds a valid OSS registration on the tax point date of the generated invoice. Once the registration ends, the line is issued as domestic and flagged for manual review.
recurring.reminder_days_before_hint: How many days before issuing you get an email reminder to add extra work. 0 = do not send.
recurring.items_required: Template must have at least one item.
recurring.placeholders_intro: Replaced on every invoice generation based on the tax date (issue date for proformas). They also work in the notes above/below items carried over from the template. Unrecognized tokens are left untouched. Examples below for tax date May 15, 2026:

placeholders_rows.d: year → 2026, 26 · shift by years: {'{YYYY+1}'} → 2027, {'{YY-1}'} → 25 · year of a shifted month: {'{YYYY+8M}'} → 2027 (pairs with {'{MMMM+8}'})
month → 5, 05 · shift by months incl. year rollover: {'{MM+8}'} → 01
month name per document language → May · {'{MMMM+1}'} → June
full date → May 15, 2026 · ±D/M/Y arithmetic: {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'} → May 14, 2027 · month overflow is clamped (Jan 31 {'{DATE+1M}'} → Feb 28)
start/end of month → May 1, 2026, May 31, 2026 · shift by months: {'{EOM+1}'} → Jun 30, 2026, {'{EOM-1}'} → Apr 30, 2026

recurring.placeholders_example: Example: "Renewal of domain example.cz for period {'{DATE}'} - {'{DATE+1Y-1D}'}" → "Renewal of domain example.cz for period May 15, 2026 - May 14, 2027"

api_tokens.intro: Tokens let you call MyÚčto.cz REST API without a browser. Endpoint reference:
api_tokens.empty: You haven't created any API tokens yet.
api_tokens.name_required: Give the token a name so you remember what it's for.
api_tokens.totp_hint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app (step-up security).
api_tokens.password_invite_placeholder: leave empty and we will send a link
api_tokens.password_invite_hint: Leave empty and we will email the user a single-use link so they set the password themselves. You will not know it.
api_tokens.password_link_sent: Link sent to the user’s e-mail.
api_tokens.invite_sent: User created. We have emailed them a link to set their password.

api_tokens.password_required: Enter your current password to create a token.

api_tokens.expires_hint: Without a date the token is valid for 90 days (max 730 days).
api_tokens.never_expires_hint: Not recommended. Only a superadmin can create a non-expiring token with write access.
api_tokens.step_up_hint: Verify your identity again before creating the token.

license.model_subtitle: A free foundation forever, with a paid accounting extension on top.
license.model_intro: Invoicing, documents, contacts, bank and cash are free in MyÚčto and will stay free. A license unlocks the accounting extension built on top of them.
model_points: The free foundation stays available after the trial ends.
A commercial license unlocks double-entry accounting, accounting tools and closing, stock and e-commerce, asset records, EPO integration and advanced VAT corrections.
Pricing is per active user and month; read-only and deactivated accounts do not count.
The license is bound to a unique installation identifier; one key runs on one installation.
The app verifies the license online roughly once a day; a brief loss of internet does not limit operation.
Only technical data is transmitted (identifier, key, version, counts). No accounting or personal data.
license.trial_body: For the first 60 days after first launch you have full access for free, without registration or payment. Afterwards the paid accounting modules are hidden and their pages and APIs are unavailable until you activate a license. The free foundation remains fully usable.
license.tiers_body: Single company (1 agenda), Accounting office (up to 10 agendas) and Unlimited (no company limit). An annual subscription costs 10 monthly payments.
license.readonly_body: After the license expires (and a 14-day grace period), invoicing and the entire free foundation remain fully operational. Double-entry accounting, Tools and closing, stock and e-commerce, asset records, EPO integration, income tax and advanced VAT corrections are unavailable. Their data remains unchanged in the database and becomes available again after activation.
license.terms_subtitle: Summary of the main articles. The full text at myucto.cz is binding.
license.terms_intro: These terms govern the subscription to the commercial license of the MyÚčto application. The contract is governed by Czech law (Act No. 89/2012 Coll., the Civil Code).
license.terms_provider: Provider: MyWebdesign.cz s.r.o., Kardinála Berana 1104/36, 301 00 Plzeň, Czech Republic. VAT payer. Contact and billing details (company ID, VAT ID, e-mail) are stated in the full terms.

terms_articles.title: 1. Subscription, plans and pricing
terms_articles.body: Three plans by number of company agendas (1 company / up to 10 / unlimited). Pricing is per active user and month, excluding VAT; VAT is added. Monthly or annual period (annual = 10 monthly payments).

terms_articles.title: 2. Order and conclusion of contract
terms_articles.body: You choose the plan, number of users, period and billing details. After a summary and the first payment the contract is concluded and you receive a confirmation and license key by e-mail.

terms_articles.title: 3. Payment terms and recurring payments
terms_articles.body: Card payments via the GoPay gateway; card details are not available to the provider. Payment recurs with your consent, at a fixed amount, monthly or annually. You can cancel any time, effective at the end of the paid period.

terms_articles.title: 4. Delivery and activation of the license
terms_articles.body: The key is sent immediately after payment (usually within minutes). Activation happens directly in the app. Scope upgrades take effect immediately.

terms_articles.title: 5. Term, termination and refunds
terms_articles.body: The license lasts the paid period and extends with further payments. Cancellation is possible any time; the license runs until the end of the period with no pro-rata refund. The first 60 days are free.

terms_articles.title: 6. Trial period and unlicensed scope
terms_articles.body: 60 days free from first launch. After the subscription expires and a 14-day grace period, the paid accounting modules become unavailable; the free foundation remains fully operational and paid-module data is not deleted.

terms_articles.title: 7. Support and liability
terms_articles.body: Complaints are handled by e-mail, resolved within 30 days. The software does not replace the user's professional judgment. Consumers have the right to out-of-court dispute resolution via the Czech Trade Inspection.

terms_articles.title: 8. Personal data protection
terms_articles.body: Payment cards are processed by GoPay. The provider processes billing and contact details. The license mechanism transmits only technical data — no accounting or personal data.

updates.warning_secret_key_text: Set `cfg.app.secret_encryption_key` to a 32B base64 value to avoid TOTP setup failures due to misconfiguration.
updates.warning_webauthn_text: Check `cfg.app.url`: it must exactly match the origin in use and use HTTPS outside localhost.
updates.warning_app_url_missing: `cfg.app.url` is missing or blank. After setup, configure the application's exact HTTP(S) origin.
updates.warning_app_url_invalid_origin: `cfg.app.url` is not a valid HTTP(S) origin. Remove credentials, path, query and fragment; keep only the scheme, hostname and optional port.
updates.warning_app_url_webauthn_incompatible: The regular UI can work over HTTP or a LAN IP, but passkeys require an HTTPS DNS origin. `http://localhost` is the only exception.
updates.warning_app_url_hostname_conflict: The hostname from `cfg.app.url` is also stored as a company custom domain. Restore the former canonical address and disable and delete the custom domain, or configure another canonical hostname.
updates.how_docker_desc: Clicking 'Update' writes a flag file `storage/upgrade-requested.json`. A host-side watcher (`cmd/docker-update-watcher.(sh/ps1)` as systemd unit / Scheduled Task) picks it up and runs `cmd/docker-update.(sh/ps1)` — pulling the new image, restarting the stack, running migrations. The result and log appear on this page.
updates.how_docker_setup: If the watcher is not yet installed, follow § 19.4 of the manual (systemd unit on Linux, Scheduled Task on Windows). Without the watcher, run on the host manually after clicking 'Update':
updates.how_native_desc: Clicking "Update" downloads the production bundle from the GitHub release (`myucto-X.Y.Z.tar.gz`), verifies its SHA-256, deploys it over the installation and runs migrations — no Composer or Node needed on the host, the bundle ships vendor, web/dist and the manual prebuilt. Configuration (`cfg*.php`) and data (`storage/`, `private/`, `log/`) are never overwritten and replaced files are backed up to `storage/updates/<version>/backup/`.
updates.trigger_native_confirm: Update to {version}? The app will download the production bundle from the GitHub release, deploy it over this installation and run migrations. Configuration and data are left untouched and overwritten files are backed up. Having a fresh database backup is recommended.
updates.in_progress_native_desc: A background worker is downloading the bundle, deploying files and running migrations. Keep the installation running — progress refreshes automatically.
updates.step_preflight: Environment check — permissions, free disk space, PHP CLI, extensions.
updates.step_download: Downloading the production bundle from the GitHub release.
updates.step_verify: Verifying the SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded bundle.
updates.step_extract: Extracting the bundle into a staging directory and validating it.
updates.step_backup: Backing up files the update will overwrite.
updates.step_swap: Deploying the new files over the installation.
updates.step_finish: Finishing — writing the new version and cleaning up.

invoice.delete_issued_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED credit note {varsymbol}

A credit note is a valid accounting record — has a generated number and may be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice is NOT affected — it stays in its current status (typically cancelled)
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Continue?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT credit note {varsymbol}

This credit note was already emailed to the client. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Credit note is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation document is deleted TOO
• Number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

Really continue?
invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm_cn:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED credit note {varsymbol}

Deletes both the credit note AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both credit note {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• The original invoice stays unchanged
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?
invoice.delete_issued_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting ISSUED invoice {varsymbol}

This is a valid accounting record — has a generated invoice number, supplier and client snapshots, and may already be in your accountant's books.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• Cached PDF is deleted from disk
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited (invoice.force_deleted)

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE instead of deleting. Continue?
invoice.delete_sent_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting SENT invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice was already emailed to the client. They have it in their inbox / may have it in their accounting. Deleting will cause a mismatch between your records and what the client has.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database (incl. archived sent PDF)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Invoice number {varsymbol} becomes available for reuse
• Action is audited

Recommended: issue a CANCELLATION or CREDIT NOTE and explain to the client. Really continue?
invoice.delete_paid_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting PAID invoice {varsymbol}

This invoice is issued, sent, paid by the client, and the money is in your bank account. You're deleting an accounting record that corresponds to a real payment.

What happens:
• Invoice is permanently removed from the database
• If matched to a bank transaction, the transaction stays but loses its pair (find it again in unmatched)
• Any linked cancellation/credit-note is deleted TOO
• Revenue / KPIs on dashboard and client/project pages are recomputed
• Action is audited

Recommended: if accidentally marked paid, use Unpay (admin). If returning money, issue a CREDIT NOTE. Really delete?
invoice.delete_cancelled_confirm:
⚠️ WARNING — deleting CANCELLED invoice {varsymbol}

Deletes both the original invoice AND the linked cancellation document — both go in cascade.

What happens:
• Both invoice {varsymbol} AND its cancellation document are removed
• Their numbers become available
• If paid, bank transaction loses its pair
• Action is audited

This is irreversible. Continue?

invoice.payment_calendar_hint: A calendar is a tax document only with a schedule of payments for a predetermined period (§ 31 and § 31a of the Czech VAT Act). Individual documents are then not issued for each instalment.
invoice.payment_schedule_required: Without a payment schedule the calendar cannot be issued — it would not be a tax document.
invoice.payment_schedule_mismatch: The schedule total ({total}) does not match the document total ({invoice}). Issuing will be rejected.

invoice.simplified_document_hint: Up to CZK 10,000 including VAT; need not state the customer, the tax base or the tax amount (§ 30a).
invoice.simplified_blocked_limit: Above the {limit} limit — the document totals {total} including VAT. A simplified document cannot be issued (§ 30(1) VAT Act).
invoice.simplified_blocked_reverse_charge: A simplified document cannot be issued under the reverse charge regime (§ 30(2)) — the customer needs their VAT ID on the document, otherwise the supply drops out of the control statement.
invoice.simplified_blocked_eu: A simplified document cannot be issued for goods supplied to another member state (§ 30(2)) — without identifying the customer the supply cannot be reported in the EC sales list.
invoice.reverse_charge_io_hint: You invoice without VAT — the amounts shown are the tax base. The customer self-assesses VAT at their country's rate; no Czech VAT rate appears on the document. The supply is included in the EC Sales List.

rounding.label: Rounding
rounding.hint: The amount due after deducting advances is rounded to the nearest crown. The tax base and VAT stay unchanged. Round cash on delivery only when paid in cash.
rounding.unavailable: Rounding is available for invoices and credit notes in CZK except card payments.

invoice.prices_include_vat_hint: Item prices are gross (incl. VAT); VAT is calculated top-down so the total matches to the cent.
invoice.income_tax_exempt_hint: Not included in the income-tax base. VAT, control statement and turnover are unaffected.
invoice.income_tax_exempt_reason_placeholder: Reason for exemption (optional) — e.g. sale of vehicle § 4(1)(c), pass-through reinvoicing
invoice.auto_send_reminders_hint: When off, the cron will not send automatic reminders for this invoice (even if the supplier and client have them enabled). Manual send always works.

items_table.gross_edit_hint: You can overwrite with the gross (incl. VAT) amount — the net unit price is back-calculated.

warning.exchange_rate_cnb_deviation: The rate on the document ({used}) differs from the daily CNB rate ({cnb}) for the tax date by {diff} %. Please check the rate.
warning.credit_note_positive_total: The credit note has a positive total — in the VAT return and control statement the supply will be ADDED instead of deducted, while the journal reverses it. Flip the sign: negative quantity or negative price (one is enough).
warning.oss_document_contradiction: The document contradicts itself: some lines are in the OSS scheme and some stayed taxed domestically, so one invoice sits in two different returns. We saved it — a single invoice may legitimately do both — but the affected lines are flagged for manual review. Check the rates: if the domestic lines belong to OSS too, they must carry the rate of the country of consumption.
warning.oss_derived_notes: The document arrived through the API without OSS data, so we derived the scheme ourselves. Per-line details are in the API response (`_warning_meta.oss_derived_notes`); lines whose place of supply could not be determined are flagged for manual review.

analytics.explainer_body: Accounts are detected from statements and settings. Every bank account has its own 221xxx sub-account (221100, 221200 …) assigned automatically; you can override it, for example to map an account onto a sub-account you already keep in the chart. The journal, balance sheet and stocktaking then break cash down per account.
analytics.empty: No bank accounts detected yet — they appear after the first statement import.
analytics.suffix_invalid: The analytic code for account {account} must be 1–6 digits.
analytics.suffix_required: The sub-account of {account} cannot be removed — it can only be changed to a different number.
analytics.series_explainer: The document series numbers bank entries in the journal: the document number is the series plus the statement month (e.g. BCR-08 for the August statement). The number does not depend on whether the movement came from a daily statement, a monthly statement or a re-import. After changing the series, entries in open periods are renumbered; closed periods stay unchanged.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

no_supplier.title: Create your supplier
no_supplier.intro: Before you can issue invoices and add clients, you need to create a supplier — your company whose details appear on documents. You skipped this step during the initial setup.
no_supplier.non_admin: Please ask your administrator to create a supplier in Settings → Codebooks → Suppliers.

onboarding.title: Welcome to MyÚčto.cz
onboarding.intro: Before you issue the first invoice, walk through a few settings so your documents match your company, tax regime and bank from day one. Open each step from its link and tick it off yourself; the guide can be hidden any time.
onboarding.hidden_note: The first-run setup guide is hidden.
onboarding.progress_hint: Tick the steps off yourself as you finish them.
onboarding.progress_all_done: All done — you can hide the guide.
onboarding.footnote: The guide shows until there are documents in the system. Ticking a step is your own note — the application neither changes nor verifies anything by it.

company.title: Company details
company.text: Name, registration number, VAT ID, address and contact. They print on every invoice and feed the tax reports, so start here.

taxes.title: Tax and accounting
taxes.text: Taxpayer type, VAT registration and filing period, tax evidence or double-entry bookkeeping. Taxes and reports follow this setting.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.text: The accounts your payments arrive on. The account number prints on invoices and drives payment matching from statements.

branding.title: Invoice look and logo
branding.text: Upload a logo, pick an accent colour and a document footer. Multiple profiles are fine if you invoice under several brands.

suppliers.title: Add more companies
suppliers.text: Your licence covers several companies. Each keeps its own documents, number series and reports; you switch between them in the header.

numbering.title: Numbering and documents
numbering.text: Number formats for invoices, proformas and credit notes, plus default due date and currency. Set it before the first document.

series.title: Journal document series
series.text: Accounting document series for the journal — prefix and numbering separately for invoices, bank, cash and internal documents.

bank_email.title: Payment notices from e-mail
bank_email.text: Connect the mailbox your bank sends payment notices to. MyÚčto matches invoice payments from them, even between statements.

databox.title: Data box
databox.text: The connection for payroll filings sent through the data box: health insurer overviews and notifications and the employer's monthly report to the social security administration (JMHZ). Tax returns and statements go through EPO instead.

ai_extraction.title: AI document extraction
ai_extraction.text: Your own Anthropic Claude key, which the application uses to read line items out of a received PDF invoice when there is no ISDOC. You pay the provider directly per use; without a key, documents are entered by hand.

users.title: Users and roles
users.text: Invite colleagues or your accountant. The role decides what each of them sees and may change.

client.title: Add your first client
client.text: Just enter the registration number — the address and the rest are pulled from the public register.

invoice.title: Issue your first invoice
invoice.text: Pick a client, add items and you are done. Numbers, VAT and reports are calculated for you.

dashboard.empty_hint: The dashboard fills up as soon as there is data. Start with your first client and issue an invoice — the figures, charts and tax reports follow on their own.

work_reports.title: Work reports
work_reports.hint: (draft issued invoices in progress — fill in and issue)

dashboard.costs_trend_hint: Monthly costs in CZK · details in CRM

dashboard.cashflow_forecast_hint: From unpaid invoices with due date in the window.

gopay.title: GoPay
gopay.subtitle: Import monthly XML clearings or XLS/XLSX statements, automatically match payments, and post payouts and fees.
gopay.subtitle_tax_evidence: Import monthly XML clearings or XLS/XLSX statements, match payments to invoices and payouts to bank movements. Income, fees and payouts are kept in the cash journal.
gopay.tax_evidence_notice: Income arises on the day of the GoPay payment (invoice payment). The payout to the bank account is a transfer between your own funds in the cash journal, fees are a tax-deductible expense on the clearing date and GoPay has its own balance in the journal.

settings.title: Posting settings
settings.description: Select analytical accounts for funds held by GoPay, receivables, fees, funds in transit, and the destination bank account.
settings.description_tax_evidence: In tax records GoPay is not posted to accounts. Enter the account GoPay sends payouts from so they can be matched with the bank movement.
settings.gopay_account_help: A separate analytical account representing funds held by GoPay.
settings.date_tolerance: Bank payment date tolerance in days

import.title: Import clearing or statement
import.description: Upload the Clearing XML or the merchant account statement (XLS/XLSX) exported from GoPay. Each movement is matched to a document and posted, while the payout is found in bank statements. A statement contains the clearing payout and fee only in the period in which GoPay sent the money.
import.configure_first_tax_evidence: Save the GoPay payout account first.
import.permission_missing: You need bank import and posting permissions to import a clearing.
import.choose_file: Select an XML or XLS/XLSX file.
import.success: The GoPay clearing was imported and processed.
import.duplicate: The clearing had already been imported, so it was only processed again.

pdf.delete_confirm: Delete the attached GoPay PDF? The XML, clearing, and journal entries will remain unchanged.

pdf.deleted: The PDF was deleted from the GoPay clearing.

clearings.empty: No GoPay clearing or statement has been imported yet
clearings.empty_description: Save the settings, then upload your first monthly Clearing XML or XLS/XLSX statement.

pending.title: Awaiting clearing
pending.description: An invoice paid through GoPay is posted on the payment date: the receivable (311) is settled and GoPay holds the money (GoPay account). These payments have not been confirmed by any clearing yet. The next clearing import takes them over without another entry.
pending.empty: No GoPay payment is awaiting clearing.

pending.posted_with_issues: Newly posted {created}, posted {posted}, with an error {issues}. The reason is shown next to the payment.

process.review: The clearing was processed, but some items need review.

bank_accounts.email_notices_question: Do you want to load bank notices, PDF invoices and PDF statements from e-mail via IMAP? Click to expand the settings.

bank_accounts.imap_subtitle: Each bank may use its own mailbox. Polling uses a read-only fetch and does not mark messages as read.

bank_accounts.folders_none: Connection works but the server returned no folders.
bank_accounts.require_email_auth_hint: Only e-mails the receiving server marked in the Authentication-Results header as dkim/dmarc=pass with the correct domain are processed. Others are rejected.
bank_accounts.ingest_pdf_invoices_hint: Supplier invoices often land in the same mailbox as bank notices. When enabled, PDF attachments of every message are inspected and those that look like a document addressed to your company are filed into Purchases → Incoming documents. The check requires a document keyword (invoice, tax document, receipt…) and a match on your company ID, VAT ID or company name (min. 70%). Nothing is posted — you process the document from the queue.
bank_accounts.ingest_pdf_statements_hint: Banks without an API e-mail their statements as PDF (KB even after every movement, separately per account currency). When enabled, PDF attachments are tried as a bank statement — only one that belongs to a bank account of your company is imported, and payment matching runs right away. Daily statements are merged into the account's monthly statement and stay attached to it as its document.
bank_accounts.allow_forwarded_hint: If this mailbox receives forwarded notices (the sender is your own address, not the bank), the bank is detected from the e-mail body too. Leave off when notices arrive straight from the bank. Forwarding destroys the bank's original DKIM signature — only the forwarder below is verified, not the bank.
bank_accounts.forwarded_from_hint: Restrict who may forward notices — enter an address (jan{'@'}firma.cz) or a domain (firma.cz). Only notices whose sender matches are processed. Empty = any forwarder.
bank_accounts.email_auth_serv_id_hint: Enter your receiving server's identifier from the first Authentication-Results header. The server must remove forged authentication results. With verification enabled, messages are rejected if this identifier is empty.

settings.payment_qr_due_date_hint: This setting controls the DT field in the Czech QR Payment (SPAYD) format. The European EPC format does not carry a due date, and an embedded QR image imported from a supplier PDF cannot be changed.
settings.invoice_qr_include_due_date: Issued documents: include the due date
settings.invoice_qr_include_due_date_hint: Newly generated QR codes in PDFs, emails, reminders and public previews will contain the document's actual due date.
settings.purchase_invoice_qr_include_due_date: Received documents: include the due date
settings.purchase_invoice_qr_include_due_date_hin: A newly generated QR code on the received-document detail will contain the document's actual due date.
settings.email_profile_managed_by_staff_hint: This profile uses system sendmail or a cryptographic signature and can only be changed by the installation administrator.

branding_profiles.hint: Optional identities for different logos, names and contact details. The supplier's legal details remain unchanged.
branding_profiles.empty: No additional profile has been created yet.
branding_profiles.supplier_default_hint: The supplier details are used whenever the document, recurring template or customer does not select another profile. Edit them in the Email and PDF branding section.

branding_profiles.branding_enabled: Use custom branding in emails and PDFs
branding_profiles.module_enabled_hint: When enabled, invoices and emails can use different visual identities. When disabled, the original supplier settings are used.
branding_profiles.disable_confirm: Really turn off branding profiles? Invoices and emails will fall back to the original supplier settings. Profiles and their client assignments are kept and will apply again once you turn the module back on.
