settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Details and default behavior of the current company.

automation.title: Posting automation
automation.hint: Choose which operation types are disabled, suggested, or posted automatically.
automation.preset_off_hint: Automation does not create or post suggestions.
automation.preset_suggest_hint: Every recognized operation waits for your approval.
automation.preset_assisted_hint: Unambiguous payments and transfers post automatically; the rest remain suggestions.
automation.preset_full_hint: Deterministic operations post automatically; uncertain and AI suggestions always require approval.
automation.daily_limit_hint: Leave empty for no daily limit.

settings.is_identified_hint: A domestic non-payer with cross-border obligations: invoices for services to the EU are issued under reverse charge (Art. 196 of the VAT Directive) and included in the EC Sales List; VAT on received foreign supplies is self-assessed without the right to deduct (a VAT return of the “identified person” type is filed only for months when an obligation arose). Nothing changes domestically — you invoice without VAT.

vat_status.title: VAT payer status
vat_status.hint: VAT payer status changes are tracked over time — each change applies from its effective date (which may be in the future; it is applied on the effective day). Changes are saved immediately, without the Save button.
vat_status.form_date_locked_hint: The date of an existing row cannot be changed — delete the row and add a new one.
vat_status.delete_confirm_text: Really delete the change effective {date} ({state})? The status for earlier dates will revert to the previous history row.
vat_status.conflict_text: The effective date falls into a locked period or before already filed returns:
vat_status.conflict_hint: Continuing will save the change despite the listed conflicts and record your confirmation in the audit log. Already filed returns are not recalculated — any corrective/supplementary return is up to you.
vat_status.collision_locked_period: The date falls into a locked accounting period (status: {status}).
vat_status.collision_date_lock: Posting is locked until {date} (posting date lock).
vat_status.s6_banner_title: Turnover exceeded the VAT registration threshold (§ 6 VAT Act)
vat_status.s6_banner_text: Turnover of {turnover} exceeded the {limit} threshold — the company becomes a VAT payer by law on {date}. Record the change in the VAT status history so documents from that date are issued with VAT.
vat_status.s6_deadline_statutory: The registration application must be filed by {deadline} (§ 94(1) VAT Act — 10 working days from the day the turnover was exceeded).
vat_status.s6_deadline_informative: Informative date {deadline} (first day as a VAT payer). The application is due within 10 working days from the day the turnover was exceeded (§ 94(1) VAT Act) — the exact crossing day is not determined for the annual threshold.
vat_status.s79_prompt_registration: Registration effective {date} may entitle you to deduct VAT on business assets acquired before registration (§ 79). Items are recorded in the VAT corrections agenda.
vat_status.s79_prompt_deregistration: Deregistration effective {date} requires reducing the VAT deduction claimed on business assets (§ 79a). Items are recorded in the VAT corrections agenda.

income_tax_profile.title: Income tax return — taxpayer profile
income_tax_profile.hint: Facts the application cannot derive from your bookkeeping. Leave the defaults for an ordinary company or sole trader. A flagged situation stops the return — the application cannot compile it correctly and would rather not issue it than state something untrue about you.
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_hint: Code from the corporate income tax form (the "taxpayer type" item). The application can only compile a return for type 1 (other). Until you confirm the type, the return is built as if it were type 1.
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_0: holder of an investment incentive promise under § 35b
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_5: investment company incl. managed unit trusts
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_6: pension company or pension insurance institution
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_7: basic investment fund for part of the period (§ 20a)
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_8: investment incentive holder under a government resolution
income_tax_profile.taxpayer_code_9: holder of an investment incentive promise under § 35a
income_tax_profile.accounting_decree_hint: Which decree you follow when compiling the balance sheet and profit and loss statement. The application only supports decree 500/2002 Coll. for businesses.
income_tax_profile.entity_status_hint: Liquidation, insolvency and transformation all change the return type and the tax period. The application always files a return for the tax period, so file such a return manually in the EPO portal.
income_tax_profile.public_benefit: Public benefit taxpayer (§ 17a Income Taxes Act)
income_tax_profile.public_benefit_hint: Associations, foundations, institutes, churches, public universities and the like. Their tax base is split by type of activity and their statements follow a different decree.
income_tax_profile.investment_incentive: Investment incentive promise holder (§ 35a/§ 35b Income Taxes Act)
income_tax_profile.investment_incentive_hint: The investment incentive tax credit uses a separate calculation and its conditions are tracked for years outside the books.
income_tax_profile.atad_cfc: Subject to ATAD / CFC rules (§ 23e-23h, § 38fa Income Taxes Act)
income_tax_profile.atad_cfc_hint: Limitation of excessive borrowing costs or inclusion of controlled foreign company income. Applies to multinational groups.
income_tax_profile.cooperating_person: I split income with a cooperating person (§ 13 Income Taxes Act)
income_tax_profile.cooperating_person_hint: The application does not track the link between taxpayers, so the §7 partial base would come out higher than the one that belongs to you.
income_tax_profile.foreign_income_credit: Foreign income with a tax credit (§ 38f Income Taxes Act)
income_tax_profile.foreign_income_credit_hint: The credit for tax paid abroad is computed in Annex 3 country by country; the application keeps no per-country records.

tax_representation.title: Representation and signatory
tax_representation.hint: If filings are submitted for the company by someone other than its director or the sole trader (tax advisor, attorney, accounting firm with a power of attorney, legal guardian…), record them here. They appear as the signatory in the VAT return, control statement, recapitulative statement and the corporate/personal income tax return. Changes are tracked over time and saved immediately, without the Save button.
tax_representation.empty: No representation history — filings are signed by the company itself.
tax_representation.form_ev_number: Registration number (Chamber of Tax Advisors / Bar)
tax_representation.delete_confirm_text: Really delete the change effective {date}? The status for earlier dates will revert to the previous history row.
tax_representation.identity_hint: EPO requires a registration number or a date of birth for a natural-person representative. A tax advisor or attorney (4b) states the registration number.
tax_representation.code_hint_advisor: Tax advisor or attorney: the income tax return states that it is filed by a tax advisor, and the filing deadline is extended under Section 136(2) of the Tax Code.
tax_representation.code_hint_other: The representative signs filings but is not a tax advisor: the filing deadline is not extended and “filed by a tax advisor” stays No.
tax_representation.signer_title: Person signing for the representing entity
tax_representation.signer_hint: The natural person who signs filings on behalf of the representing entity. Filed as the authorised person.

code.4c: legal entity providing tax advisory services
code.6a: heir after the end of probate proceedings
code.6b: representative of the heir after probate
code.7a: legal successor of a legal entity
code.7b: representative of the legal successor of a legal entity

settings.commercial_register_none_fo: A sole proprietor has no commercial register entry.

settings.default_prices_include_vat_hint: Pre-checks the “Item prices include VAT” mode on new invoices (B2C/receipts). Can be overridden per invoice.

settings.reminder_days_after_due_hint: The cron sends the first reminder once the invoice is this many days past due. Applies to automatic reminders only; manual send always works.

self_copy.hint: Messages to clients (documents, reminders, report approvals) are also copied to {email} — an audit trail of your own mail. “Per configuration” inherits the global cfg.php setting.
self_copy.approvals_note: The report approvals choice applies to both the approval request and approval reminders.

settings.auto_generate_recurring_hint: When off, the cron skips all recurring invoice templates for this supplier. Manual "Generate now" still works.
settings.embed_isdoc: Embed ISDOC XML in invoice PDFs
settings.embed_isdoc_hint: Machine-readable invoice data (ISDOC 6.0.2) is attached to the PDF. Czech accounting software (Pohoda, Money S3, …) extracts it automatically; Adobe Reader / Foxit show a paperclip icon below the variable symbol. Only applies to CZK invoices with an assigned variable symbol.
settings.purchase_import_received_at: Date received on imported purchase documents
settings.purchase_import_received_at_document: Date from the document (issue date) — recommended
settings.purchase_import_received_at_hint: Applies to every import format for received documents: AI import from PDF, ISDOC, ISDOCX, PDF/A-3, Pohoda XML, iDoklad, Fakturoid and the scan inbox. The document option takes the issue date, falling back to the tax point when the document carries none; a future date is never used. If the document carries no readable date at all, the import day remains and the document is flagged. This choice does not affect the VAT deduction period — for an imported document that is driven by the tax point and the issue date (§ 73) until you enter the date received manually.
settings.proforma_payment_document: After a proforma is paid, issue
settings.proforma_payment_document_final: A final invoice once the advance is paid in full
settings.proforma_payment_document_tax: Always a tax document for the payment received (recommended)

settings.proforma_payment_document_hint: A tax document for the payment received is the default because it is correct unconditionally: the duty to declare VAT arises on the day the payment is received, and so does the duty to issue a document. Choose the final invoice only when the supply happens on payment (fast sales, same-day shipping or service) — otherwise the document claims a supply that has not happened and makes the customer's VAT deduction harder to prove. The "Nothing" option creates no draft; paid advances without a document are then listed in the daily tasks, because the document is due within 15 days.

accounting_enabled.title: Keep accounting records

accounting_enabled.hint: Enables the journal, general ledger, statements, assets and year-end closing — and in tax evidence mode the cash journal and the receivables/payables overview. Turning it off hides them from the menu; invoicing, clients, bank, VAT returns and control statements keep working. The number of licensed companies and users does not change with this switch.

payroll_enabled.label: Run payroll

Enabling it seeds the chart of accounts, but historical documents (invoices, cash) from the tax-evidence era are NOT posted automatically — without a manual backfill, reports (trial balance, balance sheet) silently exclude the past.
settings.accounting_mode_switch_confirm: Switching to double-entry accounting will seed the chart of accounts, but {total} historical documents (cash: {cash}, sales invoices: {invoices}, purchase invoices: {purchase_invoices}) will remain WITHOUT a journal entry. Ask an administrator to run the backfill, otherwise reports (trial balance, balance sheet, accounts 211/311/321) won't include the past. Continue switching?

settings.auto_post_purchases_hint: Post a received invoice to the journal right after it is received. A posting error won't block it — you post the invoice manually.
settings.vat_period_hint: Legal entities file the VAT control statement monthly. Sole traders who are quarterly VAT payers may file it quarterly, by the same deadline as the VAT return.
settings.flat_tax_hint: Non-VAT payers only (§ 7a Income Tax Act). The Sales page shows how close you are to the band's income limit.
settings.financial_office_hint: e.g. 451 = Prague 1. Find on tax portal.

Once Payroll is on, they are carried over to Payroll → Employer settings and disappear from here once Payroll holds them.

net_turnover.title: Net turnover: business-model revenue
net_turnover.hint: For periods from 1 January 2024, net turnover is revenue from the sale of products, goods and services (§ 1a(2) of the Accounting Act, § 35 of Decree 500/2002 Coll.), by default income statement rows I. and II. If other revenue belongs to the company's business model, such as proceeds from selling assets for a lessor or income from shares for a holding company, tick its rows. This is the entity's judgement; disclose it in the notes to the financial statements.
net_turnover.suggestion_title: Based on the registered CZ-NACE activity
net_turnover.suggestion_binding: The suggestion is an aid, not a decision. Check it against what the company actually does.

reason.holding: Holding or fund company: income from shares and from other long-term financial assets is ordinary business-model revenue here, not an exceptional event.
reason.lending: Lending or finance leasing: interest is revenue from the main activity, even though the income statement reports it under financial results.
reason.securities_own_account: Trading securities on own account: the income is reported as other financial income, yet it belongs to the business model.
reason.other_financial: Other financial activity: both interest and other financial income may be business-model revenue. Pick according to what the company actually does.
reason.rental: Letting and management of real estate: selling a let property is the end of a lessor’s ordinary cycle. Nothing is suggested for the statement by function - it has no separate row for proceeds from selling assets, and the whole Other operating income row would overstate turnover.
reason.operating_lease: Renting and leasing of tangible goods: selling a retired leased item belongs to the model. Nothing is suggested for the statement by function - it has no separate row for proceeds from selling assets.

net_turnover.show_rows_without_amount: Show rows with no turnover as well

oss_rates.delete_confirm: Really delete the custom rate {rate} % for {country}?

public_holidays.hint: Czech public holidays under Act No. 245/2000 Coll. A holiday shifts every filing deadline under § 33(4) of the Tax Code — VAT returns, control and recapitulative statements, self-employed insurance summaries, payroll levies. A row is not a date but a rule: either a fixed day of the year, or an offset from Easter Sunday.

public_holidays.name: Name
public_holidays.new_hint: Enter a fixed holiday as a day of the year in MM-DD format. Enter a movable holiday as an offset from Easter Sunday (Good Friday −2, Easter Monday +1) — the Easter date is computed.
public_holidays.delete_confirm: Really delete the holiday {name}? This changes filing deadlines for every company in the instance.

system_descriptions.superadmin: A predefined system role with fixed permissions. It has full access to every company and is the only role that manages users, roles, licensing, and system-wide settings.
system_descriptions.admin: A predefined role with fixed permissions. It can do everything in assigned companies and work with multiple companies assigned by a superadmin. It cannot change system-wide items in the System menu.
system_descriptions.admin_plus: A predefined role with fixed permissions. It has the same permissions as Admin and can also create a company under System → Companies; it automatically receives Admin permissions for that company.

cron_jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
cron_jobs.subtitle: What should run automatically and when it last ran. The app cannot read crontab / Task Scheduler directly — every cron script writes its own heartbeat, and if the last successful run is missing or too old, you'll see a warning.
cron_jobs.tooltip_overdue: Last successful run is older than {hours} h.
cron_jobs.tooltip_failing: The last run ended with an error.
cron_jobs.tooltip_never_ran: Script never ran — most likely it isn't scheduled in crontab / Task Scheduler.
cron_jobs.tooltip_idle: This job only runs when there is work to do, and right now there isn't — that's why the last run is ageing. {script} is what proves scheduling still works.
cron_jobs.tooltip_pending: The installation is new and this job hasn't had a full period ({hours} h) yet — not a problem for now.
cron_jobs.tooltip_disabled: The installation's configuration (cron.disabled_jobs) disabled this job — it won't run until the admin/operator re-enables it. Not a malfunction.
cron_jobs.setup_hint: Cron setup: see {link} in the manual.
cron_jobs.all_ok: All scheduled jobs are running on time.
cron_jobs.setup_paths_hint: this server's paths — ready to copy
cron_jobs.setup_intro_linux: Add to the crontab of a user allowed to write into log/ and storage/. The .sh wrappers locate the project root themselves and redirect output to a daily log.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_windows: Run from an elevated command prompt. Change /ru SYSTEM if the tasks must run under a service account with access to network drives.
cron_jobs.setup_intro_docker: In the Docker image cron is generated from the catalog at build time — nothing is scheduled by hand, only verified.
cron_jobs.setup_foreign_platform: This server runs on a different platform — the paths below are examples, adjust them for the target machine.
cron_jobs.setup_note: Frequencies come from the job catalog (CronCatalog) — the same ones shown on the cards above. After scheduling, verify that the log directory is being written to and watch the status on this page.
cron_jobs.run_now_confirm: Really run script {script} now? It will run in the background and the result will appear in the table when it finishes.
cron_jobs.run_now_started: Script {script} has been started in the background.
cron_jobs.mode_subtitle: Controls who launches the jobs. What the individual jobs do does not change — only how many entries have to be scheduled.
cron_jobs.mode_managed: Job scheduling is run by us — the mode cannot be switched on a managed installation. If jobs stop running, please contact support.
cron_jobs.mode_individual_desc: Every job is its own crontab / Task Scheduler entry ({count} entries). Transparent and debuggable one job at a time — a failure of one does not affect the others.
cron_jobs.mode_dispatcher_desc: A single entry is scheduled ({script}, every minute) that works out what is due, skips jobs with nothing to do and launches the rest as separate processes. One entry instead of {count} — the trade-off is that its failure stops every job.
cron_jobs.mode_confirm: Switch scheduling mode to “{mode}”? Switching alone does not change the schedule — the crontab / Task Scheduler has to be regenerated (restart the container on Docker).
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_title: The job scheduler is not running
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_dispatcher_down: The {script} scheduler has stopped running, so no job runs. Check that it is scheduled every minute and that its log does not end with an error; the stale jobs in the table are only the consequence.
cron_jobs.scheduler_down_nothing_runs: No job ran within its interval, so cron on the server is not running. Check the cron service or Task Scheduler; the stale jobs in the table are only the consequence.
cron_jobs.inactive_hint: These jobs have nothing to do on this installation, so their runs are not watched. Once they get work, they appear in the table.

submissions.title: EPO filing & archive
submissions.subtitle: Hand generated XML over to the EPO form, complete the filing on the Financial Administration portal, and store the confirmation and readable copy in an evidence archive.
submissions.empty: No records match the filter. The first XML appears here after a tax report is generated.
submissions.payroll_subtitle: The statement of tax on employment income (DPZVD6) and of withholding tax (DPSVD2) is one filing for the whole company. It is built in Payroll → Overview; here you open it in EPO or sign it with a certificate and send it, just like tax returns.
submissions.payroll_empty_hint: A statement appears here once you build it in Payroll → Overview → Annual tax statement.
submissions.channels_hint: EPO carries tax submissions and the payroll advance and withholding tax reconciliations; it returns a confirmation with a submission number that proves the filing. The other payroll submissions — health insurer overviews and notifications and the monthly ČSSZ report (JMHZ) — go through the data box in Payroll → Data box and return only a delivery note, not a numbered confirmation.
submissions.delete_confirm: Delete this XML snapshot? Proof of an actually filed submission cannot be deleted.
submissions.settings_hint: Choose root folders in Documents. MyÚčto creates the year, period and form type below them automatically.
submissions.vat_root_hint: Root for VAT, control, recapitulative and OSS returns.
submissions.income_root_hint: Root for personal and corporate income tax returns.
submissions.assisted_title: Assisted filing: MyÚčto prepares, the user submits
submissions.assisted_hint: MyÚčto sends the exact archived XML to the supported EPO form. You complete checks, authentication and final submission on the portal, then drop the P7S confirmation and optional PDF copy back here.
submissions.test_mode_hint: The test=1 parameter requires a ZAREP-signed submission, so it is not used in this unsigned flow. Invalid XSD is blocked locally and the EPO form shows further problems before submission.
submissions.search_placeholder: Search form, period, filing number or hash…
submissions.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the new window. Use Continue to EPO in the detail panel.
submissions.handoff_created: The EPO form is ready and opened in a new window. You can return to it for about 20 minutes, as long as the underlying data does not change.
submissions.handoff_window: The link is single-use — the portal consumes it the first time it is opened. It is also usable only for about 20 minutes after creation and only while the underlying data stays unchanged. The portal never tells us how long the link really lives.
submissions.handoff_stale_title: The link is no longer offered
submissions.handoff_stale_hint: The link has already been opened (it is single-use and the portal then reports that the filing does not exist), or the roughly 20-minute window has passed, or the XML has been recalculated in the meantime. If you did not finish the filing, create a new link — it is cheap and always works.
submissions.moss_oss_title: The OSS return is filed in the MOSS/OSS application
submissions.moss_oss_hint: It cannot be filed through the general EPO route — neither by handing the XML over to the web form nor by a direct ZAREP filing: the portal does recognise the document, but rejects it because you must be signed in to the MOSS/OSS application. That is why no filing route is offered here. Download the XML and upload it in the MOSS/OSS application on the Czech tax portal (a separate item in the top bar next to EPO), which requires its own sign-in.
submissions.preflight_failed: The XML cannot be handed to EPO until it passes XSD validation
submissions.upload_hint: Drop the P7S confirmation and PDF copy here. MyÚčto creates the target folder first, stores the exact source XML in it and links every file to this submission.
submissions.drop_files: Drop files here or click to select
submissions.upload_partial: Some files could not be uploaded: {count}.
submissions.marked_submitted: The snapshot was manually marked as submitted.
submissions.vat_clearing_skipped: Filing recorded, but the VAT clearing entry (343) was not posted: {reason}. The tax difference is missing from the ledger — check the period lock and run the clearing again.
submissions.state_password_hint: Together with the reference number it retrieves the filing and its copy on the tax portal.
submissions.state_password_reveal_note: EPO issued this password in the receipt. Revealing it requires verification and is recorded in the audit log.
submissions.no_artifacts: No files stored yet. The source XML is saved automatically on the first handoff or upload.
submissions.artifact_submission_signer_cert: Certificate used to sign the filing

submissions.verify_problem_format: The file does not contain a recognized EPO confirmation structure.
submissions.verify_problem_form: The confirmation belongs to a different form type.

submissions.prefilled_from_pdf: Pre-filled from the PDF printout. That is extracted text, not signed proof — verify the values against the receipt.

submissions.no_attempts: The XML has not yet been handed to EPO.
submissions.manual_fallback_hint: Use this after reviewing the P7S or another receipt. The system checks available technical properties, but does not change filing status automatically without a verified EPO seal allowlist.
submissions.direct_title: Direct EPO API: full test first, deliberate submission second
submissions.direct_hint: MyÚčto signs the immutable XML snapshot with your qualified certificate, sends it with test=1 and displays every EPO validation message. Live submission is enabled only after a successful test.
submissions.direct_hint_sandbox: MyÚčto exclusively uses the MOJE daně sandbox. It first validates with test=1 and then enables a complete sandbox filing with no effect on production.
submissions.direct_hint_unknown: The EPO environment could not be determined safely. Submission actions are disabled until the configuration can be loaded.
submissions.direct_reason_readonly: You are not allowed to file for this company. Ask for a role with write permission.
submissions.direct_reason_moss_oss: An OSS return cannot be filed through the direct EPO API. Download the XML and upload it in the MOSS/OSS application on the tax portal.
submissions.direct_reason_no_credential: No signing certificate is selected. Upload and enable a ZAREP certificate for this company first.
submissions.direct_reason_validation: The XML failed local XSD validation. Fix the data and regenerate the snapshot first.
submissions.direct_reason_already_submitted: This XML snapshot has already been filed. Submitting again would create a duplicate.
submissions.direct_reason_unresolved: A previous direct attempt has an unresolved outcome. Refresh or resolve its status in the “…” menu first.
submissions.direct_reason_test_missing: Run “Check on EPO” first — live submission unlocks only after a successful test.
submissions.direct_reason_test_required: The latest direct attempt is in state “{status}”. Live submission unlocks only after a successful EPO test.
submissions.direct_reason_handoff_active: After the successful test you started an assisted EPO handoff (state “{status}”, link valid until {until}). Finish it or wait for the link to expire — otherwise you risk filing twice.
submissions.assisted_alternative: Assisted opening always uses the live interactive MOJE daně form and does not submit anything by itself. Manual receipt upload remains a separate alternative.
submissions.epo_test_environment_title: Direct EPO is using the sandbox environment
submissions.epo_test_environment_hint: Signed direct operations use zkus.mojedane.gov.cz and do not mark the snapshot as a real filing. Assisted opening uses the live interactive form but does not submit anything by itself.
submissions.epo_environment_unknown_title: The EPO environment cannot be verified
submissions.epo_environment_unknown_hint: Live filing is therefore not shown as available. Refresh the page or check access to the EPO configuration.
submissions.recover_confirmation_title: Recover filing from an EPO confirmation
submissions.recover_confirmation_hint: Upload the original P7S/P7M receipt. The application verifies the EPO signature, trusted chain and its binding to the exact submitted CMS package.
submissions.confirmation_recovered: The confirmation was verified and the filing state was completed.
submissions.delete_confirm_unresolved: This snapshot has an EPO handoff whose outcome the application cannot know — it has no way to tell whether you filed it in the portal. If you did not file it, you can delete it. The deletion is recorded in the audit trail.
submissions.delete_blocked_submitted: The snapshot is marked as filed — it is evidence for the tax authority and cannot be deleted.
submissions.delete_blocked_delivered: EPO provably accepted the filing (confirmed attempt, filing number or receipt). Legal evidence of a filing must not be deleted.
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_hint: Use only when the attempt has no filing number or status password and you verified directly in EPO that no filing was created.
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_warning: Releasing the attempt enables another live submission of the same XML. An incorrect confirmation may cause a duplicate tax filing.
submissions.resolution_note: How and where you verified that no filing was created
submissions.resolve_not_submitted_check: I confirm that I checked directly in EPO and the filing was not received.
submissions.attempt_released: The attempt was audit-closed as not received.
submissions.direct_panel_hint: The test checks the signature, structure and business rules without filing anything. A separate password confirmation performs the legally effective submission.
submissions.direct_panel_hint_sandbox: The test=1 check validates the signature, structure and content. Password confirmation then sends the same XML only to the sandbox.
submissions.direct_panel_hint_unknown: The EPO environment is not verified, so testing and submission are temporarily disabled.
submissions.no_enabled_certificate: None of your valid signing certificates is enabled for this company. Add one or enable an existing certificate.
submissions.credentials_hint: The certificate belongs to the signed-in user and can be deliberately enabled for multiple managed companies.
submissions.credentials_security: The P12/PFX and its password are stored only in encrypted form under a dedicated application key. The private key is never returned to the browser or written to logs.
submissions.step_up_hint: Your password and TOTP, when enabled, are required to store, enable or delete a certificate.
submissions.step_up_passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use TOTP if configured for the account.
submissions.no_certificates: You have no EPO certificate stored yet.
submissions.ik_mpsv_warning: IK MPSV could not be recognized in this certificate. Signing may work, but EPO may not automatically link the signer; verify the certificate details.
submissions.upload_certificate_hint: Use a personal qualified electronic-signature certificate, not an ordinary SSL or commercial certificate.
submissions.upload_moved_hint: Certificates are uploaded in one place — System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures. EPO, PDF signing, S/MIME and payroll submissions all read them from there. Here you only pick which of them this company may use.
submissions.credential_uploaded: The certificate was stored securely and enabled for this company.
submissions.credential_deleted: The certificate was removed from the active vault.
submissions.credential_delete_confirm: Remove this certificate from the active vault for every company? Historical attempts and its fingerprint remain preserved.
submissions.credential_used_by_profiles: The certificate cannot be deleted because an active signing profile uses it.
submissions.credential_used_by_company_profiles: The certificate cannot be removed from this company because one of its active signing profiles uses it.
submissions.direct_test_passed: The EPO test passed. Live submission is now available.
submissions.direct_test_passed_sandbox: The EPO test passed. A complete sandbox filing is now available.
submissions.direct_test_failed: EPO found issues. Review the displayed report.
submissions.direct_processing: EPO accepted a large filing for processing. Refresh its status later.
submissions.direct_submitted: The filing was accepted and its P7S confirmation was archived.
submissions.direct_sandbox_submitted: The sandbox filing was accepted and its confirmation archived. No real tax filing was created.
submissions.status_refreshed: The filing status was loaded from EPO and stored.
submissions.direct_test_reauth_hint: Using your personal private key requires a fresh identity verification.
submissions.direct_test_signature_warning: An electronically signed package will be created solely for the EPO test endpoint. The test does not file the return and the package will not be available for download.
submissions.submit_direct_hint: The exact XML snapshot that just passed EPO validation will be submitted.

submissions.submit_direct_sandbox_hint: The same validated XML snapshot will be sent to zkus.mojedane.gov.cz and the result fully archived.
submissions.submit_direct_sandbox_warning: This is only the Financial Administration sandbox. The result is not a legally effective tax filing and the local snapshot remains unfiled.

cnb_audit.title: FX rate audit vs. CNB
cnb_audit.subtitle: Foreign-currency documents where the accounting rate on the document deviates from the daily CNB rate for the relevant day beyond the chosen threshold. The report never changes rates — it only warns.
cnb_audit.no_data: No document exceeds the deviation threshold — rates match.
cnb_audit.fixed_mode: The company uses a fixed rate (§24/7) — deviation from CNB is intentional and lawful, the audit is skipped.
cnb_audit.note: Impact = total amount × (CNB rate − rate on document). This is the accounting conversion (563/663); it does not affect the CZK VAT amount on the document (§73/6).

series_completeness.title: Numbering series completeness
series_completeness.subtitle: A gap in the issued document numbering series is an audit red flag for the tax authority. The report only reports — it never fixes anything.
series_completeness.no_series: No issued-document numbering series are configured for the selected year, or none of them have any documents.
series_completeness.no_gaps: No gaps — the numbering series is complete.
series_completeness.missing_truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} missing numbers. A range this large usually means a manually entered or import-mangled number pushed the series up — check the highest document in the period.
series_completeness.inferred_note: Inferred from imported document numbers outside the configured templates. Only gaps between observed numbers are checked; verify that the documents belong to one series.
series_completeness.shared_note: Invoices and credit notes share one series — numbers are assessed together.

kh_evidence.submitted_title: Document list from the filed control statement
kh_evidence.submitted_subtitle: Documents from the filed control statement compared with current data.
kh_evidence.source_submitted: Source: filed control statement (filed {date}, type: {variant}). The Current columns show today's state of the document.
kh_evidence.has_differences: Current data differ from the filed statement. Consider whether a follow-up control statement is needed.
kh_evidence.no_differences: Current data match the filed statement.
kh_evidence.aggregate_note: Sections A.5 and B.3 are aggregated in the statement and are compared as one aggregated line.
kh_evidence.title: Control statement document list

section_label.A1: Supplies made under the domestic reverse charge
section_label.A2: Supplies received where the recipient declares the tax
section_label.B1: Supplies received under the domestic reverse charge

kh_evidence.no_data: There are no documents for the selected period and section.
kh_evidence.source_current: Source: current data. Documents are assigned by the same logic that builds the control statement; drafts are not included.
kh_evidence.rule_note: The CZK 10,000 limit applies to the document total including VAT, not to individual items.
kh_evidence.whole_crowns: Rounded to whole CZK (as in the VAT return): base {base}, VAT {vat}.
kh_evidence.rounding_difference: The aggregated section line is computed from unrounded document amounts and differs from the sum of rows by CZK {amount}.

dph_book.title: VAT ledger
dph_book.subtitle: Internal VAT journal grouped by VAT return rows. Not an official tax submission.

col.claim_date_hint: The date that placed this received document into the current period. Not shown for supplied transactions or § 74b corrections.

claim_hint.tax_date: The deduction period follows the tax point — the document was issued and received no later than that day.
claim_hint.issue_date: The deduction period follows the issue date: input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act), and you cannot hold it before it was issued. An earlier tax point therefore cannot pull the deduction into its own month.
claim_hint.received_at: The deduction period follows the date the document was received: input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act). If the date received is wrong, correct it on the document.

dph_book.claim_period_note: Received documents are placed by their deduction period (§ 73(1)(a) of the Czech VAT Act): input VAT can be claimed no earlier than the period in which you hold the document. A document with a tax point at the end of a month but issued or received in the next month therefore belongs to that next month.
dph_book.claim_shift_legend: * The deduction period was shifted by the date the document was received. Check it matches the day you actually got the document — for AI-extracted documents it is pre-filled with the processing date.
dph_book.note_d_marker: (If the VAT amount is marked with code D, VAT is valued at a different exchange rate than the base accounting rate.)
dph_book.no_data: No entries in the VAT ledger for the selected period.
dph_book.disclaimer_body: The VAT ledger is an internal accounting journal grouping issued and received documents by VAT return rows. It includes drafts — visually distinguished in the table. It is NOT an official tax submission.

vatCorrections.title: One-off VAT corrections
vatCorrections.subtitle: § 43 correction of the tax amount · § 79 / § 79a deduction on registration and deregistration

s43.explainer_body: § 42 corrects the tax BASE (credit note, discount) and belongs to the period in which the corrective document was DELIVERED — forwards. § 43 corrects the tax AMOUNT (wrong rate, miscalculation) and belongs BACK in the period of the ORIGINAL supply; an amended return is filed. The rate applicable to the original supply is used, not the current one. After the assessment period expires (usually 3 years from the end of the period) no correction is possible.
s43.empty: No § 43 correction recorded for the selected year.
s43.form_title: Correction of the tax amount (§ 43 VAT Act)
s43.form_hint: Enter the period of the ORIGINAL supply. The delivery date only determines the earliest date the correction could be made.
s43.required: Fill in the document, delivery date and reason.

s79.explainer_body: The deduction entitlement on registration is reported POSITIVELY in the return for the period containing the day the person became a payer — it covers assets acquired within the preceding 12 months that the company still holds on that day. The reduction on deregistration is reported NEGATIVELY in the last period of registration: inventory returns the whole deduction, a fixed asset only the proportional part for the years remaining in the adjustment period.
s79.empty: No § 79 item recorded for the selected year.
s79.form_title: Deduction on registration / its reduction (§ 79, § 79a VAT Act)
s79.form_hint: Effective date = the day the person became a payer, or the day of deregistration. It determines the period in which the figure is reported.
s79.required: Fill in the asset description and both dates.

s46.title: Bad debts (§ 46)
s46.subtitle: § 46 to § 46g VAT Act — creditor's tax base correction for bad debts and restoration after payment
s46.no_candidates_filtered: No candidates overdue longer than {days} days ({count} more hidden by the filter).
s46.explainer_title: A working list, not an entitlement
s46.explainer_body: The candidate list shows unpaid issued documents with output VAT past due — it does not imply an entitlement to a correction. The legal ground (insolvency, execution, debtor's death, liquidation, small receivable up to CZK 10,000 after 6 months) and delivery of the corrective tax document to the debtor are substantiated by the accountant when recording the correction. The correction is reported in the VAT return (lines 1/2 negative, line 33) and control statement (A.4) for the delivery period. Restoration after payment (§ 46e) is computed automatically from recorded payments. Sensitive tax output — verify with a tax advisor before filing.
s46.candidates_hint: Unpaid domestic issued invoices with output VAT past due (excluding reverse charge).
s46.no_candidates: No unpaid overdue receivables as of the given date.
s46.restorations_hint: Previously corrected receivables that were (partially) paid — the tax must be increased back in the same proportion.
s46.no_restorations: No restorations to record for the selected period.
s46.restore_confirm: Record {count} tax restorations after payment for the selected period? They will be reported in the return and control statement of that period.
s46.delivered_on: Date of delivery of the corrective document to the debtor
s46.delivered_on_hint: § 46f — determines the taxable period in which the correction is reported.

vatCoefficient.title: Input VAT reduction coefficient (§ 76)
vatCoefficient.subtitle: § 76 VAT Act — reduced deduction entitlement for supplies partly used for exempt supplies without deduction entitlement
vatCoefficient.explainer_body: The provisional coefficient (§ 76(6)) is applied to line 52 of the VAT return in every taxable period of the year — when not set, last year's settlement coefficient carries forward. The settlement coefficient (§ 76(7)) is computed from the actual full-year data and the settlement is reported in the return for the last taxable period of the year. Settlement is always an explicit action — it never runs on its own.
vatCoefficient.provisional_hint: Applied to the reduced deduction (line 52) during the year. Whole percentage 0–100.
vatCoefficient.provisional_invalid: The coefficient must be a number 0–100 %.
vatCoefficient.resolved_none: none — the deduction is not reduced
vatCoefficient.carried_forward: carried forward from last year's settlement
vatCoefficient.final_hint: Computed from the actual supplies of the whole year (numerator = supplies with deduction entitlement, denominator = all supplies).
vatCoefficient.not_settled: The annual settlement for this year has not been performed yet.
vatCoefficient.action_settle_hint: Computes the settlement coefficient from the actual year data and stores it (admin only). Belongs in the return for the last taxable period of the year.
vatCoefficient.settle_confirm: Perform the annual coefficient settlement for {year}? The settlement coefficient will be computed from actual data and stored — it is reported in the return for the last taxable period of the year.

relatedParties.title: Related parties and arm's-length prices
relatedParties.subtitle: § 36a VAT Act and § 23(7) Income Tax Act — related-party transactions and tax base adjustment
relatedParties.explainer_title: What the system claims and what it does not
relatedParties.explainer_body: A deviation is computed only where a comparison exists — that is, when the same item was also sold to unrelated parties; the median is used so a one-off clearance sale does not skew the result. Where no comparison exists, the system does NOT know the arm's-length price and does not claim one: documenting it is up to the accountant. The system never adjusts the tax base on its own — § 23(7) requires it only when the difference is not satisfactorily documented.
relatedParties.deviations_hint: Price charged to a related party against the median price of the same item for unrelated parties.
relatedParties.transactions_hint: Yearly overview. No arm's-length price is claimed here — documenting it is up to the accountant.
relatedParties.adjustments_hint: Recorded per counterparty and per reason; that is exactly how it is proven during an audit.
relatedParties.no_transactions: No related-party transactions in the selected year.
relatedParties.net_delta: Net effect on the tax base
relatedParties.action_adjust_hint: Tax base adjustment under § 23(7) — difference against prices between unrelated parties.
relatedParties.adjustment_form_hint: State how the difference is documented, or why it is not — without it the adjustment cannot be defended during an audit.
relatedParties.reason_placeholder: E.g. difference not documented; or: price per expert appraisal dated …
relatedParties.delete_confirm: Really delete this tax base adjustment?

s74b.title: VAT deduction correction on unpaid liabilities (§74b)
s74b.subtitle: Preview of the correction of claimed input VAT on liabilities long overdue — debtor's view.
s74b.record_hint: Records the §74b corrections for the period. This is not a journal posting.
s74b.record_confirm: Record the §74b corrections for the selected period? This is a deliberate state record, not a journal posting - the actual journal entry is made separately.
s74b.record_done: Recorded {count} corrections for the period into the ledger.
s74b.explainer_body: "Preview" is a non-binding calculation of §74b corrections as of the reference date - it changes nothing. "Record period" writes the current correction state into the records for the follow-up VAT return. It is neither a journal posting nor a submission to the tax office.
s74b.no_data: No liabilities eligible for §74b deduction correction in the selected period.
s74b.kh_zdph_44_hint: Enters the control statement (§44 section / return line 44).
s74b.dphdp3_note: The delta feeds VAT return lines 40/41 (base and tax, signed by the movement) and, for information, line 34.

clearing.title: Internal VAT clearing document
clearing.trigger_hint: Transfers the period's VAT from 343.100/343.200 to the settlement account 343.900. Created automatically when the VAT return is FILED — run it here manually for periods whose return is not filed from the app.
clearing.stale_hint: The document was posted at {posted}, but today's data gives {fresh} — a document was added or changed in the period after it was cleared. Recompute so the general ledger shows the real liability.
clearing.missing_hint: The period still has an untransferred balance on the VAT accounts — the clearing document is missing.

blocked.period_not_open: The accounting period is not open — the document will not be recomputed. The difference belongs in a supplementary return, not in closed books.
blocked.date_locked: The period end date is locked (filed return / manual lock). Recomputing is possible only after moving the lock in accounting settings (admin only).

clearing.done_deleted: The period came out zero — the clearing document was deleted.

post_filing.title: Documents changed after filing
post_filing.hint: These documents fall within the period of the last filed return but were changed or added after it was generated. Consider a supplementary return.
post_filing.legacy_snapshot_warning: The latest filing predates document snapshots. The queue may therefore miss a document cancelled or moved out of the period; compare the filing with the current VAT ledger manually.

oss.title: OSS return
oss.subtitle: Quarterly One Stop Shop overview from issued invoices. Lines are assigned to OSS automatically; uncertain cases are flagged for manual review.
oss.filing_channel_hint: The OSS return is filed in the MOSS/OSS application on the Czech tax portal, not through the general EPO route. Download the XML and upload it there after signing in to MOSS/OSS.
oss.manual_review_link: Show documents with lines awaiting review ({n}) in the invoice list
oss.threshold_note: The threshold (§ 8(3) of the Czech VAT Act) counts all cross-border B2C supplies to the EU, including those invoiced with Czech VAT. The EUR conversion is indicative (daily CNB rate) — verify with your accountant near the threshold.
oss.no_data: No OSS rows are marked for the selected quarter.
oss.return_rate_shifted: The ECB published no rate for the period end ({end}) — a weekend or TARGET holiday; the next available day was used.
oss.return_rate_note: All foreign-currency rows are converted using the ECB rate published for the last day of the tax period (Art. 91 of Directive 2006/112/EC). A manual rate entered on the line takes precedence.
oss.archive_note: Every OSS XML download is archived with its SHA-256 digest and the underlying data it was built from. An archived file proves what was generated — not that it was filed. Record the actual filing in Taxes → EPO filing & archive.
oss.archive_empty: No OSS filing has been archived yet.
oss.reconciliation_note: Compares the archived filing with what would be filed for the same period today. Its main purpose is to surface documents edited retroactively after filing.
oss.reconciliation_no_filing: No filing is archived for this quarter — there is nothing to compare.
oss.reconciliation_no_snapshot: The archived filing has no stored source data, so it cannot be compared with today's preview. Check the differences manually against the downloaded XML.
oss.reconciliation_in_sync: Today's preview matches the archived filing.
oss.reconciliation_out_of_sync: Today's preview differs from the archived filing. Consider whether a corrective filing for the original period is due.
oss.reconciliation_not_proven: The reference snapshot was only generated/downloaded, not proven as filed. Downloading XML is not filing — mark the snapshot as filed once submitted.
oss.evidence_note: Records of the covered supplies are kept for {years} years from the end of the calendar year in which the supply took place and are provided electronically upon request of the tax administrator. Records are created when a filing is archived and cannot be modified or deleted.
oss.evidence_empty: No records exist for this quarter — they are created when the OSS XML is downloaded.
oss.evidence_unsupported: Points of Article 63c the application cannot evidence

aiGateway.onboarding_title: How to enable AI invoice extraction
aiGateway.onboarding_intro: The app can extract the vendor, amounts and line items from a PDF or photo of an invoice without ISDOC. It needs your own API key from an AI provider, whom you pay directly based on usage.

aiGateway.onboarding_step3: Paste the key into the field below and click Save. The key is tested right away.

aiGateway.bulk_skipped_forbidden: Skipped, you may not change AI settings: {n}
aiGateway.bulk_not_applied: The key test failed, nothing was saved to other companies.
aiGateway.bulk_none: No other company to save to.
aiGateway.credentials_hint: BYOK — paste your own API key. The key is write-only (never shown). Empty field = keep existing key.
aiGateway.openai_base_url_hint: For EU data residency set https://eu.api.openai.com (project data residency).
aiGateway.ollama_base_url_hint: Only http(s)://host:port, no path. From Docker usually http://host.docker.internal:11434. Host names with an underscore (_) are not accepted — use the IP address or a name without "_".
aiGateway.ollama_models_empty: Ollama at this address has no models. Download one with ollama pull.

aiGateway.err_key_openai: The OpenAI API key must start with "sk-".

imports.purchase_upload_title: Upload PDF / ISDOC for received invoice
imports.purchase_upload_hint: Drag files (Pohoda XML, PDF with embedded ISDOC, .isdoc, .isdocx package, ZIP) — system verifies you're the customer on the document, creates a draft received invoice + auto-resolves vendor via ARES. Pohoda XML carries its own direction, so an issued invoice dropped here is rejected with a note where it belongs.
imports.purchase_scan_hint: Drop vendor PDF/ISDOC invoices into the configured directory (cfg.php → purchase_invoice.inbox_dir) and trigger scan. System dedups via SHA-256, automatically creates drafts from ISDOC.
imports.ai_active_hint: PDFs without embedded ISDOC will be automatically processed by AI (Anthropic Claude vision).
imports.ai_not_configured_skip: PDFs without embedded ISDOC are skipped by the scan. With AI set up, the app extracts them automatically.
imports.purchase_scan_path_hint: Path is configured in cfg.php. We recommend a directory outside the webroot that the web server can read.
imports.purchase_manual_hint: Upload single invoice directly in the received invoice editor (drag & drop above form):
imports.title: Imports
imports.subtitle: Load issued invoices from Pohoda XML, ISDOC or PDF (PDF/A-3 with embedded ISDOC) into the system.
imports.supplier_required_hint: A document is imported only when the currently selected company holds the right role on it — supplier on an issued invoice, customer on a received one. A document issued to another company is rejected.
imports.status_rule_hint: If the due date is more than 30 days old (we assume it's already paid), the invoice is stored as Paid. Otherwise as Issued — payment is then matched via the standard bank-statement flow or manually.
imports.drop_or_click: Drop files here or click to choose
imports.formats_hint: Supported formats: .xml (Pohoda — both dataPack and the user export from Pohoda → File → Data communication → XML export), .isdoc, .isdocx (ISDOC package bundling a PDF), .pdf (PDF/A-3 with embedded ISDOC — e.g. from iDoklad, Fakturoid, Superfaktura, MyÚčto), or .zip bundling any number of these files.
imports.file_too_large: Each file may be at most 40 MiB. Split larger exports into smaller files.
imports.too_many_files: Select at most {max} files. Split larger selections into smaller batches.
imports.purchase_as_draft_hint: Leave unchecked to create documents as received right away — drafts count towards neither costs, payables nor reports.
imports.job_background_hint: The import runs in the background — you can close this page, it will finish anyway.
imports.batch_delete_hint: Wrong export? You can discard this batch and upload it again.
imports.batch_delete_confirm: Really delete the documents just imported?
imports.batch_deleted_partial: Deleted {deleted} documents, {skipped} remain — posted, locked or paid documents are not deleted in bulk. Open them individually.
imports.batch_delete_failed: The batch could not be deleted.
imports.job_cancelled_hint: Documents created before the stop stay in the system. {n} documents were left unprocessed — you can upload the same batch again, already created documents are skipped as duplicates.
imports.hint: Clients are created automatically (preferring ARES lookup by Czech reg. no.). A project is created when the invoice has a project number or when the client has multiple emails across the batch. Duplicate invoices (by variable symbol) are skipped.
imports.subtitle_unified: Import both issued and received invoices in one place.

imports.sum_oss_credit_notes_period: credit notes without a correction period

setup.sample_hint: A realistic data set covering the last year: 24 clients, 12 vendors, 120 issued and 120 purchase invoices, credit notes, a cash register, and a vehicle logbook. For a legal entity or VAT payer, double-entry accounting and stock are enabled and populated with stock documents, e-shop categories and manufacturers, assets, bank statements, and posted journal entries. The data set can be removed safely later.

mfa_setup.intro: Before continuing to the application, activate one of the allowed security methods.

mfa_setup.passkey_unsupported: This browser or connection does not support passkeys. Choose TOTP if allowed, use a supported device, or ask an administrator to reset MFA.
mfa_setup.password_invite_placeholder: leave empty and we will send a link
mfa_setup.password_invite_hint: Leave empty and we will email the user a single-use link so they set the password themselves. You will not know it.
mfa_setup.password_link_sent: Link sent to the user’s e-mail.
mfa_setup.invite_sent: User created. We have emailed them a link to set their password.
mfa_setup.invite_failed: The user was created, but the password link could NOT be sent. Check outgoing mail and resend the link from the user detail.
mfa_setup.password_required: Enter your password again to register the first security method.
mfa_setup.transition_totp_hint: This account already has TOTP enabled. Confirm the secure transition to a passkey with its current code.
mfa_setup.transition_totp_required: Enter a valid 6-digit TOTP code to register the passkey.
mfa_setup.already_enabled_relogin: TOTP is already active, but this sign-in does not have strong verification yet. Sign out and sign in again.
mfa_setup.no_method_available: This installation allows no method you could activate here. Adjust auth.allowed_mfa_methods in cfg.php or contact an administrator.
mfa_setup.logout_hint: Until MFA is completed, the account can only sign out.
mfa_setup.offer_title: Add a second factor to your account

taxReturn.title: Income tax — return
taxReturn.subtitle: Prepare the income tax return (corporate / personal) from accounting data and download XML for the tax portal.
taxReturn.advisory_note: The calculations are an aid for the taxpayer and accountant — verify the figures before filing and consult a tax advisor if needed. Rates and limits change every year.
taxReturn.period_range_hint: The tax period the preview is computed for — profit is summed exactly over this range.
taxReturn.activities_hint: Income and actual expenses must agree with the cash journal; the flat-rate cap is calculated separately for each rate.
taxReturn.s10_items_hint: Each kind of other income is listed separately. The income kind code is mandatory — without it the tax office will flag the filing.
taxReturn.s10_kind_code: Income kind under Section 10(1) of the Act
taxReturn.payroll_gross_hint_prefilled: From the payroll module: {amount}. Leave empty to use that value.
taxReturn.payroll_gross_hint_empty: The payroll module reports nothing for this year. Fill this in only if wages were processed outside the application.
taxReturn.pension_confirmed_hint: Enter the deductible amount from the pension company's certificate — the annual contribution reduced by months where it did not exceed the threshold for the maximum state contribution. Not the gross annual payment.
taxReturn.other_parent_proved: Non-claim by the other taxpayer documented
taxReturn.locked_hint: The return is locked — unlock it to make changes.
taxReturn.vh_realtime_note: Line 10 (profit before tax) already includes posted closing steps — depreciation and the small asset accrual (381). The preview therefore shows real figures based on the current journal.
taxReturn.projection_note: Estimate of profit and tax AFTER posting the not-yet-booked closing steps. This is a projection, these figures are not yet posted in the books. Unposted depreciation of the year lowers the profit by the accounting depreciation, and its difference from tax depreciation goes to lines 50/150 the same way as for posted depreciation.
taxReturn.proj_depreciation: Depreciation of the year per depreciation plan (not posted)
taxReturn.proj_stock: Closing inventory at the balance sheet date (method B)
taxReturn.proj_fx: FX revaluation at balance sheet date
taxReturn.suggest_hint: The system found accounts that are commonly non-deductible or allow a deduction. These are suggestions to review — enter the confirmed ones manually under Adjustments (the system does not add them to the tax base automatically).
taxReturn.suggest_549: Shortages and damage beyond compensation — non-deductible (§25/1/n)
taxReturn.suggest_other: Review the tax deductibility of this account (§25)
taxReturn.suggest_561: Securities sold exceed the proceeds from sale. For shares not measured at fair value the excess is non-deductible (§24/2/w); for bonds and securities at fair value the cost is fully deductible (§24/2/r)
taxReturn.suggest_deduct_543: Gifts (§20/8) — possible deduction from the tax base
taxReturn.po_securities_income: Proceeds from sale of shares and securities (661)
taxReturn.po_securities_note: The acquisition cost of a share is deductible only up to the proceeds from its sale. The system compares totals, so the added amount is a lower bound. Enter an exempt share transfer (§19/1/ze) and per-share matching as a manual item.
taxReturn.name: Name
taxReturn.fo_optimizer_link: Personal deductions (§15), children and spouse are set in the Tax optimizer →
taxReturn.rnd_deduction_hint: Amount from the R&D project — the system cannot derive it from accounting. Any unused part may be claimed for 3 years under §34(5); the system does not track that carry-forward.
taxReturn.education_deduction_hint: Deducted from the base already reduced by the loss and by the R&D deduction.
taxReturn.stopped_execution_credit_hint: Total of the compensations awarded by the bailiff in decisions stopping an execution during the tax period. Feeds row 3 of table H, appendix 1 to part II.
taxReturn.filing_deadline_hint: Set this especially for an extended adviser or audit deadline; the advance-payment period follows this date.
taxReturn.bank_account: Account for the tax overpayment refund
taxReturn.bank_account_hint: Where the tax office should refund any overpayment (VetaNP). Without a choice the app uses the company's default (or first active) CZK account — the overpayment doesn't have to belong on the operating account, pick another one if needed.
taxReturn.puz_to_registry: Request forwarding the financial statement notes to the register's collection of documents
taxReturn.puz_to_registry_hint: Saves a separate filing with the registry court — the tax office forwards the document (it must be attached as a file, see Preview) to the public register's collection of documents on its own. Without an attached notes file, the request is left out of the return so it does not point at a document that isn't there.
taxReturn.item_flat_rate_travel_hint: Flat-rate travel expense under §24(2)(zt) (and the matching fuel add-back). A marked item is reported on line 40, resp. 112/170 instead of the general line 62/162; the tax base does not change.
taxReturn.s16a_separate_base_hint: Foreign profit shares and similar §8(1) income the taxpayer chose to tax separately at 15 %. Such income is then left out of §8 (line 38) and the §35ba/§35c credits do not apply to this tax. The value is not written to the XML — fill in the relevant lines manually in EPO.
taxReturn.loss_carryforward_hint_fo: Applied up to the §7–§10 subtotal (line 41), not against §6.
taxReturn.donations_hint_po: Aggregate amount; ignored when itemized below.
taxReturn.donation_items_hint: Donations below CZK 2,000 are not deductible under §20/8 and are excluded.
taxReturn.check_expense_mode_transition_23_8: Tax base adjustment when changing the expense method (§23(8) Income Taxes Act)
taxReturn.check_vat_returns_filed: VAT returns filed for the year
taxReturn.check_period_open: Period is open — close it before finalizing.
taxReturn.check_period_missing: No accounting period for the year.
taxReturn.check_period_na: Tax records — no accounting period kept.
taxReturn.check_dpfo_source: Completeness of personal income tax data
taxReturn.check_dpfo_children: Child data for the child tax credit
taxReturn.check_dpfo_activities: §7 activities with a valid CZ-NACE code
taxReturn.check_tax_evidence_closing: Completed annual closing of tax records
taxReturn.xml_business_warning: The draft XML was downloaded with content issues. Review the source data and warnings before filing.
taxReturn.xml_validation_warning: The XML was downloaded but failed schema validation. Check the data and correct the errors listed in the submission archive before filing.
taxReturn.unsupported_title: Situations the application cannot handle in the return
taxReturn.unsupported_blocking_hint: Finalization and export are available. Review these findings before filing and correct them as needed.
taxReturn.unsupported_warning_hint: Finalization and export are available. Review these findings before filing and correct them as needed.
taxReturn.fo_deductions_hint: Personal deductions §15 (donations, interest, pension, life insurance), spouse and child credits are taken from the Tax optimizer.
taxReturn.export_xml_hint: The XML is validated against the official XSD schema and archived. Upload the downloaded file to the tax portal.
taxReturn.export_pdf_hint: A working report of the return for review with your accountant and for the archive. It is not a filing; the amounts are read from the same XML that is downloaded for the tax portal.
taxReturn.advances_hint: Advance schedules for next year are generated from the finalized regular return. "Match payments" finds paid advances in the bank by variable symbol and pre-fills paid advances into the draft return.
taxReturn.advances_suggestion_kept: Manual value in the return was kept (not overwritten) — bank suggestion: {list}. Verify and adjust manually in the Adjustments tab if needed.
taxReturn.advances_amount_mismatch: Note: some payment matched only by VS and date — the amount doesn't match the schedule, verify it in the table below.
taxReturn.advances_empty: No advance schedules — generate them from a finalized regular return.
taxReturn.advances_generate_period_hint: Generates advance schedules for this year from the previous return (draft included) or from the tax office decision — no need to finalize last year's return.
taxReturn.advances_generated_period: Advance schedules for this year were generated.
taxReturn.advances_override_title: Tax office decision on advance amount (§174)
taxReturn.advances_override_hint: Enter the new advance amount per the tax office decision (e.g. a reduction on request under §174). From its effective date, schedules are computed at this amount instead of the prediction and payment matching is measured against it — so a genuinely reduced advance matches as certain.
taxReturn.advances_override_saved: Advance amount decision saved, schedules recomputed.
taxReturn.advances_override_deleted: Decision removed, schedules recomputed from prediction.
taxReturn.overrides_section_title: Tax office advance decisions (§174) and payment schedule
taxReturn.overrides_section_hint: Tax office decisions changing advance amounts (§174) across years. Each decision applies to a chosen period FROM–TO — within it advances follow the decision (amount and periodicity), outside it the return prediction (§38a). Ranges must not overlap.
taxReturn.overrides_empty: No tax office decisions — advance schedules are computed from prediction (§38a).
taxReturn.overrides_schedule_hint: Advance due dates and amounts across years with payment status. Status is determined automatically by matching bank payments (by tax office account and VS) — no manual matching.
taxReturn.reconcile_hint: Upload the EPO XML of the actually filed DPPDP9 return (downloaded from the Moje daně/EPO portal) — the app compares it line by line against its own calculation. Nothing is saved or posted.
taxReturn.reconcile_summary: Mismatch on {mismatched} lines (match on {matched}) — check the highlighted rows.
taxReturn.reconcile_all_match: All lines match the filed return.
taxReturn.reconcile_filing_info: Filed return: form {forma}, form version {verze}, period {od} – {do}
taxReturn.reconcile_filing_company: Company in the XML: {name} — Reg. No. {ic}, VAT ID {dic}
taxReturn.reconcile_extra_title: Other items from the filed XML (informational, not covered by our calculator)
taxReturn.item_line_hint: The return line the item is reported on. Without a choice it goes to the general line 62 or 162; the tax base does not change.
taxReturn.filed_import_title: Import the filed return into inputs
taxReturn.filed_import_hint: Takes over what does not follow from the accounts: base adjustments on their lines, loss to deduct, deductions, donations, credits and advances paid. Profit, depreciation and non-deductible accounts are computed by MyÚčto. The loss incurred and used according to the filing is written to the tax loss register.
taxReturn.filed_import_existing: The return already has draft inputs. The import replaces manual items, loss, deductions, donations and credits; other inputs stay.
taxReturn.filed_import_confirm_replace: Replace manual items, loss, deductions, donations and credits of the draft return with the filed values?
taxReturn.filed_import_dirty: Save or discard unsaved input changes first.
taxReturn.filed_import_losses: Loss register: loss incurred {year_loss}, loss used {applied}
taxReturn.filed_import_input_match: After the import all input lines match the filing. Differences remain only on lines computed from the accounts.
taxReturn.filed_import_input_mismatch: After the import these input lines do not match the filing: {n}. Check the highlighted lines and notices.
taxReturn.filed_import_done_created: Return inputs were imported from the filed return.
taxReturn.filed_import_done_replaced: Draft return inputs were replaced with the filed values.
taxReturn.filed_import_done_kept: A draft return already exists, inputs were not changed.
taxReturn.filed_import_source: Inputs imported from the filed return (form {forma}, {date}).

tax.title: Tax optimizer
tax.subtitle: Compare tax regimes on your real income and see what is best for you.
tax.mortgage_hint: deduction, max 150,000 CZK (300,000 for housing needs before 2021)
tax.mortgage_pre_2021: Housing need acquired before 1 Jan 2021 (cap 300,000 CZK)
tax.pension_hint: deductible amount from the pension company's certificate (not the gross annual payment), deduction max 48,000 CZK
tax.verdict_pausal_hint: Flat tax wins. It flips to the standard regime once your credits (spouse, children, mortgage) exceed ~73,700 CZK.
tax.verdict_regular_hint: Your credits beat flat tax — the standard regime can push tax into a bonus, flat tax ignores credits.
tax.pausal_unavailable: Not in flat tax / not possible — standard regime is used.
tax.pausal_rate_change: From {month} the monthly advance drops from {prev} to {next}.
tax.pausal_rate_change_hint: The {months} months paid at the higher rate created an overpayment of {overpaid}. You can reduce the next advance by it (paying {reduced}), or claim a refund after the year ends.
tax.expense_mode_hint: Allowance = % of income (by activity type). Actual = real expenses from tax records.
tax.social_secondary_cross: projected profit {profit} crosses it in {month} — you will pay social insurance
tax.social_secondary_ok: projected profit {profit} stays below — no social insurance
tax.defer_tip: You will cross {limit} in {month}. Deferring December invoices to January keeps you under the limit (non-VAT + flat tax).
tax.disclaimer: Indicative calculation per current constants — not tax advice. Income from issued (paid) invoices.
tax.last_month_hint: Estimate: the month is annualised (× 12) and computed the same way as the yearly tax (flat rate/actual expenses, deductions, child credits, minimum insurance bases), then divided by 12. Never an exact figure.

recommendations.title: Opportunities to improve posting
recommendations.preview_unavailable: The journal preview is not available yet. Open the source to complete its details or accounts.
recommendations.description: Recurring cases suggest missing rules. Review the evidence and save a prefilled rule here. Resolve unposted documents in open periods through their specific posting preview.
recommendations.coverage: Reviewed: {sales} issued invoices, {purchases} received invoices and {bank} bank cases.
recommendations.future_rule: The rule will recognize future cases in suggestion mode. It does not change posted history. Examples support the original proposal, not the impact of criteria edited later.
recommendations.repeated_expense_pattern: These recurring purchases do not yet have their own expense rule. Save a rule for the proposed text and account so future items can be recognized by it.
recommendations.repeated_bank_pattern: Recurring payments share consistent historical accounts but lack a matching rule. Test the proposed criteria and create a rule for future transactions.
recommendations.review_expense_rule: This rule already exists in suggestion mode. The opportunity is to switch to automatic use, not to create a new rule. Review its criteria and account before making the change.
recommendations.existing_occurrences: {n} matching historical occurrences (not confirmations of correctness)
recommendations.rules_safety_hint: Rule changes affect future use, not posted history. Examples do not test criteria edited later. Rules left in suggestion mode will continue to await review.
recommendations.edit_rule_hint: Opens the current rule definition in the original editor. Changes affect future use, not posted history. A rule left in suggestion mode will continue to await review.
recommendations.rule_updated: Rule updated. Recommendations are refreshing in the background; posted history was not changed.
recommendations.date_filter_hint: For groups, date filters refer to the latest occurrence. Counts and examples use the full reviewed history.
recommendations.rule_created: Rule created. Recommendations are refreshing in the background; posted documents were not changed.
recommendations.posted_done: Document posted. Recommendations are refreshing in the background.
recommendations.job_hint: Progress shows completed stages, not estimated time. Results reload automatically when the job finishes; you can leave and return.
recommendations.job_counts: The analysis itself does not create any rules.
recommendations.job_connection_error: Could not load the job status. We will automatically retry for a running job.
recommendations.background_hint: The daily refresh runs through cron-ai-rule-miner. Review again starts an immediate on-demand refresh.
recommendations.waiting_first: Results are not ready for the selected company yet. Start Review again or wait for the daily automatic refresh.
recommendations.refresh_pending: Results await a refresh. Review again starts it immediately; the last completed results remain visible.
recommendations.empty: There are no further actionable automation proposals for this selection. Covered cases and purely historical mismatches are not offered as new tasks.
recommendations.reason_post_invoice: This issued document has no posted journal entry. Open it and review the proposed accounts.
recommendations.reason_post_purchase: This received document has no posted journal entry. Review its items and expense accounts before posting.
recommendations.reason_bank_rule: No suggestion was generated for this unposted transaction. Open the transaction to choose accounts and save a rule for similar payments.
recommendations.period_closed: The period is not open. This recommendation is for review; follow your closing procedure before changing posted entries.
recommendations.booked: This document is already posted. The recommendation changes nothing by itself; review any historical change in the assistant preview first.

ai.sent_data_title: What we send and what we don't
ai.sent_data_body: We send the amount, currency, month, counterparty bank code, and pseudonymized identifiers as irreversible fingerprints.
ai.never_sent_body: We never send names, account numbers, variable symbols, dates of birth, or the original free-form payment message.
ai.dpa_confirm: I confirm a signed data processing agreement (DPA) with {provider}
ai.dpa_exempt_local: Ollama runs on a local or private address — data never leaves your infrastructure, no DPA confirmation is needed.
ai.dpa_required: AI suggestions require a confirmed DPA.
ai.never_posts: AI only suggests and never posts; you approve each suggestion individually.
