types.invalid_termination: Employment continuing after invalid termination (no wage compensation)

obstacle.rate_fixed: The rate is set by law and cannot be changed.
obstacle.rate_range: The law allows {min} to {max} %. Give a reason for any rate other than the table rate.
obstacle.reason_hint: For example an internal regulation, collective agreement or agreement under which the compensation exceeds the statutory minimum.
obstacle.reason_hint_partial_unemployment: Name the agreement with the trade union or the internal regulation setting the compensation (§ 209(2) of the Labour Code). Without it, this is another obstacle at 100 % of average.
obstacle.kind_missing: The obstacle has no kind, so the wage compensation cannot be determined and it cannot be approved. Cancel it and record it again with a kind selected.
obstacle.without_shifts: The obstacle is approved but no wage compensation was created ({name}): there are no scheduled shifts on the obstacle days. Schedule shifts in Attendance, or enter the compensation as a payroll input.

pick_hint.employee_obstacle: Select the personal obstacle (doctor, wedding, death, escort…). Compensation is always 100 % of average earnings and is reported monthly as compensation for employee-side obstacles (10341). Record obstacles without compensation as "Employee-side obstacle without wage compensation".
pick_hint.employer_obstacle: Select the employer-side obstacle: downtime (at least 80 %), bad weather or natural disaster (at least 60 %), partial unemployment (at least 60 % under an internal regulation), partial work with a state contribution (at least 80 %) or other obstacle (100 %). Compensation is reported monthly as 10340.

kinds.childbirth_transport: Taking the wife (partner) to give birth
kinds.death_close_relative: Death of spouse, partner or child
kinds.death_relative: Death of parent, sibling or other relative
kinds.family_escort: Escorting a family member to the doctor
kinds.disabled_child_escort: Escorting a disabled child to a facility
kinds.job_search_redundancy: Looking for a new job (redundancy notice)
kinds.blood_donation: Blood or other biological material donation
kinds.employee_representation: Trade union, works council or OSH duties
kinds.qualification_training: Training or study required for the job
kinds.weather_interruption: Work interrupted by weather or natural disaster
kinds.partial_work: Partial work with a state contribution

hints.medical_examination: Government Decree 590/2006, item 1: 100 % compensation only for the necessary time at the nearest contracted doctor, if it could not be done outside working hours. For part of a shift, fill in the missed hours of the first day.
hints.commute_prevented_disabled: Government Decree 590/2006, item 4: at most 1 day at 100 %, only for a severely disabled employee whose own vehicle journey was prevented by weather or an emergency.
hints.own_wedding: Government Decree 590/2006, item 5(a): 2 days off, 100 % compensation only for the day of the ceremony. Record the second day as an obstacle without compensation.
hints.child_wedding: Government Decree 590/2006, item 5(b): 1 day at 100 %. A parent's wedding is without compensation.
hints.childbirth_transport: Government Decree 590/2006, item 6(a): necessary time at 100 %. Attending the birth is without compensation.
hints.death_close_relative: Government Decree 590/2006, item 7(a): 2 days plus a day for the funeral at 100 %. Up to 5 further days are without compensation.
hints.death_relative: Government Decree 590/2006, item 7(b): 1 day for the funeral and another day if the employee arranges it, at 100 %.
hints.family_escort: Government Decree 590/2006, item 8(a)(1): at most 1 day at 100 % for spouse, partner, child, parent or grandparent. No compensation if the employee is entitled to care allowance.
hints.disabled_child_escort: Government Decree 590/2006, item 8(b): at most 6 working days a year at 100 %.
hints.coworker_funeral: Government Decree 590/2006, item 9: necessary time at 100 % for employees designated by the employer.
hints.relocation_employer_interest: Government Decree 590/2006, item 10: at most 2 days; 100 % only when relocating in the employer's interest.
hints.job_search_redundancy: Government Decree 590/2006, item 11(a): at most 4 days at 100 % on notice under § 52(a) to (e) of the Labour Code.
hints.blood_donation: § 203(2)(d) and (e) of the Labour Code: 100 % for travel, donation and recovery within 24 hours (48 hours for other biological material).
hints.employee_representation: § 203(2)(a) to (c) of the Labour Code: trade union, works council, OSH representative or union training at 100 %.
hints.qualification_training: § 205 and § 232 of the Labour Code: training or study required for the agreed work and in line with the employer's needs, at 100 %.
hints.other_paid_employee: A paid obstacle based on an internal regulation, collective agreement or special law (sick day, personal leave). 100 % compensation; state the basis in the reason.
hints.downtime: § 207(a) of the Labour Code: machine breakdown, missing materials or energy, faulty documents. At least 80 % of average if the employee was not moved to other work.
hints.weather_interruption: § 207(b) of the Labour Code: work interrupted by bad weather or a natural disaster. At least 60 % of average.
hints.other_employer_obstacle: § 208 of the Labour Code: other employer-side obstacles (lack of work, closed operations). 100 % of average.
hints.partial_unemployment: § 209 of the Labour Code: temporary drop in sales or demand. At least 60 % only under an agreement with the union or an internal regulation; otherwise it is another obstacle at 100 %.
hints.partial_work: Section 120a et seq. of the Employment Act: partial work for which the employer claims a contribution. At least 80 % of average. The employee is listed in the monthly cost statement, so no social security discount is due for them in that month (Section 7a(3)(e) of Act No. 589/1992 Coll.).

absences.new_needs_person: A new absence can only be created for a specific employee — it is tied to an employment.
absences.unpaid_excused_hint: Time off without wage compensation (Sections 199–202 of the Labour Code). No compensation input is created; the hours go to the monthly report only as unworked hours (10275), in the unpaid leave block. If the law grants compensation for the office, enter it as a payroll input.
absences.invalid_termination_hint: The period during which, under a final court decision (or an out-of-court settlement after the action was filed), the employment continued after an invalid termination and no wage compensation was awarded. No wage is due for it; the monthly report and the pension record report it as an excluded period under Section 16(4)(j) of Act No. 155/1995 Coll. (10536). If wage compensation was awarded, do not use this type and enter the compensation as a payroll input.
absences.empty: No absences in the selected period.
absences.cancel_confirm: Cancel the {type} absence for {name} from {from} to {to}? Annual leave creates a traceable reversing entry.
absences.correction_pending: The related payroll run requires correction review.
absences.average_required_hint: Pick the average earnings the compensation is calculated from — the absence cannot be created without it.
absences.average_missing_for_relation: No average earnings have been calculated for this relation. Calculate one on the Average earning tab and come back here.
absences.average_awaiting_approval: An average earning for this relation has been calculated but is awaiting approval. Approve it on the Average earning tab and come back.
absences.childbirth_hint: Only the part of maternity benefit before the birth is an excluded period of the insurance record. You can add the date of birth later, once it happens.
absences.lone_carer: Single employee caring for a child under 16
absences.lone_carer_hint: Nursing benefit is then paid for up to 16 calendar days instead of 9 (Section 40(1) of the Sickness Insurance Act). The monthly report uses it for the excluded care period (10360) and the benefit days (10475); days beyond the support period are reported as excused absence without compensation (10473).
absences.record_childbirth_once: The date of birth can be added only once. To correct a wrong date, cancel the absence and record it again.
absences.childbirth_recorded: The date of birth has been added.
absences.sickness_window_carried_days: Days of the compensation window used up before this part
absences.sickness_window_carried_edit: Edit days of the compensation window
absences.sickness_window_carried_hint: Fill in only when the employee was with a different employer or a previous payroll program at the start of the incapacity — the wage compensation window (Section 192 of the Labour Code) shortens by the days already used up there. For a continuation of an incapacity recorded here, the days are calculated on approval automatically. It can no longer be changed once the wage compensation has been calculated.
absences.sickness_window_carried_saved: The compensation window days have been saved.

dpn.first_day_worked: The first scheduled shift was fully worked
dpn.not_eligible: The employee is not entitled to compensation (incapacity without entitlement)
dpn.not_eligible_hint: Wage compensation belongs only to an employee participating in sickness insurance (Section 192(1) of the Labour Code). For agreements to perform work and small-scale employment, participation in the month in which the incapacity began decides (Section 15a of Act No. 187/2006 Coll.). Without entitlement the wage is reduced for the days of incapacity and neither compensation nor a sickness benefit case is created.

reduction_kinds.half_192_4: To one half (Section 192(4) of the Labour Code)
reduction_kinds.reduced_192_5: Breach of the sick-leave regime (Section 192(5) of the Labour Code)

dpn.reduction_hint: The compensation must be reduced to one half when the incapacity arose in the cases of Section 31 of Act No. 187/2006 Coll. (a fight, drunkenness, addictive substances, an intentional crime or offence). For a breach of the regime the employer may reduce the compensation or not provide it at all (100 %). The reduction is applied to the exact compensation before rounding.

averages.suggestion_loading: Looking for source data in closed payroll runs…

averages.suggestion_ready: Prefilled from closed payroll runs for the decisive period {from} to {to}.

Taken-over gross pay may include wage compensations (holiday, public holiday) that do not belong in average earnings — adjust it to the qualifying pay before confirming.

averages.source_gross: Derived from approved payroll runs of the decisive quarter.
averages.source_allocated: Enter manually — the application does not distinguish pay granted for a period longer than a quarter (§ 358 of the Labour Code).
averages.source_worked_hours: Derived from confirmed attendance work summaries.
averages.source_worked_days: Derived from the shifts the confirmed hours were built from.
averages.source_probable: Taken from the employment terms; change it there, where its justification lives.
averages.suggestion_probable: The actual average cannot be derived from closed runs, so the probable earning recorded in the employment terms was used (§ 355 of the Labour Code).

averages.bulk_created: The average earning was created and approved for {count} employments.
averages.bulk_load_failed: Could not load candidates for the bulk average calculation.
averages.bulk_inputs_changed: The underlying data changed since the list was loaded. The list has been reloaded, please check your selection and submit again.
averages.bulk_empty: There are no employments for this quarter.
averages.bulk_longer_period_note: A bulk-created actual average does not account for a proportional share of wages for a period longer than one quarter (§ 358 of the Labour Code). For people with an annual bonus, create the average manually on their employment card.

probable_source.achieved_wage: from wages achieved since joining (§ 355(2) of the Labour Code)
probable_source.agreed_monthly_gross: from the agreed monthly wage (§ 355(2) of the Labour Code)
probable_source.minimum_wage: lower limit, the minimum wage (§ 357(1) of the Labour Code) — enter a higher one in the employment terms

blockers.run_missing: One month of the decisive period has no payroll run; for a new starter the average is set as probable earnings (§ 355 of the Labour Code)
blockers.run_not_approved: The payroll run for the decisive period is not closed or is being corrected
blockers.multiple_runs_for_month: More than one payroll run exists for a single month; it is unclear which one paid the wage
blockers.run_result_missing: The closed run has no calculated result for the employment
blockers.average_earning_base_missing: The run result contains no average earning base
blockers.time_month_missing: No attendance month was frozen into the run
blockers.time_month_not_approved: Attendance for the month was not approved when the run was calculated
blockers.work_summary_missing: The month has no confirmed work summary with hours worked
blockers.work_summary_version_unsupported: The work summary uses an older version whose shift breakdown cannot be read
blockers.work_summary_source_corrupt: The source records of the work summary are unreadable
blockers.work_summary_hours_mismatch: Hours from the shifts do not match the confirmed work summary hours
blockers.worked_time_not_derivable: Recorded shifts cannot be summed without review (overlap, interval crossing a month boundary or negative duration)
blockers.worked_time_not_whole_minutes: The worked time did not come out in whole minutes; manual review is required
blockers.worked_time_missing: The decisive period has no positive qualifying earnings and time worked
blockers.takeover_worked_time_missing: The taken-over wages for a month of the decisive period have no hours worked; add them in Imports → Taken-over wages (manual entry)
blockers.takeover_gross_invalid: The taken-over gross pay for a month of the decisive period is negative; fix it in Imports → Taken-over wages
blockers.takeover_needs_review: The average is based on wages taken over from the previous program; it is not approved in bulk — create it individually and check the qualifying pay
blockers.worked_days_not_provided: The number of days worked could not be determined
blockers.probable_earning_required: The statutory minimum number of days was not worked in the decisive period; the average is set as probable earnings (§ 355 of the Labour Code)
blockers.average_already_exists: An average for this quarter already exists; the suggestion will not overwrite it
blockers.probable_earning_not_recorded: The actual average cannot be derived from closed runs and no probable earning is recorded for the employment (§ 355 of the Labour Code). Open Payroll → People, fill in the probable hourly earning and its justification on the employment card and save.

hint_by_type.ppm: Maternity leave counts as work for leave purposes, so usually Count.

hint_by_type.unpaid_leave: Unpaid leave at the employee's request is not work, so usually Do not count.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Environment check and supporting material for a support incident
diagnostics.no_admin: Diagnostics is available to administrators only.
diagnostics.checks_hint: Problems and warnings come first. Each one lists its impact, the fix and a link to the manual.

payroll_archive.title: Payroll archive encryption
payroll_archive.legacy_intro: {count} payroll documents from before encryption was introduced are stored on disk in readable form. Anyone with access to the server or a backup can read them.
payroll_archive.cli_hint: The same without a run time limit: php api/bin/payroll-archive-reencrypt.php (manual 999.9.4).
payroll_archive.rewrap_intro: After the encryption key was replaced, {count} payroll values are still encrypted with the old key. The old key cannot be removed from the configuration until they are converted.
payroll_archive.unknown_key: {count} values are encrypted with a key that is not in the configuration. They cannot be read or converted without the original key. The server administrator must put it back into app.secret_encryption_previous_keys.
payroll_archive.dialog_intro: Each document is encrypted with the key of the person it belongs to. The written copy is verified against the fingerprint of the original, and the original is deleted only after they match. Documents can still be downloaded as before.
payroll_archive.orphans_label: Also encrypt files not linked to any payroll document
payroll_archive.orphans_hint: They are encrypted with the company key; nothing is deleted. Without this option they stay readable and the check keeps reporting them.
payroll_archive.purge_label: Delete unencrypted documents of erased persons
payroll_archive.purge_hint: The key of an erased person no longer exists, so the document cannot be encrypted. The erasure means its content must not stay readable.
payroll_archive.purge_ack: I understand the deletion is irreversible and the documents cannot be restored.
payroll_archive.purge_ack_required: To delete documents of erased persons, first confirm that the deletion is irreversible.
payroll_archive.preview_partial: The preview shows the first batch; {count} more files will be processed in further batches.
payroll_archive.stopped: Processing stopped with {count} files remaining. Review the files below and run it again.
payroll_archive.done: Done. The checks have been reloaded.
payroll_archive.failed: The action could not be completed.
payroll_archive.rewrap_title: Re-wrap payroll data to the new key
payroll_archive.rewrap_dialog: Converts {count} payroll values, document data keys and exports from the old key to the current one. The content does not change, only the key it is encrypted with.
payroll_archive.rewrap_done: Nothing is encrypted with the old key any more. Ask the server administrator to remove the old key from app.secret_encryption_previous_keys.
payroll_archive.measured_at: The full measurement of payroll data keys ran at {at}. Between measurements Diagnostics checks only the oldest and newest encrypted records.
payroll_archive.measured_never: The payroll data keys have not been fully measured yet. Diagnostics checks only the oldest and newest encrypted records.
payroll_archive.measure_hint: Reads every encrypted payroll value and export and verifies the configuration can decrypt them. On a large database it may take several minutes.

status.orphan_skipped: Not linked to a payroll document, kept
status.integrity_mismatch: Content does not match its fingerprint, needs manual review

payroll_archive_encryption.label: Unencrypted payroll documents
payroll_archive_encryption.impact: Payslips and payroll sheets from before encryption was introduced are readable on disk and in backups.
payroll_archive_encryption.fix: Run Encrypt archive in the panel above.

payroll_key_rotation.label: Encryption key rotation
payroll_key_rotation.impact: Some payroll data is encrypted with the old key, which therefore has to stay in the configuration.
payroll_key_rotation.fix: Run Re-wrap to the new key in the panel above.

unknown_key.label: Payroll data encrypted with an unknown key
unknown_key.impact: Data encrypted with a key that is not in the configuration cannot be read or converted.
unknown_key.fix: Put the original key back into app.secret_encryption_previous_keys, then run Re-wrap to the new key.

retire_old_key.label: The old encryption key can be removed
retire_old_key.impact: All payroll data is now encrypted with the new key; keeping the old key in the configuration is an unnecessary risk.
retire_old_key.fix: Remove the old key from app.secret_encryption_previous_keys. First make sure no other part of the application needs it (TOTP, bank connections, certificates).

php_version.label: PHP version
php_version.impact: The application uses language features older PHP does not support — some pages will fail.

php_extensions.label: Required PHP extensions
php_extensions.impact: Without a required extension whole areas stop working — backups, exports, PDFs or price calculations.
php_extensions.fix: Install the missing extensions and restart PHP.

php_extensions_optional.label: Optional PHP extensions
php_extensions_optional.impact: A missing optional extension will not stop the application, it only falls back to a slower or more limited path.
php_extensions_optional.fix: Install the extension if you want full performance and no fallbacks.

memory_limit.label: PHP memory limit
memory_limit.impact: PDF generation, exports and closing reports abort mid-way when the limit is too low.
memory_limit.fix: Set memory_limit in php.ini to at least 256M.

upload_limits.label: Upload limits
upload_limits.impact: The application offers larger files than the server accepts — uploads fail without a clear message.
upload_limits.fix: Align upload_max_filesize and post_max_size in php.ini with the document size limit.

date_timezone.label: PHP time zone
date_timezone.impact: Without a time zone document dates can shift by a day, which carries over into VAT periods.
date_timezone.fix: Set date.timezone in php.ini to the same value the application uses.

timezone_alignment.label: Time zone alignment
timezone_alignment.impact: Different server and application zones push documents near midnight into another period.
timezone_alignment.fix: Use the same time zone for the system, PHP and the application.

opcache.label: OPcache
opcache.impact: Without OPcache every request recompiles the code — the application is markedly slower.
opcache.fix: Enable opcache.enable in php.ini and restart PHP.

opcache_validate_timestamps.label: OPcache refresh after an update
opcache_validate_timestamps.impact: With timestamp validation off the old code keeps running after an update until PHP is restarted.
opcache_validate_timestamps.fix: Either enable opcache.validate_timestamps, or restart PHP-FPM or IIS after every update.

app_url.label: Canonical application address (app.url)
app_url.impact: A missing, invalid or custom-domain-conflicting origin breaks canonical routing, links and custom domains. HTTP and LAN IP addresses remain usable for the regular UI, but not for passkeys.
app_url.fix: Set app.url to the exact HTTP(S) origin without credentials, path, query or fragment. Its hostname must not also be a company custom domain. For passkeys use an HTTPS DNS hostname; http://localhost is the exception.

values.app_url_hostname_conflict: hostname conflicts with a company custom domain
values.app_url_detected_during_setup: will be detected from the setup wizard address

db_version.label: Database version
db_version.impact: Migrations use constructs an older server or MySQL does not support — the database update will fail.

db_charset.label: Database character set
db_charset.impact: Outside utf8mb4 accented characters and emoji in names and notes get corrupted.

db_max_allowed_packet.label: max_allowed_packet
db_max_allowed_packet.impact: A low value breaks the database backup and the storage of larger attachments.
db_max_allowed_packet.fix: Raise max_allowed_packet in the MariaDB configuration and restart the server.

db_sql_mode.label: Database strict mode
db_sql_mode.impact: Without strict mode the database silently truncates oversized values instead of reporting an error.
db_sql_mode.fix: The application sets strict mode per connection itself. Align the global value for backups and manual work.

redis.label: Redis
redis.impact: Redis that is enabled but unreachable slows down every request while it waits for a connection.
redis.fix: Start Redis, or disable it in the configuration.

disk_space.label: Free disk space
disk_space.impact: Once the disk fills up, backups, PDFs and uploaded documents silently stop being created.
disk_space.fix: Free up space, or grow the data volume.

log_size.label: Log directory size
log_size.impact: Oversized logs take up the space needed for backups and documents.
log_size.fix: Clean up old logs; php-errors.log does not rotate and has to be trimmed manually.

writable_paths.label: Write permissions
writable_paths.impact: Without write access no documents, backups or caches are created — this usually shows up only as a save error.
writable_paths.fix: Grant write access to the user the web server runs as.

migrations_pending.label: Database migrations
migrations_pending.impact: A migration that never ran is the most common cause of missing table or column errors.

global_codebooks.label: Global code lists
global_codebooks.impact: An empty global code list (public holidays, rates, statements, filing recipients…) is not restored by migrations. Deadlines, statements or filings are then computed without it or fail.
global_codebooks.fix: Run php api/bin/restore-global-seeds.php --apply (Windows cmd\restore-global-seeds.ps1). The script adds the missing rows from the migration seeds and deletes nothing.

schema_integrity.label: Database structure
schema_integrity.impact: The database differs from the structure the migrations create. A missing table, column or index causes errors on save; a missing trigger or audit history silently switches off data protection.
schema_integrity.fix: Run php api/bin/check-schema.php for the full list. Missing objects are created by the migration that should have brought them, or by restoring a backup taken with this application version.

values.snapshot_outdated: snapshot does not match the migrations of this version

cron_health.label: Scheduled jobs
cron_health.impact: Without cron there are no backups, no reminders go out and exchange rates are not fetched.
cron_health.fix: Check the schedule and the last run on the Scheduled jobs page.
cron_health.info_label: Inactive jobs (not configured, turned off or with nothing to do)

values.dispatcher_down: the cron-dispatch scheduler is not running

dispatcher_down.label: The job scheduler is not running
dispatcher_down.impact: The installation uses a single dispatcher and it has stopped running. No job is launched: no backups are made, no reminders go out, no ČNB rates are fetched. The jobs themselves are fine, nobody starts them.
dispatcher_down.fix: Check that cron-dispatch is scheduled every minute in crontab or Task Scheduler and that its log in log/cron does not end with an error. Run it by hand with php api/bin/cron-dispatch.php. On Docker check that cron is running inside the container.

nothing_runs.label: The job scheduler is not running
nothing_runs.impact: No scheduled job ran within its interval, so it is cron on the server that stopped, not individual jobs. No backups are made, no reminders go out, no ČNB rates are fetched.
nothing_runs.fix: Check that the cron service (Linux) or Task Scheduler (Windows) is running and that the jobs run under an account allowed to write into log/ and storage/. The Scheduled jobs page has instructions with this server's paths.

app_debug.label: Debug mode
app_debug.impact: In production error details could end up in the server response.

logging_level.label: Log level
logging_level.impact: At debug level the log also records SMTP traffic including the credentials.
logging_level.fix: Use info or higher in production.

app_version.label: Application version
app_version.impact: A newer version is available — the problem you are chasing may already be fixed.
app_version.fix: Check the Updates section to see what the new version brings.

diagnostics.findings_more: and {n} more; run php api/bin/check-schema.php for the full list

bundle.subtitle: A ZIP with material for the incident. It is created in your installation, you download it and attach it to the incident on the support portal yourself — the application sends nothing anywhere.

item.include_version: Application version and availability of a newer one
item.include_config: Configuration without passwords, keys and tokens

bundle.logs_warning: Logs may contain personal data of third parties — for example e-mail addresses of document recipients, names and addresses of clients, or values from database error messages.
bundle.logs_removed: We remove bound database query parameters, stack traces and records of SMTP traffic. The rest is left unchanged — please review it below.
bundle.log_preview_empty: There is no record in the selected range.
bundle.preview_hint: Exactly these files will be in the bundle.
bundle.too_large: The bundle exceeds the {max} limit. Please shorten the log range.
bundle.acknowledge: I have reviewed the contents of the bundle and agree to hand it over to support.
bundle.next_step: Attach the downloaded file to the incident on the support portal as an ordinary attachment.
bundle.retention: The bundle is deleted from the installation automatically after 24 hours.

support_page.title: Support
support_page.subtitle: Where to look for help and what to attach to a report
free_items: User manual covering every feature of the application.
Public bug report or suggestion in the GitHub repository.
Private security vulnerability report through the form on the support portal.
Questions about operating the application answered by e-mail.
support_page.paid_hint: A one-off expert intervention on your installation. Billed in started blocks, with the first block paid upfront by card.
paid_items: Data analysis and root cause of an unwanted state.
Repair of data or of the installation settings.
Data migration and moving between versions or environments.

support_page.portal_hint: Opens in a new window. The portal recognises a licensed installation on its own; you never type the licence key anywhere.
support_page.attach_title: What to attach to an incident
support_page.attach_intro: The more specific the material, the shorter the resolution. What helps most:
attach_items: A description of what you did, what you expected and what happened instead.
A screenshot of the error message.
The diagnostic bundle from this application — version, environment, migration and scheduled job status.
support_page.attach_privacy: The bundle is created in your installation and stays there until you attach it to an incident yourself. Logs are not included by default; if you add them, you see their contents beforehand.

databox.title: Data box
databox.subtitle: This company's data box: sending payroll filings and reading incoming messages. What the application sends this way: health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the employer's monthly report to the social security administration (JMHZ) as an alternative to the direct VREP channel, and enforcement cooperation replies.
databox.howItWorks: How it works and what leaves where
databox.taxNote: VAT returns, control and recapitulative statements and income tax returns do not leave the application through the data box — they go through EPO. You can file them through the data box manually as a fallback, but then no confirmation with a filing number arrives, only a delivery note.
databox.gatewayLink: The sending gateway the messages physically leave through is registered by the service operator and there is one for the whole installation.
databox.companyScope: This data box and its messages belong to the company: {company}

gateway.settingsSubtitle: Global technical registration of the service operator — one for the whole installation, not created per company. It is an alternative route for sending: whoever signs in directly in the app with the Mobile Key sends without a redirect and needs no gateway.
gateway.settingsStep_redirect: On dispatch MyÚčto redirects the user to the official ISDS sign-in page.
gateway.settingsStep_signIn: They sign in there. Their account decides the method — username and password, a security key, or the eGovernment Mobile Key. MyÚčto never sees any credentials.
gateway.settingsStep_return: The data box returns them to the return address and MyÚčto records the outcome. Health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the monthly ČSSZ report (JMHZ) as an alternative to VREP, and enforcement cooperation leave this way.
gateway.settingsReadOnly: The gateway can only send, not read. That is a property of the chosen setup, not an omission: the filing is prepared as a draft in your data box and the final click — the approval — is made by a person, so the customer needs no system certificate of their own. The price is that the delivery note of a sent message has to be uploaded manually.
gateway.settingsCompanyLink: A particular company's sign-in — for sending as well as for reading incoming messages — is configured on its own page, not here.
gateway.preflightTitle: Sign-in and approval take place in ISDS
gateway.credentialsStayInIsds: You enter credentials only on the Czech Data Box Information System page. MyÚčto neither sees nor stores them.
gateway.methodsByIsds: The ISDS sign-in page and your account settings determine the available methods — for example username and password, an application password with the eGovernment security key, or the Mobile eGovernment Key.
gateway.expiresAt: This pending step remains valid until {value}.
gateway.receiptManual: Upload the delivery receipt for this message manually — the sending gateway cannot download it.

callback.title: Return from the data box
callback.invalid: The return address does not contain a valid ISDS session. Start the dispatch again from the prepared filing.
callback.failed: The return from ISDS could not be completed.

state.awaiting_login: Signing in to the data box
state.awaiting_approval: The message is waiting for your approval
state.approved: The message was sent from your data box
state.failed: The data box did not send the message
state.uncertain: We do not know whether the message was sent

registrations.title: Sending gateway registration
registrations.intro: The sending gateway prepares the filing as a draft message directly in your data box. You then send it by approving the draft in the data box system — the application never sends it for you.
registrations.operatorOnly: The registration belongs to the service operator. The commercial certificate is shared by the whole service and customers configure nothing to send through the gateway.
registrations.returnUrlTitle: Return address for the data box portal
registrations.returnUrlHint: Enter this exact value in the data box portal under Settings → External applications → Sending gateway as the return address. The user's browser returns to it, so it must point at this page, not at the API.
registrations.copyFailed: The browser refused to copy — retype the value from the box next to it.
registrations.empty: No sending gateway registration has been stored yet.
registrations.formHint: The values must match the registration in the data box portal. The certificate has to be uploaded again even when editing — it is never handed back by the application.
registrations.label: Name
registrations.atsIdHint: You will find it in the data box portal under Settings → External applications → Sending gateway.
registrations.ttlHint: Between 60 and 7200 seconds. Set the same value in the gateway registration in the data box portal.
registrations.returnUrlField: Must use HTTPS — the session identifier travels through it.
registrations.errorUrlHint: Where the data box sends the user when the dispatch fails. Must use HTTPS as well.
registrations.policy: How users sign in to the gateway
registrations.policyHint: The application does not behave differently based on this value — it only decides what we tell the user before sending them to the data box.

policies.password_invite_placeholder: leave empty and we will send a link
policies.password_invite_hint: Leave empty and we will email the user a single-use link so they set the password themselves. You will not know it.
policies.password_link_sent: Link sent to the user’s e-mail.
policies.invite_sent: User created. We have emailed them a link to set their password.
policies.invite_failed: The user was created, but the password link could NOT be sent. Check outgoing mail and resend the link from the user detail.
policies.portal_sso_or_password: An active portal session is enough

registrations.policyUnknownHint: The behaviour of the gateway sign-in page has not been verified by a live attempt yet. We therefore tell users to expect a username and password, while noting that an active portal session may let them through without one.
registrations.certificateHint: Must include the private key — it is used as a TLS client certificate. It has to be the same certificate stored in the gateway registration in the data box.
registrations.certificatePasswordHint: Stored encrypted and never handed back by the application.
registrations.savedInactiveHint: After saving, the registration is always disabled. Enable it separately once you have verified dispatch against the registered gateway.
registrations.saved: Registration saved. It is disabled for now — enable it once verified.
registrations.expired: The certificate has expired. Upload a new one — the gateway cannot be enabled with an expired certificate.
registrations.activateHint: Users will start being offered draft preparation in the data box for ready filings. Enable it only after verifying it against the registered gateway.
registrations.deactivateHint: Draft preparation in the data box will no longer be offered. The manual route stays available, so nobody loses the ability to file.
registrations.deleteHint: The stored certificate is deleted with it. The registration will have to be created again, including uploading the file.

access.title: Data box access
access.gatewayDescription: The route for when you do not want to sign in from the app. On dispatch MyÚčto redirects you to the official ISDS sign-in page and you pick the method there, according to what your account allows — nothing can be configured here. The gateway is registered by the service operator and is shared by the whole installation, so you do not switch it on yourself.
access.gatewayBoundary: MyÚčto never sees or stores any username, password, security code or mobile key. Whichever route you pick, the same things leave through it: health insurer overviews and notifications (HOZ, PPZ), the monthly ČSSZ report (JMHZ) as an alternative to VREP, and enforcement cooperation. Sent messages are on the Outgoing submissions tab, authority replies on the Incoming messages tab.
access.gatewayAvailable: The sending gateway is ready for the selected environment.
access.gatewayUnavailable: The sending gateway is a separate outgoing-only service and the operator has not activated it for this environment yet. Incoming messages can be fetched independently on the Incoming messages tab.

methods.mobileKey: Mobile eGovernment Key (app PIN/password and confirmation in the key)
methods.identity: Citizen Identity (bank identity, eID card, mojeID…)

access.certificateDescription: The stored system certificate is used for direct server operations on this company's data box, especially manually requested collection of incoming messages.
access.certificateRecommendedByIsds: The ISDS operating rules recommend this method for third-party applications. The certificate and its password are stored encrypted.
access.loginTitle: Signing in to the data box
access.loginDescription: One sign-in for both directions: sending submissions and manually fetching delivered messages. You set it up here once and only confirm it at each action.
access.loginMobileKeyText: Username and communication code, each session confirmed on your phone. Works for sending as well as reading and can be remembered encrypted.
access.loginPasswordText: Used once for a single action. With SMS authentication enabled you enter the code in a second step. Not stored.
access.loginCertificateText: Reading and machine operations only. It cannot send — nobody would be present at the dispatch.
access.whatIsStored: What is stored and what is not
access.loginBoundary: An ordinary password is never stored in the profile. During the SMS step it stays for a few minutes at most in a single-use encrypted flow; it is deleted after use and cannot be reused once expired. The SMS code is not stored. The Mobile Key username and communication code can, at your request, be stored encrypted only for the company + user pair. The box is never fetched automatically.
access.inboxLoginDescription: Choose an access method when you manually fetch messages. The sending gateway is unrelated to this operation.
access.inboxMobileKey: Mobile Key: username + communication code (app password), followed by confirmation of each session in the key. This personal access can be stored encrypted for you and the selected company.
access.inboxPassword: Username + password: used once for a single request; if SMS authentication is enabled on the account, you enter the code in the second step.
access.inboxCertificate: System certificate: encrypted and stored for the currently selected company.
access.inboxLoginBoundary: A regular password is not stored in a profile. During the SMS step it remains for at most a few minutes in a one-time encrypted flow; it is erased after use and cannot be used after expiry. The SMS code is not stored. At your request, the Mobile Key username and communication code can be stored encrypted only for the company + user combination. The mailbox is never fetched automatically.
access.certificateOnly: This setting applies only to the currently selected company. Interactive sign-in for dispatch takes place separately in ISDS.
access.label: Label
access.deleteCredentialConfirm: Really delete the stored access to data box {box}? The uploaded certificate will be removed and you will have to set it up again.
access.credentialDeleted: The data box access was deleted.
access.credentialDeleteFailed: The data box access could not be deleted.
access.certificateSource: Where to take the certificate from
access.certificateSourceHint: Certificates live in one place (System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures). Picking from the vault means the same key is not uploaded twice and its expiry is tracked in a single place.
access.sharedCertificateEmpty: No certificate in the vault is enabled for this company yet. Upload one in System → Emails & certificates → Certificates and electronic signatures, or upload a file here.
access.sharedCertificateMissing: The selected certificate is no longer in the shared vault. Pick another one or sending will fail.

polling.title: On-demand collection only
polling.explanation: The application never collects the data box automatically. It fetches new messages only after you press the button on the Incoming messages tab and confirm the action. Fetching may count as delivery and start statutory deadlines.
polling.acknowledge: I understand that a message fetched by the application counts as delivered and starts statutory deadlines.

notices.title: Notices to remedy defects in a filing
notices.intro: A defective filing is handled by the tax authority through a notice under Section 74 of the Tax Procedure Code. Remedy the defect within the stated period and the filing is treated as if it had been made properly and on time. Fail to remedy a defect under Section 74(1)(a) or (b) and the filing becomes ineffective once the period expires.
notices.respondBy: Respond by (date stated in the notice)
notices.periodDays: Or the number of days stated in the notice
notices.duplicate: A notice for this message already exists; nothing changed.
notices.deadlineHint: The application does not invent the period — the law sets no length, the tax authority states it in the notice. Copy either the date or the number of days. Without it the notice stays in the "deadline unknown" state and will never look settled.
notices.shifted: The last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so it moved to the next working day (Section 33(4) of the Tax Procedure Code).
notices.shortPeriod: The period is shorter than eight days. The law allows that only quite exceptionally (Section 32(2) of the Tax Procedure Code) — check that it is copied correctly.
notices.answerDateRequired: Fill in the day you remedied the defect — meeting the deadline is counted in days.

grounds.unknown: We do not know which letter the notice cites

grounds.b_no_effects: (b) the filing cannot have its intended effects
grounds.c_wrong_way: (c) the filing was not made in the prescribed manner
grounds.d_wrong_format: (d) the filing was not in the prescribed format or structure

connection.admin_only: Only this installation's superadmin can enable or disable the remote MCP server.

connection.remote_intro: Once enabled, the MCP server runs on this installation's domain. Add the address to your AI assistant as a custom remote connector. You do not need to download an .mjs file or install Node.js on your computer or phone; Node.js must be available on the MyÚčto server.
connection.url_requirement: The domain must resolve in public DNS and be reachable from the internet over HTTPS with a publicly trusted certificate. A local address or private CA certificate is insufficient: the assistant connects from its provider's servers, not your device.
connection.step_copy: Copy this installation's MCP server address.
connection.step_add: Add a custom remote connector in ChatGPT or Claude and enter this address.
connection.step_authorize: In the browser window, sign in to MyÚčto and review the requested access. The connection covers every company your account can currently access. If MFA is enabled, verify with a passkey or a fresh authenticator code. Without MFA, simply approve access. Choose read access for ordinary questions; allow read and write only when needed.
connection.step_verify: Enable the connector in a new chat and ask the assistant to verify the MyÚčto connection and list available companies. The whoami and list_suppliers tools return your account and companies; subsequent tools use the company ID.
connection.no_pat: Online connections do not require copying an API token. Sign-in and consent take place in the browser through MyÚčto.
connection.chatgpt_1: Under Settings → Integrations → Plugins, choose Add → Add MCP server and select Streamable HTTP. Enter a name and the address shown above.
connection.chatgpt_2: Leave Bearer token environment variable and headers empty. OAuth is not selected in this form. Save the server; restart the desktop app if needed.
connection.chatgpt_3: If Authenticate appears in the server list, select it and complete consent in MyÚčto. Then enable the server in a conversation. If authentication is unavailable, check that the remote MCP server above is enabled.
connection.chatgpt_mobile: A manually added server stays with its desktop host and does not transfer to a regular mobile chat. You can use it from mobile through Remote while the connected computer is running, if Remote is available for your account.
connection.claude_1: In Claude on the web or desktop, open Customize → Connectors. On an individual account choose + → Add custom connector; in an organization an Owner must add it first.
connection.claude_2: Enter the address above, add the connector, and use Connect to complete MyÚčto sign-in.
connection.claude_3: In a conversation, enable the connector with + → Connectors and try the verification prompt.
connection.claude_mobile: Once added to your Claude account, the remote connector is also available in the Claude mobile app.
connection.permissions: Each call checks your current company membership, permissions, and read or read and write scope against the requested company ID. Newly assigned companies become available without another consent. Accounting and taxes remain read only.
connection.revoke: Revoke a connection in the list above, and remove it from the assistant's settings if needed.

instance_export.title: Full data export
instance_export.subtitle: Build one company package: restorable data, documents, VAT records and accounting closing packages.
instance_export.info: The package contains machine-readable data, documents and an optional complete archive for safe restoration. The manifest and SHA-256 checksums describe the exact content and verify a complete download.
instance_export.no_restore_note: The restorable archive is run directly by CLI into an empty, pre-migrated database of the same or a newer MyÚčto version. It never overwrites existing data.

restore.title: How to restore data
restore.step_extract: Include the Restorable accounting archive part and prepare an empty database migrated by the target MyÚčto version.
restore.step_dry_run: Run validation against the downloaded main ZIP before writing data.
restore.step_restore: Only after validation succeeds, run the same command with the --restore parameter. The optional --documents parameter also restores received and issued invoice PDFs into the application and reconnects them to their records.
restore.note: Restoration preserves IDs and relationships, so the target database and data directory must be empty. Without --documents, data and attachments are restored but invoice PDFs are not written into the application. Users are restored disabled, without passwords or MFA. For payroll, also securely retain the original encryption and hashing keys from configuration; the ZIP does not contain them. See the manual for the full procedure.

retention.title: Retention of accounting and tax records
retention.description: The export is a practical record for the statutory duty to retain data. Retention shows deadlines under Sections 31 and 32 of the Accounting Act and lets you record a disposal hold.

instance_export.not_encrypted: The archive is not encrypted because no backup password is configured (cron.backup.password). It holds the complete accounting of the company — store it somewhere safe.
