issues.target_period_closed: The target accounting period is closed.
issues.target_date_locked: The opening balance date falls in a locked accounting period.
issues.source_period_missing: The selected accounting period is missing in the source.
issues.source_record_changed: A previously transferred record changed in the source and requires manual review.
issues.source_trial_balance_missing: The source trial balance needed for reconciliation is missing.
issues.journal_evidence_missing: The source does not provide an accounting journal.
issues.chart_evidence_missing: The source does not provide a chart of accounts.
issues.payment_links_evidence_missing: The source does not provide payment links.
issues.journal_unchanged_reconciliation_skipped: The journal did not change. Repeated reconciliation was not needed.
issues.journal_zero_entries_skipped: Zero-value technical journal rows were skipped; their count is in the transfer report.
issues.journal_foreign_bank_transfer_ambiguous: A foreign-currency transfer between bank or cash accounts has ambiguous currency attribution. Review the source posting.
issues.journal_foreign_amount_missing: A foreign-currency bank or cash posting lacks its original-currency amount.
issues.opening_balance_evidence_missing: The source did not provide opening account balances. Review the first imported year's trial balance.
issues.opening_balance_unbalanced: Opening balances in the base currency do not balance.
issues.opening_base_currency_missing: A foreign-currency opening balance has no matching base-currency accounting balance.
issues.opening_foreign_currency_ambiguous: An account has opening balances in multiple foreign currencies and needs manual review.
issues.opening_foreign_base_missing: A foreign-currency opening balance has no base-currency value.
issues.opening_foreign_adjustment_requires_revi: A foreign-currency opening balance changed. An automatic adjustment could distort the exchange difference.
issues.opening_balance_changed: An opening balance changed after the initial transfer and needs manual review.
issues.opening_target_integrity_failed: An imported opening journal entry changed in the target accounts.
issues.document_snapshot_requires_review: Document amounts were preserved, but their tax classification is not fully transferred yet. Review before using VAT returns.
issues.foreign_document_tax_requires_review: Foreign-currency documents need an exchange-rate and tax treatment review.
issues.document_tax_classification_requires_rev: Some items use VAT classifications that cannot be transferred safely. Their documents remain drafts.
issues.document_zero_quantity_requires_review: Some items have zero quantity but a nonzero amount. Review them on the transferred document.
issues.document_items_missing_snapshot_total_us: The source did not provide items for some documents. A replacement item was created from the document total.
issues.bank_account_number_unavailable: Some bank accounts have no usable account number. Compare their movements with the source.
issues.bank_account_source_analytic_not_221: Some source bank accounts do not use a 221 analytic. They received their own 221 analytic in the target, but historical journal entries remain on the original account. Review their accounting classification.
issues.bank_account_registration_rejected: A bank account could not be safely registered as belonging to this company. Review its ownership.
issues.journal_document_link_target_missing: A journal row has no matching document in the target. Its accounting entry remains intact.
issues.source_oss_extra_regime_requires_review: The source uses another OSS scheme that the target does not transfer automatically.
issues.document_vat_rate_outside_cz_schedule: A source document uses a rate outside the Czech schedule for its date. The item rate and amounts were retained; review the document.
issues.document_vat_rate_placeholder_requires_r: A source document uses a rate outside the target catalog. Its rate and amounts were retained, but review the rate before using the document.
issues.document_source_total_mismatch_requires_: The source document total differs from its base and VAT. The document remains a draft; the source total is in its review note.
issues.vat_projection_period_missing_requires_r: The VAT source data cannot be limited to the selected accounting periods. Compare the return with the source.
issues.vat_projection_unavailable_requires_revi: VAT source data is unavailable. Compare the return with the source.
issues.document_vat_projection_mismatch_require: The document tax base differs from current ABRA Flexi VAT data. Its tax was not changed automatically.
issues.document_vat_projection_target_modified_: The imported document was changed in the target. Source tax values were not applied automatically.
issues.source_cancelled_target_modified_require: The source document was cancelled, but the target document was edited or posted. Review its status.
issues.source_cancelled_target_missing_requires: A cancelled source document has no matching target document. Review the transfer.
issues.source_cancelled_movement_requires_revie: A previously imported bank or cash movement was cancelled at the source. Review it before the next synchronization.
issues.storno_payment_movement_skipped: A cancelled bank or cash movement was not imported.
issues.bank_movement_without_source_journal_req: Some imported bank movements have no source journal entry in ABRA Flexi. They remain for manual review and will not be posted automatically.
issues.opening_balances_adjusted_to_source: Opening balances were adjusted with new journal entries to match ABRA Flexi. The original entries remain available for audit.
issues.document_payment_symbol_requires_review: The source payment symbol did not fit the target field. Review it on the document.
issues.document_number_requires_review: An issued document number did not fit the target format. Compare it with the source before filing the control statement.
issues.document_number_collision_requires_revie: Another target document already uses an issued document number. Review the original number.
issues.document_vendor_number_collision_require: Several received invoices share a vendor, number, and date. The target number was disambiguated; the original is in the document note.
issues.zero_amount_link_skipped: Zero amount relations connect documents; they are not payments. The accounting journal remains intact.
issues.unsupported_document_link: Some links to orders, stock or internal documents are not converted into payments. The accounting journal remains intact.
issues.payment_currency_conversion_requires_rev: A payment between different currencies requires manual matching. The bank movement, invoice, and accounting journal remain intact.
issues.payment_cash_allocation_requires_review: A cash movement is only partly allocated to this document. The payment was not linked to avoid importing the full amount.
issues.payment_cancelled_document_requires_revi: A payment link points to a cancelled target document. It remains cancelled and the link requires review.
issues.cash_register_mapping_ambiguous: Source cash registers cannot safely be merged into one target register. The transfer stopped before creating movements.
issues.cash_vat_requires_review: A cash document contains VAT that cannot yet be transferred safely. The transfer stopped without saving documents.
issues.catalog_identity_invalid: A catalog item lacks a valid code or name and was not transferred.
issues.catalog_type_unsupported: Some catalog item types cannot be transferred safely.
issues.catalog_unit_defaulted: The unit ks was used for items without a source unit.
issues.catalog_unit_invalid: Some item units are too long.
issues.catalog_ean_skipped: An overlong EAN was not transferred.
issues.catalog_price_invalid: Some sale prices are missing or outside the supported range.
issues.catalog_price_rounded: Some source prices have more than two decimal places and were rounded to cents in the target.
issues.catalog_stock_flag_unknown: The stock flag is unclear for some items. Review their settings.
issues.catalog_vat_rate_requires_review: A target VAT rate could not be assigned safely to some items.
issues.catalog_source_changed_requires_review: An imported item changed in the source. The target card was not overwritten.
issues.catalog_target_changed_requires_review: An imported stock card changed in MyÚčto. It was not overwritten.
issues.catalog_target_conflict: Another target card already uses the product code. The item was not transferred.
issues.stock_negative_quantity_skipped: A stock card with negative quantity was not transferred.
issues.stock_negative_valuation_skipped: A stock card with negative valuation was not transferred.
issues.stock_source_changed_requires_review: An imported stock balance changed at the source and was not overwritten automatically.
issues.stock_card_invalid: A stock card is missing its product, warehouse, quantity, or valuation.
issues.stock_quantity_precision_unsupported: A stock card quantity has more than three decimal places.
issues.stock_item_requires_review: The target product is inactive or uses unsupported inventory tracking.

status.failed: Transfer failed. Check the result before retrying.
status.cancelled: Transfer cancelled. Records already transferred remain in the system.

money_s3.title: Switch from Money S3
money_s3.subtitle: Transfer the accounting agenda from a Money S3 backup: journal, address book, invoices, cash, bank, closing of historical years and reconciliation to the cent.
money_s3.upload_hint: In Money S3 choose Back up agenda and upload the resulting .lz file. The backup is only read; the Money installation is not changed.
money_s3.support_notice: This import is intended for smaller amounts of data. Migrations from other systems are not supported by their vendors and data exports differ between versions and installations, so {recommend}. As part of our paid service we will be happy to help with the migration and tailor it to your needs; it typically takes up to 10 hours at CZK 1,500/h + VAT. Whether you import on your own or with us, always verify the transferred data.
money_s3.support_notice_recommend: we recommend {contact} and leaving the import to us
money_s3.file_help_title: What the agenda backup file is
file_help_items: A single file with the .lz extension that Money S3 creates with its Back up agenda function. The name contains the company ID and the agenda number, for example 12345678ag001.lz.
Inside is a plain ZIP with the agenda data files (*.DAT) split by fiscal year and basic information about the agenda. One backup contains all years.
Upload it exactly as Money created it, without unpacking. The same file renamed to .zip is accepted too.
The backup does not carry the Money electronic document archive. Attach document scans separately in Documents → Scans to documents.
The backup contains the company's entire accounting. The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 7 days without any work on the migration.
money_s3.choose_file_first: Choose the agenda backup file first.
money_s3.uploading_hint: The backup is uploaded in parts. Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
money_s3.processing_hint: The server is unpacking the backup and reading the agenda details. A large backup can take several minutes; you may reload the page meanwhile.
money_s3.upload_interrupted: The backup upload was interrupted. Choose the file and upload it again.
money_s3.upload_failed: The agenda backup could not be read.
money_s3.preflight_ok: The backup is fine, the transfer can start.
money_s3.preflight_blocked: The pre-transfer check reports an error. Fix it and upload the backup again.
money_s3.close_history: Close historical years with the closing wizard
money_s3.close_history_hint: A year is closed only when its closing balances match, account by account, the opening balances of the next year from Money. The last year stays open.
money_s3.first_period_start: Start of the first accounting period
money_s3.first_period_start_hint: Fill in only for a company founded during the first transferred year (date of incorporation). Otherwise the first period starts on 1 January, or with the first journal entry for a year without opening balances.
money_s3.from_year_hint: Older years and their documents are not transferred and stay in the Money archive. Useful when years in Money do not follow on (the pre-transfer check suggests the year from which everything can be closed).
money_s3.reports_hint: Trial balance exported from Money to CSV: account in the first column, then opening debit, opening credit, debit turnover, credit turnover, closing debit, closing credit. Reconciliation compares it with the MyÚčto trial balance to the cent.
money_s3.report_failed: The report could not be read.
money_s3.dry_run_hint: The whole transfer runs, including closing of historical years and reconciliation, and then everything is rolled back. Nothing stays in MyÚčto.
money_s3.dry_run_locks_hint: The dry run runs in a single database transaction and holds locks on the transferred accounting periods for its whole duration. Run it outside normal work in the company: entries into those periods wait until the dry run ends.
money_s3.start_failed: The transfer could not be started.
money_s3.import_confirm: I understand: the transfer writes the journal, address book, invoices, cash and bank from the agenda {company} into this company, switches it to double-entry bookkeeping and closes historical years. Repeating the transfer duplicates nothing.
money_s3.import_confirm_first: Confirm first that you understand the impact of the transfer.

differences.title: The dry run failed only on acceptable differences ({count})
differences.hint: The migration found only differences that do not break the accounts: a document that was not migrated, or a result that does not match the source program. Everything else is fine. Fix the differences in the source and repeat the dry run, or run the migration with them and resolve them in MyÚčto. Accepted differences stay in the migration protocol.
differences.accept: Migrate despite the differences. I will resolve the listed documents and differences manually.
differences.accept_first: First tick “Migrate despite the differences”, or fix the differences and repeat the dry run.
differences.import_note: The live migration accepts the differences from the dry run ({count}). It finishes with warnings and the differences stay in the protocol.

money_s3.rights_missing: The live transfer writes the journal, changes company settings and closes years. You are missing write permission: {rights}. Ask the company administrator.
money_s3.ico_confirm: I confirm the backup is this company's agenda. The company ID cannot be verified because it is missing in the backup or in the company.
money_s3.ico_confirm_first: Confirm first that the backup belongs to this company.
money_s3.background_hint: The transfer runs in the background, you can close this page.
money_s3.run_delete_confirm: Delete the log of dry run #{id}? The dry run changed nothing in MyÚčto, only the record is deleted.

counts.unposted_review_skipped: unposted drafts from closed years skipped
counts.claim_shifted: deductions moved to a later period
counts.self_assessed: invoices with VAT self-assessed on internal documents
counts.other_receivables: other receivables included in the VAT return
counts.later_years: put into use after the conversion
counts.helper_cards: helper cards without an asset account
counts.payroll_tax_mismatches: months with tax off the Money total

checks.balance_sheet_balanced: Balance sheet balanced, every account in the statements

closing_status.next_opened: Closed, opening of the next year completed
closing_status.blocked: Not closed because of the previous year
closing_status.no_opening: Next year has no opening balances

protocol.title: Protocol #{id}
protocol.automation_left_off: Automation stays off until the transfer finishes without errors. Documents not linked to the journal would otherwise be posted twice.
protocol.payroll_totals_title: Payroll by month (control totals from Money)
protocol.payroll_totals_hint: Totals of the company's payroll documents, not taken-over payroll of individual employees. Advance tax is compared with Money's monthly employment income tax statement (withheld advances after annual settlement refunds).

batch.intro: A batch converts several companies at once, for example all clients of an accounting office. Each backup is one company, recognised by the company ID in the backup. A company that is not in MyÚčto yet is created by the batch (name and address from the backup, completed from the filed corporate income tax return and ARES). A failure of one company does not stop the others; the summary protocol shows checks K1 to K4 for each company.
batch.load_failed: Batch backups could not be loaded.
batch.upload_failed: The backup could not be uploaded.
batch.delete_failed: The file could not be removed.
batch.filing_failed: The file is not a filed corporate income tax return.
batch.superseded: Older backups of the same company ({n}) are not converted, the newest one applies.
batch.start_failed: The batch could not be started.
batch.cancel_failed: The batch could not be cancelled.
batch.company_forbidden: Company exists, you have no access
batch.company_ambiguous: Several companies with the same ID
batch.company_new: A new company will be created
batch.company_new_forbidden: Company missing, you may not create companies
batch.select_first: Select at least one uploaded backup first.
batch.create_forbidden: The batch would create companies that are not in MyÚčto and you are not allowed to create companies. Ask an administrator, or create the companies first.
batch.confirm_first: Confirm the live conversion with the checkbox above first.
batch.backups_hint: Choose Money S3 agenda backups (.lz files, one per company). They are uploaded one by one and the server reads each after upload; uploaded backups stay here for a week.
batch.will_create: The batch will create new companies: {n}.
batch.filings_hint: Attach filed returns (EPO XML) of the converted companies. The batch takes the NACE code, entity category and audit of a created company from them and, after the conversion, takes them over into the tax return and the tax loss register. Returns are matched by company ID; the latest filing of each year applies.
batch.take_over_filings: Take filed returns over into Taxes after the conversion
batch.take_over_filings_hint: An existing draft return is not overwritten and a final one is never changed. A dry run only shows which returns would be taken over.
batch.from_year_auto: Automatic (from the year balances in Money carry over)
batch.from_year_hint: A year whose closing balances in Money do not carry over to the opening balances of the next year cannot be closed. The automatic choice starts each company with the first year from which balances carry over; older years stay in the Money archive.
batch.existing_update: Convert again (adds only what is missing)
batch.existing_hint: A repeated conversion is safe: already converted documents and entries are neither duplicated nor overwritten.
batch.group_hint: Companies in a group share global dimensions (common jobs and projects).
batch.disposal_year_tax: Tax depreciation in the year of asset disposal
batch.disposal_half: Half (section 26(7) of the Income Tax Act)
batch.related_parties_hint: A partner with the ID of another batch (or group) company is marked as a related party in the address book. Only for a group of connected companies, not for independent clients of an office.
batch.use_registry: Complete data from ARES and the VAT payer register
batch.use_registry_hint: For created companies, verifies VAT registration, legal form, registry file number and tax office.
batch.import_confirm: I understand the live conversion writes the accounting of the {n} selected companies (and creates missing companies). We recommend a dry run first.
batch.criteria_legend: K1 trial balance against the Money journal, K2 balance checks, K3 statement mapping completeness, K4 documents against the journal. The detailed protocol of a live conversion is available for the company in the single company wizard.

stock.title: Stock transfer
stock.enable: Transfer stock: {cards} stock cards, quantities as of {date}
stock.hint: Warehouses, cards with quantities per warehouse, price lists as price levels and warehouse structure as categories are transferred from the {year} agenda. Movement history is not transferred; stock in MyÚčto starts with the quantities as of this day. Stock must be enabled for the company.
stock.choice_hint: The stock kind from the POHODA card takes precedence; the warehouse choice applies only to cards without it (POHODA keeps it for inventory method A). Consignment warehouses are preset to do not transfer, as their stock is not owned by the company.

pohoda.export_auto_detect: Upload the resulting ZIP from any route below. The wizard detects its format automatically; all routes use the same preview, dry run and transfer.
pohoda.mdb_help_requirements: The converter runs in Windows PowerShell 5.1; you do not need to install PHP on your computer. This route supports MDB data files; POHODA SQL databases are handled by route 3.
pohoda.mdb_driver_hint: If the Access driver is missing, install
pohoda.mdb_driver_link: Microsoft 365 Access Runtime from Microsoft's website.
pohoda.mdb_driver_architecture: Choose the 32-bit (x86) or 64-bit (x64) version to match your installed Office.
mdb_help_items: Prepare the .mdb data file for the correct company and fiscal year. Close POHODA for all users and make a copy of the file. If you have a ZIP backup, restore the data file from it first; the backup ZIP itself is not an MDB.
Download the tools below and extract pohoda-export.zip into one folder on a Windows computer.
Double-click Export-PohodaMdbAccounting.cmd and select the prepared MDB copy.
The converter reads the accounting data directly and creates a ZIP containing XML. It displays the output path when finished.
Upload only the resulting ZIP from the converter here. The source MDB stays on your computer; do not upload it or the original POHODA backup.
pohoda.mdb_help_title: 2. Convert an MDB data file on Windows
sql_help_items: Download the tools below and extract pohoda-export.zip into one folder on a Windows computer that can reach the SQL Server running POHODA.
Copy the pohoda-sql.example.json sample as pohoda-sql.json next to the script and fill in the server, port and login. Without this file the tool asks for everything; the password is entered hidden.
Double-click Export-PohodaSQL.cmd. Pick the agenda from the list (database StwPh_<company ID>_<year>), or set it in the configuration or with the -Ico and -Rok parameters.
The tool sends SELECT queries only over a read-only connection and creates the same ZIP as the MDB conversion. It displays the output path when finished.
Upload the resulting ZIP here unchanged, do not unpack it.
pohoda.sql_help_requirements: All you need is Windows PowerShell 5.1 and network access to the SQL Server. The SQL user only needs read access: we recommend a dedicated login with the db_datareader role in the agenda database. An empty user means signing in with the Windows account.
pohoda.sql_driver_hint: The default driver ships with Windows. Only if you choose driver odbc in the configuration (for example because of TLS), install
pohoda.sql_driver_link: Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server.
pohoda.title: Migration from POHODA
pohoda.subtitle: Migrates an accounting year from POHODA: journal, address book, invoices, internal tax documents, cash, bank and reconciliation to the last haler. Payroll from PAMICA is migrated separately under Migration from PAMICA.
pohoda.support_notice: This import is intended for smaller amounts of data. Migrations from other systems are not supported by their vendors and data exports differ between versions and installations, so {recommend}. As part of our paid service we will be happy to help with the migration and tailor it to your needs; it typically takes up to 10 hours at CZK 1,500/h + VAT. Whether you import on your own or with us, always verify the transferred data.
pohoda.support_notice_recommend: we recommend {contact} and leaving the import to us
pohoda.upload_title: Create a POHODA export and upload it
pohoda.upload_hint: Choose one of three routes. All produce a ZIP containing XML for this wizard and only read the source data.
export_help_items: Download the export tool and copy it to a computer with POHODA installed. It runs on Windows in PowerShell 5.1, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.
Run Export-Pohoda.cmd by double-clicking it, or with parameters, for example Export-Pohoda.cmd -Uzivatel Admin -Rok 2026 -Ico 12345678.
Enter the password of the POHODA user. The user needs the XML import/export right; Admin is the simplest choice.
If POHODA keeps more companies, the company ID must be given with -Ico. Without -Rok all fiscal years are exported.
The export only reads; nothing in POHODA is changed. A large agenda takes tens of minutes.
The file pohoda_export_<date>.zip appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
pohoda.tool_hint: The pohoda-export.zip package contains the tools for all three routes. Extract it into one folder: Export-Pohoda.cmd exports through POHODA, Export-PohodaMdbAccounting.cmd converts an MDB copy and Export-PohodaSQL.cmd reads a POHODA SQL database.
pohoda.tool_group_xml_hint: Run Export-Pohoda.cmd on a computer with POHODA installed. The tool requests XML exports directly from the application.
pohoda.tool_group_mdb_title: 2. Fast conversion of an MDB copy
pohoda.tool_group_mdb_hint: Run Export-PohodaMdbAccounting.cmd and select an MDB copy. The converter includes accounting, assets and payroll in one ZIP. No separate helper needs to be started. Download and extract the entire package so the converter has all required files.
pohoda.tool_group_sql_hint: Run Export-PohodaSQL.cmd on a computer with access to the SQL Server. The tool uses supporting scripts from the same folder; download and extract the entire package.
pohoda.tool_group_support_title: XML export add-on: assets and payroll
pohoda.tool_group_support_hint: Use this tool if you need to add assets or payroll from MDB to an XML export separately. The fast MDB conversion in step 2 already includes their export.
pohoda.tool_role_script: PowerShell script: started by the corresponding .cmd; keep both files together.
pohoda.tool_role_optional: Optional standalone export of assets and payroll only.
pohoda.tool_role_shared: Supporting PowerShell script: called automatically by the main tools.
pohoda.tool_role_config: Configuration sample: fill it in and save it next to the script as pohoda-sql.json.
pohoda.tool_empty: The export tool is not available on the server. Contact support.
pohoda.tool_failed: The export tool could not be downloaded.
file_help_items: POHODA keeps every fiscal year separately. The years you tick in the preview are transferred (one or several at once).

The POHODA XML export does not contain assets or payroll. The wizard takes the fixed asset and small asset cards from the 90_majetek.xml file that the export tool adds to the export (see the manual); payroll from 91_mzdy.xml is not processed by this wizard.
The ZIP may contain subfolders. The wizard finds the XML files of all agendas in them and offers for transfer those that belong to the MyÚčto company by company ID.
The company must exist in MyÚčto with the same company ID as in POHODA. The transfer goes into the company you are working in; create a new company first.
The export contains the company's entire accounting. The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 7 days without any work on the migration.
pohoda.uploading_hint: The export is uploaded in parts. Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
pohoda.processing_hint: The server is unpacking the export and reading the agendas. A large export can take several minutes; you may reload the page meanwhile.
pohoda.upload_interrupted: The export upload was interrupted. Choose the file and upload it again.
pohoda.upload_failed: The POHODA export could not be read.
pohoda.processing_slow: Processing is taking longer than usual. The server keeps working on the export; you can wait or reload the status.
pohoda.preview_failed: The export preview could not be loaded. The uploaded export stays on the server, try again in a moment.
pohoda.payroll_only_hint: The agenda contains payroll only (91_mzdy.xml). Employees, employment relations and processed payroll are transferred month by month.
pohoda.payroll_dry_run_hint: The whole payroll transfer of the selected years ({years}) runs: missing employees and relations are created and all months are imported. Everything is then rolled back, nothing stays in MyÚčto.
pohoda.payroll_import_confirm: I understand: the transfer creates the employees and employment relations missing in this company and imports the payroll of {years} from the agenda {company} as monthly payroll import batches. Repeating the transfer duplicates nothing.
pohoda.payroll_rights_missing: The payroll transfer creates employees, employment relations and payroll inputs. You are missing write permission: {rights}. Ask the company administrator.
pohoda.payroll_identifiers_confirm: I confirm that the OIČ and ID PPV numbers kept in PAMICA (on the cards and in the sent JMHZ reports and registrations) come from the social security administration protocols. The transfer stores them with the employees and relations, JMHZ reports are matched by them. Without this confirmation these numbers are not transferred.
pohoda.supplier_ico: Only an agenda with the company ID of the MyÚčto company ({ico}) can be transferred.
pohoda.no_matching_agenda: The export contains no agenda with the company ID of the MyÚčto company ({ico}). Create the export with the -Ico parameter, or check the company ID in company settings.
pohoda.supplier_ico_missing: The company you are working in has no company ID in MyÚčto, so no agenda of the export can be assigned to it. Fill in the company ID in company settings and upload the export again.
pohoda.year_hint: The checked years are transferred in ascending order, each with its own protocol. All years of agendas with the company ID are preselected.
pohoda.choose_year_first: Choose at least one year to transfer first.
pohoda.later_year_row: Documents of {year} kept in the {agenda} agenda
pohoda.later_year_hint: A POHODA agenda also keeps documents after the year end (journal entries, bank and cash movements, invoices dated in the next year). A later year can only be transferred together with the agenda year: checking it selects the agenda year too, unchecking the agenda year clears it. An unselected later year is skipped and a repeated transfer including it adds it without duplicating anything.
pohoda.dry_run_years_hint: The dry run transfers each selected year separately and rolls it back. A later year therefore does not see the data of the previous year (opening balances, transferred documents and payments) and its result may differ from the live transfer.
pohoda.years_not_run: Years {years} did not run: the previous year failed or the transfer was cancelled.
pohoda.preflight_ok: The agenda is fine, the transfer can start.
pohoda.preflight_blocked: The pre-transfer check reports an error. Fix it and upload the export again.
pohoda.files_hint: The transfer reads these files as empty. This explains why part of the data is missing from the transfer.
pohoda.dry_run_hint: The whole transfer of the selected years ({years}) runs, including reconciliation, and then everything is rolled back. Nothing stays in MyÚčto.
pohoda.dry_run_locks_hint: The dry run runs in a single database transaction. Run it outside normal work in the company: entries it touches wait until it ends.
pohoda.dry_run_background_hint: The dry run is one transaction, so it does not report individual steps while running — the full protocol with every step appears when it ends. It usually takes up to a minute; you can close this page.
pohoda.start_failed: The transfer could not be started.
pohoda.import_confirm: I understand: the transfer writes the journal, address book, invoices, internal tax documents, cash and bank of {years} from the agenda {company} into this company and switches it to double-entry bookkeeping. The years are transferred in ascending order. Repeating the transfer duplicates nothing.
pohoda.import_confirm_first: Confirm first that you understand the impact of the transfer.

differences.title: The dry run failed only on acceptable differences ({count})
differences.hint: The migration found only differences that do not break the accounts: a document that was not migrated, or a result that does not match the source program. Everything else is fine. Fix the differences in the source and repeat the dry run, or run the migration with them and resolve them in MyÚčto. Accepted differences stay in the migration protocol.

shoptet.title: Shoptet
shoptet.subtitle: Shoptet e-shop connection without the API: import orders and documents from files or a permanent link, and a stock and price feed for automatic import.
shoptet.load_failed: Shoptet settings could not be loaded.

steps: In the Shoptet admin open Orders → Export and create your own XML template (or copy the system template Shoptet - XML). For CSV, enable exporting individual order items and the header row.

The template must contain the order code, date, currency and exchange rate, e-mail, billing and delivery address with country code, company ID, VAT ID, total price and items with type, code, EAN, quantity, price including VAT and VAT rate.
In Include orders choose All. MyÚčto keeps track of changes since the last download itself.
In Settings → Administration → Export security create a partner with a hash and allow downloads only from the IP address of the MyÚčto server.
Paste the permanent export link in the Settings tab, or download the export and upload it here as a file.

steps: In Shoptet open Settings → Orders → Documents → Document export and turn on Use the ISDOC format.
In the Tax documents overview click Export and choose XML (ISDOC), the period and the currency. Export Credit notes and Documents for received payment the same way.
Shoptet does not issue advance invoices in ISDOC, export them as XML (Pohoda).
Upload the files or a ZIP here. Documents keep their numbers, we check the totals and link them to the imported orders.

steps: Generate the feed link below and copy it. It is shown only once.
In the Shoptet admin open Products → Import → Automatic imports and add a new import from URL.
Paste the link, choose the Shoptet XML format and pairing by product code. In the update import tick only Stock, and Price if you send it.
On MyÚčto product cards turn on export to the e-shop. The card code must match the product or variant code in Shoptet.

registration.title: JMHZ
registration.hint: Upload employee registration XML files (REGZEC, PREZEC) accepted by ČSSZ, the employee export from the ČSSZ ePortal or JMHZ monthly reports from another payroll program. Registrations are matched to people and employments, the missing ones are created and changed data is filled in. The employee export fills in OIČ and ID PPV; a new person is created from it only together with a monthly report from which the start date is derived. From monthly reports the app takes over the taxpayer declaration, tax credits and dependants and offers to take over the payroll history. First and last names are never changed automatically. NEMPRI, HZUPN and OZUSPOJ submissions the previous program already sent are recorded as settled by it and nothing is sent again: NEMPRI and HZUPN are attached to a benefit case (or create one), for OZUSPOJ you enter the delivery day from the ČSSZ protocol. A sickness absence without HZUPN stays in the deadline watcher.
registration.no_permission: You are not allowed to edit payroll people, so the registration preview and import cannot run.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom and the first one matching a column wins. An empty sheet means all sheets. The asterisk * stands for any text (e.g. “Bonus*”). Component code * means the component named by the column header. A condition limits the rule to rows where another column has the given value (e.g. department = production); other rows use the next rule. For an employer-side obstacle, enter the wage compensation rate instead of a component code (80 % of the average when empty).

pamica.title: Migration from PAMICA
pamica.subtitle: Transfers HR records and payroll from the PAMICA payroll data file: employees, employments, monthly payroll inputs, attendance summaries and opening balances of annual accumulators. Accounting is migrated separately under Migration from POHODA.
pamica.upload_title: Create the PAMICA export and upload it
pamica.upload_hint: PAMICA has no XML interface like POHODA, so payroll is read straight from the data file (Mzdy*.mdb) or from the PAMICA SQL database. The tools only read the data and change nothing in PAMICA.
pamica.export_auto_detect: Upload the resulting ZIP from any route below; the same preview, dry run and transfer follow.
export_help_items: Download the export tool and copy it to the computer that holds the PAMICA data file. It runs on Windows in PowerShell 5.1, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.
Close PAMICA so the data file is not locked. The tool opens it read-only, but a running program can still hold a write lock.

Run Export-Pamica.cmd by double-clicking it. The tool looks for the data file in the usual PAMICA locations; otherwise pass the path, for example Export-Pamica.cmd -Mdb "C:\ProgramData\STORMWARE\PAMICA\Data\Mzdy.mdb".
To migrate selected years only, use the -Rok parameter, for example -Rok 2026. Without it every year found in the data file is exported.
A pamica_export_<date>.zip file appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
sql_help_items: Download the tools below and extract them into one folder on a Windows computer that can reach the SQL Server running PAMICA.
Copy the pamica-sql.example.json sample as pamica-sql.json next to the script and fill in the server, port and login. Without this file the tool asks for everything; the password is entered hidden.
Double-click Export-PamicaSQL.cmd. Pick the payroll database from the list (databases with employees, employments and processed payroll are offered), or set it in the configuration.
To migrate selected years only, use the -Rok parameter, for example -Rok 2026. The result is the same as for the MDB data file.
A pamica_export_<date>.zip file appears next to the script. Upload it unchanged, do not unpack it.
pamica.sql_help_requirements: All you need is Windows PowerShell 5.1 and network access to the SQL Server. The SQL user only needs read access: we recommend a dedicated login with the db_datareader role in the payroll database. An empty user means signing in with the Windows account.
pamica.tool_hint: Download all files at once as a ZIP, or one by one. The files of one route must sit in the same folder. The tools connect to PAMICA data, not to POHODA.
pamica.tool_group_mdb_hint: Run Export-Pamica.cmd on the computer that holds the PAMICA data file.
pamica.tool_group_sql_hint: Run Export-PamicaSQL.cmd on a computer with access to the SQL Server. It needs Export-Pamica.ps1 and PohodaSql-Common.ps1 next to it; download the entire package.
pamica.tool_role_config: Configuration sample: fill it in and save it next to the script as pamica-sql.json.
file_help_items: The export carries employees and employments, processed payroll by month, pay components, absences, deductions, leave, payout accounts and the submission status for the social security and health insurance authorities.
It contains no accounting. The journal, invoices, cash and bank are migrated separately under Migration from POHODA.
The company must already exist in MyUcto with the same company ID as in PAMICA. Data is migrated into the company you are working in; create a new company first if needed.
Months preceding the payroll start period are not recalculated. Their results are stored as opening balances of annual accumulators so that annual settlement and caps follow on.
The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 7 days of inactivity.
pamica.no_matching_agenda: The export contains no payroll for the company ID used in MyUcto ({ico}). Check the company ID in the company settings and in PAMICA.

premier.title: Migration from PREMIER
premier.subtitle: Migrate a fiscal year from a PREMIER data backup: journal, address book, invoices, VAT documents outside invoices, bank, assets, employees and payroll and reconciliation to the last cent. Years must be migrated one by one, oldest first, because a year's opening balances derive from prior years in the same backup.
premier.support_notice: This import is intended for smaller amounts of data. Migrations from other systems are not supported by their vendors and data exports differ between versions and installations, so {recommend}. As part of our paid service we will be happy to help with the migration and tailor it to your needs; it typically takes up to 10 hours at CZK 1,500/h + VAT. Whether you import on your own or with us, always verify the transferred data.
premier.support_notice_recommend: we recommend {contact} and leaving the import to us
premier.upload_title: Create a backup in PREMIER and upload it
premier.upload_hint: Create the backup directly in PREMIER, no separate export tool is needed.
backup_help_items: In PREMIER open Administrator → Data backup (key F11).
Save the backup to disk. PREMIER offers the iZIP or iCAB format, either works.
Upload the resulting file into the wizard unchanged.
file_help_items: The backup contains all fiscal years kept in PREMIER, not just one. Years are still migrated one at a time, starting with the oldest.
The company must already exist in MyUcto with the same company ID as in PREMIER. Data is migrated into the company you are working in; create a new company first if needed.

The backup also contains payroll. The wizard creates the employees and takes over the processed payroll as records of the previous system. For a company that has no payroll in MyÚčto yet it enables the Payroll module, creates a payroll office and sets the payroll start after the last processed month; fill in the social security variable symbol and institution accounts in Payroll → Settings. Payroll entries are in the migrated journal and are not created again.
The uploaded file is deleted automatically after 7 days of inactivity.
premier.uploading_hint: The backup is uploaded in parts. Keep the page open until the upload finishes.
premier.processing_hint: The server is extracting and reading the backup. For a large backup this can take several minutes; you may refresh the page meanwhile.
premier.upload_interrupted: The backup upload was interrupted. Select the file and upload it again.

premier.supplier_ico_missing: The company you are working in has no company ID set in MyUcto, so no year from the backup can be matched to it. Fill in the company ID in the company settings and upload the backup again.
premier.year_hint: The checked years are migrated in ascending order from the oldest, each with its own protocol. A year's opening balances derive from prior years in the backup, so do not skip an older year that has not been migrated.
premier.choose_year_first: Select at least one year to migrate first.
premier.dry_run_years_hint: The dry run migrates each selected year separately and rolls it back. A later year therefore does not see the data of the previous year (opening balances, migrated documents and payments) and its result may differ from the live migration.

premier.dry_run_hint: The full migration of the selected years ({years}) runs, including reconciliation, but everything is rolled back at the end. Nothing remains in MyUcto.
premier.dry_run_locks_hint: The dry run runs in a single database transaction. Run it outside normal work in the company: entries the dry run touches wait until it finishes.

premier.import_confirm: I understand: the migration writes the journal, address book, invoices, VAT documents outside invoices, bank, assets and employees with payroll of {years} from agenda {company} into the company and switches it to double-entry bookkeeping. The years are migrated in ascending order. Repeating the migration will not duplicate anything.

differences.hint: The migration found only differences that do not break the accounts: a document that was not migrated, or a result that does not match the source program. Everything else is fine. Fix the differences in the source and repeat the dry run, or run the migration with them and resolve them in MyÚčto. Accepted differences stay in the migration protocol.

counts.time_evidence_unsupported_year: relations with records of a year without payroll rules
counts.deductions_person_not_found: deductions without a relation in the company
counts.deductions_not_converted: relations with deductions without a deduction card

checks.balance_sheet_balanced: Balance sheet balanced, all accounts included in the report

protocol.title: Protocol #{id}
protocol.unmapped_accounts: Accounts unknown to the reports: {accounts}. Map them in report mapping.
protocol.automation_left_off: Automation stays off until the migration finishes without errors. Documents without a journal link would otherwise be booked twice.

dimensions.license_hint: Available during the trial or with a valid accounting licence. After it expires, dimensions cannot be enabled or used.
dimensions.analytics_subtitle: Revenue, costs and profit by project, cost centre or another dimension. Compare values, follow monthly trends and, for a global dimension, compare companies in the group.
dimensions.analytics_company_local: A company dimension applies to this company only.
dimensions.analytics_change: Year over year change in selected metric
dimensions.analytics_cumulative: Cumulative profit / loss versus previous year
dimensions.analytics_previous_total_only: Previous year comparison is available for the whole dimension.
dimensions.analytics_top_twelve: The chart shows the first 12 values. The table includes all values.
dimensions.analytics_method: Amounts come from posted journal entries on revenue and expense accounts, excluding VAT. Splits across values are allocated to the cent. Totals also include entries without a dimension value. Non-deductible costs follow the corporate and personal income tax return rule: a non-deductible account or purchase invoice. Income tax on 59x accounts is shown separately.
dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.subtitle: Analytical breakdown of documents and journal entries — cost centres, projects, vehicles, locations and more. A value can have a parent; a report for the parent sums the whole branch.
dimensions.level_global_needs_group: A global type requires the company to belong to a company group (Global tab).
dimensions.disabled_hint: Dimensions are enabled per company in Company settings. While disabled, documents and the journal stay unchanged.
dimensions.enabled_toast: Dimensions are enabled and default types created.
dimensions.analytics_no_values_hint: The statistics need at least one dimension value, such as a project or cost centre. Add it under Company → Dimensions and assign it to documents.
dimensions.types_empty: There are no dimension types yet
dimensions.types_empty_hint: Create the default types (Cost centre, Project, Vehicle, Location, Business case) or a custom type.
dimensions.defaults_created: Default dimension types have been created.
dimensions.type_delete_confirm: Delete type “{name}”? A type already in use is only deactivated.
dimensions.type_deactivated: The type is in use, so it was only deactivated.
dimensions.type_code_hint: Prefilled from the name. Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. Cannot be changed later.
dimensions.value_code_hint: Prefilled from the name; you can override it.
dimensions.approval_on_toast: Approval is on. Only documents with values that have an approver will need approval.
dimensions.type_deactivated_toast: The type is inactive and is no longer offered on new documents.
dimensions.show_on_documents: Offer on documents and in the journal
dimensions.drives_accounts_hint: The dimension value decides the analytic account: a cost or revenue posted to a synthetic account goes to the analytic account mapped on the value. Only one dimension of the company can drive accounts.
dimensions.requires_approval_hint: Received documents with a value that has an approver must be approved by that person before they are received. Values without an approver are not approved.
dimensions.approval_threshold_hint: Empty or 0 = always approved. A document under the limit needs no approval.
dimensions.approver_hint: Documents with this value are approved by the selected person. Without an approver, documents of this value are not approved.
dimensions.drives_accounts_mask_hint: Comma-separated P&L account prefixes, exclusions start with an exclamation mark, e.g. 5, 6, !59.
dimensions.account_map_hint: A document posted to the synthetic account with this dimension value goes to the selected analytic account. The analytic account must sit under the synthetic one and have the same tax deductibility. The mapping applies to this company.
dimensions.account_map_empty: No mapping yet, postings stay on the synthetic account.
dimensions.account_map_after_create: Analytic accounts can be set once the value is saved.
dimensions.needs_repost_account: The dimension change would move a posted line to another analytic account (account-driving dimension). The line kept its previous dimension; repost the document.
dimensions.name: Name
dimensions.code_immutable: The code cannot be changed after creation.
dimensions.value_delete_confirm: Delete value “{name}”? A value in use is only closed.
dimensions.value_closed_due_to_usage: The value is in use or has children, so it was only closed.
dimensions.values_empty: This type has no values yet.
dimensions.responsible_hint: This is an attribute of the value — it is never copied into the journal.
dimensions.link_cost_center: Cost centre in the cost centre list
dimensions.group_none: The company is not part of any group. Global dimensions are shared by the companies of one group — for example projects of a parent company and its SPVs.
dimensions.group_joined: The company has joined the group.
dimensions.group_leave_confirm: Leave the group? Global dimensions of the group will no longer be visible to this company.
dimensions.group_left: The company has left the group.
dimensions.profit_group_scope: Sum all companies of the group
dimensions.profit_comparison: Largest profits and losses by value
dimensions.profit_comparison_own: Amounts assigned directly to each value, without its descendants.
dimensions.profit_no_activity: There is no posted revenue or cost for this selection in the chosen period.
dimensions.balance_range_adjusted: The balance sheet shows a position on one date. The linked range spanned multiple accounting periods, so the period containing the end date was selected.
dimensions.trial_range_adjusted: The trial balance supports one accounting period. The linked range was limited to the period containing its end date; the adjusted dates appear in the filters and URL.
dimensions.other_reports_hint: The balance sheet, trial balance and general ledger open for the current company, period and selected dimension value. A group-wide total does not carry over to these reports.
dimensions.profit_hidden: Companies of the group you cannot access are not included ({count}).
dimensions.reports_subtitle: Profit and cash flow by project, cost centre or job. A line split between several values counts by its share; the values plus “No value” add up to the company result. Balance sheet, trial balance and general ledger by dimension are available as a filter on those reports.
dimensions.profit_restricted_note: The report is limited to a branch or a responsible person, so the “No value” row is not shown and the total is not the whole company result.
dimensions.cf_operating: A. Cash flow from operating activities
dimensions.cf_investing: B. Cash flow from investing activities
dimensions.cf_financing: C. Cash flow from financing activities
dimensions.cf_no_activity: There is no cash flow for this selection in the chosen period.
dimensions.cf_cash_movement: Movement on cash accounts in the selection
dimensions.cf_untagged_hint: The difference is cash that does not carry the dimension value, typically a bank payment of a project invoice without the project. The project receivable or payable then stays open in the report.
dimensions.cf_unbalanced_hint: The computed flow does not match the cash movement. Check unbalanced entries or cash accounts outside 211, 213, 221 and 261.
dimensions.cf_method_note: Indirect method: profit adjusted for non-cash items and changes of balance sheet accounts on lines carrying the value (a split line by its share). Without a value it covers the whole company. The official cash flow statement for the financial statements is under Cash flows & equity.
dimensions.balance_filter_note: The balance sheet is filtered by a dimension: it contains only lines with this value (a split line by its share). It balances only when both sides of the entries carry the value; a payment without the dimension leaves the receivable or payable of the value open.
dimensions.filter_active_note: The report is filtered by a dimension: it contains only lines of that value (a split line only by its share), so the checks against the whole journal may not match.
dimensions.item_toggle_open: Different dimensions for this item (otherwise the document dimensions apply)
dimensions.item_toggle_close: Remove item dimensions - the document dimensions apply
dimensions.save_failed: The document is saved, but its dimensions could not be saved: {message}
dimensions.needs_repost: The document items carry different dimensions but the posted cost line is a single one. Repost the document to split the cost by items.

split.title: Split across several values
split.hint: The amount is split across the chosen values of one dimension type. The journal line stays a single line; reports by dimension count it proportionally.
split.duplicate: A value is repeated in the split.
split.need_two: A split needs at least two values.

rules.title: Dimension rules by account
rules.hint: A line on an account matching the mask must carry a value of the dimension type. If it is missing, the rule's default value is filled in; if there is none, posting a document or manual entry fails (or warns). A value from the document, job or client always wins.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Without rules posting works as before.
rules.mask_hint: Account prefixes separated by commas, exclusions with an exclamation mark: 5, 6, !59, !69
rules.enforcement_error_long: Required – cannot be posted without a value
rules.enforcement_none_long: Only fill in the default value
rules.default_hint: Filled in on a line without a value of the type (e.g. the project the company belongs to).
rules.from_card: Fill in the vehicle from the payment card (card holder → their car)
rules.audit_hint: Posted lines in the period that lack a dimension value required by the rules – typically imported history, system entries or entries from before the rule. Closing, opening and reversed entries are not counted.
rules.audit_ok: All lines in the period carry dimensions according to the rules.
rules.audit_truncated: The list is truncated, the summary above counts all lines.
rules.coverage_title: Coverage of synthetic accounts by dimensions
rules.coverage_empty: No cost, revenue or dimension-tagged lines in the period.

defaults.title: Default dimensions
defaults.hint_client: Prefilled into the header of issued and received invoices and cash documents of this client. A document without a dimension of that type gets it when posted. Project defaults take precedence.
defaults.hint_project: Prefilled into the header of invoices of this project. A document without a dimension of that type gets it when posted. They take precedence over the client defaults.
defaults.hint_product: A document line with this product gets them unless it has its own. On revenue and expense lines they take precedence over the document header.
defaults.hint_category: Applies to products of this category and its subcategories that have no value of the type themselves.
defaults.save_failed: The record is saved, but its default dimensions could not be saved: {message}
defaults.autofilled: Prefilled from the default dimensions of the client, project or paid document.

stereo_nx.title: Migration from Stereo NX
stereo_nx.intro: Upload the encrypted backup, select a company with the matching company ID, and run a dry run first. Ambiguous documents will be created as drafts for manual review.
stereo_nx.dry_hint: The dry run checks the data and lists documents that will need manual review.
stereo_nx.import_hint: Review the dry run protocol and confirm the selected company before importing.

protocol.title: Stereo NX migration protocol
protocol.automation_left_off: Automation stays off until the transfer finishes without errors. Documents not linked to the journal would otherwise be posted twice.
protocol.payroll_totals_title: Payroll by month (control totals from Money)
protocol.payroll_totals_hint: Totals of the company's payroll documents, not taken-over payroll of individual employees. Advance tax is compared with Money's monthly employment income tax statement (withheld advances after annual settlement refunds).

stereo_nx.upload_hint: Upload a .zip file created in Stereo NX. The backup is only read; the migration does not change the original data or the Stereo NX installation.
stereo_nx.upload_help_title: How to create a backup in Stereo NX
upload_help_items: Start Stereo NX as an authorized user.
In Ostatní → Zálohování dat, select the company you want to migrate.
Create the backup and upload the resulting .zip file.
stereo_nx.ico_mismatch: The company ID does not match the selected MyÚčto company.
stereo_nx.vat_required: This migration requires a VAT payer.
stereo_nx.blocked: Migration is blocked; resolve the listed errors.
stereo_nx.confirm: I reviewed the result and want to import into the selected company.
stereo_nx.delete_after_import: Delete the uploaded backup after a successful import
stereo_nx.partial_backup_kept: Some agendas or fields still need to be transferred or completed. The uploaded backup will not be deleted automatically after this transfer.
stereo_nx.cleanup_failed: The import succeeded, but the uploaded backup could not be deleted. You can remove it from the backup list.
stereo_nx.migration_required: The Stereo NX database migration is missing. An administrator must run php api/bin/migrate.php, then retry the dry run.
stereo_nx.upload_incomplete_help: Remove this backup and upload the original file again.
stereo_nx.mode_required: The target company must use tax evidence or double-entry accounting mode.
stereo_nx.mode_mismatch: The backup contains {source}, but the selected MyÚčto company uses {target}. Importing into a different mode could omit or misclassify accounting data. Verify and change the target company's mode in settings, then run the dry run again.
stereo_nx.source_mode_unknown: The backup journal does not clearly identify the accounting mode. Check the target company's settings before importing.
stereo_nx.profile_suggestions_title: Company details available in the backup
stereo_nx.profile_suggestions_hint: Select which values to transfer. Empty fields are selected by default; you can select populated fields individually. The company ID, accounting mode and VAT payer status will remain unchanged.
stereo_nx.profile_changed: Company details changed since the preview. Reload the company list and select the fields again.
stereo_nx.fill_company_profile: Transfer selected company details from backup
stereo_nx.target_vat_required: The target company must be a VAT payer.
stereo_nx.date_bounds: Period covered by the backup: {from} to {to}

review_reasons.advance_application_unlinked: Advance application is not linked to the original advance document
review_reasons.movement_journal_unverified: No verified link to the imported journal; automatic posting is disabled
review_reasons.movement_vat_unverified: Unverified VAT on the payment transaction
review_reasons.pending_reconciliation: Payment matching or classification requires review
review_reasons.issued_lines_aggregated: Issued document lines imported as a summary
review_reasons.purchase_lines_aggregated: Purchase lines imported from the VAT recap
review_reasons.document_tax_date_missing: VAT date or supply date is missing
review_reasons.price_mode_unassigned: Whether prices include VAT is unspecified
review_reasons.tax_date_supply_mismatch: Supply date and VAT date differ
review_reasons.partner_country_changed: Document country differs from the counterparty card
review_reasons.vat_register_mismatch: VAT control register differs from the document
review_reasons.mixed_vat_deduction: Document combines items with different VAT deduction eligibility
review_reasons.foreign_currency_rate_mismatch: CZK document amount does not match the foreign amount and exchange rate
review_reasons.foreign_currency_vat_base_mismatch: CZK VAT base differs from the converted document amount
review_reasons.payment_agenda_not_imported: Payment of a liability outside the imported invoices

stereo_nx.job_counts: documents and journal entries written {created}, errors {failed}
stereo_nx.background_hint: The migration runs on the server and finishes even if you close the page. The result is shown while the page stays open.
stereo_nx.blank_country_is_cz: I confirm that a blank counterparty country in this backup means the Czech Republic. Other ambiguous countries will remain for review.

counts.tax_depreciation_applied: Tax depreciation included in opening balances
counts.accounting_depreciation_applied: Accounting depreciation included in opening balances

checks.balance_sheet_balanced: Balance sheet balanced, every account in the statements

company_profile.title: Company profile
company_profile.hint: The company's hand-built settings in one file: statement mapping overrides, statement and closing options (net turnover, prior period, offsetting of tax balances with the tax office), tax profile, dimensions and client default dimensions, posting templates and bank rules. Download it before deleting or re-converting the company and upload it back after the conversion.
company_profile.hint_migration: Converting the company again? Download the company profile before the conversion and upload it back once the live conversion finishes. It restores statement mapping overrides, statement options, tax profile, dimensions, posting templates and bank rules that the conversion does not create.
company_profile.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
company_profile.preview_title: Preview of uploading profile {file}, nothing saved yet
company_profile.no_changes: The company already matches the profile, nothing to change.

parallelRun.title: Parallel run with the previous system
parallelRun.subtitle: Monthly comparison of MyÚčto with the outputs of the program the company still keeps its books in: trial balance, documents, open items, bank, VAT, assets, cost centers and statements.
parallelRun.backup_hint: The backup is compared without writing anything to MyÚčto: it provides the trial balance and document counts unless you upload them as files. Upload the backup in the migration wizard.

criteria.K1: Trial balance at the last day of the month
criteria.K6: Open items by account and partner

notes.open_only_in_myucto: Paid in the previous program, open in MyÚčto
notes.open_only_in_source: Paid or missing in MyÚčto, open in the previous program

parallelRun.run_disabled: Upload at least one output of the previous program or select a company backup first.
parallelRun.run_done_differences: Check finished, differences need to be classified.
parallelRun.run_done_incomplete: Check finished, some criterion ended with an error.
parallelRun.truncated: {count} more differences are only counted; fix the cause and run the check again.
parallelRun.close_blocked_errors: Some criterion ended with an error. Fix the input and run the check again.
parallelRun.close_blocked_migration: Migration differences ({count}) must be fixed and the check run again.
parallelRun.history_empty: No check has been run yet.

purchase_approval.title: Documents awaiting approval
purchase_approval.subtitle: Received documents waiting for the approval of the person responsible for the cost center.
purchase_approval.empty_pending_hint: Once a document waits for your decision, it will show up here.

action.cancel_confirm: Really cancel the approval? The document stays a draft without approval.

reject_dialog.title: Reject document
reject_dialog.intro: Document {number} from supplier {supplier} goes back to the accountant. She and the other approvers will see the reason.
reject_dialog.reason_placeholder: E.g. wrong cost center or missing attachment
reject_dialog.reason_required: The reason for rejection is required.

toast.approved_all: Document approved by all approvers and received.

purchase_approval.no_approver: Cost center {name} has no responsible person, so the document cannot be sent for approval. Add one in Company / Dimensions.
purchase_approval.no_approver_generic: A cost center on the document has no responsible person, so it cannot be sent for approval. Add one in Company / Dimensions.

panel.title: Approval
panel.none: The document has not been sent for approval yet.
panel.required_hint: The document requires approval. It will be received once all approvers approve it.
panel.pending_hint: The document stays a draft until all approvers have approved it.
panel.rejected_hint: The document was rejected. After editing it you can send it for approval again.
panel.approver_missing: Cost center {name} has no responsible person, so approval cannot start.

public.heading: Document approval request
public.intro: {approver}, please approve this received document for cost center {center}.
public.no_pdf: No PDF is attached to the document.
public.reject_reason_required: Please provide a reason for rejection.
public.invalid_text: This link is invalid or has already been used.
public.expired_text: This approval link is no longer valid. Ask the sender to send it again.
public.approved_text: We have recorded your approval, nothing further is needed from you.
public.rejected_text: We have recorded the rejection and informed the sender.
public.cancelled_text: The approval request was cancelled, nothing further is needed.
public.already_decided: The document has already been decided
public.action_failed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

group_stats.related_parties_hint: Documents with contacts marked as a related party (typically transfers between group companies). Applies to revenue, costs, receivables and payables, not to accounting statements.
group_stats.title: All companies
group_stats.subtitle: Management view of results, money and risks across accessible companies.
group_stats.management_note: Management totals without eliminating transactions between companies. This is not a consolidated financial statement.
group_stats.currency_note: Individual currencies remain separate. All converts available amounts to CZK; accounting totals only combine matching periods.
group_stats.conversion_note: Document results use recorded document rates; cash registers use their recorded conversion. Bank balances, receivables and forecasts use the latest available rate as of the report date. Missing rates are excluded.
group_stats.missing_rates: Missing rates for: {currencies}. The total is incomplete.
group_stats.coverage: Data coverage: {restricted} sections without permission, {failed} calculation errors, {noPeriod} without an accounting period.
group_stats.no_total_hint: No total available. Check data coverage and access to each company.
group_stats.empty_hint: This view includes companies with permission for the management dashboard. Access to individual sections follows permissions in each company.
group_stats.document_basis_note: Document amounts exclude VAT for VAT payers and include VAT for non-payers. The amount basis is shown for each company.
group_stats.accounting_result: Accounting result for the current period
group_stats.accounting_note: Income and expenses from accounting for each period. Separate from document profit; companies with a different period start have a separate total.
group_stats.partial_trend: Charts and totals contain only known contributions. Some calculations are missing; this is not a complete total of all companies.
group_stats.trend_comparison_hint: Total for {from} - {to} in the selected currency. Boundary months include only the selected days; only months with document activity are shown.
group_stats.cashflow_note: Forecast of inflows and outflows based on expected due dates. Cumulative net flow starts at zero and is not a forecast of the bank account balance. Tax and payroll liabilities are included according to permissions in each company.
group_stats.cashflow_exclusions: Forecast sources are limited by permissions
group_stats.balance_note: Bank balances show the latest imported or recorded balance and the date for each account. Cash registers are as of today. Bank data may have different ages; unknown balances are not zeros.
group_stats.unknown_balances: Balances are unknown for {count} accounts. Totals include only accounts with a known value.
group_stats.aging_note: Unpaid receivables and payables grouped by due date, in their original currencies.
group_stats.risk_note: Overdue receivables and payables, document losses and dependency on the largest customer or vendor. Counts represent observed contributions; source availability follows permissions.
group_stats.no_risks: No risks found in the available data.

risk_kinds.document_loss: Document loss for the selected period

group_stats.forecast_annual_note: Annual revenue, cost and profit forecast for the current calendar year. It is independent of the period selected for historical charts.
group_stats.forecast_sources_note: Invoice models use current-year documents, including any future document dates. The known result impact of other items is added separately. These amounts are neither actual YTD results nor financial statements.
group_stats.forecast_coverage_note: Forecast unavailable for {count} companies. It requires read access to issued invoices, purchase invoices and other items.
group_stats.forecast_installments_note: Other items affect results only through revenue or expense accounts. Loan principal and its installments are not automatically expenses; their receipts and payments are included in Cashflow. Recurring schedules that have not generated items are excluded here.
group_stats.forecast_method_note: Revenue is the median of run-rate, short-term growth and long-term trend. Costs use last year's seasonality adjusted by the current-to-previous-year ratio. The profit range reflects only the revenue model range with one cost estimate; it is not a confidence interval. Posted and draft volumes are supplementary figures and are not added twice.
group_stats.concentration_window: Concentration uses a monthly window starting {from}, independently of the selected period. Shares are measured in the original currency.

myucto_import.title: Import a company from MyÚčto
myucto_import.intro: Upload a Complete data export and transfer supported data into the currently selected company.
myucto_import.requirements: The target company must have the same company ID, accounting and tax settings including VAT history, and no business data of its own. Import does not create a company.
myucto_import.rights: Write access to imports, the accounting journal and company settings is required.
myucto_import.file_hint: Full restorable ZIP for one company, up to 2 GiB. Selected data and attachments: up to 64 MiB / 100,000 rows.
myucto_import.source_hint: Use a stable unique name and keep it unchanged for retries. Letters, digits, periods, hyphens and underscores are allowed.
myucto_import.password_hint: For an encrypted ZIP. The password is temporarily encrypted for the worker and removed after pickup. Leave blank to use the target instance’s backup password.
myucto_import.applying: Transferring data into the current company. Please wait for the result.
myucto_import.processing: Checking data and relationships. Please wait for the result.
myucto_import.failed: The request could not be completed. Repeat the dry run to verify whether the import has already completed.
myucto_import.invalid_file: Select a non-empty ZIP up to 2 GiB.
myucto_import.recurring_hint: Recurring templates are imported paused. Automatic issuing, sending and invoice reminders remain disabled.
myucto_import.accounting_hint: Company posting rules, bank and cash movement classifications and their history are transferred. Global posting rules remain those of the target installation. Authors are mapped to the importing user. An earlier restore without these areas cannot be extended; use an empty company.
myucto_import.confirm: I confirm the import into “{name}” and acknowledge the excluded areas.
myucto_import.background_hint: Validation and restore run in the background. You can close this page and reopen progress or the protocol from run history.
